NT2 and NCCIT were radiosensitive while 2102 EP and S2 were resistant, and p53 status correlated only partly with sensitivity. Bcl-2 family protein levels did not explain the differences. The authors conclude that apoptosis susceptibility does not reliably predict clonogenic radiosensitivity.

pmid-9607423.summary_ja: ドイツ小児腫瘍学会の共同研究で、小児胚細胞腫瘍780例中の奇形腫329例を解析した。成熟奇形腫の再発率は10%、未熟奇形腫は18%で、主な危険因子は不完全切除であった。悪性再発の多くは卵黄嚢腫瘍であり、高リスク症例に対する国際的無作為化試験が提案された。
pmid-9607423.summary_en: This German pediatric cooperative analysis reviews 329 teratomas among 780 children with germ cell tumors. Relapse occurred in 10% of mature and 18% of immature teratomas, with incomplete resection as the main risk factor. Most malignant relapses were yolk sac tumor, and adjuvant chemotherapy did not clearly prevent relapse in immature teratoma. The authors propose an international randomized trial for high-risk, incompletely resected teratomas.

pmid-9607498.summary_ja: 11か月の乳児で、クラインフェルター症候群に後腹膜成熟奇形腫を合併した症例を報告している。腫瘍とリンパ球の双方で47,XXY核型が確認された。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍とクラインフェルター症候群の関連が近年指摘されており、その成因の可能性について考察している。
pmid-9607498.summary_en: This case report describes an 11-month-old infant with Klinefelter syndrome who developed a retroperitoneal mature teratoma, an extragonadal germ cell tumor. Karyotyping of both the tumor and lymphocytes revealed 47,XXY. The authors review the reported association between Klinefelter syndrome and germ cell tumors, including extragonadal sites, and discuss possible explanations for this link. The report highlights that chromosomal abnormalities such as Klinefelter syndrome may be relevant in infants presenting with germ cell tumors outside the gonads.

pmid-9607888.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤に救援手術を行った14例を検討した。切除標本では壊死・線維化が最も多く、奇形腫やがんも認められた。原発巣に奇形腫成分がある場合、残存腫瘍に奇形腫またはがんが存在することが示唆された。一方、腫瘍縮小率では組織所見を予測できなかった。化学療法後の救援手術の意義を示す報告である。
pmid-9607888.summary_en: This study examined metastatic testicular germ cell tumour in 14 patients who underwent salvage surgery for residual masses after chemotherapy. Among resected specimens, necrosis or fibrosis was most common, while teratoma and cancer were found in others. Residual necrosis or fibrosis alone appeared when the primary tumour lacked teratomatous elements. The presence of teratoma in the primary tumour suggested residual teratoma or cancer, whereas tumour reduction rate did not predict histological findings. The findings support the role of salvage surgery in guiding management after chemotherapy.

pmid-9607889.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対し化学療法4コースを受けた27歳男性で、縦隔の増大する腫瘤を切除した症例。原発巣は燃え尽き状態で、縦隔転移には未熟奇形腫が含まれていた。切除標本では奇形腫と横紋筋肉腫が認められた。化学療法後の残存腫瘤切除の重要性を示す稀な症例である。
pmid-9607889.summary_en: A 27-year-old man with testicular cancer developed a growing anterior mediastinal mass after four cycles of combination chemotherapy. The primary testicular lesion was burned out, and the mediastinal metastasis contained immature teratoma. After tumour marker normalization, complete surgical resection revealed teratoma with rhabdomyosarcoma. The authors highlight two rare clinical conditions occurring together in this patient: a burned-out primary tumour with growing mediastinal metastasis, and the coexistence of teratoma with rhabdomyosarcoma. The case illustrates the importance of resecting post-chemotherapy residual masses.

pmid-9609651.summary_ja: 病期II古典的セミノーマの44歳男性が、化学療法後に腰椎再発と硬膜外脊髄圧迫を来した。その後、髄膜転移と馬尾再発による対麻痺をきたし、髄腔内および全身化学療法に抵抗性であった。頭蓋脊髄照射により症状は改善し、30か月間完全寛解を維持している。セミノーマの中枢神経系孤立再発に対する救援療法として有用性が示唆される。
pmid-9609651.summary_en: A 44-year-old man with bulky stage II classic seminoma achieved complete remission after cisplatin-etoposide chemotherapy but relapsed in the lumbar spine five months later. After further treatment, he developed isolated leptomeningeal disease with cranial nerve palsies and cauda equina recurrence, refractory to intrathecal and systemic chemotherapy. Craniospinal axis irradiation resolved his symptoms, and he remained in complete remission 30 months later. The authors suggest that craniospinal irradiation should be considered as salvage therapy for isolated central nervous system relapse of seminoma.

pmid-9610706.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌37例を、良性のMCTと比較した多施設研究である。年齢、腫瘍径、SCC、CA125、CEA、CA19-9に有意差を認めた。診断効率はSCCが最も高く、ROC解析ではCEAが最良のスクリーニングマーカーであった。45歳以上で99mmを超えるMCT様腫瘍ではSCCとCEAの測定が推奨されている。
pmid-9610706.summary_en: This Tokai Ovarian Tumor Study Group series of 37 patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma of the ovary compared clinical and tumour marker features with benign MCT. Age, tumour size, SCC, CA125, CEA and CA19-9 differed significantly between groups. SCC showed the highest diagnostic efficiency, while CEA was the best screening marker on ROC analysis. Patients aged 45 years or older with an MCT-like ovarian tumour larger than 99 mm should have SCC and CEA measured, according to the authors.

pmid-9610904.summary_ja: この症例報告は、病期Iのセミノーマ患者において、フォローアップ中に血清hCGの上昇が認められた経過を記述している。調査の結果、患者は検査の数日前に外因性hCGを自己注射していたことが判明し、再発の可能性を示す偽の所見が生じていた。著者らは、この種のホルモン乱用は以前にも報告されているが、胚細胞腫瘍のサーベイランスに干渉した初めての報告であると述べている。本症例は、フォローアップ中の腫瘍マーカー結果を解釈する際には外因性hCG投与を考慮する必要があることを示している。
pmid-9610904.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with stage I seminoma whose follow-up was complicated by an elevated serum hCG level. Investigation revealed that the patient had self-injected exogenous hCG several days before testing, producing a false signal of possible relapse. The authors note that this type of hormone abuse has been documented previously, but this is the first report of it interfering with germ cell tumour surveillance. The case highlights the need to consider exogenous hCG administration when interpreting tumour marker results during follow-up.

pmid-9611051.summary_ja: 1975年から1994年に診断された卵巣胚細胞腫瘍18例を検討した。平均年齢は36歳で、ディスジャーミノーマと悪性奇形腫が多かった。病期Iの5年生存率は80%、病期IIIでは0%であった。術後補助治療を受けた症例の成績が良好であり、温存手術とBEP療法の併用は妊孕性を保ちつつ有効で、忍容可能な毒性であると結論している。
pmid-9611051.summary_en: This series reviews 18 ovarian germ cell tumours diagnosed among 313 ovarian cancers between 1975 and 1994. Patients had a mean age of 36 years, and dysgerminoma and malignant teratoma were the most frequent histologies. Most patients presented with stage I disease, and conservative surgery was performed in nearly half. Five-year survival was 80% in stage I but 0% in stage III. Patients receiving postoperative adjuvant treatment fared better. The authors conclude that conservative surgery followed by BEP may preserve fertility with acceptable efficacy and toxicity.

pmid-9614784.summary_ja: 子宮内満期妊娠を伴う患者の片側卵管に生じた良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。卵管原発の奇形腫は極めてまれで、既報は約50例にとどまる。そのうち卵管外妊娠を伴ったものは6例のみであった。本例は子宮内満期妊娠と併存した初めての報告例として提示されており、卵管奇形腫の臨床像を広げる症例である。
pmid-9614784.summary_en: This case report describes a benign cystic teratoma arising in a unilateral fallopian tube in a woman with a concurrent term intrauterine pregnancy. Primary teratomas of the fallopian tube are extremely rare, with only about 50 cases reported previously, and only six associated with tubal ectopic pregnancy. The authors present what they describe as the first reported case of this combination with an intrauterine term pregnancy, reported from Taiwan. The report expands the known clinical spectrum of tubal teratomas.

pmid-9615319.summary_ja: 本後方視的比較研究は、2歳未満の小児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍で精巣摘除術後に化学療法が必要かを検討しました。22例は両親の選択により、10例がPVB化学療法を受け、12例は経過観察の方針で追跡されました。化学療法を受けなかった2例が再発し、1例はPVBで治癒、1例は肺転移で死亡しました。化学療法を受けた小児は再発しませんでした。7年全生存率は91.6%でした。著者らは、PVBは有効で安全であり、4コース未満で十分な可能性があるとし、無作為化試験の必要性を指摘しています。
pmid-9615319.summary_en: This retrospective comparison assessed whether chemotherapy is needed after orchiectomy for stage I testicular yolk sac tumour in children under two years. Twenty-two patients were divided by parental choice: ten received PVB chemotherapy and twelve were followed with a wait-and-see policy. Two untreated children relapsed; one was cured with PVB and one died of lung metastasis. No treated child relapsed. The 7-year overall survival was 91.6%. The authors suggest PVB is effective and safe, that fewer than four courses may suffice, and call for a randomised trial.

pmid-9617623.summary_ja: 1988年から1996年に名古屋大学病院で治療された予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍11例を検討した。完全奏効は73%だったが、長期的に無病で維持されたのは45%にとどまった。縦隔腫瘍の2例が化学療法中に死亡した。成績は満足できるものではなく、早期の大量化学療法など新たな戦略が必要と結論している。
pmid-9617623.summary_en: This Japanese clinical study from Nagoya University Hospital reviewed 11 poor-risk patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours treated between 1988 and 1996. Poor risk was defined by advanced disease, primary mediastinal or retroperitoneal disease with lung metastases, or unnormalised tumour markers after induction. Overall, 73% achieved complete response, but only 45% remained disease-free long term. Two patients with mediastinal tumours died during chemotherapy. Tumour markers often failed to normalise, and surgical specimens mostly showed necrosis or fibrosis. The authors conclude outcomes were unsatisfactory and that early high-dose chemotherapy is needed.

pmid-9619017.summary_ja: 36歳男性が急性の左下腹部痛で受診し、当初は嵌頓鼠径ヘルニアと診断された。開腹術で捻転した停留精巣内に大きな腫瘤を認め、病理学的に絨毛癌と奇形腫を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。陰嚢内に精巣を触れない患者の急性腹症では、停留精巣の捻転を考慮すべきと強調している。
pmid-9619017.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man who presented with acute left lower abdominal pain and was initially diagnosed with an incarcerated inguinal hernia. At laparotomy, a large mass was found in an undescended testis that had undergone torsion. Pathology revealed a mixed germ cell tumour with choriocarcinoma and teratoma components. The authors stress that acute abdominal symptoms in a patient with an absent scrotal testis should prompt consideration of torsion of an undescended testis, which carries a higher malignancy risk than a normally descended testis.

pmid-9619364.summary_ja: 本総説は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の最近の進歩をまとめたものである。胎盤を介したエストロゲン曝露と二卵性妊娠が、子の危険度上昇と関連することが疫学的に示されている。これら腫瘍における内在性レトロウイルスの発現が新たに報告され、家族例には劣性遺伝子モデルが最もよく適合する。p53の過剰発現は化学療法反応性の低下と関連し、特にセミノーマで顕著である。カルボプラチンはブレオマイシン・エトポシドとの併用で3年時点の成績が劣ることも示された。
pmid-9619364.summary_en: This review summarises recent advances in testicular germ cell cancer. Epidemiological evidence links transplacental estrogen exposure, including severe maternal nausea, and dizygotic pregnancy to higher risk in offspring. Endogenous retrovirus expression in these tumours is newly described, and a recessive gene model best fits familial cases. Excess p53 expression is associated with poorer chemotherapy response, particularly in seminoma. Preclinical oxaliplatin activity in cisplatin-resistant tumours supports further trials, while carboplatin combined with bleomycin and etoposide proved inferior at 3 years.

pmid-9620551.summary_ja: 転移性の男性胚細胞腫瘍の約20〜30%がシスプラチン併用化学療法に抵抗性を示す理由を検討した。抵抗性腫瘍ではエクソン6〜9にTP53変異が見つかり、耐性細胞株はアポトーシスが低下していた。機能不全のTP53変異がアポトーシス応答を妨げ、この一群の耐性を説明すると結論づけられている。
pmid-9620551.summary_en: The authors investigated why about 20 to 30% of metastatic male germ cell tumors resist cisplatin-based chemotherapy. In a panel of resistant tumors, they identified TP53 mutations in exons 6 to 9, which were absent from random tumor samples. A resistant cell line carrying the same mutation showed reduced apoptosis, impaired induction of p53 target genes, and lower bax levels after cisplatin exposure. The authors conclude that a functionally inactivating TP53 mutation prevents an apoptotic response and explains resistance in this subset of tumors.

pmid-9622699.summary_ja: 稀な胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の2症例について細胞学的所見を報告した。不正出血や無月経で受診し、子宮摘出術が行われた。腫瘍細胞の多くはヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン(hPL)陽性で、一部がhCG陽性であった。分裂像がまれなため良性と考えられたが、フォローアップが必要である。鑑別には磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)と免疫組織化学が有用とされる。
pmid-9622699.summary_en: This report describes cytologic findings in two women with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare trophoblastic neoplasm. Both presented with abnormal bleeding or amenorrhea, and endometrial smears suggested trophoblastic disease before hysterectomy. Hormone levels showed mild hCG and beta-hCG elevation with normal placental lactogen. Tumor cells were mostly placental lactogen positive, with some hCG positivity. Cells were considered benign because of rare mitoses, but follow-up is advised. Diagnosis benefits from MRI and immunostaining.

pmid-9624562.summary_ja: 40歳男性の精巣セミノーマ原発巣から新規細胞株JKT-1を樹立し、2年以上維持した。細胞はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)やβ-hCGを産生せず、ビメンチンと胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼに陽性であった。染色体はY染色体欠失を伴う。ヌードマウスへの皮下移植で古典的なセミノーマ組織を再現し、in vitroおよびin vivo研究の有用なモデルとなる。
pmid-9624562.summary_en: The authors established JKT-1, a new human testicular seminoma cell line from a 40-year-old man's primary tumor, and maintained it for over two years. Cells grew as a monolayer and did not produce AFP or beta-hCG. They expressed vimentin and placental alkaline phosphatase, and showed a modal chromosome number of 66 with Y loss. Subcutaneous transplantation into nude mice reproduced classical seminomatous tissue. The line is proposed as a model for both in vitro and in vivo studies of seminoma biology.

pmid-9624568.summary_ja: 19歳男性が縦隔腫瘍と両側肺結節を伴う絨毛癌と診断された症例報告である。血清β-hCGは985 ng/mLと著明に上昇していた。精巣超音波検査で精巣微小石灰化を認めたが、精巣生検では腫瘍は検出されなかった。精巣がんを伴わない絨毛癌と精巣微小石灰化の関連は不明で、高いhCG値を反映している可能性がある。
pmid-9624568.summary_en: A 19-year-old man presented with cough, chest pain and fever. Chest CT showed a large mediastinal mass and bilateral lung nodules, while abdominal and pelvic CT was normal. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated at 985 ng/mL. Testicular ultrasonography revealed bilateral punctate echoes consistent with testicular microlithiasis, yet testicular needle biopsies showed no cancer. Transthoracic needle biopsy of the mediastinal mass confirmed choriocarcinoma. The authors note that the link between microlithiasis and choriocarcinoma without testicular cancer is unclear, possibly reflecting high hCG levels.

pmid-9627338.summary_ja: 本研究では、非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜転移病変に対するL-[1-11C]チロシンPETの有用性を、10例で検討した。PETで集積が確認されたのは一部にとどまり、6例では転移腫瘤が描出されなかった。結果が不良であったため、治療後の検査は実施されなかった。著者らは、緩徐に増殖するこの腫瘍や化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘤の評価にはチロシンPETは適さないと結論づけている。
pmid-9627338.summary_en: This study evaluated whether L-[1-11C]tyrosine PET can detect metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors and monitor response to cisplatin-based chemotherapy in ten patients with retroperitoneal disease. PET showed uptake in only four patients, and metastatic masses were not depicted in six. Because of these poor results, posttreatment scans were not performed. The authors concluded that tyrosine PET is unsuitable for visualizing these slowly proliferating tumors or characterizing residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy.

pmid-9631595.summary_ja: 卵巣の類皮嚢腫に生じた扁平上皮癌4例と良性類皮嚢腫22例で、各種マーカーとp53を検討した。悪性例の3例で扁平上皮癌抗原(SCC)が陽性であった。全悪性例でp53の過剰発現がみられた。SCCは類皮嚢腫の悪性転化の検出に有用なマーカーとなる可能性があり、p53変異は悪性転化の遺伝的事象の一つと考えられる。
pmid-9631595.summary_en: This study examined serum and tissue markers in four squamous cell carcinomas arising in ovarian dermoid cysts and in 22 benign dermoid cysts. SCC antigen was elevated in tissue or serum in three of four malignant cases, while CA 19-9 and CA 125 were not detected in the carcinomas. p53 overexpression was seen in all malignant tumors. The authors suggest that SCC may be a useful marker for detecting malignant transformation of a dermoid cyst and that p53 mutation may be a genetic event in this process.

pmid-9632138.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における12p過剰の責任領域を、核型解析、CGH、FISHを用いて絞り込んだ。原発性腫瘍49例中8例で12p11.1-p12.1の増幅が認められ、最小重複領域は1750～3000kbと推定された。KRAS2、JAW1、SOX5がこの領域内に位置し、腫瘍発生に関わる候補遺伝子と考えられる。
pmid-9632138.summary_en: This study refined the critical region of 12p over-representation in testicular germ cell tumors of adolescents and adults using karyotyping, comparative genomic hybridization, and FISH. Among 49 primary tumors, eight showed amplification of 12p11.1-p12.1, defining a shortest region of overlap of about 1.75–3.0 Mb. KRAS2, JAW1, and SOX5 lie within this region. KRAS2 and JAW1 are expressed in all tumors, while one amplified tumor lacked SOX5 expression. The authors suggest these genes are candidates for testicular germ cell tumor development.

pmid-9633853.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の総説である。まれな腫瘍だが若年者に発生し、適切な治療によく反応する。1991年以降に発表された卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に関する重要な報告を取り上げ、知見を更新している。また精巣がんにおける化学療法の研究成果も併せて整理し、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療を理解するうえで役立つ概要を示している。
pmid-9633853.summary_en: This review updates knowledge on ovarian germ cell tumors, which are rare but occur in young patients and respond well to appropriate treatment. It summarizes important publications since 1991 that focus specifically on ovarian germ cell tumors. It also reviews new findings on chemotherapy for testis cancer, which informs treatment strategies. The article gives clinicians and researchers a concise overview of progress in this field.

pmid-9635829.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の4細胞株を用いて、シスプラチン誘導性アポトーシスとp53、Bcl-2、Baxの発現を検討した。3株は高感受性、2102EP株は抵抗性を示した。野生型p53の存在は感受性と必ずしも一致せず、Bcl-2とBaxも感受性とは相関しなかった。シスプラチン感受性の機序を理解するうえで、p53以外の要因の関与を示唆する基礎研究である。
pmid-9635829.summary_en: This study examined cisplatin-induced apoptosis in four testicular germ cell tumor cell lines and measured p53, Bcl-2, and Bax expression. Three lines were highly sensitive to cisplatin, whereas 2102EP was resistant. Sensitivity tracked with the MTT assay but not with platinum accumulation or DNA adduct removal. Wild-type p53 was induced in both sensitive and resistant lines, so it was not essential for apoptosis. Bcl-2 and Bax did not correlate with apoptosis sensitivity.

pmid-9635841.summary_ja: ヒト卵巣奇形腫20例でc-MOS癌原遺伝子のコード領域全体を解析した。c-mosを欠損させたマウスは卵巣奇形腫を発生するため、本遺伝子は候補となる癌抑制遺伝子であった。解析の結果、既知の多型1つと新規の配列変異1つのみが見つかり、いずれも発症に関与するとは考えにくかった。コード領域の変異はヒト卵巣奇形腫の発生に大きな役割を果たさないと結論づけている。
pmid-9635841.summary_en: This study analyzed the entire coding region of the c-MOS proto-oncogene in 20 human ovarian teratomas. Because c-mos-deficient transgenic mice develop ovarian teratomas, c-mos was a candidate tumor suppressor. Screening by SSCA and heteroduplex analysis, with full sequencing of nine tumors, identified one known polymorphism and one new sequence variant. Neither was likely to be disease-causing. The authors conclude that coding-region c-MOS mutations do not play a significant role in human ovarian teratoma genesis.

pmid-9635847.summary_ja: 再発または難治性の胚細胞腫瘍31例に対し、糸球体濾過量に基づき調整したカルボプラチンを含む大量化学療法を施行した。治療関連死は1例で、急性腎不全によるものであった。原発性難治例または反応性再発の21例では、3年全生存率60%、無病生存率42%であった。難治性再発の10例は無病生存者がおらず、予後不良因子と考えられた。
pmid-9635847.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of high-dose therapy including carboplatin, dosed by measured glomerular filtration rate, in 31 patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors. One treatment-related death from acute renal failure occurred. For 21 patients with primary refractory disease or responsive relapse, 3-year overall survival was 60% and disease-free survival was 42%. None of ten patients with refractory relapse survived disease-free, identifying refractory relapse as a poor prognostic factor.

pmid-9640220.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマの初期治療を比較した研究。Institut Gustave-Roussyの14例と文献データを解析した。シスプラチン併用化学療法群では長期無病生存率が約85%と、放射線療法単独群（文献上約62%）より高かった。ランダム化試験は希少疾患のため困難とされる。残存腫瘤の外科的切除の重要性も示された。
pmid-9640220.summary_en: This study compared initial management of primary mediastinal seminoma, reviewing 14 patients from the Institut Gustave-Roussy and literature data. Patients receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy showed higher long-term disease-free survival (about 85%) than those treated with radiotherapy alone (about 62% in the literature). The authors conclude cisplatin-based chemotherapy appears superior but note that a randomised trial is unlikely given the rarity of the neoplasm. Surgical resection of residual masses was important, and the single death occurred in a patient who refused it.

pmid-9640221.summary_ja: 進行した純粋セミノーマ72例に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法の成績を報告。85%が持続的な奏効を得た。再発は11例で、中央値6か月で起こった。中央値64か月の追跡で83%が生存・無病だった。hCG、LDH、p53染色などの初期因子は生存との有意な関連を示さなかった。化学感受性マーカーの同定が今後の課題とされる。
pmid-9640221.summary_en: This retrospective report describes outcomes of 72 patients with advanced pure seminoma treated with various cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy regimens. A sustained durable response was achieved in 85%, with 11 relapses at a median time to failure of 6 months. At a median follow-up of 64 months, 83% remained alive and disease-free. Baseline clinical and biological factors, including serum hCG, serum LDH and p53 immunostaining, did not retain statistical significance in univariate analysis. The authors conclude that cure rates are high and call for markers of chemosensitivity.

pmid-9641232.summary_ja: 20歳女性の卵巣原発純粋絨毛癌の症例報告。非妊娠性絨毛癌は純粋型が混合型より少なく、生殖年齢では診断が困難とされる。文献的考察とともに腫瘍の起源について論じている。若年女性におけるこの疾患の診断の難しさを示す報告である。
pmid-9641232.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old woman with primary pure choriocarcinoma of the ovary, a rare nongestational form. Nongestational choriocarcinoma can be pure or mixed with other germ cell tumors, and the pure form is less common than the mixed form. The authors note that diagnosis is difficult during the reproductive period. They present the case alongside a literature review and discuss the origin of the tumor. The report highlights the diagnostic challenge of this entity in young women.

pmid-9648599.summary_ja: 41歳女性の卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(多胚腫と未熟奇形腫)の症例報告である。AFPとhCGが高値を示し、免疫組織化学でAFPは卵黄嚢様細胞、hCGは合胞体栄養膜細胞に局在した。手術とシスプラチン併用化学療法後、4年以上マーカー上昇はみられていない。
pmid-9648599.summary_en: A 41-year-old woman with an ovarian mixed germ cell tumor composed of polyembryoma and immature teratoma, with markedly elevated AFP and hCG. Immunohistochemistry localized AFP to yolk sac-like cells and hCG to syncytiotrophoblastic cells. She underwent surgery followed by cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy and has remained free of marker elevation for over four years. This case report illustrates marker-guided follow-up.

pmid-9649228.summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍の高い治癒率の生物学的背景をまとめた総説である。化学療法が必須であるが、腫瘍生物学の理解、微小残存病変を捉える腫瘍マーカーの利用、全身療法と局所療法の統合も重要だったと論じている。多職種治療の模範例として位置づけられている。
pmid-9649228.summary_en: A review of the biologic basis for the cure of advanced germ cell tumors. It argues that chemotherapy was the essential driver of high cure rates, but that understanding tumor biology, availability of tumor markers for detecting minimal residual disease, and integration of systemic and local therapies were also critical. The authors frame germ cell cancer as a paradigm of multidisciplinary cancer care.

pmid-9649229.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍870例で、化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清の成績を報告している。再発・予後不良の危険因子は、救援化学療法前の残存腫瘍、腫瘍マーカー上昇、再手術の必要性、切除不能であった。危険因子のない患者の再発率は9.8%、生存率は95.5%であった。
pmid-9649229.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 870 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell cancer undergoing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Risk factors for relapse and poor survival included residual cancer before salvage chemotherapy, elevated tumor markers, need for redo surgery, and unresectability. Although about half had at least one risk factor, 67.5% were long-term survivors, and patients without risk factors had only 9.8% relapse with 95.5% survival.

pmid-9649230.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織学的所見の臨床的意義をまとめた総説である。病期や血清マーカーに加え、組織型、各成分の割合、脈管侵襲が重要とされる。純粋な胎児性癌や混合腫瘍中の胎児性癌が80%を超える場合、脈管・リンパ管侵襲は再発の高リスク因子であり、治療選択の判断に用いるべきである。
pmid-9649230.summary_en: A pathology-oriented review of testicular germ cell neoplasms, which are highly curable. Beyond stage and serum markers, the authors highlight cell type, the proportion of each component, and vascular or lymphatic invasion as clinically important. Pure embryonal carcinoma, or embryonal carcinoma exceeding 80% in a mixed tumor, and vascular or lymphatic invasion are high-risk predictors of relapse that should guide oncologic management.

pmid-9649231.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の病期分類と予後について総説している。病期は原発部位、組織型、血清腫瘍マーカー、腫瘍量に基づく。臨床病期Iは精巣内に限局し、IIとIIIは後腹膜リンパ節および内臓転移を示す。1997年の国際胚細胞コンセンサス分類は予後に基づき、各施設間の比較を可能にした。
pmid-9649231.summary_en: A review of germ cell tumor staging and prognosis. GCT staging is based on primary site, histology, serum tumor markers, and disease bulk. Clinical stage I is confined to the testis, while stages II and III denote retroperitoneal nodal and visceral spread. The authors summarize historical systems and the 1997 International Germ Cell Consensus Classification, which is prognosis-based and enables cross-group comparison.

pmid-9649232.summary_ja: M.D.アンダーソンがんセンターの立場から、胚細胞腫瘍治療における投与量強度について論じている。予後不良例や腫瘍量の多い症例では治療成績がなお不十分である。治療間隔の短縮や用量反応関係のある薬剤の増量などが検討中で、骨髄移植や造血幹細胞支持を併用する場合もある。
pmid-9649232.summary_en: A commentary on dose intensity in germ cell tumor therapy from M.D. Anderson Cancer Center. Although GCT treatment is a model of solid tumor success, outcomes remain unsatisfactory for patients with poor-risk or high-volume disease at presentation. The authors discuss strategies under investigation, including shortening treatment intervals and dose escalation of agents with dose-response relationships, with or without bone marrow transplant or stem cell support.

pmid-9649918.summary_ja: 避妊薬(皮下インプラントやレボノルゲストレル含有IUD)による不規則な出血が絨毛癌を覆い隠し、診断が大幅に遅れた2症例を報告している。絨毛癌は併用化学療法で多くが治癒するが、診断の遅れは治療失敗につながる。両症例とも初診時にhCGβの割合が上昇しており、臨床症状が不明瞭な場合にこの比率が絨毛癌の同定に役立つ可能性が示された。
pmid-9649918.summary_en: Two women with choriocarcinoma whose diagnosis was substantially delayed are reported. Contraceptive use, including subdermal implants and levonorgestrel-containing IUDs, caused irregular bleeding that masked the tumor. Choriocarcinoma is usually curable with combination chemotherapy, but delayed diagnosis can lead to treatment failure. In both cases, the proportion of hCG-beta relative to total hCG immunoreactivity was elevated at presentation, suggesting that this ratio may help identify choriocarcinoma when clinical signs are obscured.

pmid-9650555.summary_ja: 絨毛癌を主体とし卵黄嚢腫瘍の巣を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された悪性卵巣腫瘍の染色体異常を解析した。過三倍体/過低四倍体の核型と12p等染色体の2コピーなどが認められ、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のパターンと非常によく似ていた。既報の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のデータと合わせ、卵巣と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍は起源や発症経路を共有する近縁の疾患群であると論じている。
pmid-9650555.summary_en: The cytogenetic profile of a malignant ovarian tumor diagnosed as a mixed germ cell tumor, composed of extensive choriocarcinoma and foci of yolk sac tumor, is described. The karyotype was hypertriploid or hypotetraploid and included several clonal structural abnormalities, notably two copies of an isochromosome 12p. The pattern closely resembled that of testicular germ cell tumors. Combined with previously reported data on malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, the authors argue that ovarian and testicular germ cell tumors are closely related entities with a likely shared origin and pathogenetic pathway.

pmid-9651951.summary_ja: 右卵巣嚢腫の捻転により急性腹痛を呈した27歳女性の症例である。病理組織学的検査で、高度に組織化された小脳組織を主成分とする成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が確認された。極めてまれな所見である。神経組織内の未熟な前駆細胞からの悪性神経上皮腫瘍の発生の可能性があるため、完全切除が妥当と結論づけている。
pmid-9651951.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman presented with acute abdominal pain due to torsion of a right ovarian cyst. Histopathology revealed a mature cystic ovarian teratoma whose predominant component was highly organized cerebellar tissue, an exceedingly rare finding. The authors note that a malignant neuroepithelial tumor could arise from immature precursor cells within such neural tissue, and therefore conclude that these lesions justify complete surgical excision.

pmid-9656101.summary_ja: インディアナ大学基準で予後不良の進行精巣がん非セミノーマ5例を報告した。VIP療法で2例が病理学的完全奏効を得た。残り3例は大量ICE化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を行い、部分奏効が得られた。20か月以上の観察で4例が無病生存し、1例は死亡した。
pmid-9656101.summary_en: This report describes five patients with advanced metastatic testicular non-seminoma, poor-risk by Indiana University criteria. All received VIP chemotherapy (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin), and two achieved pathological complete response after surgical resection. The remaining three received high-dose ICE chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation, yielding partial responses, and residual masses were resected. At minimum follow-up of 20 months, four were disease-free and one died of cancer. No serious complications occurred. The authors conclude that VIP induction followed by early salvage high-dose ICE with PBSCT is well tolerated and effective for poor-risk testicular cancer.

pmid-9656119.summary_ja: 早期妊娠の正常着床部位の中間栄養膜細胞と胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)6例の細胞周期制御分子を免疫組織化学で比較した。PSTTではKi-67標識率が高く、サイクリン類とCDKが広く発現していた。正常中間栄養膜では増殖活性が低く、発現も限られていた。PSTTの増殖異常を示す研究である。
pmid-9656119.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared cell cycle regulatory molecules in normal implantation-site intermediate trophoblast from early pregnancy (19 cases) with placental site trophoblastic tumors (6 cases). Normal intermediate trophoblast showed very low Ki-67 labeling and lacked cyclin and CDK expression, except cyclins B and E. In contrast, PSTT tumor cells displayed high Ki-67 indices and expressed all examined cyclins and CDKs. p53 was present in PSTT cells, with a distribution matching cyclin A-positive cells. The authors conclude that transformed intermediate trophoblast in PSTT has high proliferative activity and aberrant regulation of cell cycle molecules absent in normal tissue.

pmid-9657016.summary_ja: 縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍が自然退縮した症例を報告した。血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は初診時高値から正常化した。開胸手術で奇形腫とセミノーマの混在と診断された。その後の化学療法で、10年以上再発なく生存している。
pmid-9657016.summary_en: This case report describes primary mediastinal germ cell tumor that showed spontaneous regression. Serum hCG was elevated on admission and fell to normal as the anterior mediastinal mass shrank. Thoracotomy was performed, with artificial vascular replacement between the bilateral brachiocephalic veins and the right atrium. Histology showed combined teratoma with seminoma. Subsequent chemotherapy was given, and the patient has remained alive without recurrence for over 10 years. The case highlights that spontaneous regression can occur in mediastinal germ cell tumors and that long-term survival is achievable with multimodal management.

pmid-9657344.summary_ja: セミノーマの血清マーカーとして胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼ(GCAP)の特異性向上を検討した。GCAPは構造が不均一で、血清での測定には免疫測定法のみが感度を満たした。健康な献血者の15%で高値を示し、喫煙と相関した。将来は射精液中の上皮内癌細胞の検出への応用が示唆されている。
pmid-9657344.summary_en: The authors evaluated two-dimensional electrophoresis, ion-exchange chromatography, and immunoassay to improve the specificity of germ cell alkaline phosphatase (GCAP) for detecting seminoma. Two-dimensional electrophoresis revealed structural heterogeneity of GCAP in seminoma tissue, attributed to allelic substitutions, variable sialylation, and differential membrane-anchor cleavage. Immunoassay was the only technique sensitive enough for serum measurement. GCAP was elevated in 15% of healthy blood donors and correlated with smoking, which complicates interpretation. The authors suggest future use for detecting carcinoma in situ cells in ejaculate.

pmid-9660225.summary_ja: 本研究は、日常の産科超音波検査で診断された胎児仙尾部奇形腫21例を後方視的に検討した。子宮内死亡率は19%、周産期死亡率は14%であった。充実性腫瘍は予後不良因子であり、周産期死亡はすべて腫瘍破裂によるものであった。新規発症の羊水過多は早産と関連していた。著者らは、慎重な出生前フォローアップの必要性を提唱している。
pmid-9660225.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 21 fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas detected on routine obstetric ultrasound examined natural history and prognostic factors. In utero mortality was 19% and perinatal mortality 14%, with premature labor in half the cases. A solid tumor was a significant negative prognostic factor, and all perinatal deaths were attributable to tumor rupture. New-onset polyhydramnios predicted premature labor. The authors recommend close antenatal follow-up for these findings to optimize counseling and treatment.

pmid-9663417.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対して29年前に腹部放射線療法を受けた患者が、3年以内に2つの大腸癌と腹膜中皮腫という3つの固形悪性腫瘍を発症した症例を報告する。腹部照射後には大腸癌と腹膜中皮腫の頻度が高いことが知られている。著者らは、低リスク病期Iのセミノーマに対する補助放射線療法を検討する際、このような晩期の放射線関連有害事象を考慮すべきであると指摘している。
pmid-9663417.summary_en: The authors describe a patient who developed three separate abdominal solid malignancies within three years, 29 years after abdominal radiotherapy for testicular seminoma: two colon cancers and a peritoneal mesothelioma. Both colon cancer and peritoneal mesothelioma are reported to be more frequent after abdominal irradiation. To their knowledge, no other case with three nearly simultaneous solid tumors possibly related to prior irradiation has been reported. The authors caution that such late radiation-related effects should be weighed when considering adjuvant radiotherapy for low-risk stage I seminoma.

pmid-9666691.summary_ja: 1988年に左精巣腫瘍と後腹膜リンパ節転移と診断された男性症例です。精巣摘除術、化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を経て、8年間に残存後腹膜奇形腫が成熟していく経過を追跡しています。最終的に腸管成分から腺癌が生じ、組織の成熟度では悪性度を評価できないため、残存病変は可能な限り完全切除すべきだと結論づけています。
pmid-9666691.summary_en: A man initially diagnosed with left testicular cancer with retroperitoneal nodal metastasis (1988) was treated with orchiectomy, PVB and cisplatin-etoposide chemotherapy, and incomplete retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Over eight years, repeated resections showed progressive maturation of the residual retroperitoneal teratoma, and finally mature teratoma with adenocarcinoma arising in enteric elements. The authors conclude that histologic maturity cannot predict malignant potential, so residual retroperitoneal teratomas should be resected as completely as possible.

pmid-9666776.summary_ja: 1978年から1995年に化学療法後の外科的切除を受けた転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍107例を後方視的に検討しています。腫瘍マーカー陽性の30例と陰性の77例を比較し、無病生存は陰性例92%、陽性例57%でした。局所に限局した化学療法抵抗性病変では外科的切除が根治的となりうる一方、サルベージ手術の時期と後続化学療法の順序は議論が続いています。
pmid-9666776.summary_en: This retrospective series reviews 107 patients with metastatic NSGCT who underwent surgery after chemotherapy from 1978 to 1995. Thirty patients with elevated tumour markers were compared with 77 patients with normal markers. Disease-free status was achieved in 92% with normal markers versus 57% with raised markers. Among those with positive markers, 11 of 22 with viable tumour in resected specimens were disease-free. The authors conclude that surgery is curative for localized chemotherapy-resistant masses, although outcome depends on marker status, and timing of salvage surgery and subsequent chemotherapy remains debated.

pmid-9667270.summary_ja: 本研究は、シスプラチン・エトポシド基盤の導入療法後に進行した播種性胚細胞腫瘍135例へのVeIP二次治療の成績を報告する。67例(49.6%)が無病状態を達成し、長期無病生存は全体で23.7%であった。性腺外非セミノーマ性腫瘍では32例全例が無病ではなかったのに対し、性腺原発では100例中30例が無病であった。著者らは、VeIPは性腺病変では持続的寛解をもたらすが、性腺外非セミノーマ性腫瘍には不十分と結論づけている。
pmid-9667270.summary_en: This study reports 135 patients with progressive disseminated germ cell tumours treated with vinblastine, ifosfamide and cisplatin (VeIP) as second-line therapy after cisplatin-etoposide-based induction. Sixty-seven patients (49.6%) achieved disease-free status after chemotherapy with or without surgical resection. Long-term disease-free survival was 23.7% overall, with none of 32 patients with nonseminomatous extragonadal tumours disease-free, compared with 30 of 100 gonadal primaries. The authors conclude that VeIP produces durable remissions in gonadal disease but not extragonadal nonseminomatous tumours.

pmid-9669816.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍70例を対象に、免疫組織化学でbcl-2発現を検討し、組織型、転移、病期、MDR1/Pgpとの関係を解析した研究です。全体の58%でbcl-2が陽性で、非セミノーマ性腫瘍（68%）はセミノーマ（42.3%）より高率でした。転移例や進行病期で陽性率が高く、MDR1/Pgpとも有意に関連しており、より悪性度の高い表現型と関連すると結論づけています。
pmid-9669816.summary_en: This study screened 70 patients with germ cell testicular tumours by immunohistochemistry for bcl-2 expression and correlated the results with histology, metastasis, clinical stage and MDR1/Pgp expression. Bcl-2 was detected in 58% of tumours, including 42% of seminomas and 68% of nonseminomatous tumours. Positivity was more frequent in patients with metastases and advanced stages, and was significantly associated with MDR1/Pgp. The authors conclude that bcl-2 expression is linked to a more advanced malignant phenotype in these tumours.

pmid-9670832.summary_ja: 縦隔と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍120例を免疫染色で比較した研究です。縦隔セミノーマは精巣セミノーマに比べCAM 5.2、PLAP、ビメンチンの陽性率が高く、より成熟した表現型が示唆されました。CD30は胎児性癌に加え一部の卵黄嚢腫瘍やセミノーマでも陽性となり、腫瘍型間の近い起源関係を支持します。
pmid-9670832.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared 120 mediastinal and testicular germ cell tumors using a marker panel including CAM 5.2, PLAP, AFP, hCG, vimentin and CD30. Mediastinal seminomas more frequently expressed CAM 5.2, PLAP and vimentin than testicular seminomas, suggesting a more mature phenotype. Staining patterns for yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma did not differ by site. CD30 was strongly expressed in embryonal carcinoma and occasionally in yolk sac tumor and seminoma, supporting a close histogenetic relationship among these types.

pmid-9671130.summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する自家幹細胞支援を伴う大量化学療法の総説です。カルボプラチンとエトポシドが中心的薬剤とされ、骨髄抑制や神経毒性などの有害事象が報告されています。シスプラチン抵抗性や多重再発例で有効性を示唆する知見があり、一次治療での実施時期は未確定で、無作為化試験の結果が待たれています。
pmid-9671130.summary_en: This review discusses high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell support for poor-risk germ cell tumor patients. Carboplatin and etoposide are the key drugs, and the role of ifosfamide or cyclophosphamide is unclear. The authors note toxicities such as myelosuppression, neurotoxicity and renal impairment. Evidence supports use in cisplatin-refractory patients and in multiply relapsed patients, though randomized trials are lacking. Timing in first-line versus salvage therapy remains undefined, and prognostic factors help select suitable candidates.

pmid-9671881.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者22例を対象に、術後のカルボプラチン単剤療法2コース前後の精子所見と血清FSHを前向きに検討しました。治療前は判定可能17例中11例で精子数が低下し、FSHも上昇していました。4年間で精子数は改善し、68%が正常精子数に達し、FSHも正常化傾向を示しました。
pmid-9671881.summary_en: This prospective study examined semen parameters and serum FSH in 22 men with clinical Stage I seminoma before and after two courses of adjuvant single-agent carboplatin. Before chemotherapy, 11 of 17 evaluable men had abnormal sperm counts, and FSH was elevated. Over four years, sperm counts steadily improved, with 68% reaching normospermia and FSH trending toward normal. The authors conclude that spermatogenesis recovers in a high proportion of patients after adjuvant carboplatin.

pmid-9672464.summary_ja: 21歳女性の再発性胸水と腹水の症例報告です。骨盤内腫瘍が原因で、病理組織学的に良性の成熟奇形腫と診断されました。開腹下に腫瘍を摘出した後、腹水・胸水は再発せず消失しました。Meigs症候群と偽Meigs症候群の文献的レビューも含み、救急医が女性の再発性胸水を評価する際の重要性を論じています。
pmid-9672464.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with recurrent hydrothorax and ascites caused by a pelvic tumor, ultimately diagnosed as a benign mature teratoma. Ultrasonography revealed the ascites and mass, and laparotomy with tumor removal resolved both effusions without recurrence. The authors review the literature on Meigs' and pseudo-Meigs' syndromes, including their history, pathology and clinical features, and highlight their importance for emergency physicians evaluating women with recurrent effusions.

pmid-9673396.summary_ja: 正常精巣、セミノーマ、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)におけるグルタチオンS-トランスフェラーゼ(GST)のα、μ、πアイソフォームをウェスタンブロットで比較しました。セミノーマの多くはπを発現し、NSGCTの多くはαを発現していました。NSGCTではGSTαが進行期（病期IIB・III）で有意に高く、予後不良の一因となる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-9673396.summary_en: This Western blot study measured glutathione S-transferase alpha, mu and pi isoforms in normal testes, seminomas and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Normal testes expressed alpha and mu but little pi. Most seminomas expressed pi, while most NSGCTs expressed alpha. GST alpha expression was significantly associated with later disease stage (IIB and III) in NSGCTs. The authors suggest that high GST alpha content may contribute to the poorer prognosis of advanced NSGCTs.

pmid-9674702.summary_ja: 多能性ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2の分化過程におけるWnt遺伝子発現を解析しました。未分化細胞ではWnt-13は検出されず、レチノイン酸などによる分化誘導で発現しました。悪性奇形腫細胞株577MFでも高発現し、奇形癌の組織発生への関与が示唆されています。Wnt-13は胚細胞腫瘍で欠失が多い1p13に位置します。
pmid-9674702.summary_en: This study examined Wnt gene expression during differentiation of the pluripotent human embryonal carcinoma line NTERA-2. Wnt-13 was absent in undifferentiated cells but induced during retinoic acid and HMBA-driven differentiation, and it persisted in non-neural differentiated cells. Wnt-13 was also highly expressed in the malignant teratoma line 577MF. Because frizzled receptors were co-expressed, the authors propose Wnt-13 may modulate teratocarcinoma histogenesis. The gene maps to 1p13, a region with frequent loss in germ cell tumors.

pmid-9675597.summary_ja: 卵管に発生した胎盤部位結節の第2例目の報告です。23歳女性の帝王切開時、偶発的に右卵管で発見されました。多形性を示す中間型栄養膜細胞が管腔を置換し、偽浸潤像を呈しました。Ki-67指数は3%でした。悪性疾患との鑑別診断が重要であり、潜在性子宮外妊娠や子宮からの細胞移動が発生起源として考察されています。
pmid-9675597.summary_en: This report describes the second known case of placental site nodule arising in the fallopian tube. It was incidentally found during cesarean section and tubal ligation in a 23-year-old woman after a term pregnancy. Microscopy showed a tubal lumen replaced by pleomorphic intermediate trophoblastic cells with pseudoinvasive features, positive for hPL, PLAP, EMA and CAM5.2, with a Ki-67 index of 3%. The authors stress inclusion in the differential diagnosis of malignancy and discuss origins from prior subclinical tubal pregnancy or uterine migration.

pmid-9679978.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍27例を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションで解析した。悪性例では12p、21、8、1qの増加と13番染色体の欠失が多く、成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍と類似していた。未熟奇形腫では一貫した異常は認められなかった。遺伝子異常が予後不良を示す可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9679978.summary_en: This comparative genomic hybridization study analyzed 27 ovarian germ cell tumors to characterize chromosomal gains and losses. Malignant tumors (dysgerminomas, endodermal sinus tumors, mixed GCTs) showed frequent gains of 12p, 21, 8 and 1q and loss of 13, resembling adult testicular GCTs. Immature teratomas showed almost no consistent alterations, and tumors in dysgenetic gonads of 46,XY patients were diploid yet still showed 12p gain. The authors suggest genetic abnormalities may predict worse prognosis.

pmid-9681081.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍で精巣上皮内がん(CIS)を有する33例に白金製剤化学療法を行った。30例でCISは消失したが、6例で再発が認められた。両側または対側CISには放射線療法、性腺外病変を伴う片側CISには精巣摘除術を推奨している。
pmid-9681081.summary_en: Thirty-three men with disseminated germ-cell cancer and biopsy-proven contralateral testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS) received platinum-based chemotherapy. CIS disappeared on first follow-up biopsy in 30 patients, but six later relapsed, with an estimated 21% five-year and 42% ten-year cumulative risk. Based on these data, the authors recommend radiotherapy for bilateral or contralateral CIS and orchiectomy for CIS in patients with extragonadal disease, while suggesting long-term biopsy follow-up when fertility matters.

pmid-9683843.summary_ja: イラクのがん登録と29例の診療記録を後方視的に解析した。精巣がんの罹患率は低いが死亡率は高かった。術後のフォローアップ不足、治療順序の不適切さ、低用量化学療法が予後不良の要因とされた。
pmid-9683843.summary_en: This retrospective study from Iraq analyzed the age-specific incidence of testicular cancer using a national registry and reviewed management of 29 patients with testicular and non-testicular germ-cell tumors. Annual incidence was low, but mortality was high. Poor outcomes were linked to lack of postoperative surveillance, inappropriate sequencing of chemotherapy, surgery and radiation, and low-dose chemotherapy. Tumor marker studies were infrequently performed, and the authors conclude that incomplete penetration of medical knowledge into practice drives mortality.

pmid-9684508.summary_ja: 台北退役軍人総合病院で121例の妊娠中・産褥期の卵巣手術を後方視的に検討した。奇形腫が31.4%を占め、悪性腫瘍は3.3%であった。緊急手術は選択的手術より胎児喪失率が高かった。妊娠前に奇形腫などの非機能性卵巣腫瘍を摘除することが推奨される。
pmid-9684508.summary_en: This 12-year retrospective review from Veterans General Hospital-Taipei examined 121 women who underwent ovarian surgery during pregnancy or puerperium. Most tumors were benign, with teratoma in 31% and malignancy in 3%. Emergency surgery was associated with higher fetal wastage (14.1% vs 1%) and more oophorectomies than elective surgery. Surgery before seven weeks of gestation always resulted in fetal wastage. The authors recommend preconception removal of nonfunctional ovarian tumors, especially teratoma, and elective well-planned surgery.

pmid-9684705.summary_ja: カナダ・オンタリオ州の人口ベース症例対照研究で、1987〜1989年に診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍502例と対照975例を比較した。思春期の遅さは精巣がんに対して防御的に働き、早い思春期のリスクは結論が得られなかった。思春期の低年齢化が罹患率上昇の一因である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9684705.summary_en: This population-based case-control study in Ontario, Canada, included 502 men aged 16 to 59 diagnosed with testicular germ cell cancer in 1987-1989 and 975 matched controls. Puberty age was assessed by self and maternal reports of shaving, hair appearance, growth spurt and voice change. Later puberty was consistently protective against testicular cancer, with greater protection for more later-puberty events, while earlier puberty risk was inconclusive. The authors suggest declining puberty age may reduce this protection and help explain rising incidence.

pmid-9688304.summary_ja: 精巣原発胚細胞腫瘍のリンパ節転移巣からクローン化した細胞株HGCT-1を樹立した研究。12p領域の高度増幅を認め、血清条件により表現型が可逆的に変化した。レチノイン酸処理で上皮様細胞への不可逆的分化が誘導された。免疫不全ラットへの異種移植では上皮様および間葉様構造を形成し、多能性の細胞モデルとして有用であることが示された。
pmid-9688304.summary_en: Researchers established HGCT-1, a clonal cell line derived from a lymph node metastasis of a primary testicular germ cell tumor. The line showed amplification at 12p and displayed reversible phenotypic modulation depending on serum conditions. Retinoic acid induced irreversible differentiation toward epithelial-type cells with desmosome formation. Xenografts in immunosuppressed rats formed mixed epithelial and mesenchymal structures. The authors propose HGCT-1 as a pluripotential model distinct from established embryonal carcinoma lines.

pmid-9688762.summary_ja: 妊娠継続中の胎盤内に生じた絨毛癌の5例を報告。母体の転移を認めない3例と、分娩時に肺転移を有していた2例が含まれた。通常の絨毛から発生し、絨毛間質への浸潤はなかった。全例で児は腫瘍の所見なく生存した。化学療法を受けて無病で経過した例がある一方、1例はフォローアップ不能となった。胎盤内絨毛癌は報告より多い可能性があり、慎重な病理評価が必要である。
pmid-9688762.summary_en: Five cases of choriocarcinoma arising within the placenta during ongoing pregnancy with viable infants are described. Three mothers had no metastases, while two had known pulmonary metastases at delivery. Histology showed tumor arising from otherwise normal chorionic villi without villous stromal invasion. All infants survived without evidence of tumor. Some mothers received chemotherapy and remained disease-free, while one was lost to follow-up. The authors argue that intraplacental choriocarcinoma may be more common than reported and requires careful pathologic evaluation.

pmid-9692471.summary_ja: 隣接臓器に浸潤した原発性縦隔腫瘍89例に対する拡大切除の後方視的解析。内訳には胚細胞腫瘍17例が含まれ、そのうち14例で化学療法後の残存腫瘤を切除した。胚細胞腫瘍の5年生存率は48%であった。完全切除は生存を有意に改善した。化学療法後の残存腫瘤は切除すべきであると結論づけている。
pmid-9692471.summary_en: A retrospective review of 89 patients who underwent extended resection of primary mediastinal tumors invading adjacent structures. Germ cell tumors comprised 17 cases. Residual masses after chemotherapy were excised in 14 germ cell tumor patients. Five-year survival was 48% for germ cell tumors and 69% for thymoma. Total resection significantly improved survival. The authors conclude that malignant mediastinal tumors can be safely resected even with invasion, and residual masses after germ cell tumor chemotherapy should be removed.

pmid-9692555.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1の分化と増殖抑制におけるレチノイン酸受容体（RAR）とレチノイドX受容体（RXR）の協調作用を検討。RXRβの過剰発現は増殖を抑制し、RARγと共発現させると顕著な増殖抑制と神経マーカーの発現が得られた。両受容体の協調が終末分化に必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-9692555.summary_en: This study examines how retinoic acid receptors and retinoid X receptors cooperate to drive differentiation and growth suppression in NT2/D1 human embryonal carcinoma cells. Overexpression of RXRbeta, but not RXRalpha or RXRgamma, suppressed growth. Co-transfection of RARgamma and RXRbeta produced marked growth suppression and expression of neuronal markers. Reporter assays showed combined repression of the FGF4 promoter-enhancer. The authors conclude that these receptors must cooperate for terminal differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-9692831.summary_ja: 胎児機能不全で帝王切開された妊娠36週の胎盤に偶発的に見つかった単発性の大きな絨毛癌を報告。母子ともに1年半にわたり転移は生じなかった。胎盤梗塞の組織学的検索の重要性を指摘し、転移検索と血清β-hCGの経時測定による待機的管理を提案している。
pmid-9692831.summary_en: A large solitary choriocarcinoma was found incidentally in a near-term placenta at 36 weeks during cesarean section for fetal distress. The tumor showed central necrosis with a viable trophoblastic rim and was in contact with fetal vessels. No metastases developed in the mother or child over 1.5 years. The authors note that placental infarcts are often not examined histologically and recommend pathologic clarification of friable, unusually colored lesions. Management should be expectant, with metastasis workup and serial beta-hCG measurements.

pmid-9692832.summary_ja: 上腹部痛と食欲不振で受診した52歳男性の肝腫瘤。AFPとβ-hCGが高値で、初回生検では低分化腺癌とされた。悪性胚細胞腫瘍を疑いPEI療法を開始したが、10日後に肝機能障害で死亡した。剖検で絨毛癌と胎児性癌成分を含む性腺外混合性悪性胚細胞腫瘍と確定した。
pmid-9692832.summary_en: A 52-year-old man presented with upper abdominal pain, anorexia, and a large hepatic mass with elevated AFP and beta-hCG. Repeated biopsies initially suggested poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma. After clinical suspicion of malignant germ cell tumor, PEI chemotherapy was started, and markers declined rapidly. The patient died 10 days later of liver dysfunction and pneumonia. Autopsy confirmed an extragonadal mixed malignant germ cell tumor with choriocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma components. The authors note that fewer than 20 primary hepatic germ cell tumors have been reported.

pmid-9694107.summary_ja: 1945〜1997年に当院で治療された小児の非奇形腫性胚細胞腫瘍78例の後方視的研究。性腺外原発は性腺原発より完全切除率が低く、予後も不良であった。予後は組織型よりも原発部位により規定され、外科的切除の重要性が示された。局在性病変は転移例より予後が良好であった。
pmid-9694107.summary_en: This retrospective review of 78 children with nonteratomatous germ cell tumors, treated at one institution between 1945 and 1997, found germinoma, endodermal sinus tumor, and embryonal carcinoma as the main histologies. Extragonadal primaries were common (46%) and were associated with lower complete resection rates and worse survival (47% versus 76% for gonadal primaries). Localized disease had better survival than regional disease or metastases. The authors conclude that tumor location, rather than histology, drove prognosis, likely through differences in complete resection, which underscores the central role of surgery.

pmid-9694866.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の分化に伴うTGF-β受容体II型(TbetaR-II)遺伝子の転写調節を解析した基礎研究。未分化の親細胞では転写産物がなく、分化により発現が著明に上昇した。プロモーター解析では、ATF-1が結合するcAMP応答配列が正の、NF-Yが結合する逆向きCCAAT配列が負の調節領域として同定された。
pmid-9694866.summary_en: This basic research study examines how embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, a stem-like germ cell tumor model, regulate the type II TGF-beta receptor gene during differentiation. The authors show that TbetaR-II transcription is activated upon EC cell differentiation, while undifferentiated parental cells lack its transcripts. Promoter analysis identified a cAMP response element bound by ATF-1 that acts as a positive regulator, and an inverted CCAAT box bound by NF-Y that acts as a negative element. Dominant-negative NF-YA increased promoter activity, indicating that ATF-1 and NF-Y regulate TbetaR-II expression.

pmid-9696034.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症に関与する候補腫瘍抑制遺伝子DOC-2/hDab2の発現を検討した研究。正常絨毛組織に比べ、特に胞状奇胎や絨毛癌で発現が低下していた。絨毛癌細胞株への導入により増殖が抑制され、発症への関与が示唆された。
pmid-9696034.summary_en: This study investigates DOC-2/hDab2 as a candidate tumor suppressor in gestational trophoblastic diseases. DOC-2/hDab2 expression was high in normal trophoblasts but reduced in gestational trophoblastic disease tissues, especially complete mole and choriocarcinoma. Transfection of DOC-2/hDab2 into choriocarcinoma cell lines Jar, JEG, and BeWo significantly slowed their growth in culture. The authors propose that downregulation of DOC-2/hDab2 contributes to the development of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-9698477.summary_ja: ギリシャ共同腫瘍学グループによる卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍53例の後方視的研究。術後に白金製剤を基盤とした化学療法を受け、5年全生存期間(全生存率)はディスジャーミノーマで100%、非ディスジャーミノーマ性腫瘍で85%であった。化学療法の良好な成績が確認された。
pmid-9698477.summary_en: This Hellenic Cooperative Oncology Group retrospective study reviewed 53 women with ovarian germ cell malignancies treated after surgery with platinum-based chemotherapy over 14 years. Forty percent underwent complete resection. Regimens included PVB, BEP, and BEC. The 5-year overall survival was 100% for dysgerminoma and 85% for nondysgerminomatous tumors, and most patients with advanced nondysgerminomatous tumors and residual disease remained disease free. Platinum-based chemotherapy yielded a favorable outcome.

pmid-9698483.summary_ja: 転移性妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。分娩後に続発性の産後出血を来し、肺転移と筋層浸潤が認められた。第2コース化学療法後に敗血症を合併し子宮摘出を要したが、集中治療により救命された。続発性産後出血は絨毛癌を示唆する所見である。
pmid-9698483.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma who developed secondary postpartum hemorrhage after delivery. At presentation, extensive pulmonary metastases and myometrial penetration were seen on ultrasound. After the second chemotherapy course, she developed fulminant sepsis from a uteroperitoneal fistula requiring hysterectomy, but survived with intensive care. The authors highlight that secondary postpartum hemorrhage with an anemic fetus suggests choriocarcinoma, and that color Doppler vaginal ultrasound can show myometrial invasion.

pmid-9699512.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3におけるレチノイド受容体の発現と機能を解析した研究。RXRαが優位に発現し、RXRα特異的リガンドは増殖を強く抑制するとともに、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌を著明に増加させた。レチノイドの作用の多くはRXRαを介すると考えられた。
pmid-9699512.summary_en: This study characterizes retinoid receptors in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells and their role in hCG secretion. JEG-3 cells expressed RAR alpha and RXR alpha, with RXR alpha predominant. Retinoids inhibited growth, and the RXR alpha-specific ligand Ro 25 produced maximal growth inhibition and strong stimulation of hCG secretion at 48 hours. These findings suggest RXR alpha mediates most retinoid effects in choriocarcinoma cells and that retinoic acid may induce 9-cis RA production.

pmid-9701855.summary_ja: 残存した肺の成熟奇形腫から生じた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発例を報告している。晩期再発の機序と、文献で報告されている治療選択肢についても考察している。治療後に残存する成熟奇形腫が、後年に再発する悪性の可能性を持つことを示す症例に基づく論文である。
pmid-9701855.summary_en: This case report describes a late relapse of non-seminomatous germ cell tumour arising from residual mature teratoma located in the lung. The authors present the patient's course and discuss the proposed mechanisms underlying late relapse in germ cell tumors. They also review therapeutic options described in the literature for such recurrences. The paper highlights that residual mature teratoma after treatment can harbor malignant potential and may recur years later. It is a brief case-based review focused on clinical management and disease biology.

pmid-9702861.summary_ja: 44歳女性に生じた15cm大の卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、成熟奇形腫の4成分からなり、免疫染色で各成分を確認した。Ia期として化学療法を行い、二回目開腹で残存腫瘍はなく、術後15か月時点で良好な経過である。40歳以上での発症例として文献的にも稀な4例目と位置づけられている。
pmid-9702861.summary_en: This report describes a 44-year-old woman with a 15 cm ovarian mixed germ cell tumor. The tumor comprised dysgerminoma (over half of the mass), endodermal sinus tumor, choriocarcinoma, and mature teratoma, confirmed by immunohistochemistry for hPL, hCG, placental alkaline phosphatase, and AFP. Stage Ia disease was treated with chemotherapy, and second-look laparotomy showed no residual tumor. The patient remained well at 15 months. The authors review the literature and note that this is only the fourth reported case of ovarian mixed germ cell tumor in patients over 40 years old.

pmid-9703386.summary_ja: LH/hCG受容体のヘテロ接合性活性化変異（Asp578Gly）による家族性男性限定性思春期早発症の男性に、1994年に精巣セミノーマが発症した症例である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍を伴うFMPP患者としては初の報告である。幼少期からの性ホルモン過剰が精巣の細胞成分に影響を及ぼす可能性が示唆されているが、仮説の域を出ない。
pmid-9703386.summary_en: This report describes a man with familial male-limited precocious puberty caused by a heterozygous activating mutation (Asp578Gly) of the LH/hCG receptor. Diagnosed in childhood, he later developed a testicular seminoma in 1994. The authors note this is the first described testicular germ cell tumor in a patient with this condition. They propose that prolonged early exposure to elevated sex hormone levels could potentially harm the cellular components of the testis. The report links endocrine hyperstimulation with germ cell tumorigenesis as a hypothesis for further study.

pmid-9704799.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は甲状腺組織からなる稀な良性卵巣腫瘍で、特殊型奇形腫に分類される。本報告では、放射免疫検出法と共同記録により2例の卵巣甲状腺腫を検出したことが述べられている。抄録が短いため、使用したトレーサーや臨床経過の詳細は不明である。診断画像法に焦点を当てた論文である。
pmid-9704799.summary_en: This report describes the first in vitro identification of struma ovarii using radioimmunodetection and coregistration in two patients. Struma ovarii is a rare, typically benign ovarian tumor composed of thyroid tissue, classified as a specialized teratoma. The authors present radioimmunoscintigraphy as the diagnostic approach in these cases. Because the abstract is brief, details of the imaging protocol, tracer, clinical course, and outcomes are not provided. The paper addresses diagnostic imaging of an ovarian germ cell-derived tumor rather than its treatment.

pmid-9708216.summary_ja: 45歳男性に生じた原発性空腸絨毛癌の症例報告である。大量の下血と血清β-hCGの著明な上昇で発見された。剖検で精巣、縦隔、松果体に原発巣は認められず、典型的な絨毛癌の組織像を示した。血清β-hCGは本疾患の早期診断と経過観察に有用なマーカーになりうると結論づけている。
pmid-9708216.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the jejunum, presenting with massive melaena and markedly elevated serum beta-hCG. Necropsy found no primary lesion in the testes, mediastinum, or pineal gland, and histology showed typical choriocarcinoma without adenocarcinomatous elements. The authors suggest that non-gonadal choriocarcinoma may arise from retrodifferentiation or metaplasia of a carcinomatous component. They conclude that serum beta-hCG may be a useful marker for earlier diagnosis and monitoring of this potentially treatable disease.

pmid-9708647.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍と脊髄性筋萎縮症を合併した患者に、シスプラチン併用化学療法を施行し良好な経過をたどった症例報告である。シスプラチンは一般に忍容性が高く、重篤な神経毒性は稀だが、神経筋疾患患者の治療指針は乏しい。本報告は、そのような患者にも標準的な根治的治療を行いうることを示している。
pmid-9708647.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastatic testicular germ cell tumor and spinal muscular atrophy, an inherited neuromuscular disorder, who was successfully treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Cisplatin is generally well tolerated and rarely causes severe neurotoxicity, but there is little guidance for treating patients with neuromuscular disease. The authors show that such patients can receive standard curative treatment successfully, supporting cautious use of cisplatin regimens in this population.

pmid-9710695.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍29例の穿刺吸引細胞診標本を後方視的に再検討した研究である。22例で診断に適した細胞が得られ、すべて悪性と診断された。純粋型と混合型の両方で信頼できる診断が可能な細胞所見を示し、経験の浅い細胞診断医が誤診しやすい点も検討している。細胞診は有用な補助手段だが、組織診断を完全に代替することはできないと結論している。
pmid-9710695.summary_en: This retrospective review re-examined fine needle aspiration smears from 29 testicular germ cell tumors that had matching orchiectomy specimens and histologic diagnoses. Cytologic diagnosis was adequate in 22 cases, all diagnosed as malignant, while four were suspicious and three were non-diagnostic because of hemorrhage and necrosis. The authors describe cytologic features that allow reliable diagnosis of pure and mixed tumors, along with pitfalls that may mislead less experienced cytopathologists. They conclude that FNA is a helpful adjunct but cannot fully replace histologic diagnosis.

pmid-9712444.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対する予防的放射線療法(27例)とサーベイランス(41例)の長期成績を後方視的に比較した。追跡期間の中央値は、それぞれ15年と7.3年である。放射線療法群の1例は肺に再発して死亡し、サーベイランス群の5例は後腹膜リンパ節に再発したが化学療法で救済された。両群間に有意差はなく、頻回のフォローアップが確実に行われればサーベイランスは推奨されうるとされた。
pmid-9712444.summary_en: This retrospective survey compared long-term outcomes of 27 stage I testicular seminoma patients who received prophylactic radiotherapy after orchiectomy with 41 patients managed by surveillance alone. Median follow-up was 15 years in the radiotherapy group and 7.3 years in the surveillance group. One irradiated patient relapsed in the lung and died, while five surveillance patients relapsed in retroperitoneal nodes and were cured with chemotherapy. There was no significant difference between groups, and the authors suggest surveillance may be recommended when frequent follow-up is reliably maintained.

pmid-9713510.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍77例で、P糖タンパク(Pgp)、p53、メタロチオネイン(MT)の発現を免疫組織化学的に評価した研究である。Pgp陽性は進行病期と相関した。p53とMTの陽性は化学療法への良好な反応および良好な予後と関連した。Pgp陽性腫瘍の予後不良は、古典的な多剤耐性よりも、より進行性の悪性表現型によると考えられている。
pmid-9713510.summary_en: This study immunohistochemically evaluated P-glycoprotein, p53, and metallothionein expression in 77 germ cell testicular tumor specimens and examined their associations with stage and treatment outcome. Pgp positivity correlated with advanced stage, while p53 and MT immunoreactivity predicted better chemotherapy response and favorable outcome. Pgp and p53 showed an inverse association, whereas p53 and MT were strongly associated. The authors suggest that Pgp in certain tumors reflects a more progressive malignant phenotype rather than classic multidrug resistance.

pmid-9715278.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株とヒト胚細胞腫瘍を用い、FGF4の役割を検討した研究である。FGF4はレチノイン酸で抑制されるが、過剰発現させても分化は妨げられなかった。一方、異種移植腫瘍ではレチノイン酸による腫瘍抑制作用をFGF4が打ち消した。胎児性癌成分を含む胚細胞腫瘍、特に非セミノーマでFGF4発現が多く、分化シグナルと抗腫瘍シグナルは分離しうると結論している。
pmid-9715278.summary_en: This study examined fibroblast growth factor-4 (FGF4) in human embryonal carcinoma cells and patient germ cell tumors. FGF4 was repressed by retinoic acid in sensitive lines but not in resistant ones, and overexpression did not block differentiation. However, FGF4 overexpression overcame the tumor-suppressive effect of retinoic acid in xenografts. FGF4 expression was more frequent in germ cell tumors with embryonal carcinoma components, especially non-seminomas. The findings suggest that differentiation and antitumor retinoic acid signals can be dissociated in germ cell cancer.

pmid-9716562.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎から新規cDNAのCHMS-1をクローニングし、TNF受容体2と相同性を持つことを示した研究である。CHMS-1は正常胎盤に比べ胞状奇胎で高発現し、持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍や絨毛癌由来細胞では検出されなかった。悪性転化の過程で発現が低下する可能性がある。胞状奇胎の後期に腫瘍退縮へ関与しうると考察している。
pmid-9716562.summary_en: This study cloned a novel cDNA, CHMS-1, from a complete hydatidiform mole and found it shares homology with TNF receptor 2 and contains a death domain. CHMS-1 was highly expressed in molar tissue compared with normal placenta and matched the expression pattern of TNF-R1. It was undetectable in persistent gestational trophoblastic tumor and in choriocarcinoma-derived JEG-3 cells, suggesting downregulation during malignant transformation of trophoblast. The authors propose that CHMS-1 may participate in tumor regression during later molar development.

pmid-9716865.summary_ja: 副鼻腔に発生し、頭蓋内の中頭蓋窩と後頭蓋窩へ進展した悪性の未熟奇形腫の生後3か月児の症例報告である。生検で診断され、化学療法後に経鼻内視鏡手術で完全切除された。術後10か月のMRIと内視鏡検査で再発は認めなかった。選択された症例では、外切開アプローチに代わる良い選択肢になりうると述べている。
pmid-9716865.summary_en: This report describes a three-month-old infant with an immature malignant teratoma arising from the paranasal sinuses and extending intracranially into the middle and posterior fossae. Biopsy confirmed the diagnosis, and chemotherapy was given before complete endoscopic endonasal resection without complications. At 10 months of follow-up with MRI and endoscopy, there was no recurrence. The authors suggest that endonasal endoscopic removal may be a good alternative to external approaches in selected cases because it reduces operative trauma.

pmid-9719944.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に伴う腹腔内播種を呈した42歳男性の症例報告です。未分化セミノーマ細胞が腹水と陰嚢水腫液から検出されました。BEP化学療法により腹水と腫瘍マーカーは著明に減少しました。リンパ節や遠隔転移を伴わない精巣腫瘍の腹腔内播種として初の報告とされています。
pmid-9719944.summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with a right testicular tumor, left hydrocele, and massive ascites, with markedly elevated LDH but no distant metastases. Right high orchiectomy and fluid sampling showed anaplastic seminoma cells in the testis, ascites, and hydrocele fluid. Three cycles of BEP chemotherapy reduced the ascites and tumor markers. The authors suggest intraperitoneal spread followed the spermatic cord, though the route to the contralateral hydrocele is unclear. This is reported as the first testicular tumor showing intraperitoneal dissemination without nodal or distant metastasis.

pmid-9720507.summary_ja: 精巣の性索間質性腫瘍と胚細胞腫瘍の免疫組織化学的マーカーを比較した研究です。インヒビンAは感度が最も高く、胚細胞腫瘍では全く陽性を示しませんでした。インヒビンは性索間質性腫瘍と胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別する特徴的マーカーと結論づけられています。
pmid-9720507.summary_en: The authors compared immunohistochemical markers in testicular sex cord-stromal tumors and germ cell tumors. Inhibin A was the most sensitive marker, expressed in 91% of Sertoli cell tumors and in all Sertoli and Leydig cell adenomas and benign Leydig cell tumors. It was also expressed in non-neoplastic Sertoli and Leydig cells, while none of the germ cell tumors stained. Chromogranin, synaptophysin, S-100, cytokeratins, and steroid receptors showed variable expression. Inhibin is proposed as a characteristic marker that distinguishes sex cord-stromal tumors from germ cell tumors.

pmid-9720544.summary_ja: 1980～1994年に経過観察を受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者76例を対象に、遵守状況と予後を検討しました。受診遵守率は1年目61.5%、2年目35.5%に低下し、CT検査の遵守率はさらに低いものでした。全体の遵守状況は不良でしたが、症例数が少ないため生存への影響は示せていません。
pmid-9720544.summary_en: This study assessed adherence to post-orchiectomy surveillance in 76 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treated at one centre from 1980 to 1994. Compliance with clinical visits fell from 61.5% in year 1 to 35.5% in year 2, and CT compliance was much lower at 25% and 11.8%. Relapse occurred in 37% of patients, at a median of 5.5 months after orchiectomy. Relapse occurred in 23 of 47 compliant and 5 of 29 noncompliant patients, and two noncompliant patients died of CNS disease. Overall compliance was poor, but the sample was too small to show an effect on survival.

pmid-9720678.summary_ja: 吸気性喘鳴と無呼吸発作を呈した新生児女児の中咽頭奇形腫の症例報告です。吸気時に喉頭へ吸い込まれて気道閉塞を起こしていました。CO2レーザーで切除し、病理組織学的検査で奇形腫と診断されました。術後経過は良好でした。
pmid-9720678.summary_en: A newborn girl presented with inspiratory stridor and apnoeic episodes caused by an oropharyngeal mass that was drawn into the larynx during inspiration. The mass was intubated under flexible endoscopic control and excised with a CO2 laser. Histopathology showed a teratoma of the oropharynx. The postoperative course was uneventful. The authors note that oropharyngeal teratomas are rare, are managed by surgical excision, and that airway security takes priority when respiratory distress is present.

pmid-9724341.summary_ja: Wiedemann-Beckwith症候群の新生児の胎盤(730g)に、間葉様および腸管様パターンを示す卵黄嚢腫瘍が2病巣見つかった症例です。胎盤に卵黄嚢腫瘍が発生した報告は初めてとされています。症候群に関連する胎盤異常と腫瘍の範囲を広げる知見です。
pmid-9724341.summary_en: The authors describe a placenta weighing 730 g from a newborn with Wiedemann-Beckwith syndrome, in which two foci of yolk sac tumor with mesenchyme-like and enteroid patterns were found. Yolk sac tumor had not previously been reported in the placenta. The case expands the spectrum of placental abnormalities in Wiedemann-Beckwith syndrome and adds to the list of tumors associated with the syndrome.

pmid-9724996.summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った98例を後方視的に検討した。97%で腫瘍を肉眼的に完全切除できたが、全例で血管手術を要した。急性尿細管壊死、腎萎縮、下大静脈切除後の静脈血栓症などの合併症がみられた。血管手術に習熟した外科医による治療が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-9724996.summary_en: This retrospective review of 98 men undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection (RPLND) for metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis examined vascular interventions and complications. Macroscopic tumour clearance was complete in 97 percent, and vascular procedures were required in every case. Major complications included acute tubular necrosis, progressive renal atrophy, colonic stricture, and iliac or femoral venous thrombosis after inferior vena cava excision. The authors conclude that complete clearance is achievable but needs vascular surgical expertise.

pmid-9725279.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫17例のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を後方視的に検討し、術前または術中に破裂が確認された7例と非破裂例を比較した。破裂例は胸痛や喀血などの重い症状が多く、全例で腫瘤内部成分が不均一であった。周囲の肺、胸膜、心膜の所見も破裂の徴候として有用と報告している。
pmid-9725279.summary_en: This retrospective study compared CT findings in 17 surgically resected mediastinal teratomas, seven of which had ruptured before or during surgery. Ruptured tumors more often caused severe symptoms such as chest pain or hemoptysis. Heterogeneous internal components were seen in all ruptured tumors, while most unruptured masses were homogeneous. Ancillary findings in adjacent lung, pleura, or pericardium, including fat-containing masses and effusions, also suggested rupture. The authors propose these CT features as signs of tumor rupture.

pmid-9725401.summary_ja: 8歳男児で思春期早発症と縦隔腫瘤を認め、クラインフェルター症候群を伴っていた症例報告である。文献検索で、この症状はクラインフェルター症候群の小児の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍で最も多いとされた。術前化学療法後に完全切除され、術後2年経過して良好である。同症候群の胚細胞腫瘍は約50倍多く、非セミノーマ性で若年発症し、精巣発生は稀と記載している。
pmid-9725401.summary_en: This case report describes an 8-year-old boy with precocious puberty and a mediastinal mass who had Klinefelter syndrome. A literature search showed that this presentation is most common with mediastinal germ cell tumours in children with Klinefelter syndrome. The tumour was completely resected after preoperative chemotherapy, and the patient remained well two years after surgery. The report notes that germ cell tumours in Klinefelter syndrome are about 50 times more common, usually nonseminomatous, occur at an earlier age, and are seldom testicular.

pmid-9725408.summary_ja: 本報告は、妊娠26週に子宮内で診断された胎児の心膜内腫瘍の症例を記述する。出生前の心エコー検査で胎児水腫の初期像が確認され、緊急手術の判断に用いられた。病理組織学的に良性奇形腫(grade I)と診断された。術後に予期せぬ縦隔腫瘍が見つかり、後に摘出されたが、これも良性奇形腫(grade 0)であった。両奇形腫は独立した原発性病変と結論づけられ、奇形腫による心タンポナーデと出生前モニタリングの有用性が示された。
pmid-9725408.summary_en: This report describes a fetal intrapericardial tumour diagnosed in utero at 26 weeks of gestation. Serial prenatal echocardiography tracked incipient hydrops and guided emergency surgery. Histology showed a benign grade I teratoma. After birth an unexpected mediastinal tumour was found and later removed, which was also a benign teratoma, grade 0. The authors concluded that the two teratomas were independent primary lesions. The case illustrates cardiac tamponade caused by a fetal teratoma and the value of prenatal monitoring.

pmid-9725767.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の手術検体49例と胚細胞腫瘍細胞株9株を、12p領域特異的プローブを用いた3色FISHで解析した。全腫瘍で12pの3つのバンドすべてに増幅を認めた。コピー数は4から11と症例ごとに異なったが、同一腫瘍のクローン内では一定であった。12p13の過剰表現を初めて報告し、複数の遺伝子が成人男性の発がんに関与すると示唆している。
pmid-9725767.summary_en: This study used triple-colour FISH with microdissected 12p band-specific probes to analyse 49 surgical specimens and nine germ cell tumour cell lines. Amplification of all three 12p bands was found in every tumour. Copy number varied from four to eleven and was consistent within clones of the same tumour, and i(12p) and AMP12p never coexisted in one cell. Overrepresentation of 12p13 was described for the first time. The findings support the idea that several 12p genes contribute to the oncogenesis of adult male germ cell tumours.

pmid-9727244.summary_ja: 初発の後腹膜病変から9年後に顕在化した原発性精巣セミノーマの症例報告である。原発が性腺外にあると考えられ、精巣の病変が見落とされやすい診断の難しさが示されている。後腹膜腫瘤を認めた場合には、原発巣が他にみえても精巣の慎重な評価が必要と強調している。治療成績ではなく診断上の課題に焦点を当てた短報である。
pmid-9727244.summary_en: This case report describes primary testicular seminoma that presented nine years after an initial episode of retroperitoneal disease. The delay illustrates the diagnostic difficulty associated with primary extragonadal germ cell tumours, in which the testicular origin may be obscured. The authors emphasize that a retroperitoneal mass should prompt careful evaluation of the testes, even when the primary site appears to be elsewhere. The report is brief and focuses on diagnostic challenge rather than treatment outcomes.

pmid-9727259.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の28歳男性で、画像検査により脾転移が確認された症例報告である。癌腫からの脾転移は稀で、本腫瘍型では脾臓への進展は非典型的である。脾病変は化学療法で消失し、報告時点で1年間の完全寛解が続いていた。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の画像評価では、脾臓も転移の確認対象となりうることを示している。
pmid-9727259.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old man with germ cell tumour of the testis in whom splenic metastasis was demonstrated radiologically. Splenic metastasis from carcinomas is rare, and the spleen is an unusual site of spread for this tumour type. The splenic lesion resolved with chemotherapy, and the patient had been in complete remission for one year at the time of reporting. The case suggests the spleen should be considered as a possible metastatic site when evaluating testicular germ cell tumours by imaging.

pmid-9728211.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の管理について、サーベイランス、補助化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を比較したレビューである。生存率はほぼ同等で、合併症も少なく、治療費も大差ないと結論づけている。自己管理の確実な患者には選択的サーベイランスが安全とされる。長期成績が不明な補助化学療法より、経験豊富な施設では初回の補助的RPLNDが推奨されている。
pmid-9728211.summary_en: This review examines management options for stage I nonseminomatous germ cell cancer, comparing surveillance, adjuvant chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The author concludes that survival is nearly identical across options, with low morbidity and similar costs. Surveillance is financially favoured, and selective surveillance may be safe for reliable patients. Less motivated patients may be better served by primary therapy. Without long-term data on adjuvant chemotherapy, primary RPLND is preferred where surgical support is experienced, and the author's preferred approach is selective surveillance with modified RPLND for others.

pmid-9728212.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の臨床病期I精巣セミノーマに対する、サーベイランス、補助放射線療法、補助化学療法の3つの治療選択肢を比較したレビューです。多くの施設では後腹膜への補助放射線療法が標準ですが、サーベイランスの成功やCTの進歩を受けて再検討が進んでいます。各治療法の利点と欠点を整理し、サーベイランスが臨床における治療の選択肢の中でどこに位置づけられるかを示しています。
pmid-9728212.summary_en: This review examines surveillance as a management option for clinical stage I testicular seminoma after orchiectomy, compared with adjuvant radiotherapy and adjuvant chemotherapy. It notes that adjuvant retroperitoneal radiotherapy remains the standard at most centers, but that the success of surveillance in nonseminomatous tumors and advances in computed tomography have prompted reconsideration. Available surveillance and adjuvant radiotherapy series suggest nearly all patients are cured regardless of approach. The authors weigh the advantages and disadvantages of each option and define where surveillance fits in clinical practice.

pmid-9728213.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の臨床病期I精巣がんの治療をまとめたレビューです。セミノーマでは補助放射線療法が長く標準であり、再発例の多くは化学療法で救済され、全生存率は約98%です。サーベイランスは過剰治療を減らせますが、長期フォローアップの負担があります。放射線療法後の二次悪性腫瘍や、補助カルボプラチンの役割についても論じています。
pmid-9728213.summary_en: This review summarizes management of clinical stage I testicular cancer. For seminoma, adjuvant radiotherapy after orchiectomy has long been standard, with few relapses that are mostly salvaged by chemotherapy and overall survival near 98%. Surveillance spares most patients overtreatment but requires long-term follow-up, which can be burdensome, and relapses occur mostly in para-aortic nodes. The authors also discuss concerns about second malignancies after radiotherapy and the limited role of carboplatin as adjuvant therapy given the lack of reliable prognostic factors.

pmid-9728214.summary_ja: 病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療を概説したレビューです。従来は後腹膜リンパ節郭清が初回治療の中心で、化学療法は補助療法として使われてきました。化学療法の有効性を示すエビデンスの増加により、化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清はいずれも初回治療や二次的な補助治療として位置づけられています。管理には、リスク層別化と患者の希望の反映が重要であると述べています。
pmid-9728214.summary_en: This article reviews the treatment of clinical stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Historically, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was the primary treatment, with chemotherapy used as adjuvant therapy. Growing evidence for chemotherapy efficacy has expanded options, so both chemotherapy and RPLND now have roles as primary therapy and as secondary adjunctive treatment. The authors emphasize that management requires careful risk stratification and incorporating patient preferences into the treatment decision-making algorithm.

pmid-9728215.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清の意義をまとめたレビューです。リンパ節転移陽性は26〜30%で、補助化学療法を行わない場合、3分の2は再発せず、再発例は化学療法で救済されます。陰性例は長期的な毒性がなく、QOLもサーベイランス群より良好とされています。
pmid-9728215.summary_en: This review examines retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for staging and treating clinical stage I nerve-sparing nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, focusing on nerve-sparing techniques. About 26 to 30 percent of cases are node positive, and without adjuvant chemotherapy two-thirds do not relapse, with relapses rescued by chemotherapy. Node-negative patients have no long-term toxicity and better quality of life than surveillance patients. Risk-benefit and cost-benefit analyses support RPLND's competitive position among several reasonable options chosen by regional availability and experience.

pmid-9728217.summary_ja: 病期II・IIIの精巣がんにおいて、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を省略できるかを検討したレビューです。1970年代に導入されたシスプラチン併用化学療法により、手術単独では治せなかった大容量転移性疾患の患者も治癒が可能になりました。化学療法が主要な役割を担う一方、化学療法後の手術は治癒の可能性を高める補完的な役割を果たしてきたと述べています。
pmid-9728217.summary_en: This review considers whether retroperitoneal lymph node dissection can be omitted after chemotherapy in patients with stage II and III testicular cancer. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy, introduced in the 1970s, transformed outcomes for patients with high-volume metastatic disease, who could not be cured by surgery alone. Although chemotherapy plays the major role, post-chemotherapy surgery has been complementary in improving the overall chance of cure for these patients.

pmid-9728218.summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍における近年の進展をまとめたレビューです。標準治療であるBEP療法4サイクルで約半数が治癒し、従来用量の化学療法でBEPを上回るレジメンは示されていません。造血幹細胞移植などを伴う大量化学療法を初回治療とする無作為化試験が2件行われています。予後不良の判定には国際胚細胞腫瘍コンセンサス分類を統一して用いるべきだと強調しています。
pmid-9728218.summary_en: This review summarizes recent developments in poor-risk germ cell tumors. Standard treatment remains four cycles of BEP chemotherapy, curing about half of patients, and no conventional-dose regimen has proven superior. Preliminary data on high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell or bone marrow transplantation prompted two randomized trials as initial therapy. The authors stress that the International Germ Cell Consensus Classification should be uniformly applied to determine poor-risk status for both clinical decisions and trial risk assignment.

pmid-9728219.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者のフォローアップにおける費用対効果の高い戦略を論じたレビューです。自然経過、画像診断などの検査の精度と費用、再発時の治療効果を基盤にすべきとしています。病期Iと病期IIの自然経過(晩期再発を含む)を整理し、画像診断の精度と費用を検討したうえで、効率的なフォローアップのための一般的な推奨を提案しています。
pmid-9728219.summary_en: This review discusses cost-effective strategies for follow-up of patients with germ cell tumors. Such strategies should rest on the natural history of the disease, the accuracy and cost of diagnostic tests, and the efficacy of therapy when recurrence is detected. The authors describe the natural history of stage I and stage II tumors, including late recurrences, review the accuracy and cost of imaging modalities, and propose general recommendations for efficient surveillance.

pmid-9728220.summary_ja: 精巣がんの治療後に生じうる長期的な副作用をまとめたレビューです。診断時は若年者が多いため、手術・放射線療法・化学療法による晩期の影響が大きな懸念となります。新しい治療は照射野の縮小やブレオマイシンの除外などで毒性を減らしつつ高い治癒率を維持することを目指しています。治療による全生存期間と無病生存期間の利益は、持続的な副作用のリスクをはるかに上回ると結論づけています。
pmid-9728220.summary_en: This review addresses long-term side effects of treatment for testis cancer. Because patients are often young at diagnosis, consequences of surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy are a major concern. Newer regimens aim to reduce toxicity while preserving high cure rates, by limiting radiation fields, decreasing chemotherapy cycles, and eliminating bleomycin. The authors conclude that for newly diagnosed patients the benefits for overall and disease-free survival far outweigh the limited probability of persistent treatment-related effects.

pmid-9731905.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍149例を対象に、後腹膜転移の予測因子を検討した。胎児性癌の割合と血管侵襲が独立した危険因子であり、両者の組み合わせで88%の症例で病理病期を正しく予測できた。p53などの他のマーカーには予後的意義は認められなかった。精巣摘除標本でこれらの所見を評価し、治療方針の決定に役立てることが推奨される。
pmid-9731905.summary_en: This study aimed to identify risk factors predicting occult retroperitoneal metastasis in patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Among 149 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, the percentage of embryonal carcinoma and vascular invasion were the strongest independent predictors of pathologic stage II disease. Combining these two factors correctly predicted final pathologic stage in 88% of patients. Other markers, including p53, bcl-2, MIB-1, cathepsin D, and E-cadherin, showed no prognostic value. The authors recommend routine evaluation of these features in orchiectomy specimens to guide management.

pmid-9732501.summary_ja: 新生児の頸部奇形腫の症例を報告し、MRIの有用性を強調している。頸部奇形腫は稀で、大きな嚢胞性腫瘤として気道圧迫をきたすことがある。嚢胞性リンパ管腫との鑑別や緊急手術の計画においてMRIが重要であると述べられている。画像診断が新生児の頸部奇形腫の評価に不可欠であることを示している。
pmid-9732501.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with cervical teratoma, a rare head and neck germ cell tumor that often presents as a large cystic neck mass causing airway compromise. The authors emphasize that MRI is valuable in distinguishing teratoma from cystic hygroma and in planning urgent surgical resection. The paper also reviews the epidemiology and typical neuroepithelial and thyroid components of these lesions. It highlights imaging as a key tool in the preoperative assessment of neonatal cervical teratomas.

pmid-9736808.summary_ja: 17歳の女性に生じた24cmの卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の症例である。左付属器切除術と放射線療法2サイクルを受けた。その後13年間無月経が続いたが自然妊娠し、33週で生児を出産した。放射線療法後の無月経は早発閉経と即断すべきでなく、一時的な卵巣機能障害の可能性があると結論づけている。
