pmid-9736808.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old with a 24 cm ovarian dysgerminoma treated with left adnexectomy and two cycles of radiotherapy. Thirteen years of amenorrhea with high gonadotropin levels followed, which might have been mistaken for premature menopause. The patient then conceived spontaneously and delivered a live fetus at 33 weeks. The authors conclude that post-radiotherapy amenorrhea with elevated gonadotropins does not always indicate precocious menopause, since radiotherapy may cause only temporary ovarian dysfunction.

pmid-9737244.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の転移巣に生じた腎芽腫様腫瘍を9例で検討した。原始尿細管、芽体成分、間質からなる三相性の構造を示し、2例では横紋筋分化が認められた。外科的切除を受けた多くの患者は長期生存し、原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍との鑑別が重要とされている。
pmid-9737244.summary_en: This study reviewed nine men with testicular germ cell tumors who developed nephroblastoma-like tumors at metastatic sites. These lesions showed a triphasic pattern of primitive tubules, blastema, and stroma, with skeletal muscle differentiation in two cases. Neuroendocrine markers were negative. Most patients treated with surgical excision had prolonged survival, with six alive without disease after 4 to 12 years. The authors emphasize distinguishing these tumors from primitive neuroectodermal tumors, which have a more aggressive course and fatal outcome.

pmid-9737245.summary_ja: POG/CCGの治療試験に登録された小児の未熟奇形腫を主体とする胚細胞腫瘍135例を検討した。全ての混合型腫瘍に卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分が認められた。2〜6年生存率は96%で、再発予測因子は未熟奇形腫の悪性度ではなく顕微鏡的な卵黄嚢腫瘍の存在であった。病理診断の誤りも指摘されている。
pmid-9737245.summary_en: This review of 135 pediatric germ cell tumors with a major immature teratoma component from POG/CCG protocols classifies cases as pure immature teratoma or mixed tumors. Yolk sac tumor foci were present in all mixed tumors and correlated with stage and grade. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated in most tumors containing yolk sac tumor. The overall 2- to 6-year survival was 96%, and microscopic yolk sac tumor foci, rather than immature teratoma grade, predicted recurrence. Pathologists frequently misclassified differentiated tissues and overlooked yolk sac tumor patterns.

pmid-9738766.summary_ja: 先天性頭頸部奇形腫の乳児6例(頸部4例、鼻咽腔2例)を後方視的に検討した報告です。全例で外科的切除が行われ、再発は認められませんでした。難しい症例では、術後のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)測定による再発モニタリングを推奨しています。
pmid-9738766.summary_en: This retrospective review of six infants with congenital head and neck teratomas, four cervical and two nasopharyngeal, describes surgical excision as the treatment, with no recurrence observed. The authors also review the literature from referral centers. They recommend postoperative AFP monitoring for recurrence in difficult cases, alongside clinical and radiographic follow-up.

pmid-9740429.summary_ja: 1990年から1996年に良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された84例を対象に、腹腔鏡下切除の安全性を検討した前向き研究です。嚢胞切除術は47例、卵巣摘除術は37例で行われました。内容物の漏出は11例に起きたものの、腹膜炎や発熱は生じず、平均術後在院日数は0.9日でした。
pmid-9740429.summary_en: This prospective protocol study of 84 women with benign ovarian cystic teratomas (1990 to 1996) evaluated laparoscopic resection using an EndoCatch bag. Cystectomy was performed in 47 patients and oophorectomy in 37. Spillage occurred in 11 cases without peritonitis or fever. Mean postoperative stay was 0.9 days, leading the authors to conclude that laparoscopic resection is safe, well tolerated, and shortens hospitalization.

pmid-9740707.summary_ja: 49歳女性の子宮内膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告です。不正性器出血で受診し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の免疫染色で確認されました。化学療法は拒否し、放射線療法を受けた後、術後28か月間無病で経過しています。既報4例との比較から、卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍との類似性が示されています。
pmid-9740707.summary_en: A 49-year-old woman presented with abnormal uterine bleeding and was found to have a primary yolk sac tumor of the endometrium, confirmed by alpha-fetoprotein immunostaining. She declined chemotherapy and received external radiotherapy, remaining disease-free for 28 months. The report reviews four previously published cases and notes clinical and pathological similarities to ovarian yolk sac tumors.

pmid-9740709.summary_ja: 閉経後女性に発生した卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍と、子宮内膜症から生じた類内膜腺癌が併存した症例です。経過は攻撃的で化学療法に反応せず、術後6か月で死亡しました。両成分でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の発現が認められ、性ステロイドホルモン受容体とp53の発現は内膜症組織と癌組織で逆の傾向を示しました。
pmid-9740709.summary_en: This report describes a postmenopausal woman with an ovarian yolk sac tumor arising alongside endometrioid adenocarcinoma from endometriosis. The tumor followed an aggressive course, did not respond to chemotherapy, and the patient died six months after surgery. Immunohistochemistry showed AFP expression in both components, and the authors describe an inverse pattern of sex steroid receptors and p53 between endometriotic and carcinomatous tissue.

pmid-9743088.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理、臨床像、病期分類を含む包括的な総説です。予後分類別の化学療法(BEP療法、EP療法)、残存腫瘤の外科的切除、臨床病期Iや小容積の病期IIに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清と監視療法の位置づけを解説しています。晩期合併症にも言及しています。
pmid-9743088.summary_en: This review covers male germ cell tumors, including pathology, clinical presentation, and staging. It summarizes chemotherapy regimens (BEP, EP) by risk group, the role of residual-mass resection, and RPLND and surveillance for stage I and small-volume stage II disease. Radiotherapy for seminoma and treatment-related late effects, including etoposide-induced leukemia and preservation of ejaculatory function, are also discussed.

pmid-9743309.summary_ja: 中等度予後の転移性精巣非セミノーマ84例を対象に、VIP療法4コースとBEP療法4コースを比較した無作為化試験です。完全奏効率は両群で同程度(74%対79%)で、再発率、無病生存期間、全生存期間にも差はありませんでした。VIP療法は骨髄毒性が強く、ブレオマイシンを通常用量のイホスファミドで置き換えるべきではないと結論づけています。
pmid-9743309.summary_en: This randomized EORTC trial compared four cycles of VIP (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) with four cycles of BEP in 84 patients with intermediate-prognosis metastatic testicular non-seminoma. Complete response rates were similar (74% vs 79%), as were relapse, disease-free and overall survival, and 5-year PFS (85% vs 83%). VIP caused more bone marrow toxicity. Bleomycin should not be replaced by conventional-dose ifosfamide.

pmid-9743698.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞精巣腫瘍72例を対象とした研究です。脈管侵襲と原発腫瘍の組織型に応じて、補助化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、監視療法を使い分けました。全生存率は98.6%でした。著者らは、脈管侵襲のない症例にのみ監視療法を続ける方針としています。
pmid-9743698.summary_en: This study of 72 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors stratified treatment by histology after orchiectomy. Patients with vascular invasion and embryonal carcinoma received adjuvant BEP; those with vascular invasion and teratomatous elements underwent primary RPLND; those without vascular invasion were managed by surveillance. Overall survival was 98.6%, and the authors will continue surveillance only for patients without vascular invasion.

pmid-9744468.summary_ja: 甲状腺原発悪性奇形腫の若年女性2例の症例報告です。精巣腫瘍の大量病変に用いられるレジメンを参考に、積極的な化学療法を行いました。1例では部分奏効後に残存病変の外科的切除を実施しています。両例とも32か月以上無病で生存しています。胚細胞腫瘍に準じた治療が有効であると示唆されています。
pmid-9744468.summary_en: This report describes two young women with primary malignant teratoma of the thyroid, treated with aggressive combination chemotherapy modeled on regimens for high-volume testicular tumors, followed by surgery for residual disease in one patient. Both patients remained alive and disease-free at 32 and 26-plus months. The authors suggest that thyroid malignant teratoma is chemosensitive and may be managed like germ cell tumors.

pmid-9750020.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株11種について、G-CSFやGM-CSFなどの造血ペプチド増殖因子の産生を検討した前臨床研究です。細胞株H12.1ではSCFによりインビトロで増殖が促進されました。ヌードマウス異種移植モデルではG-CSFとSCFの併用で腫瘍体積が対照より増加傾向を示し、臨床試験の前にさらなる検討が必要とされました。
pmid-9750020.summary_en: This preclinical study screened eleven human non-seminomatous germ cell tumour cell lines for hematopoietic peptide growth factor production, including G-CSF, GM-CSF, SCF, M-CSF, and IL-6. In vitro, SCF stimulated growth of cell line H12.1. In nude mouse xenografts, however, SCF alone had no significant effect, while G-CSF combined with SCF showed higher relative tumor volumes than control. The authors conclude that this combination requires further preclinical study before clinical trials in germ cell tumor patients receiving chemotherapy.

pmid-9751352.summary_ja: ブレオマイシンを含む化学療法後に外科的切除を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者77例を対象とした研究です。術後の酸素飽和度低下は25%に認められ、輸血量、術前努力肺活量、手術時間が独立した予測因子でした。周術期の酸素制限は不要であり、輸液管理が重要とされています。
pmid-9751352.summary_en: This study of 77 patients with high-volume stage II to IV nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent 97 major surgeries after bleomycin-containing chemotherapy examined predictors of postoperative pulmonary morbidity. Postoperative oxygen saturation problems occurred in 25% of patients. On multivariate analysis, transfusion volume, preoperative forced vital capacity, and surgical time were significant predictors, while intraoperative inspired oxygen fraction was not. The authors conclude that perioperative oxygen restriction is unnecessary in bleomycin-treated patients and emphasize fluid management.

pmid-9751353.summary_ja: 精巣がん186例で対側精巣生検の結果を検討し、二次性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高い群を定義した研究です。対側精巣の萎縮と若年発症が上皮内癌と独立して関連し、31歳未満で萎縮を伴う群は全体の約6%と推定されました。この群に絞った対側生検は、上皮内癌の効率的な検出につながると結論されています。
pmid-9751353.summary_en: This study evaluated 186 testicular cancer patients who underwent contralateral testicular biopsy because of a maldescent history or an atrophic contralateral testis, to define those at high risk for carcinoma in situ and a second germ cell tumor. Contralateral atrophy, low sperm density, young age, and low Johnsen score were associated with positive biopsies. Multivariate analysis identified only atrophy and age as independent determinants. Patients with an atrophic contralateral testis presenting at 31 years or younger were at high risk and comprised about 6% of testicular cancer patients. The authors propose that biopsy in this group would be productive.

pmid-9754641.summary_ja: デンマークの助産師記録をもとに、35歳未満の精巣がんの組織型ごとに周産期因子との関連を検討した症例対照研究です。母親が30～45歳、初産、早産の徴候を2つ以上持つ新生児でリスクの上昇が見られました。停留精巣との関連は1955年以降に生まれた男児では認められませんでした。初産のリスクは主にセミノーマで認められ、母親の年齢と統計的に有意な関連があったのは奇形腫のみでした。
pmid-9754641.summary_en: This Danish study examined whether perinatal factors recorded by midwives shortly after birth were associated with specific histological types of testicular cancer in men under 35. The case-control analysis included 357 cases and 704 controls born 1950-1968. Maternal age of 30-45 years and first birth carried higher risk, and newborns with two or more signs of prematurity had an odds ratio of 1.62. Undescended testis was linked to cancer only before 1955. The risk for first births was mainly seen for seminomas, and only teratomas showed a statistically significant association with maternal age.

pmid-9755714.summary_ja: 1992～1994年に超音波検査で診断された精巣微小石灰化の5症例と、報告された124例の文献レビューをまとめた論文です。精巣悪性腫瘍は44例（35%）に認められ、内訳はセミノーマ24例、非セミノーマ20例でした。微小石灰化の診断後に精巣がんを発症した例が4例ありました。著者は本疾患を前がん状態とみなし、慎重なフォローアップを推奨しています。
pmid-9755714.summary_en: This report describes five cases of testicular microlithiasis diagnosed by ultrasonography between 1992 and 1994, combined with a literature review of 124 reported cases. Testicular malignancy was found in 44 patients (35%), including 24 seminomas and 20 non-seminomas. Four patients developed testicular cancer after an earlier diagnosis of microlithiasis. The authors conclude that the condition should be regarded as premalignant and that affected patients require careful follow-up.

pmid-9758182.summary_ja: 精巣がんが頸部に転移した6症例を報告しています。初回治療は組織型に応じて放射線療法や化学療法が行われ、残存した頸部腫瘤に対して3例は改変頸部郭清術を受け無病生存となりました。一方、非外科的な補助療法のみを受けた3例は原病で死亡しています。鎖骨上部の頸部腫瘤では精巣転移を考慮すべきで、化学療法後の残存腫瘤には外科的切除が有用と考えられます。
pmid-9758182.summary_en: This report describes six patients with testicular carcinoma metastatic to the neck, all initially treated with radiation, chemotherapy, or both depending on histology. Neck masses persisted in several cases. Three patients underwent subsequent modified neck dissection and remained disease-free, while three others who received nonsurgical adjuvant therapy died of their cancer. The authors suggest that supraclavicular neck masses should prompt consideration of testicular metastasis and that residual masses after chemotherapy may warrant surgical resection.

pmid-9758270.summary_ja: 38週で出生前超音波検査により心臓内奇形腫が診断された新生児の症例報告です。分娩誘発後に急速に状態が悪化し、出生16時間後に死亡しました。剖検では心室中隔に4cmの嚢胞性成熟奇形腫が認められ、右心室へ進展していました。出生前に診断された良性心臓内奇形腫の初例と考えられ、出生前超音波検査の有用性を示しています。
pmid-9758270.summary_en: This report describes an infant with an intracardiac teratoma detected prenatally by ultrasound at 38 weeks of gestation, after earlier scans had been normal. Labor was induced, and the infant deteriorated rapidly and died 16 hours after birth. Necropsy revealed a 4 cm cystic mature teratoma in the interventricular septum extending into the right ventricle, with no other anomalies. The authors believe this is probably the first reported benign intracardiac teratoma diagnosed prenatally, highlighting the role of prenatal ultrasound in detecting primary cardiac tumors.

pmid-9761166.summary_ja: 17歳女性の巨大な成熟充実性卵巣奇形腫に、腹膜および大網への神経膠組織の播種を伴った症例を報告した。術中に播種が悪性を疑われ子宮摘出が提案されたが家族が拒否したため、卵巣摘出術を施行した。病理組織学的検査で腫瘍と播種がいずれも良性と確認された。不要な過大手術を避けるため、神経膠組織の播種の良性の性質を認識することの重要性を強調している。
pmid-9761166.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with a massive mature solid ovarian teratoma and glial implants on the peritoneum and omentum, a condition known as gliomatosis peritonei. The large tumor made diagnosis difficult. Seedlings seen at laparotomy were initially suspected to be malignant, and hysterectomy was proposed but declined by the family. Oophorectomy was performed, and histopathology confirmed benign tumor and implants. The authors emphasize recognizing the benign nature of glial seedlings to avoid unnecessary extensive surgery.

pmid-9761167.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫を穿刺した際の合併症を扱った短い症例報告である。著者らは、類皮嚢腫を穿刺した場合は直ちに洗浄を伴う腹腔鏡下手術または開腹手術を行うべきだと助言している。これは嚢腫内容物の漏出に伴う問題を避けるためである。臨床的詳細は限られるが、卵巣成熟奇形腫の医原性破裂への実践的指針を示す警鐘的な報告である。
pmid-9761167.summary_en: This brief case report describes the complication of puncturing an ovarian dermoid cyst. The authors advise that when a dermoid cyst is punctured, immediate operative laparoscopy or laparotomy should be performed along with lavage. This is intended to avoid problems associated with spillage of cyst contents. The paper is a short cautionary report with limited clinical detail, but it offers practical guidance for managing iatrogenic rupture of ovarian mature teratomas.

pmid-9762943.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者153例の化学療法後残存腫瘤を病理組織学的に再検討した後方視的研究である。中央値7年の追跡で25%が増悪した。切除が不完全なことと悪性成分の存在が独立した危険因子であった。完全切除例では胎児性癌が最も強い増悪因子で、その2年無増悪生存率は12.5%であり、不在の例では88.0%であった。無増悪生存率は切除の完全性と悪性胚細胞成分の有無で予測されると結論づけている。
pmid-9762943.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed histopathology of residual masses from 153 germ cell tumor patients after chemotherapy, with a median follow-up of 7 years. Progression occurred in 25 percent. Incomplete resection and malignant elements were independent risk factors. Among completely resected patients, embryonal carcinoma was the strongest predictor of progression, with 2-year progression-free survival of 12.5 percent versus 88.0 percent when absent. The authors conclude that progression-free survival is predicted by complete excision and the presence of malignant germ cell components.

pmid-9762997.summary_ja: 経験豊富な超音波検査医が、特定の超音波所見のみで卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫を診断できるかを検討した。2名の検査医が252例の付属器腫瘤を標準化されたチェックリストで独立に評価した。各検査医の陽性的中率は98%、感度は85%であった。関連所見を2つ以上有する腫瘤では陽性的中率が100%であった。2つ以上の所見がある付属器腫瘤は嚢胞性奇形腫と確実に診断できると結論づけている。
pmid-9762997.summary_en: This study assessed whether experienced sonologists could diagnose ovarian cystic teratomas using specific sonographic features alone. Two sonologists independently reviewed 252 adnexal masses using a standardized checklist. Each reviewer achieved 98% positive predictive value and 85% sensitivity for cystic teratoma. Masses with two or more associated features were diagnosed with 100% positive predictive value. Individual features such as shadowing echodensity showed variable predictive values. The authors conclude that an adnexal mass with two or more features can be confidently diagnosed as cystic teratoma.

pmid-9763059.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対する細胞毒性化学療法が、その後の生殖能力に与える影響を検討した。単一施設に登録された生存者1211例のうち96%から回答が得られた。妊娠を試みた728例の大半が少なくとも1回の生児出産を報告した。メトトレキサート単剤群と多剤併用化学療法群の間に差はなかった。帝王切開と死産の頻度は予想より高かった。使用された化学療法レジメンが、その後の生殖能力に与える影響は最小限であると結論づけている。
pmid-9763059.summary_en: This study examined how cytotoxic chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic disease affects later reproductive performance. Of 1211 survivors registered at a single center, 96% responded to a questionnaire. Among 728 women who attempted pregnancy, most reported at least one live birth. Methotrexate monotherapy and multi-agent chemotherapy groups showed no differences in outcomes. Caesarean section and stillbirth rates were higher than expected. The authors conclude that the chemotherapy protocols used had minimal impact on subsequent reproductive ability.

pmid-9764350.summary_ja: 正常胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性疾患を含む病的胎盤でFasリガンド(FasL)の発現とアポトーシスを検討した。FasLは免疫染色とRT-PCRで確認され、アポトーシスはTUNEL法で評価された。FasLは正常胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性疾患の双方に認められ、アポトーシス白血球はFasLの分布と一致して母体-胎児境界に局在した。胎盤のFasLが父親由来の同種抗原に対する母体の免疫寛容に寄与すると提唱している。
pmid-9764350.summary_en: This study investigated Fas ligand expression and apoptosis in normal and pathologic placentas, including gestational trophoblastic disease, to determine whether Fas-FasL-induced apoptosis occurs during implantation. FasL was detected by immunohistochemistry and confirmed by RT-PCR, and apoptosis was assessed by TUNEL. FasL was present in normal placentas and in gestational trophoblastic disease, and apoptotic leukocytes localized to the maternal-fetal interface, matching FasL distribution. The authors propose that placental FasL contributes to maternal immune tolerance to paternal alloantigens.

pmid-9764375.summary_ja: 本単施設研究は、15年間に治療された精巣セミノーマ314例を対象とし、特に病期Iの管理を検討した。サーベイランスと精巣摘除術後放射線療法を比較したところ、サーベイランス群で再発が多かった(15%対4%)が、全生存期間は両群で同等であり、病期I患者の腫瘍関連死は両群ともになかった。術前血清β-hCGの上昇は病期I患者の18%、病期II患者の62%に認められ、進行病期とは関連したが生存とは関連しなかった。著者らは、集中的なフォローアップが可能であればサーベイランスは安全な代替法であると結論づけている。
pmid-9764375.summary_en: This single-institution study reviewed 314 patients with testicular seminoma over 15 years, focusing on Stage I management. Surveillance was compared with postorchidectomy radiotherapy. Relapse was more frequent with surveillance (15% versus 4%), yet overall survival was identical, with no tumor-related deaths among Stage I patients in either group. Elevated preoperative beta-hCG was seen in 18% of Stage I and 62% of Stage II patients, associated with advanced disease but not survival. The authors conclude that surveillance is a safe alternative when intensive follow-up is feasible.

pmid-9764651.summary_ja: 46,XX純粋性腺異形成の18歳女性に生じた、合胞体栄養膜巨細胞を伴うディスジャーミノーマの症例報告である。血清hCGは上昇し、巨細胞内にhCGが免疫組織化学的に検出された。病期Iで、腫瘍DNAにSRY遺伝子は認められなかった。
pmid-9764651.summary_en: This case report describes a dysgerminoma with syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells arising in an 18-year-old with 46,XX pure gonadal dysgenesis. The patient had elevated serum hCG, and hCG was detected within the giant cells by immunohistochemistry. The tumor was clinically stage Ia and no SRY sequence was found. The authors suggest that this rare ovarian tumor can arise from dysgenetic gonads without an identifiable Y chromosome component, in addition to gonadoblastoma and pure dysgerminoma.

pmid-9766571.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞とJEG-3細胞を用い、持続的な高血糖がグルコース輸送に与える影響を検討した研究である。JAR細胞では高血糖によりVmaxが増加し、GLUT1とGLUT3の発現が変化した。JEG-3細胞では変化は認められなかった。
pmid-9766571.summary_en: This in vitro study examined how sustained hyperglycemia affects glucose transport in choriocarcinoma-derived JAR and JEG-3 cells. JAR cells cultured in 25 mM glucose showed increased uptake through higher Vmax, with GLUT1 and GLUT3 expression changed accordingly. JEG-3 cells were not affected. The authors suggest that hyperglycemia-induced transporter changes may contribute to the adjuvant benefit of glucose in tumor therapy.

pmid-9766648.summary_ja: 化学療法に感受性の17例と抵抗性の17例の男性胚細胞腫瘍を、比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションで解析した研究である。抵抗性腫瘍の5例で8つの増幅領域が同定された。染色体増幅がシスプラチン抵抗性への経路となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9766648.summary_en: This study used comparative genomic hybridization on 17 chemotherapy-sensitive and 17 resistant male germ cell tumors. High-level amplification was rare in sensitive tumors but present in resistant ones, identifying eight amplified regions in five resistant tumors. These regions suggest that chromosomal amplification may be a pathway to cisplatin resistance. The authors propose that the amplified or overexpressed genes at these sites could reveal new mechanisms of chemotherapy resistance in germ cell tumors.

pmid-9766657.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3およびBeWoと胎盤で、糖転移酵素の活性とmRNA発現を比較した研究である。癌細胞ではα2→6シアリルトランスフェラーゼとα1→2フコシルトランスフェラーゼの活性が数倍上昇していた。この変化は転写レベルで制御されていると結論された。
pmid-9766657.summary_en: This study compared glycosyltransferase activities and mRNA levels in human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 and BeWo cells with placenta. The alpha2-3 sialyltransferase activity was unchanged, whereas alpha2-6 sialyltransferase and alpha1-2 fucosyltransferase activities were several times higher in the cancer cells. Competitive PCR showed corresponding increases in their mRNA levels. The authors conclude that these glycan structural changes during tumorigenesis are regulated at the transcriptional level.

pmid-9769381.summary_ja: 組織学的に純粋なセミノーマでAFPが16 ng/ml以下に上昇した10例を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分は認められず、平均6年の追跡で卵黄嚢腫瘍の発生はなかった。軽度のAFP上昇は隠れた卵黄嚢腫瘍を示さない可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9769381.summary_en: This study reviewed 10 cases of histologically pure seminoma with elevated serum AFP (10.4 to 16 ng/ml). None had yolk sac tumor components, and AFP staining was negative in tumor cells. Patients were treated according to either seminoma or nonseminoma protocols, and none developed evidence of yolk sac tumor at a mean follow-up of 6 years. One patient later developed a mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor with yolk sac tumor. The authors suggest that minor AFP elevations in pure seminoma may not indicate a hidden yolk sac component.

pmid-9770367.summary_ja: 正常栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞株(BeWo、Jeg-3、JAr)で分化誘導と浸潤能の関係を比較した研究。hCG分泌は多くの薬剤で増加したが、浸潤能は細胞株により逆に変化した。分化療法が一部の腫瘍細胞で浸潤を促すおそれを指摘している。
pmid-9770367.summary_en: This study compares differentiation and invasiveness in normal trophoblast and choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, Jeg-3, JAr) treated with retinoic acid, methotrexate, dibutyryl-cAMP, or PMA. All agents stimulated chorionic gonadotropin secretion. In normal trophoblast and BeWo cells, invasion decreased as differentiation increased, showing an inverse relationship. In Jeg-3 and JAr cells, PMA (and retinoic acid in JAr) increased invasion. The authors conclude that differentiation therapy could unintentionally promote invasiveness in some tumor subpopulations, which has implications for choriocarcinoma treatment strategy.

pmid-9770582.summary_ja: 2歳男児の心臓内に生じた原発性卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。当初は横紋筋腫と疑われて手術されたが、病理組織学と免疫組織化学により悪性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。小児の心臓腫瘤の鑑別にも胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきことを示す。
pmid-9770582.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with fever, complete heart block, and congestive heart failure. Echocardiography revealed a dumbbell-shaped mass in the right ventricle and right atrium, initially suspected to be a rhabdomyoma, and it was surgically resected. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry identified a malignant germ cell tumor with predominant yolk sac differentiation. This is an extremely rare primary intracardiac yolk sac tumor, showing that germ cell tumors can arise outside the gonads and mediastinum, and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of pediatric cardiac masses.

pmid-9771440.summary_ja: 妊娠初期・中期の胎盤、胎盤嵌入、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌における内皮型一酸化窒素合成酵素(eNOS)を免疫組織化学で検討。絨毛外栄養膜で強く発現し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の増殖細胞にも発現が見られた。血行性転移との関連が示唆されている。
pmid-9771440.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examines endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) in normal first- and second-trimester placentas, placenta accreta, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinoma. eNOS staining was strong in extravillous trophoblast and weaker in syncytiotrophoblast. In trophoblastic disease, proliferating large mononuclear cells positive for human placental lactogen also expressed eNOS. The authors suggest eNOS may contribute to trophoblastic implantation and vascular invasion, and that its expression in complete mole and choriocarcinoma may relate to the hematogenous spread of trophoblastic disease.

pmid-9772905.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株833Kとそのシスプラチン耐性サブクローン64CPの12p染色体再構成を解析した研究です。染色体マイクロダイセクションとFISHで、両株の由来染色体12断片が遠位12pに由来することを示しました。ブレイクポイントは断片ごとに異なっていました。胚細胞腫瘍の発生・進展の解明に寄与すると考えられます。
pmid-9772905.summary_en: This study characterized multiple chromosome 12p rearrangements in the testicular germ cell tumor cell line 833K and its cisplatin-resistant subclone 64CP. Using chromosome microdissection and FISH, the authors showed that derivative chromosome 12 segments in both lines originate from distal 12p (12p12 to 12pter), with different breakpoints. Ectopic rDNA-containing stalk regions flanked by beta-satellite DNA were also identified. These findings may help clarify germ cell tumor development or progression.

pmid-9774147.summary_ja: 抗レトロウイルス薬PMEAのラット絨毛癌細胞に対する分化誘導作用を検討した。PMEAは濃度依存的に増殖を抑制し、巨細胞形成やアルカリホスファターゼ誘導を伴う分化を引き起こした。その効果はヒト絨毛癌の標準化学療法薬であるメトトレキサートに匹敵した。類似体PMPAには分化誘導作用がなく、作用の特異性が示された。
pmid-9774147.summary_en: This study evaluates the antiretroviral agent PMEA as a differentiation-inducing agent in rat choriocarcinoma (RCHO) cells. PMEA produced concentration-dependent growth inhibition and differentiation, including giant cell formation and alkaline phosphatase induction, with effects comparable to methotrexate, the standard chemotherapy for human choriocarcinoma. The closely related analogue PMPA failed to induce differentiation, suggesting specificity. The findings suggest PMEA may have potential as an anti-choriocarcinoma agent.

pmid-9775496.summary_ja: 98例の小児胚細胞腫瘍を後方視的に検討し、米国の報告と発生部位の分布を比較した。性腺発生は51％で、精巣腫瘍（26.5％）と頭蓋内腫瘍（20.4％）は米国報告より多かった。仙尾部腫瘍は10.2％と少なかった。卵巣腫瘍の頻度は米国とほぼ同等であった。小児胚細胞腫瘍の疫学に地域差があることを示している。
pmid-9775496.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review of 98 pediatric germ cell tumors compares local incidence and site distribution with American reports. Gonadal tumors accounted for 51%, with testicular tumors (26.5%) and intracranial tumors (20.4%) notably more frequent than in American series. Sacrococcygeal tumors were less common locally (10.2%). Ovarian tumors were approximately equal in frequency to American reports. The study highlights geographic and ethnic variation in pediatric GCT epidemiology.

pmid-9776602.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患が疑われた女性32例を対象とした前向き研究で、子宮動脈のカラードプラ超音波検査による抵抗係数が、良性の胞状奇胎と悪性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の鑑別に有用かを検討した。化学療法を要した群は抵抗係数が有意に低く(中央値0.29対0.46、p<0.001)、早期の鑑別に役立つ可能性が示された。
pmid-9776602.summary_en: This prospective study of 32 women referred with gestational trophoblastic disease examined whether color Doppler measurement of uterine artery resistance index can distinguish benign hydatidiform mole from malignant gestational trophoblastic disease. Patients who required chemotherapy had a significantly lower median uterine artery resistance index (0.29) than those managed with suction curettage alone (0.46; p<0.001). The authors conclude that uterine artery color Doppler ultrasonography helps differentiate benign molar pregnancy from malignant disease early in management.

pmid-9777959.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍と正常精巣実質におけるヒト内在性レトロウイルスK型(HERV-K)転写産物の発現を比較した研究である。env転写産物は体細胞分化のみを示す腫瘍では検出されず、正常精巣実質のほとんどでは検出された。HERV-Kの検出は早期診断には使えないと結論づけられた。
pmid-9777959.summary_en: This study examined expression of human endogenous retrovirus type K (HERV-K) gag, env and prt transcripts in testicular parenchyma and testicular germ cell tumors of various histologies. gag and prt were expressed in all samples, while env transcripts were absent in tumors showing only somatic differentiation but present in most normal testis. The authors conclude that HERV-K transcript detection cannot serve for early diagnosis of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-9778115.summary_ja: 縦隔成熟奇形腫に血管肉腫、造血領域、顆粒球肉腫が併存した29歳男性の症例報告である。手術の8か月後、扁桃と頸部リンパ節への転移により死亡した。白血病は経過中に認められなかった。顆粒球肉腫は、奇形腫内の異常な造血領域に由来すると考察されている。
pmid-9778115.summary_en: A 29-year-old man with a mediastinal mature teratoma containing angiosarcoma, a hematopoietic region and granulocytic sarcoma is reported. The round malignant cells were confirmed as granulocytic sarcoma by immunostaining. The patient died of metastasis to the tonsils and cervical lymph nodes eight months after surgery, without leukemia. The authors suggest the granulocytic sarcoma arose from the abnormal hematopoietic area within the teratoma.

pmid-9779237.summary_ja: 類皮嚢腫30例の後方視的研究で、診断と治療の方針を検討した。MRIと経膣超音波検査は、保存的・低侵襲手術の術前選択に有用である。腫瘍マーカーは閉経後患者では適応があるが、若年患者ではあまり有用ではない。適切な術前選択により、患者は保存的・低侵襲手術の恩恵を受けられると結論づけられた。
pmid-9779237.summary_en: This retrospective study of 30 dermoid cysts evaluates diagnostic and therapeutic approaches. MRI and endovaginal sonography help select patients for conservative and minimally invasive surgery. Tumor markers are clearly indicated in postmenopausal women but less useful in young patients. With adequate preoperative selection, conservative and minimally invasive surgery can benefit patients. The authors conclude that careful selection before surgery is key.

pmid-9779717.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍302例を対象に、累積エトポシド投与量2g/m²超における二次性急性骨髄性白血病(s-AML)のリスクを後方視的に検討した。s-AMLは4例(累積発生率1.3%)で、標準化罹患比は一般人口に比べて有意に高かった。結論として、このリスクは許容可能な低さとされた。
pmid-9779717.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter analysis of 302 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors treated with high-dose chemotherapy and autologous stem-cell support assessed secondary AML risk after cumulative etoposide doses above 2 g/m2. Median cumulative etoposide was 5 g/m2. Four s-AML cases (1.3% cumulative incidence) and two secondary MDS cases were observed. The standardized morbidity ratio was 160 versus the general population. The authors conclude the risk is acceptably low.

pmid-9780659.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌(病期I)に対し監視療法を行った32歳男性の症例報告。13か月後にAFPとhCG-βが上昇し、後腹膜腫瘤を認めた。化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーは正常化したが腫瘤は増大し嚢胞化した。切除標本は悪性成分のない成熟奇形腫で、growing teratoma syndromeと診断された。
pmid-9780659.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 32-year-old man with a left testicular teratocarcinoma (stage I) managed by surveillance without prophylactic chemotherapy. Thirteen months later, AFP and hCG-beta were elevated, and retroperitoneal masses were found. After COMPE chemotherapy, markers normalized, but the masses enlarged and became cystic. Resection revealed mature teratoma without malignancy, establishing growing teratoma syndrome. Early recognition and complete resection are emphasized.

pmid-9781445.summary_ja: 幼児の同時性両側精巣奇形腫の稀な症例。術前の超音波検査、腫瘍マーカー、術中所見から良性腫瘍が示唆され、左は精巣摘除術、右は精巣温存手術を施行した。小児の奇形腫、特に両側例の外科的治療には議論があり、精巣温存手術が治療選択肢となり得ると考察している。
pmid-9781445.summary_en: This report describes a rare case of infantile synchronous bilateral testicular teratoma treated with testis-sparing surgery on the right and high orchiectomy on the left. Preoperative ultrasonography, tumor marker status, and intraoperative findings suggested benign neoplasia, which guided the conservative approach. The authors discuss the controversy surrounding surgical management of childhood teratoma, particularly when bilateral, and argue that testis-sparing surgery can be considered a treatment option.

pmid-9781660.summary_ja: 18か月の女児の後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を認めた症例。腹囲膨満とAFPの中等度上昇を呈した。成熟奇形腫が悪性胚細胞分化を伴う病変へ進展する可能性を示し、奇形腫の前がん病変としての位置づけを提唱している。
pmid-9781660.summary_en: This report describes an 18-month-old girl with a retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma that contained a focus of endodermal sinus tumor. She presented with an expanding abdominal girth and moderately elevated alpha-fetoprotein. The excised 18 cm benign-appearing mass harbored a 4 cm hemorrhagic focus showing malignant germ-cell differentiation. The authors propose that mature teratoma may be premalignant, suggesting a new early pattern of teratoma carcinogenesis.

pmid-9783311.summary_ja: 仙尾部由来の腹部腫瘍を呈した早産児の症例報告。組織学的に硬膜外粘液乳頭状上衣腫成分を伴う奇形腫であった。新生児期の生理的なAFP高値を腫瘍マーカーと誤認しかけた点が特徴である。乳児における腫瘍マーカーの解釈の難しさと鑑別診断について論じている。
pmid-9783311.summary_en: This case report describes a preterm infant with an abdominal tumor arising from the precoccygeal region, histologically a teratoma with an extradural myxopapillary ependymoma component. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated and was initially misinterpreted as a tumor marker, although AFP is physiologically high in preterm infants. The authors review sacrococcygeal origins of germ cell tumors, paragangliomas, and extradural MPE, and discuss the difficulty of interpreting tumor markers in infants.

pmid-9783712.summary_ja: 55歳の閉経後の表現型女性で左付属器領域にセミノーマを認めた症例報告。右付属器には未熟精巣を認めた。末梢血でt(Y;15)転座を有し、同じ核型は弟にも認められた。皮膚線維芽細胞に45,X細胞株によるモザイクを認めたが、SRY遺伝子の異常は検出されなかった。45,X細胞株が非典型的なXY女性の病態に関与した可能性を示唆している。
pmid-9783712.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 55-year-old phenotypic female with late-onset menarche who had a seminoma of the left adnexal region, with an immature testis in the right adnexa. Peripheral blood karyotype showed 46,X,-Y,t(Y;15), which her brother also carried. Skin fibroblasts showed 45,X mosaicism, and no SRY gene abnormality was detected. The authors suggest that the 45,X cell line may have contributed to the atypical presentation in an XY female.

pmid-9784313.summary_ja: 本研究は、POG試験9048および9049に登録された小児卵巣胚細胞腫瘍22例について、DNA含量(倍数性)を解析したものである。未熟奇形腫は悪性度にかかわらず大半が二倍体であったのに対し、悪性胚細胞腫瘍は異数性を示した。未熟奇形腫内の異数性クローンは、認識されにくい卵黄嚢腫瘍の存在を示唆し、診断に有用である可能性がある。二倍体の悪性腫瘍は性腺芽細胞腫に伴っており、性腺形成異常例では発生機序が異なる可能性が示された。
pmid-9784313.summary_en: This study assessed DNA ploidy by image cytometry in 22 pediatric ovarian germ cell tumors from POG protocols 9048 and 9049. Most immature teratomas were diploid regardless of grade, whereas malignant GCTs showed aneuploidy with DNA index 1.4 to 2.4. An aneuploid clone within an immature teratoma suggested occult endodermal sinus tumor, which may be diagnostically useful. Diploid malignant tumors were associated with gonadoblastoma, suggesting a different pathogenesis in dysgenetic gonads. Polyploidization appears characteristic of malignant ovarian GCTs in normal patients, similar to adult testicular GCTs.

pmid-9785136.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した悪性腫瘍13例を、パラフィン包埋組織を用いた染色体in situハイブリダイゼーションで解析した。染色体11、12、16、Xの増加が高頻度に認められ、8例でトリソミー12が見られた。良性の奇形腫成分の変化はわずかであった。複雑な染色体異常が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化に関与することが示唆された。
pmid-9785136.summary_en: This study used chromosome in situ hybridization on paraffin-embedded tissue to analyze chromosomal gains in cancers arising in ovarian mature cystic teratomas. Thirteen cancers were examined, including ten squamous cell carcinomas, one adenocarcinoma, one papillary thyroid carcinoma, and one strumal carcinoid. Gains of chromosomes 11, 12, 16, and X were frequent, with trisomy 12 in eight cases. The strumal carcinoid showed no aberrations, and benign teratoma areas showed few changes. The findings suggest that complex chromosomal aberrations contribute to malignant transformation of mature cystic teratomas.

pmid-9785874.summary_ja: 血清SCC高値を伴う縦隔成熟奇形腫の2症例を報告している。17歳女性と32歳男性はいずれも手術で切除され、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。SCC上昇の原因は不明であったが、肺無気肺が関与した可能性が示唆された。悪性腫瘍を伴わなくてもSCCが上昇しうることを示し、腫瘍マーカーの解釈には注意が必要である。
pmid-9785874.summary_en: This report describes two patients with mature mediastinal teratomas and elevated serum SCC levels. A 17-year-old woman and a 32-year-old man each underwent resection, and pathology showed mature teratoma in both. The cause of the elevated SCC was unclear, but the authors suspected pulmonary atelectasis may have contributed. The cases show that mediastinal mature teratomas can be associated with elevated SCC without malignancy, which may lead to misinterpretation of tumor marker results.

pmid-9788270.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した小細胞癌の症例報告である。28歳未経妊女性が鎖骨上リンパ節転移を呈して受診した。既存の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の癌で、リンパ節転移が初発徴候となった初めての症例とされる。組織像は肺小細胞癌に類似し、免疫組織化学、フローサイトメトリー、超微細構造の所見も記載されている。文献的考察も含む。
pmid-9788270.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old nulliparous woman with a small cell carcinoma arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma. She presented with supraclavicular lymph node metastasis, which the authors describe as the first reported case in which lymph node metastasis was the initial sign of cancer in a pre-existing mature cystic teratoma. Histology resembled pulmonary small cell carcinoma, and immunohistochemical, flow cytometric, and ultrastructural findings are described. The paper also reviews the literature on malignant transformation of mature cystic teratomas.

pmid-9788409.summary_ja: 1950年から1995年にロンドン地域がんセンターで、精巣摘除術後に補助放射線療法を受けた病期Iおよび病期IIのセミノーマ212例の後方視的研究である。中央値7.5年の追跡で、5年および10年の生存成績は良好であった。巨大病変を伴う病期II例では再発が多かった。晩期の消化管毒性や第二の悪性腫瘍はまれであった。病期Iおよび早期病期IIのセミノーマに対し、術後放射線療法は安全で有効であると結論づけている。
pmid-9788409.summary_en: This retrospective study of 212 patients with stage I or stage II seminoma treated with adjuvant radiotherapy after orchiectomy at the London Regional Cancer Centre between 1950 and 1995. Median follow-up was 7.5 years. Five- and ten-year survival outcomes were excellent, and bulky stage II disease was associated with more failures. Late gastrointestinal toxicity and second malignancies were uncommon. The authors conclude that postoperative radiotherapy remains safe and effective for stage I and early stage II seminoma.

pmid-9788609.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の神経分化で発現が上昇する亜鉛フィンガー遺伝子TCF17を、ヒト精子形成および精巣胚細胞腫瘍で検討した。精原細胞が精母細胞へ分化する際に発現が増加した。上皮内癌とセミノーマで高発現する一方、高悪性度の胎児性癌では低下していた。胚細胞腫瘍の診断において予測的な価値を持つ可能性が示された。
pmid-9788609.summary_en: This study examined TCF17, a zinc finger gene upregulated during neuronal differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells, in human spermatogenesis and testicular germ cell tumors. TCF17 expression increased as spermatogonia differentiated into spermatocytes. mRNA levels were high in carcinoma in situ and seminoma but decreased in highly malignant embryonal carcinoma. The authors propose that differential TCF17 regulation during neoplastic germ cell differentiation may help diagnose germ cell tumors.

pmid-9788651.summary_ja: ノースカロライナ大学病院で7年間に出生前診断され管理された胎児仙尾部奇形腫9例の後方視的検討である。新生児期を生存したのは6例で、妊娠20週以降に診断された例は全例生存した。胎児水腫を発症した3例は全例死亡した。早期診断、胎児水腫、早産は予後不良因子であった。可能な限り分娩を遅らせ、切除前に新生児を安定させることが推奨されている。
pmid-9788651.summary_en: This retrospective review describes nine fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally and managed at the University of North Carolina Hospitals over seven years. Six infants survived the neonatal period, and all fetuses diagnosed after 20 weeks survived. Fetal hydrops developed in three fetuses, all of whom died, with ventilatory inadequacy from prematurity contributing. Early gestational diagnosis, hydrops, and preterm delivery predicted poor outcome. The authors recommend delaying delivery when possible and stabilizing the neonate before resection.

pmid-9790464.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の化学療法中に、B型肝炎ウイルスキャリアの若年患者が黄疸性肝炎を発症した。プレドニゾロン単独では肝不全の進行を防げなかったが、ラミブジン投与により数日で肝性脳症が改善し、HBV DNAは検出限界以下となった。免疫不全患者のHBV再活性化には、ステロイドよりも抗ウイルス療法が救命につながる可能性を示した。
pmid-9790464.summary_en: A young HBsAg-positive carrier developed icteric hepatitis with high HBV DNA during chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma. Prednisolone failed to prevent hepatic failure, but lamivudine rapidly reversed encephalopathy and reduced HBV DNA to undetectable levels. The authors suggest that in immunocompromised patients with HBV reactivation, antiviral inhibition may be life-saving rather than steroids alone.

pmid-9790798.summary_ja: 38歳女性が右卵巣の大きな腫瘍に対しTAH-BSOを受けた。病理および免疫組織化学検査で、良性嚢胞性奇形腫内の消化管上皮由来の粘液性腺癌と診断された。奇形腫の悪性転化は稀で、扁平上皮癌が最も多く、消化管由来の腺癌は過去に1例しか報告がないことを指摘している。
pmid-9790798.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman underwent total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy for a large right ovarian tumor. Pathology and immunohistochemistry showed mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from gastrointestinal epithelium within a benign cystic teratoma. The authors note that malignant transformation of mature teratoma is rare, with squamous carcinoma most common and only one prior case of gastrointestinal-origin adenocarcinoma reported.

pmid-9790800.summary_ja: 初回手術時にサイログロブリン値が高値だった悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の患者で、甲状腺抑制療法中のサイログロブリン値の上昇から再発が確認された。放射性ヨウ素療法によりサイログロブリン値は正常化し、患者は甲状腺ホルモン補充下で無病経過を維持している。サイログロブリンが再発の追跡マーカーとして有用であることを示す。
pmid-9790800.summary_en: A woman with malignant struma ovarii and elevated thyroglobulin at initial surgery was found to have recurrence based on progressive thyroglobulin rise during thyroid suppressive therapy. Radioiodine treatment normalized the thyroglobulin level, and she remains disease free on thyroid hormone replacement, supporting thyroglobulin as a monitoring marker.

pmid-9791864.summary_ja: 1960年代に精巣胚細胞腫瘍が化学療法で治癒可能となり、シスプラチン併用療法により転移例を含めて治癒率が80%を超えた経緯を概説した総説である。他の固形腫瘍と異なる特異な生物学・遺伝学的特徴が、高い治癒率の一因と考えられることを論じている。
pmid-9791864.summary_en: This review traces how testicular germ cell tumors became curable with chemotherapy after the 1960s, and how cisplatin-based regimens raised cure rates above 80%, even in metastatic disease. It highlights the unusual biology and genetics of these tumors that distinguish them from other solid tumors and may contribute to their routine curability.

pmid-9792151.summary_ja: グラスゴーで1991〜95年に胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法を受けた194例を後方視的に検討し、致死的なブレオマイシン肺毒性が5例(2.8%)に認められた。致死例は高齢で糸球体濾過量が低く、40歳以上で腎機能が低下している患者ではリスクが10%を超えうるため、ブレオマイシン使用の妥当性に疑問を呈している。
pmid-9792151.summary_en: A retrospective review of 194 germ cell tumor patients in Glasgow (1991-95), 180 of whom received bleomycin, identified five fatal pulmonary toxicity cases (2.8%). Fatal cases were older and had lower glomerular filtration rates, with no difference in cumulative bleomycin dose or oxygen exposure. Risk may exceed 10% in patients over 40 with low-normal renal function, questioning bleomycin use in that group.

pmid-9792441.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera-2を用い、all-trans レチノイン酸とインターフェロンγがCD95リガンドおよび受容体の発現に及ぼす影響を検討した。レチノイン酸はリガンドを減少させ受容体を増加させてCD95依存性アポトーシスへの感受性を高め、IFN-γはリガンドと受容体の両方を増加させた。両者による異なるアポトーシス制御は抗腫瘍免疫に影響しうることを示唆している。
pmid-9792441.summary_en: The study examined how all-trans retinoic acid and interferon gamma regulate CD95 ligand and receptor expression in human Tera-2 embryonal carcinoma cells. Retinoic acid reduced ligand and increased receptor levels, sensitizing cells to CD95-mediated apoptosis, whereas IFN-gamma increased ligand and receptors and enhanced killing of CD95-bearing lymphocytes. The findings suggest differential regulation of apoptosis with potential impact on antitumor immunity.

pmid-9793027.summary_ja: 1990〜96年に筑波大学病院で転移性精巣がんの治療を受けた男性20例を後方視的に解析した。9例で拡散能が予測値の75%未満に低下し、化学療法中の血清クレアチニン値の上昇が独立したリスク因子であった(オッズ比22.3)。特にクレアチニン上昇時には肺機能検査を行うことを推奨している。
pmid-9793027.summary_en: In 20 men treated for metastatic testicular cancer at Tsukuba University Hospital (1990-96), the authors analyzed risk factors for bleomycin pulmonary toxicity. Nine patients had diffusing capacity below 75% of predicted. Elevated serum creatinine during chemotherapy was the only independent risk factor (odds ratio 22.3). The authors recommend pulmonary function testing, especially when creatinine rises.

pmid-9793032.summary_ja: 血友病AとHIV感染を合併した36歳男性に生じた病期IIIBの未分化セミノーマの症例報告である。精巣摘除術の後、後腹膜リンパ節腫大に対して化学放射線療法を行い、腫瘍マーカー陰性の部分奏効が得られた。CD4陽性リンパ球数は低値であったが、重篤な日和見感染は生じなかった。一方、手術創からの出血が持続し、第VIII因子補充を要した。
pmid-9793032.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with hemophilia A and HIV infection who presented with stage IIIB anaplastic seminoma of the testis. He underwent inguinal orchiectomy followed by chemoradiotherapy for retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy and achieved a marker-negative partial response. Despite a low CD4+ count, he tolerated treatment without life-threatening opportunistic infection. Persistent bleeding from the operative wound complicated postoperative care, requiring factor VIII supplementation.

pmid-9793033.summary_ja: 難治性非セミノーマ性精巣がん(セミノーマと絨毛癌の混合)の44歳男性が、大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植後に好中球減少性腸炎を発症した。投与10日後に発熱、水様性下痢、腹痛が出現し、イレウス、腹水、播種性血管内凝固、腎不全を併発した。集中治療により辛うじて死亡を回避した。固形腫瘍に対する強力化学療法による高度好中球減少下でも、重篤な消化管合併症が起こりうることを示す。
pmid-9793033.summary_en: A 44-year-old man with refractory nonseminomatous testicular cancer (seminoma plus choriocarcinoma) developed neutropenic colitis after high-dose chemotherapy with carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide, followed by autologous stem-cell transplantation. Fever, watery diarrhea, and abdominal pain appeared on day 10, followed by ileus, ascites, disseminated intravascular coagulation, renal failure, and hyperbilirubinemia despite antibiotics. Intensive care barely prevented death. The authors note that this serious gastrointestinal complication can occur under profound neutropenia caused by intensive chemotherapy for solid tumors.

pmid-9796278.summary_ja: 18年間に治療した原発性縦隔セミノーマの5例の報告である。放射線療法単独、放射線療法後のシスプラチン投与、ドキソルビシン増量PVB療法と放射線療法の併用などの治療を含む。5年および10年生存率はいずれも100%であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法の後に統合的放射線療法を行えば、進展例でも手術を行わずに治癒しうると結論づけている。
pmid-9796278.summary_en: This report describes five patients with primary mediastinal seminoma treated over 18 years with chemoradiotherapy, without routine surgery. Patients received radiation alone, radiation followed by cisplatin, or adriamycin-reinforced PVB with consolidation radiation. The 5- and 10-year survival rates were both 100%, although one early patient treated with surgery and radiation developed recurrences and died. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based chemotherapy followed by consolidation radiation can cure primary mediastinal seminoma, even in extended disease.

pmid-9796404.summary_ja: 病期II縦隔混合型胚細胞腫瘍に対し手術とVP16併用化学療法を受けた36歳男性が、約3年後に急性巨核芽球性白血病(M7)を発症した。染色体11q23やMLL遺伝子に異常はなく、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に伴う血液腫瘍症候群と診断された。血清神経特異エノラーゼ値が上昇していた。寛解後に再発し、発症3か月後に死亡した。国内では本症候群の3例目の症例報告である。
pmid-9796404.summary_en: A 36-year-old man treated for stage II mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor with surgery and VP16-containing combination chemotherapy developed acute megakaryoblastic leukemia (FAB M7) about three years later. Cytogenetic and MLL studies were normal, and the authors diagnosed the syndrome of mediastinal germ cell tumors associated with hematologic neoplasia. Serum neuron-specific enolase was elevated. The leukemia relapsed after remission, and the patient died three months after onset. This is the third reported case of this syndrome in Japan.

pmid-9797810.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法の現状と課題をまとめた総説である。予後良好群にはBEP療法3コースまたはEP療法4コース、予後不良群にはBEP療法4コースが有効とされる。予後因子に基づく病期分類で危険度を層別化でき、国際的な予後分類により基準の統一が期待される。自家幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法は一部の難治例を治癒させ、予後不良例の初回治療成績を改善しうるが、シスプラチン耐性は克服されていない。
pmid-9797810.summary_en: This review summarizes chemotherapy for disseminated germ cell tumors. Three cycles of BEP or four cycles of EP are effective for good-risk disease, and four cycles of BEP for poor-risk disease. Prognostic staging distinguishes risk groups, though varying criteria hinder comparison; an international prognostic classification is expected to resolve this. High-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell rescue cures a small subset of heavily pretreated patients and may improve first-line outcomes in poor-risk disease, but cisplatin resistance is not fully overcome.

pmid-9805244.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるモノクローナル抗体43-9Fの免疫染色を検討した研究。胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の両方で陽性を示したが、両者の鑑別には有用でないと結論された。上皮内癌の検出にはPLAP染色と光学顕微鏡の併用がより優れており、胎児性癌が上皮内癌から直接発生する可能性も示唆された。
pmid-9805244.summary_en: This study evaluated monoclonal antibody 43-9F immunostaining in testicular germ cell tumors, aiming to distinguish embryonal carcinoma from other malignant germ cell components in clinical stage I NSGCT. Positivity was found in all embryonal carcinomas and yolk sac tumors, but also in about half of seminomatous components. AFP and PLAP staining were also compared. The authors concluded that 43-9F was not clinically useful for this distinction, and that PLAP with light microscopy was superior for detecting carcinoma in situ.

pmid-9805848.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者138例の血清を用いて、HIVおよび梅毒の感染を検査した研究。HIVおよびVDRL陽性はそれぞれ1例のみで、両感染の病因的関与は否定的と結論された。感染が本疾患の原因であるという仮説を検証しており、本サイトの対象領域に該当する。
pmid-9805848.summary_en: This study tested sera from 138 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease for HIV and syphilis using micro-ELISA and a rapid plasma reagin test. Only one sample was positive for HIV and one for VDRL. The authors concluded that HIV and syphilis infections have no etiologic role in gestational trophoblastic disease. The study addresses a proposed infectious cause of this trophoblastic disease, so it is directly within the site's scope.

pmid-9808132.summary_ja: 類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍（ETT）の14症例を報告。単調な絨毛膜型中間型トロホブラストからなり、癌腫に類似した外観を呈する。インヒビンαやサイトケラチンが陽性であった。絨毛癌より悪性度が低く、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に近い経過を示し、子宮内病変の2例で肺および骨転移が生じた。
pmid-9808132.summary_en: This report describes 14 cases of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, a rare gestational trophoblastic tumor that often mimics carcinoma. Tumors showed a monomorphic population of chorionic-type intermediate trophoblast with geographic necrosis, and were positive for inhibin-alpha and cytokeratin. Behavior was less aggressive than choriocarcinoma and resembled placental site trophoblastic tumor, with two uterine cases developing lung and bone metastases. The authors propose that ETT derives from chorionic-type intermediate trophoblast.

pmid-9808441.summary_ja: 67歳女性の成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫に、浸潤性扁平上皮癌と無色素性悪性黒色腫が併存した症例報告。真皮成分の接合部メラノサイト増殖から卵巣起源と考えられた。既報例と比較し、無色素性であること、リンパ向性、扁平上皮癌との併存が特徴とされた。
pmid-9808441.summary_en: This case report describes a 67-year-old woman with a mature ovarian cystic teratoma containing invasive squamous cell carcinoma and an amelanotic nodular malignant melanoma. Junctional melanocytic proliferation in the dermal component supported an ovarian origin of the melanoma. Comparison with previously reported melanoma-associated mature cystic teratomas highlighted this case's amelanotic character, lymphotropism, and coexistence with squamous carcinoma.

pmid-9808847.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清で下大静脈を切除した65例のうち、生存者24例を長期追跡した研究である。慢性静脈後遺症が再建の適応となったのは1例のみで、大半は軽度または無症状だった。広範な郭清にIVC再建を追加する必要は一般的にはないと結論づけている。
pmid-9808847.summary_en: This long-term study followed patients who underwent inferior vena cava resection during retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell testis tumors. Of 65 patients requiring IVC resection, 24 survivors were assessed a median of 89 months after surgery. Long-term disability was mild or absent in 75%, and only one patient met criteria for elective IVC reconstruction. The authors conclude that routine IVC reconstruction during extensive RPLND is generally unnecessary.

pmid-9809569.summary_ja: 1993〜1997年に40例の閉経前女性の卵巣類皮嚢腫44個を腹腔鏡下に摘出した臨床研究である。全例で被膜を保ったまま内容物の漏出なく摘出でき、平均手術時間は125分、全例48時間以内に退院した。術後評価を得た一部の患者では軽度の癒着が20%に認められた。漏出は防げるが高度な技術と時間を要すると結論づけている。
pmid-9809569.summary_en: This open clinical study describes laparoscopic removal of 44 intact ovarian dermoid cysts (mature teratomas) in 40 premenopausal women between 1993 and 1997. A technique involving cleavage plane creation, dissection using water and gravity, and extraction in a laparoscopic bag was used. All cysts were removed intact without spillage, mean operating time was 125 minutes, and all patients were discharged within 48 hours. Follow-up was available for 15 patients, with mild adhesions in 3 (20%). The authors conclude that spillage can be prevented, though the technique is time-consuming and requires expert skill.

pmid-9813418.summary_ja: 妊娠32週で診断された胎児頸部奇形腫の症例で、帝王切開中に硬性気管支鏡で気道を確保した経過を報告している。児は出生後に腫瘍からの出血と換気障害を来し、生後40分で死亡した。出産前の多職種相談と子宮弛緩による胎児酸素化の維持が主な管理上の工夫である。
pmid-9813418.summary_en: This case report describes a prenatally diagnosed fetal neck teratoma identified at 32 weeks of gestation. Multidisciplinary planning preceded a cesarean delivery at 34 weeks under epidural anesthesia. Uterine relaxation with magnesium sulfate and nitroglycerin preserved fetal oxygenation, and the airway was secured with a rigid bronchoscope while the head was delivered. Despite satisfactory cord blood gases, the neonate developed external and intratracheal bleeding with ventilatory difficulties and died at 40 minutes of age. The report highlights management options for airway compromise in this setting.

pmid-9813425.summary_ja: 妊娠22週で発見された嚢胞性の骨盤内（グレードIV）仙尾部奇形腫に対し、羊水カテーテルを用いて子宮内減圧を行った症例報告である。腫瘍による両側尿管閉塞と水腎症の軽減が目的であった。嚢胞性仙尾部奇形腫を出生前にこの方法で減圧した初の報告とされている。
pmid-9813425.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with a cystic presacral (grade IV) sacrococcygeal teratoma detected at 22 weeks of gestation. The tumor caused bilateral ureteral obstruction and hydronephrosis. The authors performed in utero decompression by draining the cyst through an amniotic catheter to relieve the mass effect. They state this is the first reported prenatal decompression of a cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma. The paper also notes that these tumors are usually external and mostly solid or mixed.

pmid-9818077.summary_ja: 成人男性の原発性頸部悪性奇形腫に肋骨転移を生じた症例報告。手術と化学療法を行い、術後5年以上再発なく生存している。致死例の文献的予後は短く、完全切除と胚細胞腫瘍に準じた補助化学療法の有用性が示唆されている。
pmid-9818077.summary_en: A 35th reported case of primary cervical malignant teratoma in an adult man, with a chondrosarcomatous rib metastasis. The patient underwent resection, chemotherapy and later rib tumor resection, and remained free of recurrence for over five years. Literature review shows that previously reported patients with lethal outcomes survived a median of nine months. The authors suggest that complete excision combined with germ cell tumor-type adjuvant chemotherapy may improve prognosis for non-gonadal malignant teratoma.

pmid-9818899.summary_ja: 傍腫瘍性辺縁系・脳幹脳炎を呈した男性2例で、潜在性の非転移性精巣セミノーマが見つかった。いずれも臨床的な精巣診察は正常で、精巣超音波検査によってのみ腫瘍を検出できた。肺癌を認めない場合は精巣超音波検査を行うべきとしている。
pmid-9818899.summary_en: Two patients with paraneoplastic limbic and brainstem encephalitis were found to have occult, nonmetastatic testicular seminoma. In both, the tumor was detected only by testicular ultrasonography, despite normal clinical examination. The authors recommend testicular ultrasound in male patients with this syndrome when lung cancer is absent, because physical examination alone can miss an occult seminoma.

pmid-9819878.summary_ja: 思春期女児の後腹膜類皮嚢腫の症例。当初は卵巣由来が疑われたが、腹腔鏡では同定できなかった。術中超音波検査で嚢腫を確認し、開腹により摘出した。まれな性腺外病変の診断における超音波検査と術中評価の有用性を示した。
pmid-9819878.summary_en: A retroperitoneal dermoid cyst in an adolescent girl was initially suspected to be ovarian. Transabdominal ultrasound showed a complex pelvic mass typical of a dermoid cyst, but laparoscopy failed to identify it. Intraoperative ultrasonography confirmed the cyst, which was then removed through laparotomy from the retroperitoneum. The case highlights the diagnostic value of ultrasound in rare extragonadal lesions and the usefulness of intraoperative scanning.

pmid-9821053.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後ろ向き検討で、57.8%に奇形腫成分を認めた。奇形腫陽性群では病期I例が少なくリンパ節転移が多かったが、腫瘍マーカーの反応は良好で、救援手術後に無病生存する例が多かった。全体として侵襲性は低いと結論している。
pmid-9821053.summary_en: The authors reviewed non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumors and found teratomatous elements in 57.8 percent. Teratoma-positive tumors had fewer stage I cases, more lymph node metastases, and excellent tumor marker responses in metastatic disease. Most patients were alive without disease after salvage surgery, and pure teratoma relapses responded to multimodal therapy. The authors conclude that teratoma-positive tumors are overall less aggressive.

pmid-9821054.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の2例で胸腔鏡手術を行い、肺の病変を検索した。組織学的には癌ではなく、正常リンパ節と肺線維症であった。CT所見を示し、播種性精巣がんの管理上の意義を考察した。
pmid-9821054.summary_en: Two patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell cancer underwent thoracoscopic surgery to resect residual tumor or biopsy new lesions during chemotherapy. Histology revealed normal lymph node tissue and pulmonary fibrosis rather than cancer. The authors present CT findings of these noncancerous pulmonary lesions and discuss their implications for managing disseminated testicular cancer.

pmid-9821708.summary_ja: 仙尾部卵黄嚢腫瘍の乳児2例。肝様組織亜型はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)アイソフォーム解析で卵黄嚢腫瘍由来と判断された。典型例はVAB-6療法に良好に反応したが、肝様亜型は部分効果にとどまった。救援化学療法(VIP)と完全切除で完全寛解に至った。
pmid-9821708.summary_en: Two infants with sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumor are described; one had typical histology and one a uniform hepatoid pattern. AFP isoform analysis indicated the hepatoid tumor was yolk sac-derived rather than hepatocellular. The typical tumor responded to VAB-6 chemotherapy, while the hepatoid tumor responded only partially. Salvage VIP chemotherapy combined with complete resection achieved complete remission, sustained for more than four years in both patients.

pmid-9823315.summary_ja: 本研究はセミノーマ細胞由来のcDNAライブラリーからアルカリホスファターゼ遺伝子をクローニングした。胚細胞型(PLAP様)と肝・骨・腎型(L/B/K AP)の2種類が同定され、後者はセミノーマで発現が亢進しており、腫瘍マーカーとなりうることが示唆された。
pmid-9823315.summary_en: This study cloned and characterized alkaline phosphatase cDNAs expressed in seminoma cells. Two types were identified: germ cell alkaline phosphatase (PLAP-like) and liver/bone/kidney-type alkaline phosphatase (L/B/K AP). The finding that L/B/K AP expression is enhanced in seminoma suggests it may serve as a tumor marker for this tumor type, beyond the known placental alkaline phosphatase family.

pmid-9823978.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がん669例を対象に、化学療法開始後のAFPおよびhCGの一過性上昇(サージ)の予後的意義を検討した。AFPサージは無増悪生存に独立して不良な予後因子であったが、hCGサージには予後的意義は認められなかった。
pmid-9823978.summary_en: This study of 669 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for non-seminomatous testicular cancer examined AFP and hCG surges after treatment initiation. An AFP surge, found in about 29% of patients with elevated AFP, was an independent adverse prognostic factor for progression. hCG surges had no prognostic significance for progression or survival.

pmid-9824200.summary_ja: まれな精巣腫瘍である精母細胞性セミノーマ4例の初期腫瘍を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法と間期細胞遺伝学で解析した。ほぼ全例で数的異常が認められ、全例で染色体9の増加が見られた。本腫瘍の染色体構成に関する初めての報告である。
pmid-9824200.summary_en: Spermatocytic seminomas, a rare testicular tumor subtype, were analyzed by comparative genomic hybridization and interphase cytogenetics in four primary tumors. Nearly all showed numerical aberrations, with near-trisomic average copy number. Gain of chromosome 9 occurred in all cases, suggesting a role in tumor development. This is the first report on their chromosomal constitution.

pmid-9824648.summary_ja: 精巣がん症例148例と対照314例を対象とした症例対照研究で、職業性曝露および生活因子とリスクの関連を検討した。プラスチック製造作業、虫除けスプレー(DEET)の使用、ディスプレイ作業でリスク上昇が認められ、組織型により関連が異なった。少数の曝露者に基づく結果もあり、偶然の可能性がある。
pmid-9824648.summary_en: A case-control study of 148 testicular cancer cases and 314 controls assessed occupational and other exposures. Plastics work, insect repellent use (DEET), and video display unit work were associated with increased risk, with some associations differing by histology (embryonal cancer versus seminoma). Several findings rested on few exposed subjects and may be spurious.

pmid-9825403.summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併し、停留精巣に発生したセミノーマの1症例を報告している。精巣がんとダウン症候群の関連について文献的に考察し、両者の関連や停留精巣に伴うリスクに注意を促している。症例報告を通して、ダウン症候群患者における精巣腫瘍の早期発見の重要性が示唆される。
pmid-9825403.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with Down syndrome who had seminoma arising in an undescended testis. They discuss the reported association between testicular cancer and Down syndrome, which has recently been emphasized in the literature. The case highlights the potential link between the two conditions and the risk associated with cryptorchidism.

pmid-9826461.summary_ja: マウス腹腔内卵巣奇形腫モデルを用い、腫瘍細胞のTGF-βアンチセンス遺伝子治療とインターロイキン2(IL-2)遺伝子治療を併用した。TGF-βアンチセンス改変腫瘍細胞とIL-2導入線維芽細胞の免疫は、腫瘍攻撃に対する防御効果を有意に高めた。単独では効果がなく、併用が必要であった。
pmid-9826461.summary_en: Using a murine intraperitoneal ovarian teratoma model, the authors combined TGF-beta antisense gene therapy of tumor cells with interleukin-2 gene therapy. Immunization with TGF-beta antisense-modified tumor cells plus IL-2-transduced fibroblasts gave significantly better protection against tumor challenge than unmodified tumor cells alone. Neither intervention alone was effective, indicating the combination is required.

pmid-9826481.summary_ja: 絨毛癌と診断され化学療法を受けた女性3例で、血清hCGが持続的に低値だが尿中hCGは陰性であった。基準サービスの解析で、免疫測定を妨害する偽ゴナドトロピンであるファントムhCGと判明し、治療は中止された。絨毛癌の診断前に希釈直線性と尿中hCGの確認が重要と強調している。
pmid-9826481.summary_en: The authors report three women with persistently low serum hCG, no urinary hCG, and non-parallel dilution, who had been treated for presumed choriocarcinoma. Analysis at a reference service identified phantom hCG, a pseudogonadotropin interfering with immunoassays. Therapy was stopped. The paper stresses checking dilutional parallelism and urine hCG before diagnosing choriocarcinoma.

pmid-9827974.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の末梢血および末梢血幹細胞採取物に残存する腫瘍細胞の検出法を検討した。細胞株を正常血液に混入して感度を比較したところ、GCAPのRT-PCRが最も高感度（正常細胞10^6個中1個）で、正常対照では陽性を認めなかった。患者20例中、GCAPのRT-PCRは7例で腫瘍細胞混入を検出し、免疫細胞化学法の3例を上回った。
pmid-9827974.summary_en: This study developed sensitive assays for detecting residual germ cell tumor cells in peripheral blood and progenitor cell harvests. Immunocytochemistry for cytokeratin and RT-PCR for EGF-R and germ cell alkaline phosphatase (GCAP) were compared using Tera-1 and Tera-2 cell lines spiked into normal blood. RT-PCR for GCAP was the most sensitive, detecting one tumor cell in 10^6 normal cells, with no positivity in controls. Among 20 patients, GCAP RT-PCR detected tumor contamination in seven, compared with three by immunocytochemistry, suggesting its suitability for clinical monitoring.

pmid-9832060.summary_ja: 妊娠中に胎盤血管腫を伴う胎盤内絨毛癌が発見された症例である。妊娠33週の超音波検査で胎盤血管腫が確認され、37週に帝王切開を施行した。病理組織学的に血管腫に隣接して絨毛癌が認められた。出産後10か月の時点で母体・児ともに転移(性)病変は認められていない。
pmid-9832060.summary_en: This case report describes intraplacental choriocarcinoma associated with a placental hemangioma in a pregnancy. Ultrasound at 33 weeks showed the hemangioma, and cesarean section was performed at 37 weeks. Histology confirmed choriocarcinoma within the placenta adjacent to the hemangioma. No metastasis was found in the mother or infant at 10 months after delivery. The case highlights the rare coexistence of gestational choriocarcinoma and a placental vascular tumor with a favorable outcome.

pmid-9833609.summary_ja: 本論文は、完全胞状奇胎から絨毛癌が発生する過程におけるIGF2およびH19のゲノムインプリンティングの関与について考察している。完全奇胎は父性由来で、父方由来の遺伝マーカーがホモ接合性を示す。著者らは、ホモ接合性の形成または父方からのサイレンシングによる腫瘍抑制遺伝子の不活化が、10～20%の症例における悪性転化の基盤になると提唱している。IGF2は父方から、H19は母方から発現しており、インプリンティングの破綻が悪性腫瘍と関連する可能性が示されている。
pmid-9833609.summary_en: This paper discusses how genomic imprinting of IGF2 and H19 may contribute to choriocarcinoma development from complete hydatidiform mole. Complete moles are androgenetic, with homozygous and paternally derived genetic markers. The authors propose that inactivation of tumor suppressor genes, through homozygosity or paternal silencing, underlies malignant transformation in 10 to 20 percent of cases. IGF2 is paternally expressed and H19 maternally expressed, linking disruption of imprinting to malignancy.

pmid-9833612.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患および非絨毛性腫瘍の患者の血清と尿中のhCG関連物質を、特異的酵素免疫測定法で解析した。絨毛性疾患では血清の無傷hCGが腫瘍マーカーとして優れ、各分画比は鑑別診断に有用と考えられる。非絨毛性癌では尿中β-core fragmentが検出され、卵巣癌で84%と最も高い陽性率を示した。
pmid-9833612.summary_en: This study measured intact hCG, free hCGβ, and β-core fragment in serum and urine of patients with trophoblastic disease and non-trophoblastic tumors using specific enzyme immunoassays. In trophoblastic disease, intact hCG should be measured in serum as the preferred tumor marker, and the ratios among hCG forms may aid differential diagnosis. Ectopic urinary β-core fragment was detected in cervical, endometrial, ovarian, lung, and bladder carcinomas, with the highest positivity in ovarian cancer (84%). The authors propose urinary β-core fragment as a tumor marker for non-trophoblastic cancers.

pmid-9833613.summary_ja: 1971～1995年の韓国の医療記録を解析し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生率と時間的推移を検討した。7,198例のうち胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を対象とした。胞状奇胎の発生率は1000分娩あたり40.2から2.3へ低下した。寛解率は改善し、社会経済の発展が背景と考えられている。
pmid-9833613.summary_en: This study analyzed medical records from Korean hospitals from 1971 to 1995 to determine the incidence and time trends of gestational trophoblastic disease. Among 7,198 cases, hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and PSTT were included. The hospital-based incidence of hydatidiform mole declined markedly from 40.2 to 2.3 per 1,000 deliveries between 1971 and 1995. Maternal age and gravidity decreased, and annual remission rates improved. The authors attribute the decline in incidence and rising survival largely to Korea's socioeconomic development.

pmid-9833615.summary_ja: 転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の患者2例を報告し、奏効はそれぞれ3年と8年持続した。血清β-hCGは再発や進展の予測に乏しい。成功例の要点は、多剤大量化学療法、転移発見時の早期介入、画像による病変範囲の確認、局所病変への手術、G-CSFの使用である。
pmid-9833615.summary_en: The authors describe two patients with metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) treated successfully, with responses lasting 3 and 8 years. PSTT shows monomorphic intermediate trophoblast cells that express human placental lactogen. Serum beta-hCG poorly predicts recurrence and spread. Key elements of successful treatment include dose-intensive multi-agent chemotherapy, early intervention at metastasis, imaging to define spread, surgery for localized disease, and G-CSF support. The report highlights the high mortality of metastatic PSTT.

pmid-9833618.summary_ja: 1974～1993年の日本の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の全国登録データを概観した。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の発生率は著明に低下した。絨毛癌の先行妊娠は、1974年の胞状奇胎から1993年には正常分娩へ移行した。8つの臨床項目による絨毛癌リスクスコア表も示された。
pmid-9833618.summary_en: This review summarizes Japanese nationwide registration data on gestational trophoblastic disease from 1974 to 1993. Incidence of molar pregnancy and choriocarcinoma declined markedly. The antecedent pregnancy of choriocarcinoma shifted from molar pregnancy in 1974 to term pregnancy in 1993. The authors present a Choriocarcinoma Risk Score Table using eight clinical items that distinguishes choriocarcinoma from invasive or metastatic mole with over 90% probability compared with histological diagnosis.

pmid-9833619.summary_ja: 1959～1985年に絨毛癌と侵入奇胎の患者1,500例を、主に5-FUを用いた化学療法で治療した。絨毛癌の死亡率は90%超から20%未満に低下し、侵入奇胎の死亡はなかった。10～38年追跡した生存者に残存病変はなく、若年患者の多くは化学療法後に妊娠し、妊娠転帰も一般集団と差がなかった。
pmid-9833619.summary_en: This 45-year series treated 1,500 patients with choriocarcinoma and invasive mole from 1959 to 1985 using chemotherapy, mainly 5-fluorouracil. Mortality from choriocarcinoma fell from over 90% to under 20%, and no deaths occurred from invasive mole. Survivors followed for 10 to 38 years showed no residual disease, and most young patients conceived after chemotherapy alone with normal pregnancy outcomes. The authors conclude that 5-FU chemotherapy can cure even widely metastatic disease.

pmid-9833621.summary_ja: 新潟大学で20年にわたる絨毛性疾患の研究を総括した。登録データ、妊娠性絨毛癌の治療成績、hCG測定系に交差反応する物質を抑制するGnRHアナログ投与の試み、子宮外妊娠性絨毛癌の2例を扱う。hCG測定の干渉への対応と絨毛癌の疫学・治療の両面を含む。
pmid-9833621.summary_en: This review summarizes 20 years of trophoblastic disease research at Niigata University. Topics include prefectural registration data, treatment outcomes for gestational choriocarcinoma, a trial of GnRH analogue to suppress hCG-like substance that cross-reacts with hCG immunoassays, and two rare cases of extrauterine gestational choriocarcinoma. The GnRH analogue trial addresses assay interference in hCG monitoring. The paper covers both epidemiology and management of gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-9833622.summary_ja: マレーシアの妊娠性絨毛性疾患の管理を検討した。胞状奇胎の発生率は1000分娩あたり2.8で、吸引掻爬が主な除去法であった。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の主な治療は化学療法で、リスク群別の生存率は100%、98%、61.7%であった。高リスク群の予後不良の要因を考察し、手術と放射線療法の役割は限られるとしている。
pmid-9833622.summary_en: This paper reviews management of gestational trophoblastic disease in Malaysia, where the molar pregnancy incidence is 2.8 per 1,000 deliveries. Suction curettage was the preferred evacuation method, and partial moles comprised 30% of cases. Chemotherapy remains the main treatment for gestational trophoblastic tumors. Patients stratified by risk group had survival of 100%, 98%, and 61.7%, and by FIGO stage 100% to 68.2%. Surgery and radiotherapy play limited roles, and Doppler flow studies need further evaluation.

pmid-9836006.summary_ja: ターナー症候群のモザイク核型（45X/46X+mar）を有する23歳女性に生じた、純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍を報告した。異形成性の性腺から発生し、分子生物学的検査でY染色体断片がDNA中に確認された。この組み合わせは極めてまれであると述べている。
pmid-9836006.summary_en: The authors report a 23-year-old woman with mosaic 45X/46X + mar Turner syndrome who developed a pure yolk sac tumor (endodermal sinus tumor) arising from a dysgenetic gonad. Molecular studies detected a Y-chromosome fragment in her DNA. The authors describe this as an extremely rare combination of a pure yolk sac tumor with mosaic Turner syndrome carrying a Y-chromosomal fragment.

pmid-9838790.summary_ja: 42歳女性が喀血と胸部X線異常陰影で入院した。肺炎治療後も陰影が改善せず、胸部CTで縦隔腫瘤を認めた。開胸下に6×5×5cmの腫瘍を切除し、病理診断は成熟奇形腫で肺への直接浸潤を伴っていた。肺炎の原因として縦隔奇形腫も考慮すべきだと報告している。
pmid-9838790.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman admitted with hemoptysis and an abnormal chest shadow that persisted despite treatment for pneumonia. Chest CT revealed a mediastinal mass, which was resected by thoracotomy. The 6 x 5 x 5 cm tumor was pathologically diagnosed as a mature teratoma with direct invasion into the lung. The authors emphasize that mediastinal teratoma should be considered as a cause of pneumonia that does not respond to standard treatment.

pmid-9839905.summary_ja: 計画帝王切開時に、10歳初産のヒヒで奇形腫が見つかった。腫瘍は雌核型で第16染色体トリソミーを有していた。ヒヒの奇形腫としては初報告である。ヒト染色体マーカーの解析から、成熟卵子の減数分裂第II分裂の異常または核内倍加が起源と推定された。トリソミー16は腫瘍形成後に生じたと考えられる。
pmid-9839905.summary_en: The authors describe a teratoma discovered during a planned cesarean section in a 10-year-old primigravida baboon (Papio hamadryas). The tumor had a female karyotype and trisomy 16, representing the first baboon teratoma report and the first chromosomal abnormality described in a nonhuman primate teratoma. Using genetic markers from human chromosomes 5, 8, and 17, the authors determined that the origin was most consistent with failure of meiosis II or endoreduplication in a mature ovum. The trisomy 16 arose after tumor formation.

pmid-9840167.summary_ja: 74歳男性の膵臓類皮嚢腫の症例を報告した。胚細胞由来の稀な嚢胞性腫瘍で、嚢胞性奇形腫とも呼ばれる。術前は超音波検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で診断できず、術前の認識を可能にする特異的所見はない。文献上の既報12例をレビューし、他の膵嚢胞性腫瘍との鑑別診断と完全切除の重要性を強調している。
pmid-9840167.summary_en: This report describes a 74-year-old man with a preoperatively unsuspected dermoid cyst of the pancreas, a rare cystic neoplasm of germ cell origin also called cystic teratoma. Ultrasonography and CT were not diagnostic, as there are no pathognomonic features for preoperative recognition. The authors reviewed the 12 previously reported cases in the literature. They emphasize that the differential diagnosis should include other pancreatic cystic tumors and that complete surgical removal is mandatory.

pmid-9840562.summary_ja: 超音波検査で卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された不妊女性6例に対し、排卵誘発または体外受精・胚移植を行った。平均径は2.4cmであった。卵巣刺激は成功し、5例が妊娠して健康な乳児6名が出生した。治療および妊娠中に嚢胞サイズは変化せず、合併症もなかった。卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫は排卵誘発や体外受精の禁忌とはならないと結論づけている。
pmid-9840562.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of ovulation induction and IVF-embryo transfer in six infertile women with ultrasonographically diagnosed ovarian cystic teratomas with a mean diameter of 2.4 cm. Four underwent IVF-ET and two underwent ovulation induction. Ovarian stimulation was successful, and three IVF patients and both induction patients conceived, resulting in six healthy infants. Cyst size remained unchanged, and there were no cyst-related complications during treatment or pregnancy. The authors conclude that ovarian cystic teratoma should not be considered a contraindication for ovulation induction or IVF-ET.

pmid-9841071.summary_ja: 絨毛癌は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の中で最も悪性度が高く、肺・肝・脳へ転移しやすい。腎転移は稀である。本報告では腎絨毛癌の1例を磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で評価した。MRIは病変組織の画像化に有用で、疾患の評価と治療管理に寄与することを示している。
pmid-9841071.summary_en: This case report describes renal metastasis from choriocarcinoma, the most malignant tumor of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, which typically spreads to the lung, liver, and occasionally the brain. Renal involvement is rare. The authors present one case of renal choriocarcinoma evaluated by MRI, highlighting its contribution to evaluating and managing this rapidly growing malignancy.

pmid-9846678.summary_ja: セミノーマに対し単側精巣摘出術と予防的放射線療法を受けた男性16名の精子形態を評価した。精子変形指数と精子多発奇形指数は、他の原因による不妊男性と有意差はなかったが、妊孕性のある男性より高値であった。精巣は精子形成への負の影響の原因によらず同様に反応すると結論づけている。
pmid-9846678.summary_en: Sixteen men who had undergone unilateral orchiectomy for seminoma and preventive radiotherapy to ipsilateral paraaortic and iliac lymph nodes were assessed for two sperm morphology indices: the sperm deformity index and the sperm multiple anomalies index. Values in these men did not differ significantly from those of men with other subfertility causes, but both were higher than in fertile men. The authors conclude that testicular response to a negative spermatogenic insult is the same regardless of its cause.

pmid-9846711.summary_ja: 本研究は、XY核型を有する表現型女性7例の男性仮性半陰陽に対し、診断評価後に腹腔鏡下性腺摘除術を施行した報告である。7例中2例で病理組織学的に性腺腫瘍が確認され、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）と潜在性セミノーマであった。いずれの症例にも合併症は生じなかった。著者らは、侵襲の軽減と入院期間の短縮から、経験豊富な術者であれば腹腔鏡下性腺摘除術が性腺摘除の第一選択になりうると結論づけている。
pmid-9846711.summary_en: Seven phenotypic females with an XY karyotype and male pseudohermaphroditism underwent laparoscopic gonadectomy after diagnostic evaluation. Two of the seven had gonadal neoplasia on histopathology: one dysgerminoma and one occult seminoma. No complications occurred. Given lower morbidity and shorter hospital stay, the authors conclude that laparoscopic gonadectomy is the preferred approach for removing gonads in these patients when performed by experienced surgeons.

pmid-9846713.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)に対し、腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢腫摘出術と開腹術を無作為化で比較した。腹腔鏡群は出血量が少なく、入院期間が短く(3.2日対6.3日)、術後疼痛と合併症も少なかった。著者らは類皮嚢腫の女性に対し腹腔鏡手術を第一選択とすることを推奨している。
pmid-9846713.summary_en: This study compares laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy with laparotomy for ovarian dermoid cysts, which are mature teratomas. Forty-four patients treated at Siena University between 1992 and 1996 were randomized to laparotomy or laparoscopy. Laparoscopy was associated with less blood loss, shorter hospitalization (3.2 versus 6.3 days), less postoperative pain, and fewer complications. The authors recommend laparoscopy as the elective treatment for women with dermoid cysts.

pmid-9846719.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫が捻転・自然切断され大網に再移植されて生じた寄生性大網奇形腫の2症例を報告し、文献レビューで23例を追加した。成熟奇形腫は単純切除で治療可能である一方、未熟奇形腫は悪性の可能性があり術後化学療法と放射線療法が必要である。超音波検査とCTが診断に有用である。
pmid-9846719.summary_en: The authors report two cases of parasitic omental teratoma that arose from an ovarian dermoid which had undergone torsion, autoamputation, and omental reimplantation. A literature review identified 23 additional omental teratomas, mostly in women. Mature lesions may be treated by simple resection, whereas immature omental teratomas are potentially malignant and require postoperative chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Ultrasonography with Doppler and CT aid diagnosis, but localization is difficult.

pmid-9846727.summary_ja: 35歳の日本人女性の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫で、血清の胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)、神経特異的エノラーゼ(NSE)、プロラクチンが上昇していた。腫瘍摘出後に腫瘍マーカーは改善した。免疫染色ではPLAPとNSEが陽性、プロラクチンは陰性であった。PLAPとNSEが陽性となった未分化胚細胞腫の初の報告である。
pmid-9846727.summary_en: A 35-year-old Japanese woman with ovarian dysgerminoma had elevated serum placental alkaline phosphatase, neuron-specific enolase, and prolactin. All elevated tumor markers improved after tumor removal. Immunohistochemistry showed positive staining for PLAP and NSE and negative staining for prolactin. The authors report this as the first dysgerminoma with positive PLAP and NSE immunostaining, and note that prolactin fell with tumor debulking.

pmid-9848329.summary_ja: プラチナ系導入化学療法と減量手術で完全寛解に至らなかった非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者16例に、パクリタキセルとシスプラチンによる救済化学療法を施行した。奏効率は25%で、完全寛解1例、部分寛解3例であった。生存期間中央値は7か月で、好中球減少や末梢神経障害などの有害事象が見られた。予後不良例に対し中等度の有効性が示された。
pmid-9848329.summary_en: Sixteen patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor who had not achieved complete remission after platinum-based induction chemotherapy and cytoreductive surgery received paclitaxel followed by cisplatin as salvage treatment. The overall response rate was 25%, with one complete and three partial responses. Median survival was 7 months. Grade 3 neutropenia occurred in 29% and peripheral neuropathy in 50%. The authors conclude the regimen shows modest activity in patients with poor prognosis.

pmid-9848330.summary_ja: EORTCの第II相試験で、進行または再発した卵巣未分化胚細胞腫18例にPVB化学療法(シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン)を施行した。完全奏効率は66%、部分奏効率は28%であった。中央値76か月の追跡で78%が生存していた。PVBは高い有効性を示したが、同等に強力で毒性の少ないBEP療法が望ましいとされている。
pmid-9848330.summary_en: This EORTC phase II trial evaluated PVB chemotherapy (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin) in 18 patients with advanced or recurrent pure ovarian dysgerminoma. The complete response rate was 66% and the partial response rate 28%. After a median follow-up of 76 months, 78% were alive and well. Severe toxicities were mainly leukopenia and thrombocytopenia. The authors judge PVB highly effective but prefer the BEP regimen, which is equally potent and less toxic.

pmid-9849418.summary_ja: 本30年間の単施設研究は、初発病期I精巣腫瘍に対して精巣摘除術のみを行いサーベイランスを実施した患者における両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の有病率と予後を検討した。有病率は1967～1981年の4.7%から1982～1997年の2.9%へ低下し、全体では3.6%であった。1982年以降の対側腫瘍例は全例が病期Iで、全例が無病生存中である。著者らは、集中的なフォローアップ、CT技術、血清腫瘍マーカー、患者教育により早期診断が可能となり予後が改善したと述べている。
pmid-9849418.summary_en: This single-centre study of 30 years examined bilateral testicular germ cell tumours in patients with initial stage I disease managed by orchidectomy alone with surveillance. Prevalence was 4.7% in 1967-1981 and 2.9% in 1982-1997, with an overall rate of 3.6% that decreased modestly over time. Since 1982, all contralateral tumours were stage I and all patients survived. Intensive follow-up, improved CT, serum tumour markers and patient education enabled earlier diagnosis and improved prognosis.

pmid-9849480.summary_ja: 1971～1990年に妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTT）と診断された女性を対象に、化学療法の有無による閉経年齢を後方視的アンケート調査で比較した。化学療法群の閉経年齢の中央値は50歳で、対照群の53歳より有意に早かった。併用療法は単剤のメトトレキサートより早期閉経と関連していた。差は統計的に有意だが小さく、妊孕性や閉経後骨粗鬆症への影響は大きくないと結論している。
pmid-9849480.summary_en: A retrospective controlled questionnaire survey compared menopause timing in women diagnosed with gestational trophoblastic tumours between 1971 and 1990, treated with chemotherapy or not. Chemotherapy-treated women reached menopause at a median age of 50 versus 53 in controls, and combination regimens produced earlier menopause than single-agent methotrexate. Although statistically significant, the magnitude was modest, and the authors conclude that neither fertility nor postmenopausal osteoporosis is greatly affected.

pmid-9850843.summary_ja: 再発精巣腫瘍に対し末梢血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法を施行中に、好中球減少性腸炎を発症した症例を報告した。難治性または再発精巣腫瘍に対する本治療は有用で比較的安全だが、重篤な合併症を伴うことがあると述べている。救済療法中には好中球減少性腸炎への注意が必要であることを示す。
pmid-9850843.summary_en: This Japanese urology case report describes a patient with relapsed testicular tumour who developed neutropenic enterocolitis during high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. The authors note that this treatment is useful and safe for refractory or relapsed testicular tumours but can be accompanied by serious complications. The report highlights neutropenic enterocolitis as a potentially serious toxicity that requires vigilance during this salvage regimen.

pmid-9853229.summary_ja: 非妊娠性・性腺外に発生した絨毛癌2例（胃原発1例、膵原発1例）のCT所見を報告した。これらは極めて稀な腫瘍であり、膵原発例は過去に報告がないとしている。非典型的な原発部位に生じる絨毛癌を認識するうえで役立つ画像所見を示した。
pmid-9853229.summary_en: This radiology report presents CT findings in two non-gestational, extragonadal choriocarcinomas, one arising in the stomach and one in the pancreas. The authors emphasise that these tumours are rare and that a pancreatic primary has not been described previously. The study provides imaging features that may help recognise choriocarcinoma arising at these unusual primary sites.

pmid-9853671.summary_ja: 口腔内の歯肉に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告した。組織像は性腺原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍に典型的な所見を示し、免疫染色でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が陽性であった。血清AFPも高値を呈した。歯肉原発例の報告はこれが初めてとしている。
pmid-9853671.summary_en: This case report describes an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumour arising from the gingiva in the oral cavity, a very rare extragonadal site. Histology showed typical features of gonadal yolk sac tumours, and immunohistochemistry demonstrated alpha-fetoprotein positivity. Serum AFP was elevated. The authors state that this is the first reported gingival case in the literature.

pmid-9853891.summary_ja: 悪性疾患を有する男性231例に対する8年間の精子凍結保存の成績を報告した。そのうち精巣腫瘍は79例で、精子品質は血液悪性腫瘍などの群より有意に低かった。ただし多くは凍結に十分な精子を保有していた。凍結精子を用いた生殖補助医療により、6組の夫婦のうち複数組で妊娠・出産に至った。三次施設での体系的な保存プログラムの確立を提唱している。
pmid-9853891.summary_en: This eight-year single-centre report describes a semen cryopreservation programme for 231 men with malignant disease, including 79 with testicular tumours. Testicular tumour patients had significantly lower sperm quality than the haematological and other cancer groups, although most had enough sperm for freezing.
