Grade and mode of infiltration were independent predictors of survival in multivariate analysis. Preoperative squamous cell carcinoma antigen was higher than in benign mature cystic teratomas, suggesting it may serve as a preoperative marker.

pmid-9179213.summary_ja: 本研究は尿路悪性腫瘍に対するFDG-PETの有用性を検討し、精巣がん、前立腺がん、腎細胞がんの初期病期分類における診断精度を比較した。精巣がんのリンパ節転移の検出はCTより優れていたが、微小転移や高分化奇形腫は検出できなかった。前立腺がんでは代謝活性が低く、有用性は疑問視された。
pmid-9179213.summary_en: This study evaluated FDG-PET for urologic malignancies, focusing on primary staging of testicular carcinoma, prostate carcinoma, and renal cell carcinoma. FDG-PET detected lymph node metastases in testicular cancer more accurately than CT, but missed micrometastases and highly differentiated teratoma. Its utility in prostate cancer was questioned due to low metabolic activity. For other urinary tract malignancies, limited experience precluded firm conclusions.

pmid-9179666.summary_ja: 播種性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者20例に対し、シスプラチンを含むCOMPE化学療法を施行した研究。17例(85%)が完全寛解に到達し、3年全生存率は89%であった。予後良好群は全例が生存し、有害事象は腎毒性を含め比較的軽度であった。COMPEは有効な化学療法レジメンと結論づけられている。
pmid-9179666.summary_en: This trial evaluated COMPE (cisplatin, vincristine, methotrexate, peplomycin, etoposide) chemotherapy in 20 patients with disseminated testicular germ cell tumors, with residual masses surgically resected. Complete remission was achieved in 85% (17/20). Three-year overall and cause-specific survival were 89% and 94%. All good-risk patients remained alive at a median follow-up of 43 months. Toxicities, particularly nephrotoxicity, were mild.

pmid-9179701.summary_ja: 成人に発生した原発性後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告。まれな腫瘍であり、術前にCTおよび磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で評価された。MRIは腫瘍と周囲臓器との正確な位置関係を明らかにする点で重要であったと報告されている。術前画像診断の有用性を示す症例である。
pmid-9179701.summary_en: This case report describes a primary retroperitoneal teratoma in an adult, a relatively rare neoplasm in this age group. The lesion was evaluated preoperatively using both computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The authors highlight that preoperative MRI was particularly valuable, as it delineated the precise anatomical position of the tumor relative to surrounding organs. Such precise localization informs surgical planning for resection of retroperitoneal masses.

pmid-9181232.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍154例を対象に、新規腫瘍マーカーTRA-1-60の有用性を検討した。基準値は230 U/mlで半減期は9.5日。再発の1か月前には約半数で高値を示し、AFPおよびhCGが陰性の症例も含まれた。500 U/ml超では無再発生存率が低く、3マーカーの併用により再発の早期発見が向上する可能性が示された。
pmid-9181232.summary_en: This study evaluates TRA-1-60 as a tumor marker in 154 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. The reference value was 230 U/ml with a half-life of 9.5 days. Elevated TRA-1-60 was not associated with recurrence at orchidectomy, but it was elevated in about half of patients one month before CT-confirmed recurrence, including some with negative AFP and hCG. Levels above 500 U/ml predicted worse recurrence-free survival. The authors suggest combining AFP, hCG and TRA-1-60 to improve early detection of recurrence.

pmid-9185198.summary_ja: 生後5日の男児に重度の左眼球突出を認めた。CTとMRIで石灰化を伴う左眼窩腫瘤を認め、頭蓋内進展はなかった。眼球の温存は困難と判断され、眼瞼温存型の変法眼窩内容除去術が行われた。組織学的に三胚葉すべての成熟組織を認め、真の先天性眼窩奇形腫と診断された。
pmid-9185198.summary_en: A five-day-old boy presented with severe left proptosis and was found to have a left orbital mass with calcifications on CT and MRI, without intracranial extension. Because the eye was not salvageable, a lid-sparing modified exenteration was performed. Histology showed mature tissues from all three germ layers, confirming a true congenital orbital teratoma. The authors note that MRI may help distinguish it from more common causes of neonatal proptosis.

pmid-9185220.summary_ja: 間期細胞遺伝学により、先天性性腺外奇形腫13例の性染色体の状態を検討した。全ての組織型で胎児・胎盤組織と同一の性染色体状態を示した。少なくとも男性では単為生殖ではなく、多能性の二倍体前駆細胞から発生することが示唆された。
pmid-9185220.summary_en: Using interphase cytogenetics with centromere-specific probes, the authors examined the gonosomal status of 13 congenital extragonadal teratomas. Each tissue type showed the same sex chromosome status as nontumorous fetal and placental tissue, regardless of location, age or histology. These findings suggest that extragonadal teratomas arise from pluripotent diploid precursor cells, such as premeiotic germ cells or ectopic embryonal cells, rather than by parthenogenesis, at least in males.

pmid-9187897.summary_ja: 原発性精巣セミノーマ111例について、フローサイトメトリーで核DNA含量を解析した。二倍体の症例では診断時に進行例を認めず、進行や癌関連死は全て異数体の症例で生じた。核DNA倍数性は精巣セミノーマの予後を示す重要な指標であると結論づけている。
pmid-9187897.summary_en: This study examined nuclear DNA content by flow cytometry in 111 patients with primary testicular seminoma. About half of the tumors were DNA aneuploid and half diploid. No patients with diploid tumors had advanced-stage disease at diagnosis, and all progression and cancer-related deaths occurred in aneuploid cases. The authors conclude that DNA ploidy provides important prognostic information in testicular seminoma.

pmid-9187898.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ43例に、単剤カルボプラチン400 mg/m2を3週間隔で2コース投与した。放射線療法の代替となり得るかを検討した第II相試験である。忍容性は良好で、中央値28か月のフォローアップ期間中に再発は認められなかった。第III相試験での確認が必要である。
pmid-9187898.summary_en: This phase II study treated 43 patients with clinical stage I seminoma using adjuvant single-agent carboplatin, two courses at 400 mg/m2 three weeks apart, as an alternative to para-aortic and ipsilateral iliac radiotherapy. The regimen was well tolerated, with only minor gastrointestinal effects and mild myelosuppression. With a median follow-up of 28 months, no recurrences had been observed. The authors suggest carboplatin could be an alternative if a phase III trial confirms low recurrence rates.

pmid-9187899.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者726例で、精巣静脈と肘静脈のhCG値を比較した。精巣静脈の値は末梢より高かったが、病期や腫瘍径と関連するのは末梢静脈のhCG値のみであった。セミノーマの臨床評価には末梢静脈のhCG測定で十分であると結論づけている。
pmid-9187899.summary_en: Among 726 patients with hCG-positive seminoma, hCG was measured in the cubital vein in all and in the testicular vein in 144. Testicular vein levels were higher than peripheral levels, following a regression equation. Patients with elevated peripheral hCG had higher stage and larger tumors, but testicular vein hCG added no further prognostic information. The authors conclude that only peripheral venous hCG is clinically useful in the assessment of seminoma.

pmid-9188665.summary_ja: DNA解析で雄性発生と確認された早期完全胞状奇胎4例を検討した。羊膜や卵黄嚢など内細胞塊由来の構造が認められ、免疫染色で確認された。母性ゲノムがなくても羊膜形成や卵黄嚢発生が起こることを示す。胎児様構造があっても完全奇胎は除外できず、絨毛癌への進展リスクに注意が必要である。
pmid-9188665.summary_en: This study reports four early complete hydatidiform moles, confirmed as androgenetic by DNA analysis, that contain inner cell mass-derived structures such as nucleated red blood cells, endothelial cells, stromal macrophages, amnion, and yolk sac. The amnion and yolk sac were confirmed by immunocytochemistry. The findings suggest that the maternal genome is not required for amniogenesis, yolk sac development, vasculogenesis, or hematopoiesis. The authors caution that fetal-like structures do not exclude a complete mole, which carries a markedly increased risk of subsequent choriocarcinoma.

pmid-9191534.summary_ja: 4歳以下の小児と思春期・成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍25例について、p53、c-kit、CD34の発現を免疫組織化学で比較した。CD34は思春期前の5例のみで陽性であった。c-kitは思春期前腫瘍で多く発現していた。p53は思春期後の多くの腫瘍で強く発現した。両群で腫瘍発生に関わる経路が異なる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9191534.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared p53, c-kit, and CD34 expression in 25 testicular germ cell tumors from children aged 4 or younger and from adolescents or adults. CD34 was expressed only in five prepubertal tumors. C-kit was more frequently expressed in prepubertal tumors, with intensity comparable to adjacent normal tubules. Strong p53 expression was seen in most postpubertal tumors but in few prepubertal ones. The authors suggest that CD34 may link prepubertal tumors to teratomas, and that c-kit/SCF signaling and p53 play different roles in the two age groups.

pmid-9191747.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後21年および32年に再発したセミノーマの症例報告。胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発、その機序、生涯にわたるサーベイランスの必要性について考察している。2年間無病であれば治癒とみなされることが多いが、本症例は数十年後の再発を示す。長期のフォローアップの重要性を強調する報告である。
pmid-9191747.summary_en: This case report describes seminoma that recurred 21 and 32 years after orchiectomy. The authors review late recurrences in germ cell cancer, the possible mechanisms underlying recurrence, and the need for lifelong surveillance. Patients with testicular cancer are generally considered cured after two years of disease-free survival, but this case shows that relapse can occur decades later. The report highlights the importance of long-term follow-up even for patients whose early-stage disease appears cured.

pmid-9192961.summary_ja: 片側精巣摘除後の病期Iセミノーマ患者44例について、2種類の放射線療法による内分泌への影響を比較した。ホッケースティック照射群ではFSHが照射6か月後に有意に上昇し、3年後に正常化した。限局照射では軽度のFSH上昇のみで、LHの変化はなかった。FSHは一過性の放射線影響を捉える指標として有用である。散乱線量は20 cGy未満に抑えるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-9192961.summary_en: This study compared endocrine effects of two radiotherapy techniques in 44 patients with stage I seminoma after semicastration. Hockey stick fields gave a mean testicular scatter dose of 54.8 cGy, while limited paraaortic irradiation gave 25 cGy. FSH rose significantly six months after hockey stick irradiation and normalized after three years. Limited irradiation caused only a minimal, dose-dependent FSH increase with no LH change. The authors conclude that FSH is a reliable marker of transient radiation effects and that scatter doses should be kept below 20 cGy to avoid spermatogenic disturbance.

pmid-9193335.summary_ja: 初回治療でシスプラチン含有療法を受けた再発セミノーマ患者24例を後方視的に検討した。二次治療のVeIP療法で20例（83%）が完全寛解に達した。中央値7年の追跡で13例（54%）が長期生存者である。性腺外原発例では6例中4例が無病を継続している。治癒の可能性が高いと結論している。
pmid-9193335.summary_en: This retrospective study of 24 patients with recurrent seminoma evaluated VeIP (vinblastine, ifosfamide, cisplatin) as second-line salvage chemotherapy after cisplatin-containing first-line treatment. Twenty of 24 patients (83%) achieved complete remission with VeIP alone, and one more became disease-free after resection. With a median follow-up of 7 years, 13 of 24 (54%) are long-term survivors. Among patients with extragonadal primary tumors, four of six remain continuously disease-free. The authors conclude that VeIP has significant curative potential and yields higher complete remission rates than in nonseminomatous disease.

pmid-9193339.summary_ja: 1978～1995年にハノーバー医科大学で治療された精巣がんの脳転移患者44名の長期成績を解析した。大多数は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍であった。10名（23%）が長期生存を得た。脳転移が初診時または再発時に判明した群の予後は、シスプラチン併用化学療法中に生じた群より良好であった。化学療法と放射線療法の併用例で持続的な生存が認められ、全身治療中に生じた脳転移には緩和的放射線療法のみを推奨している。
pmid-9193339.summary_en: This series from Hannover of 44 patients with brain metastases from testicular cancer, treated between 1978 and 1995, analyzes outcomes by when brain metastases were detected. Most patients had nonseminomatous germ cell cancer. Ten patients (23%) achieved long-term survival. Survival was better when brain metastases were present at diagnosis or relapse than when they developed during cisplatin-based chemotherapy, where only one of 22 survived. Patients receiving combined radiotherapy and chemotherapy, with or without surgery, had sustained survival, whereas single-modality treatment did not. The authors recommend aggressive combined treatment and palliative radiation only for brain metastases arising during systemic therapy.

pmid-9193340.summary_ja: インディアナ大学で1987年から1994年に一次化学療法を受けた播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者295人を後方視的に解析した。患者は治療への反応と原発腫瘍の奇形腫の有無で分類された。血清学的および画像上の完全寛解に達した患者は、初発時の腫瘍量にかかわらず、手術なしで安全に経過観察できた。奇形腫陰性で90%以上の縮小に留まった患者は再発リスクが高く、その後の切除の是非は議論が続いていると著者らは述べている。
pmid-9193340.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 295 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, treated with primary chemotherapy at Indiana University from 1987 to 1994, stratified patients by response and by teratoma status in the primary tumor. It compared outcomes of observation versus postchemotherapy surgery. Patients with complete serologic and radiographic remission could be safely observed regardless of initial tumor bulk. Patients with teratoma-negative primary tumors and at least 90% radiographic remission, managed without surgery, had a higher risk of relapse, so postchemotherapy resection in that group remains controversial.

pmid-9195578.summary_ja: 13歳女児の卵巣未熟奇形腫に伴う腹膜神経膠腫症の症例。化学療法後も腹膜病変が残存し、7年後に骨盤内で膠芽腫様の悪性神経外胚葉腫瘍を発症して死亡した。腹膜病変の悪性転化の2例目の報告。
pmid-9195578.summary_en: A 13-year-old girl underwent resection of an ovarian grade 1 immature teratoma, and mature glial implants were found in the omentum. Despite chemotherapy with vincristine, cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, peritoneal glial implants persisted. Seven years later she developed a pelvic malignant neuroectodermal tumor resembling glioblastoma, which did not respond to debulking or chemotherapy, and she died eight years after her initial presentation. The authors report the second documented case of malignant transformation of peritoneal glial implants.

pmid-9196160.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生存者255例を対象とした質問票調査。化学療法、特にPVB療法群でレイノー現象や感覚異常が多く、勃起障害はレイノー現象と関連した。精巣摘除と経過観察のみの群より性機能障害が多かった。
pmid-9196160.summary_en: This questionnaire study surveyed 255 survivors of nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor and compared sexual dysfunction across treatment modalities. Patients receiving chemotherapy, particularly PVB, had more Raynaud's phenomenon and paresthesia. Erectile dysfunction was associated with Raynaud's phenomenon but not with acral paresthesia. Chemotherapy, with or without resection of residual retroperitoneal masses, was associated with more sexual dysfunction than orchidectomy and surveillance alone.

pmid-9198108.summary_ja: 妊娠7週の常位胎盤早期剥離後に発症した32歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍例。当初は頸部生検で子宮頸癌と誤診され、広汎子宮全摘術が施行された。術後14か月間無病であった。稀少腫瘍であり、診断上の落とし穴を示す症例である。
pmid-9198108.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman developed a placental site trophoblastic tumor after abruptio placentae at seven weeks of gestation. The tumor was initially misdiagnosed as cervical carcinoma on punch biopsy, and a radical Wertheim-Held hysterectomy was performed. The uterus showed a tumor confined to the uterine cavity without cervical invasion, and histology and immunohistochemistry confirmed PSTT. Pelvic lymph nodes were negative, and the patient remained disease-free 14 months after surgery. The case highlights the diagnostic pitfalls of this rare trophoblastic tumor.

pmid-9201244.summary_ja: 52歳女性が腹水と腹痛で受診した。手術で大網と腹膜結節に硬化性腹膜炎を認め、左卵巣には良性嚢胞性奇形腫があった。腹膜炎は卵巣病変、特に奇形腫に続発したと考えられた。術中所見は癌腫を思わせたが、術後26か月の経過は順調であった。
pmid-9201244.summary_en: A 52-year-old woman presented with ascites and abdominal pain. Surgery revealed sclerosing peritonitis in the omentum and peritoneal nodules, along with a benign cystic teratoma in the left ovary. The authors considered the peritonitis secondary to the ovarian changes, most probably the teratoma. Intraoperatively the omentum resembled carcinoma. Follow-up was uneventful for 26 months, making this a rare association between a benign ovarian teratoma and sclerosing peritonitis.

pmid-9201282.summary_ja: 1981～1995年に精巣がんで治療を受けた650例中、7例（1.08%）に家族性発生が認められ、停留精巣の合併が多かった。HLA型判定を含め家族を詳細に解析した。精巣がんが疑われる患者の初期評価に、泌尿生殖器の発生異常と腫瘍の家族歴の聴取を加えることを提案している。自己検診と併せ、二次予防に重要とされる。
pmid-9201282.summary_en: Among 650 patients treated for testicular cancer between 1981 and 1995, familial occurrence was found in seven (1.08%), most often together with cryptorchidism. Families were analyzed in detail, including HLA typing. The authors recommend that the initial workup of suspected testicular cancer include a detailed family history of urogenital developmental anomalies and tumors. Combined with testicular self-examination, this knowledge is considered important for secondary prevention.

pmid-9201681.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの早期患者10例を対象に、腰椎を含むドッグレッグ照射後の椎体骨髄をMRIのT2緩和時間で評価した。照射群では非照射群や皮下脂肪より有意に延長しており、照射患者と対照を明確に区別できた。放射線療法による晩期の骨髄変化を定量的MRIで検出できることを示した。
pmid-9201681.summary_en: Ten patients with early-stage testicular seminoma who had received dog-leg field radiotherapy including the lumbar spine were compared with healthy and nonirradiated controls using quantitative MRI. Irradiated lumbar bone marrow showed significantly longer T2 relaxation times than controls and than subcutaneous fat. This difference clearly distinguished irradiated patients from controls, suggesting that late radiation effects on marrow can be detected by T2 measurement.

pmid-9202564.summary_ja: CTで下大静脈閉塞が疑われた精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜転移5例を、1.5T MRIとMRAで評価した。MRIは血栓や外部圧迫による閉塞、側副血行路を明瞭に描出し、全例でCTより有用な情報を得た。放射線被曝や造影剤を要しない利点があり、手術計画や抗凝固療法の判断に役立つと述べている。
pmid-9202564.summary_en: Five patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis and abdominal nodal metastases, in whom CT suggested inferior vena cava occlusion, were imaged with 1.5 T MRI and MRA. MRI clearly detected partial and total occlusion from thrombus or extrinsic compression, as well as collateral circulation and cavernous transformation. MRI gave better information than CT in all patients, without ionizing radiation or contrast media. The authors suggest MRI be used for IVC imaging when occlusion is suspected.

pmid-9202807.summary_ja: 正常核型を示す姉弟に胚細胞腫瘍が発生した症例である。姉は右卵巣のディスジャーミノーマで、治療により完治した。弟は縦隔の胎児性癌で化学療法中である。弟は精巣超音波検査で異常を認めたが、診断時の病理組織学的検査は正常であった。胚細胞腫瘍の兄弟姉妹がいる小児は、別の腫瘍の発生に注意して評価すべきと提言している。
pmid-9202807.summary_en: Two siblings with normal karyotypes developed germ cell tumours. The sister, now 23, had a right ovarian dysgerminoma that was successfully treated; the brother, 15, had mediastinal embryonal carcinoma and was receiving chemotherapy. Testicular ultrasonography in the brother was abnormal, though histopathology at diagnosis was normal. The authors recommend careful assessment of children who have a sibling with a germ cell tumour, to watch for further tumours.

pmid-9203042.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍12例の新鮮腫瘍細胞を用い、8剤についてMTT法でin vitro薬剤感受性を検討した。高濃度ではほぼ全剤が増殖を抑制した。低濃度ではインターフェロンとビンクリスチンの効果が低かった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍は薬剤感受性が高く、一部の患者で二次化学療法薬の選択に有用と結論づけている。
pmid-9203042.summary_en: Fresh cells from 12 testicular germ cell tumours were tested in vitro with eight agents, including interferon-alpha, cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, using an MTT colorimetric assay. Most tumours were inhibited by high concentrations of all drugs. At low concentrations, interferon and vincristine were less effective, at 33.3% and 58.3% respectively. The authors conclude that these tumours are highly drug-sensitive and that in vitro assay may help identify effective second-line agents for a small number of patients.

pmid-9205864.summary_ja: 30歳女性が、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法および放射線療法の後に、侵襲性の全身性肥満細胞症を発症した。主訴は骨痛で、長年にわたり線維性異形成症と誤診されていた。骨髄検査、脾摘出、肝生検、剖検により診断が確定した。卵巣発生という点が特異的であり、胚細胞腫瘍に伴う血液悪性腫瘍との関連が示唆された。
pmid-9205864.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman developed aggressive systemic mastocytosis after chemotherapy and radiotherapy for a malignant ovarian germ cell tumour. Her chief complaint was skeletal pain, which was misdiagnosed as fibrous dysplasia for years. Bone marrow examination, splenectomy, liver biopsy and autopsy confirmed the diagnosis. The authors note the unusual ovarian location of the tumour. They suggest a link to the haematological malignancies previously reported in association with germ cell tumours, particularly mediastinal ones.

pmid-9207575.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者では、化学療法前からすでに精子形成が障害されていることが多い。待機的戦略（サーベイランス）や化学療法の有無を比較する前向き試験により、化学療法そのものの影響を評価できるようになった。不可逆的な生殖腺障害はシスプラチン累積投与量に依存し、400 mg/m2超で予想される。標準治療4コース相当の400 mg未満では不可逆的障害の可能性は低い。
pmid-9207575.summary_en: This paper examines whether cytostatic chemotherapy causes long-term infertility in testicular germ cell cancer patients, many of whom already have impaired spermatogenesis before treatment. Surveillance strategies and prospective trials comparing chemotherapy with no chemotherapy now allow the true chemotherapy effect to be estimated. Irreversible gonadal damage depends on cumulative cisplatin dose and is expected above 400 mg/m2. Below 400 mg, roughly four standard courses, irreversible damage is unlikely.

pmid-9208904.summary_ja: 縦隔原発悪性胚細胞腫瘍18例にシスプラチン併用化学療法を施行した。セミノーマ9例は全例完全奏効し、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は9例中2例のみであった。中央値48か月の時点で、セミノーマ全例と非セミノーマ4例が無病生存している。縦隔セミノーマの予後は極めて良好で、非セミノーマは不良であり、残存腫瘍の切除が転帰を改善する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9208904.summary_en: Eighteen patients with primary mediastinal malignant germ cell tumours were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, with consolidation radiotherapy for seminoma. All nine seminoma patients achieved complete response, while only two of nine non-seminomatous patients did. At a median follow-up of 48 months, all seminoma patients and four non-seminoma patients were disease-free. The authors conclude that mediastinal seminoma has an excellent prognosis, while non-seminoma is poorer, and suggest that resection of residual masses may improve outcomes.

pmid-9209461.summary_ja: 精巣原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍、残存成熟奇形腫、増殖性奇形腫病変の染色体異常を比較した。12例で原発腫瘍と残存成熟奇形腫、1例で3病変すべて、2例で残存成熟奇形腫と増殖性病変を解析した。同一患者内で染色体異常の違いが認められたが、特定の染色体変化が転移や分化に関与する証拠は得られなかった。
pmid-9209461.summary_en: The authors compared chromosomal patterns in primary testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumours, residual mature teratomas (RMT) and growing teratoma (GTE) lesions. Twelve patients were analysed for primary tumour and RMT, one patient for all three lesion types, and two patients for RMT and GTE. Several chromosomal differences appeared between primary tumours and RMT, and between RMT and GTE within the same patient. No specific chromosomal alteration was found to play a role in metastasis or differentiation.

pmid-9210263.summary_ja: 7週齢雄のICRマウスの左精巣に自然発生した奇形腫を報告した。腫瘍は三胚葉すべての由来の高分化組織から成り、神経組織、骨、軟骨、骨格筋、脂肪組織、呼吸上皮を含んでいた。転移は認められなかった。129系統と同様に先天性由来が示唆され、ICR系統における自然発生精巣奇形腫の初報告である。
pmid-9210263.summary_en: The authors describe a spontaneous testicular teratoma in the left testis of a seven-week-old male ICR mouse. The tumour contained well-differentiated tissues from all three germ layers, including neural tissue, stratified epithelium, bone, cartilage, striated muscle, adipose tissue and respiratory epithelium. No metastasis was detected. The authors suggest a congenital origin, as in strain 129 mice. This is described as the first report of a spontaneous testicular teratoma in the ICR strain.

pmid-9212008.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術と放射線療法のみを受けた純粋型セミノーマ患者53例で、精子濃度、FSH、性的満足度を追跡した。残存精巣への付随的な照射線量は妊孕性回復の遅れと関連し、FSHの変化は精子濃度の変化を反映した。結論として、残存精巣を守るためクラムシェル型の精巣シールドの使用を支持している。
pmid-9212008.summary_en: This Southwest Oncology Group analysis followed 53 pure seminoma patients treated with orchiectomy and radiotherapy alone, measuring sperm concentration, FSH levels, and sexual satisfaction. Some men were infertile before radiotherapy. Incidental radiation dose to the remaining testis delayed fertility recovery, and FSH changes mirrored sperm concentration over time. Patients rated their sexual activity as good. The authors support clamshell-type testicular shields to protect the remaining testis.

pmid-9212009.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマ患者で、傍大動脈照射とドッグレッグ照射の精巣表面線量を測定し、1年後の精子数を評価した。平均線量は傍大動脈照射0.09Gy、ドッグレッグ照射0.32Gyで、精子数の有意な減少はドッグレッグ照射でのみ認められた。正中面線量と恥骨結合-精巣間距離から個々の性腺線量を予測するモデルを作成し、患者で検証した。
pmid-9212009.summary_en: Researchers measured gonadal surface dose in stage I seminoma patients receiving para-aortic or dog-leg radiotherapy and assessed sperm counts one year later. Mean doses were 0.09 Gy for para-aortic and 0.32 Gy for dog-leg fields. Only dog-leg irradiation significantly reduced sperm count. A model predicting gonadal dose from midplane dose and symphysis-to-testicle distance was developed and validated in patients, allowing individualized dose estimation.

pmid-9213047.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの若年男性が、傍大動脈リンパ節転移の評価目的でコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)検査を受けた症例を提示する教育的記事。病期分類には正常解剖、解剖学的変異、病理像の理解が不可欠であり、誤解を招きうる画像診断の落とし穴を示している。読者の理解に役立つ教材である。
pmid-9213047.summary_en: This case-based teaching article describes a young man with testicular seminoma who underwent CT to assess for para-aortic metastatic spread. The authors emphasize that accurate staging requires understanding normal anatomy, possible anatomical variants, and expected pathology. The case illustrates an imaging pitfall that may mislead the unwary reader. The article is an educational case report rather than a clinical study, offering a teaching example for readers interpreting staging imaging.

pmid-9215823.summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍患者にVIP化学療法を行い、腫瘍マーカーに基づき大量CEC療法と自家骨髄移植を併用した。30例中57%が完全奏効し、中央値30か月の追跡で67%が生存していた。早期の大量化学療法は従来型シスプラチン療法より生存期間が長く、忍容性は良好であった。
pmid-9215823.summary_en: Patients with poor-risk germ cell tumors received first-line VIP with or without high-dose carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide (CEC) followed by autologous marrow transplant. Of 30 patients, 57% achieved complete response, and 67% were alive at a median follow-up of 30 months. Compared with conventional cisplatin therapy, marker-guided early high-dose chemotherapy was associated with longer survival. The regimen was well tolerated, and a randomized trial was initiated.

pmid-9215824.summary_ja: 予後良好な転移性胚細胞腫瘍214例にエトポシドとシスプラチン(EP)4コースを行った後方視的研究。91%が完全奏効し、完全奏効例の9%が中央値10か月で再発した。不完全奏効または再発の8例は救援化学療法で無病となった。中央値7.6年の追跡で86%が生存していた。
pmid-9215824.summary_en: This retrospective study of 214 patients with good-risk metastatic germ cell tumors treated with four cycles of etoposide and cisplatin reports response, relapse, survival, and salvage outcomes. Complete response occurred in 91%, and 9% of those in complete response later relapsed, at a median of 10 months. Eight patients with incomplete response or relapse were rendered disease-free by salvage therapy. At a median follow-up of 7.6 years, 86% were alive. The authors conclude that EP is effective for good-risk disease.

pmid-9215825.summary_ja: 一次のシスプラチン含有療法に抵抗性の進行胚細胞腫瘍56例に、イホスファミド、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチンまたはエトポシドを併用する救援化学療法を行った。36%が完全奏効し、中央値52か月の追跡で23%が無病生存した。精巣原発で初回治療に完全奏効していた症例は予後が良く、性腺外原発や不完全奏効例は予後不良であった。
pmid-9215825.summary_en: Fifty-six patients with advanced GCT resistant to one prior cisplatin regimen received VeIP or VIP salvage chemotherapy. Thirty-six percent achieved complete response, and 23% remained continuously disease-free at a median follow-up of 52 months. Patients with a testicular primary and prior complete response to first-line therapy had a 65% survival rate, while those with extragonadal primaries or incomplete response fared worse. Durable responses occurred only in a minority, supporting risk-directed trials.

pmid-9219001.summary_ja: 生後5か月の女児に発生した卵巣の混合性胚細胞-性索間質性腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的解析です。核型解析で22番染色体のモノソミーが唯一の異常として見つかり、比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションでも他の不均衡は認めませんでした。顆粒膜細胞腫でも報告される所見であることから、両腫瘍の共通の発症経路が示唆されています。症例は1例のみです。
pmid-9219001.summary_en: Cytogenetic report of a mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumor of the ovary in a 5-month-old girl. Karyotyping showed monosomy 22 as the sole abnormality, confirmed by comparative genomic hybridization, which revealed no other imbalances. This is the first reported chromosomal aberration in this tumor type. Because monosomy 22 has also been described in ovarian granulosa cell tumors, the authors propose a shared pathogenetic pathway for these two tumor types. The study is a single case, so generalizability is limited, but it offers a molecular clue for classifying pediatric ovarian mixed tumors.

pmid-9220287.summary_ja: タキソール（パクリタキセル）の前臨床試験で、NSGCT細胞株とシスプラチン不応性の異種移植片に対する効果を評価した。シスプラチン感受性株および一部のシスプラチン耐性株では、IC50が低ナノモル域で強い細胞毒性を示した。高度耐性の2株では感受性が低下しており、大量化学療法後に再発した患者のモデルとなりうる。15 mg/kg/日で用量依存的な抗腫瘍活性が認められ、併用研究の必要性が示された。
pmid-9220287.summary_en: Preclinical study testing paclitaxel (taxol) against non-seminomatous germ cell tumor cell lines and cisplatin-refractory xenografts. Taxol was highly cytotoxic in cisplatin-sensitive and some cisplatin-resistant lines, with IC50 values in the low nanomolar range. Two lines with high cisplatin resistance (1411HP and 1777NRp Cl-A) showed reduced sensitivity, potentially modeling patients who relapse after high-dose platinum therapy. Exposure time strongly affected potency, and dose-dependent antitumor activity was seen in a cisplatin-refractory xenograft at 15 mg/kg/day. The authors call for further combination studies to address drug-resistant relapsed disease.

pmid-9220289.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株パネルを用い、オキサリプラチンとシスプラチンの細胞傷害性をin vitroで比較した研究です。中等度の耐性株ではオキサリプラチンがシスプラチンより有意に効果的で、耐性倍率も低値でした。感受性株や高度耐性株では差は認められませんでした。長時間曝露のスケジュールが有用と考察され、併用療法の前臨床研究が提案されています。
pmid-9220289.summary_en: In vitro comparison of oxaliplatin and cisplatin cytotoxicity in a panel of NSGCT cell lines, including cisplatin-resistant lines, using short and long drug exposures in an SRB assay. Oxaliplatin was significantly more active than cisplatin in lines with intermediate acquired or intrinsic cisplatin resistance, with lower fold-resistance (1.7 to 2.2 versus 3.9 to 6.1). Activity was similar in sensitive lines and in highly resistant lines. The authors suggest oxaliplatin may lack cross-resistance with cisplatin and support prolonged-exposure schedules, recommending preclinical study in combination with cisplatin, ifosfamide and etoposide.

pmid-9224327.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がん159例を対象に、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清と開胸術の結果を再解析した研究です。後腹膜の壊死は肺病変の壊死と強く相関し、後腹膜で壊死を認めた場合は肺でも89%の確率で壊死を認めました。胸部手術の前に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行うべきと結論づけています。
pmid-9224327.summary_en: Re-analysis of 159 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and thoracotomy after cisplatin-based induction chemotherapy. Necrosis at retroperitoneal dissection was more common when the primary lacked teratoma, residual masses were small, or shrinkage was marked. Residual mass size did not predict lung histology. Retroperitoneal and pulmonary histology were strongly correlated: necrosis in the retroperitoneum carried an 89 percent probability of necrosis in the lung. The authors conclude that retroperitoneal dissection should precede thoracotomy, since its findings predict the thoracic result.

pmid-9224380.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者89人の保存原発腫瘍を、潜在性リンパ節病変を予測する目的でMIB-1（Ki-67）染色と、胎児性癌の割合および脈管侵襲について評価した。MIB-1スコアは病理学的病期を区別しなかった。脈管侵襲と胎児性癌の割合は有意な危険因子であり、その組み合わせにより病理学的病期IIを86.5%の症例で正しく予測した。著者らは、リンパ節転移の同定には MIB-1ではなくこれらの組織学的特徴が有用であるとし、前向き多施設共同試験の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-9224380.summary_en: Archival primary tumors from 89 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor were stained for MIB-1 (Ki-67) and assessed for embryonal carcinoma percentage and vascular invasion, to predict occult nodal disease. MIB-1 scores did not distinguish pathological stage. Vascular invasion and percentage of embryonal carcinoma were significant risk factors, and their combination predicted pathological stage II correctly in 86.5 percent of cases. The authors conclude these histologic features, rather than MIB-1, are useful for identifying lymph node metastasis in clinical stage I disease, and call for a prospective multicenter trial.

pmid-9224517.summary_ja: 後縦隔と後腹膜に及ぶ巨大な嚢胞性良性奇形腫を有する成人例の報告です。完全切除ではなく、部分的な嚢胞内膜切除とテトラサイクリンの嚢胞腔内注入による保存的治療を行いました。術後2か月のCTで残存嚢胞は6×5×3cmでした。嚢胞内面の切除と硬化療法が、液体の再貯留と腫瘍の増大を抑える可能性が考察されています。
pmid-9224517.summary_en: Report of an adult with a giant cystic benign teratoma (33 x 22 x 18 cm) involving the posterior mediastinum and retroperitoneum. Treatment was conservative: partial endocystectomy followed by intracystic tetracycline injection into the residual cavity, avoiding complete resection. Two months postoperatively, CT showed a residual cyst of 6 x 5 x 3 cm. The authors propose that excising the inner cyst lining and sclerosing with tetracycline may prevent fluid reaccumulation and progressive enlargement of large benign cystic teratomas. This is a single case report.

pmid-9225188.summary_ja: 有茎性の鼻咽頭皮様嚢腫により新生児に呼吸窮迫を来した症例で、MRIによる評価と外科的完全切除の経過を報告しています。鼻咽頭奇形腫は稀で、三胚葉由来の組織から成り、新生児期に気道閉塞として出現すると述べています。安全な気道確保が治療の第一の目標とされています。
pmid-9225188.summary_en: Case report of neonatal respiratory distress caused by a pedunculated nasopharyngeal dermoid, assessed by MRI. The lesion was removed surgically without complications. The authors note nasopharyngeal teratomas are uncommon, arise from all three germ layers, and present in the neonatal period with airway obstruction. The first management priority is a safe airway established through complete surgical excision. The report is relevant as an example of an extragonadal teratoma in an infant, though it is a single case.

pmid-9226322.summary_ja: 中国医学科学院の施設で、矯正済みおよび未矯正の鼠径部停留精巣に生じたセミノーマ66人を後方視的に検討した。受診時の26%にリンパ節転移があり、以前に精巣固定術を受けた患者でより多く認められた。病期I患者の10年全生存率は100%、病期II患者は68%であった。4人が再発し、そのうち2人は照射野の辺縁不足による鼠径部再発であった。著者らは、予後は極めて良好であるとし、病期Iおよび病期IIAには精巣摘除術後の放射線療法を推奨し、傍大動脈および同側骨盤リンパ節を含めることを勧めている。
pmid-9226322.summary_en: This retrospective study of 66 patients from the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences examines inguinal seminomas arising in corrected and uncorrected cryptorchidism. Nodal metastases were present in 26% at diagnosis, more frequently after prior orchiopexy. Stage I patients had 100% 10-year survival, and stage II had 68%. Four patients relapsed, with two inguinal failures attributed to marginal misses. The authors conclude prognosis is excellent and recommend postorchiectomy radiotherapy for stage I and IIA disease, including para-aortic and ipsilateral pelvic nodes.

pmid-9226323.summary_ja: 北京で1958〜1991年に治療された骨盤内停留セミノーマ60例を解析した。初診時の転移は43%と陰嚢型より高率であった。病期IおよびIIは外科的術式にかかわらず放射線療法で良好に制御され、病期Iでは全腹部・骨盤照射は不要とされた。病期IIB以上には白金製剤による化学療法が推奨されている。
pmid-9226323.summary_en: Sixty patients with pelvic cryptorchid seminoma treated in Beijing from 1958 to 1991 were analyzed. Forty-three percent had metastatic disease at presentation, and pelvic nodal spread was more frequent than in scrotal seminoma. Stage I and II disease was well controlled by radiotherapy regardless of surgical approach, with 100% and 94% five-year survival respectively. Whole abdominal-pelvic irradiation was not necessary for stage I and IIA, and the authors recommend platinum-based chemotherapy for stage IIB to IV disease.

pmid-9228272.summary_ja: 19歳女性が精神病と痙攣、中枢性低換気を伴う辺縁系・脳幹脳炎を発症した。血清AFP上昇と卵巣腫瘍から未熟奇形腫と診断され、切除後に認知機能は大きく回復した。抗Hu抗体は陰性で、奇形腫内の神経成分との免疫交差反応が推測されている。卵巣原発の胚細胞腫瘍に伴う傍腫瘍性神経症候群の例である。
pmid-9228272.summary_en: A 19-year-old woman developed limbic and brainstem encephalitis with psychosis, seizures, and central hypoventilation requiring ventilation. An elevated serum AFP and an ovarian tumor led to the diagnosis of an immature ovarian teratoma. After tumor resection, cognitive function substantially recovered, although some psychotic sequelae remained. Anti-Hu antibodies were negative, so the authors propose cross-reactivity between neuronal elements within the teratoma and brain tissue, possibly through cell-mediated immunity. The report illustrates a paraneoplastic neurological complication of a non-CNS germ cell tumor.

pmid-9229152.summary_ja: 精巣がん増加の要因として、環境化学物質、熱ストレス、座位生活、免疫抑制などの仮説を概説した総説である。胚細胞腫瘍の化学感受性に関わる分子機序としてp53と熱ショック応答が取り上げられている。大量化学療法と幹細胞移植は治療関連死亡のため二次治療に限られる。早期病変での患者の同意も課題とされる。
pmid-9229152.summary_en: This review on testis cancer discusses hypotheses for the rising incidence, including estrogen-mimicking chemicals, heat exposure, sedentary lifestyle, and immunosuppression. It highlights p53 abnormalities and heat-shock responses as possible explanations for the chemosensitivity of germ cell tumors. The authors note that immunosuppression raises risk 20 to 50 times, and that high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation remains restricted to second-line use due to treatment-related mortality. Patient consent for expanding early-stage treatment options is identified as an emerging issue.

pmid-9230496.summary_ja: セミノーマに対する精巣摘除術の後にエロトマニア（恋愛妄想）を発症した若年の男性患者の症例報告である。妄想が生じる心理的機序について考察している。がん治療に伴うこのような精神症状の管理には、腫瘍内科と精神科リエゾンサービスの連携が重要であると強調されている。
pmid-9230496.summary_en: A case report describes a young man who developed erotomania, a delusional belief that another person is in love with him, after orchiectomy for seminoma. The authors discuss possible psychological mechanisms underlying this delusion. The report emphasizes the value of collaboration between the oncology ward and psychiatric liaison services in managing such complications of cancer treatment.

pmid-9233528.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性339例に対するPOMB/ACE周期療法の長期成績を報告した研究です。5年全生存率は82%で、未治療例や精巣原発例で良好でした。予後不良群の生存率はIGCCCG導出コホートより改善しました。致死的毒性は既存の単純なレジメンと同程度でした。
pmid-9233528.summary_en: This large retrospective series reports outcomes of 339 men with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors treated with cyclical POMB/ACE chemotherapy, a regimen in use since 1977. Patients were classified by IGCCCG criteria, and 42 had prior treatment. Five-year overall survival was 82%, with better results in untreated patients and testicular primaries than extragonadal ones. Poor-risk patients had improved survival compared with the derivation cohort. Fatal toxicity was comparable to simpler regimens, including five early treatment-related deaths and five cases of acute leukemia.

pmid-9233891.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫と大網の嚢胞性奇形腫が併存した2症例の報告です。大網の良性嚢胞性奇形腫は稀で、これまで卵巣奇形腫を伴う例は7例のみ報告されていました。本例では嚢胞壁に特徴的な濃い辺縁石灰化が認められ、画像所見の特徴として示されています。この併存例を認識するうえで役立つ点を強調しています。
pmid-9233891.summary_en: This case report describes two patients with cystic teratoma of the omentum coexisting with an ovarian teratoma. Benign cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) of the omentum is rare, while ovarian cystic teratoma is among the most common ovarian neoplasms. The authors note that only seven omental cases associated with ovarian teratoma had been reported previously. Imaging showed unusual dense rim calcification of the cystic wall. The paper highlights these imaging features to help recognize this unusual combination.

pmid-9238159.summary_ja: 予後良好な転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍50例に対するmVAB-6レジメンの第II相試験の長期成績です。完全奏効率は92%、中央値8年の追跡で90%が無病生存しました。晩期毒性は軽微でした。二次性腫瘍は3例で、対側の胚細胞腫瘍2例と膵腺癌1例でした。非常によい予後群で高い有効性と安全性が示されました。
pmid-9238159.summary_en: This phase II trial evaluated a modified VAB-6 regimen in 50 patients with good-prognosis metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, over half with retroperitoneal nodes only. Complete response was achieved in 92%, and 90% remained disease-free at median follow-up of 8 years. Eight relapses occurred 3 to 60 months after treatment. Long-term toxicity was minimal. Three secondary tumors developed, including two contralateral germ cell tumors and one pancreatic adenocarcinoma, supporting the regimen's excellent results and safety in very good-risk disease.

pmid-9238285.summary_ja: 思春期の卵巣悪性腫瘍を概説した総説で、胚細胞腫瘍が61.5%を占めます。ディスジャーミノーマが最も多く、腫瘍マーカーはフォローアップに有用です。多くは病期Iで診断され、保存的手術が選択されます。上皮性腫瘍と性索間質性腫瘍についても述べています。
pmid-9238285.summary_en: This review describes ovarian malignancies in adolescence, which are rare but the most common genital neoplasms in this age group. Germ cell tumors account for 61.5% of cases, with dysgerminoma being the most frequent. These tumors often secrete hormones and tumor markers useful for monitoring, and are often diagnosed at stage I, where conservative surgery is preferred. Epithelial neoplasms, including mucinous and borderline tumors, and sex cord-stromal tumors such as juvenile granulosa cell tumor are also discussed, with adnexectomy as adequate treatment for low-malignant-potential lesions.

pmid-9238288.summary_ja: 妊孕性を温存したい若年女性の悪性卵巣腫瘍に対する保存的手術を検討した総説です。病期Iの胚細胞腫瘍などでは片側卵管卵巣摘出術が選択されうるとしています。ほぼすべての卵巣胚細胞腫瘍には補助化学療法が必要とされ、保存的管理後の妊娠は可能と述べています。
pmid-9238288.summary_en: This review examines conservative surgery for malignant ovarian neoplasms in young women who wish to preserve fertility. Unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy may be used for stage I borderline, germ cell, sex cord-stromal, and grade I epithelial tumors, while bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy with uterine preservation may be considered for bilateral involvement. Complete surgical staging is mandatory. Adjuvant chemotherapy is necessary in almost all ovarian germ cell tumors. The authors note conception is possible after conservative management, and that chemotherapy did not cause obvious malformations in newborns.

pmid-9239831.summary_ja: 妊娠32週の超音波検査で発見された、外部成分のない完全内部嚢胞性の仙尾部奇形腫（IV型）の症例報告です。仙尾部奇形腫の多くは外部に突出する充実性または混合性の腫瘤です。この型では鑑別診断が、外部病変が主体の腫瘍とは異なると強調しています。
pmid-9239831.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with a large, completely cystic internal sacrococcygeal teratoma, a type IV variant without an external component, identified prenatally by ultrasonography at 32 weeks' gestation. Most sacrococcygeal teratomas are solid or mixed masses with an external caudal component, and entirely internal cystic forms are rare. The authors emphasize that the differential diagnosis for this presentation differs from that for predominantly external complex tumors, which is important for prenatal counseling and planning.

pmid-9240157.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の男性14例に、化学療法後に胸腹腔外腹膜外アプローチで外科的切除を行った研究です。精巣は正常でも、hCGやαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇していることが多い症例です。合併症は軽微で、14例中13例が生存、11例が無病生存しました。従来の経腹膜前方アプローチより腫瘍除去、合併症、回復の点で優れると結論しています。
pmid-9240157.summary_en: This study reports 14 men with primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumors treated with chemotherapy followed by surgical resection via a thoracoabdominal extraperitoneal approach. These patients typically present with large abdominal masses and raised hCG or AFP despite normal testes. Minimal morbidity occurred, with survival in 13 of 14 and disease-free survival in 11 of 14 after median follow-up of 15 months. The authors conclude the approach improves tumor clearance, morbidity, and recovery compared with the transperitoneal anterior approach.

pmid-9241079.summary_ja: 1977〜1994年にグロニンゲン大学病院で精巣がんと診断された264例を後方視的に調査し、性機能を評価した。約40%で機能低下がみられ、多剤化学療法を受けた非セミノーマ患者で低下が強かった。放射線療法を受けた病期I-IIAのセミノーマでは待機観察群との差はなかった。がん診断に伴う心理的要因の関与も示唆された。
pmid-9241079.summary_en: This retrospective survey of 264 men treated for testicular cancer in Groningen (1977-1994) assessed sexual function. Forty percent reported some decline, most often in ejaculation and orgasm. Men given polychemotherapy, with or without resection of residual retroperitoneal mass, reported sharper declines than wait-and-see Stage I nonseminoma patients, and chemotherapy alone worsened outcomes more than chemotherapy with surgery. Radiotherapy for Stage I-IIA seminoma showed no significant difference. The authors conclude that psychological factors arising from the cancer diagnosis may strongly mediate sexual dysfunction.

pmid-9241501.summary_ja: 1979〜1994年に治療された悪性仙尾部奇形腫の小児20例を検討した。転移は60%に認められ、化学療法レジメン(BEP、JEB)の改良に伴い生存率が向上した。JEB療法を受けた12例中11例が生存した。血清AFPの上昇は臨床的再発に先行することが多く、原発巣と尾骨の完全切除が推奨されている。
pmid-9241501.summary_en: This 16-year review of 20 infants and children with malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma examined survival under successive chemotherapy regimens. Sixty percent had distant metastases, most often to the lung. Survival improved with the cisplatin-based BEP and later carboplatin-based JEB protocols, with 11 of 12 JEB-treated patients surviving. Rising serum AFP often preceded clinical relapse. The authors recommend JEB chemotherapy, complete excision of the primary tumour and coccyx, and surgery for chemoresistant metastases, reporting an overall cure rate above 90%.

pmid-9241566.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍からの孤発性脳転移を2例報告した。組織型は奇形癌と胎児性癌であった。両例とも外科的切除、全脳放射線療法、化学療法を受け、42か月および72か月の無病生存が得られている。脳転移に対する集学的治療の有用性を、文献レビューとともに考察している。
pmid-9241566.summary_en: The authors describe two patients with solitary cerebral metastases from non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours: one teratocarcinoma and one embryonal carcinoma. Both received surgery, whole-brain radiotherapy and chemotherapy and remained disease-free at 42 and 72 months. The report notes that nervous system involvement from testicular tumours is uncommon. Based on these cases and a literature review, combined surgical, radiological and chemotherapeutic management of such metastases appears to improve outcomes.

pmid-9242768.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の70例で、術前CTによる後腹膜リンパ節転移診断を後方視的に検討した。10mm基準では感度37%・特異度100%、4mm基準では感度93%・特異度58%であった。大動脈の前方にあるリンパ節は転移との相関が強かった。4mm以上、特に前方のリンパ節は転移を疑うべきとしている。
pmid-9242768.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 70 men with clinical stage I testicular nonseminomatous germ cell cancer evaluated preoperative CT for detecting retroperitoneal lymph node metastases. Using a 10 mm criterion, sensitivity was only 37% with 100% specificity, while a 4 mm threshold raised sensitivity to 93% but reduced specificity to 58%. Nodes located anterior to the aorta correlated more strongly with metastasis than posterior nodes. Nodes of 4 mm or larger, especially anterior ones, should raise suspicion of metastasis.

pmid-9243199.summary_ja: 1985〜1992年にディクル大学医学部で妊娠性絨毛性疾患88例を後方視的に検討した。発生率は分娩1000件あたり12.9であった。胞状奇胎が81.8%、絨毛癌が18.2%を占めた。胞状奇胎には吸引掻爬とオキシトシン点滴が第一選択であった。多経妊、農村居住、低い社会経済的地位が関連要因として示唆された。
pmid-9243199.summary_en: This retrospective review of 88 pregnant women with gestational trophoblastic disease at Dicle University (1985-1992) found an incidence of 12.9 per 1000 deliveries. Hydatidiform mole accounted for 81.8% of cases and choriocarcinoma for 18.2%. Suction curettage with oxytocin infusion was the preferred treatment for moles. Higher incidence was associated with multiparity, rural residence, and low socioeconomic and educational status, which the authors suggest are aetiological factors.

pmid-9243200.summary_ja: 卵巣の未熟奇形腫を外科的切除した後に腹壁転移を生じた症例報告である。正しい診断に至るまでの経過が遅れたことを検討している。40歳未満の卵巣腫瘍患者では術前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)測定を推奨している。奇形腫の未熟性の評価は病理医にとって困難であり、正確な診断を妨げうると指摘している。
pmid-9243200.summary_en: This case report describes a delayed diagnosis of immature teratoma of the ovary, followed by abdominal wall metastases after surgical resection. The authors note that the diagnostic process was prolonged before the correct diagnosis was made. They recommend preoperative alpha-fetoprotein measurement in all women under 40 with ovarian tumours. They also emphasise the difficulty pathologists face in assessing immaturity within teratomas, which can complicate accurate diagnosis and grading.

pmid-9244352.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3およびJArに由来するクローンで、刷り込み遺伝子H19とIGF-2の発現を解析した。両遺伝子の発現と腫瘍形成能との一貫した関連は認められなかった。ヌードマウスで生じた腫瘍ではH19の発現が高値であった。H19は腫瘍抑制遺伝子ではないと結論されたが、絨毛癌の発生における役割は未解決である。
pmid-9244352.summary_en: This study examined H19 and IGF-2 expression in clones derived from choriocarcinoma cell lines JEG-3 and JAr. No consistent relationship was found between the two imprinted genes or with tumorigenic properties. After injection into nude mice, H19 expression was high in all tumours regardless of pre-injection levels. The authors conclude that H19 is not a tumour suppressor gene, but its role in choriocarcinogenesis remains unresolved. Both genes were biallelically expressed in all clones.

pmid-9247245.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された心膜奇形腫2例と既報例の検討から、胎児の管理アルゴリズムを提案している。水腫を伴わない例は経過観察し出生後に治療可能とし、水腫が出現した例では心膜液の穿刺吸引または胎児手術による切除が必要とする。出生前診断例の予後は出生後切除例より不良であり、早期の認識と適切な介入の重要性を示している。
pmid-9247245.summary_en: This report reviews prenatally diagnosed pericardial teratomas, describing two recent fetal cases and previously published cases. The authors propose a management algorithm: fetuses without hydrops can be safely followed and treated after birth, whereas those developing hydrops require pericardial fluid aspiration or fetal surgery with resection. Outcomes of prenatally detected pericardial teratomas are less favorable than those of postnatally excised tumors, underscoring the importance of early recognition and timely intervention.

pmid-9248127.summary_ja: EMA-CO、EMA-PE、BEPの各化学療法レジメンに抵抗性を示した子宮絨毛癌の30歳女性の症例である。最終的にVIP療法により治癒した。著者らは、難治性絨毛癌に対してVIP療法が有効なプロトコールとなりうると結論づけている。治療失敗の経過と奏効に至った過程を示した、救援療法の臨床例である。
pmid-9248127.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with uterine choriocarcinoma that was resistant to EMA-CO, EMA-PE, and BEP chemotherapy regimens. She was ultimately cured with the VIP regimen. The authors suggest that VIP chemotherapy may be an effective protocol for refractory choriocarcinoma. The report documents the sequence of treatment failures and the eventual response, providing a clinical example of salvage therapy for resistant uterine choriocarcinoma.

pmid-9249872.summary_ja: 妊娠20週の定期超音波検査で発見された未熟性腸間膜奇形腫の男児新生児の症例である。妊娠40週に状態良好で出生し、出生直後に手術を受けた。術後経過は順調で、現在も良好とされる。極めてまれな腸間膜奇形腫において、出生前超音波診断が計画的な周産期管理と良好な転帰につながったことを示している。
pmid-9249872.summary_en: This report describes a male newborn with an immature mesenteric teratoma detected by routine ultrasound screening at 20 weeks' gestation. The infant was delivered at 40 weeks in good condition and underwent successful surgical resection shortly after birth. The postoperative course was uneventful, and the child was doing well. The authors highlight that mesenteric teratoma is very rare and that prenatal ultrasonographic detection enabled planned perinatal management with an excellent outcome.

pmid-9250171.summary_ja: ヒト精巣腫瘍のX不活化を、XIST発現とアンドロゲン受容体遺伝子のメチル化により検討した。XISTはセミノーマ、非セミノーマ、精母細胞性セミノーマで発現し、上皮内癌を伴う実質でより高かった。アンドロゲン受容体のメチル化は、分化型非セミノーマすべてと未分化型の一部に認められた。著者らは、X不活化の計数機構が胚細胞腫瘍で機能し、分化依存的なメチル化パターンが保持されると結論づけている。
pmid-9250171.summary_en: This study examines X chromosome inactivation in human testicular tumors of different histogenesis by assessing XIST expression and androgen receptor gene methylation. XIST was expressed in seminomas, nonseminomas, and spermatocytic seminomas, and at higher levels in carcinoma in situ. Androgen receptor methylation was present in all differentiated nonseminomas but only in a subset of undifferentiated ones. The authors conclude that the X inactivation counting mechanism functions in testicular germ cell tumors and that the differentiation-dependent methylation pattern is retained.

pmid-9251738.summary_ja: 10年間に診療した頭頸部卵黄嚢腫瘍の3例の報告である。原発部位は眼窩、顎顔面、耳後部であった。2例は卵黄嚢パターン優位の悪性奇形腫、1例は純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍と病理診断された。全例で血清AFPが上昇した。2例は両親の拒否により補助化学療法を受けず、1例はシスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、ビンブラスチンにより部分寛解を得たが、4コース後に感染症で死亡した。
pmid-9251738.summary_en: This report describes three patients with endodermal sinus tumors of the head and neck, with orbital, maxillofacial, and retroauricular primaries, treated over a decade. Histopathology showed malignant teratoma with predominant endodermal sinus pattern in two patients and pure endodermal sinus tumor in one. All had elevated serum AFP. Two patients declined adjuvant chemotherapy after surgery. The third received cisplatin, bleomycin, and vinblastine, achieving partial remission, but died of infection after four courses.

pmid-9252698.summary_ja: 未治療の精巣胚細胞腫瘍77例を対象に、p53の免疫組織化学的発現を組織型、病期、化学療法への反応、MDR1/Pgp発現と比較した。分化型奇形腫を除くほぼ全ての腫瘍でp53陽性であった。p53発現は病期と逆相関し、化学療法感受性と正の相関を示した。著者らは、p53の状態が化学療法感受性の予測因子となり、耐性例に対する治療選択の指標になりうると結論づけている。
pmid-9252698.summary_en: This study examines p53 immunohistochemical expression in 77 untreated patients with testicular germ cell tumors, correlating it with histologic subtype, stage, chemotherapy response, and MDR1/P-glycoprotein expression. Nearly all tumor types except differentiated teratomas were p53-positive, with seminomas and embryonal carcinoma showing the most intense staining. p53 expression inversely correlated with stage and positively with chemosensitivity, and was inversely related to P-glycoprotein. The authors suggest p53 status predicts chemotherapy susceptibility and may guide alternative regimens for resistant patients.

pmid-9253126.summary_ja: 再発・転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し精巣摘除術後、エトポシド併用化学療法と放射線療法を受けた44歳男性の症例である。累積エトポシド投与量は6,400mg/m2であった。精巣摘除後11年で急性単球性白血病を発症した。文献レビューでは精巣がん治療後の二次性白血病が他に25例報告されていた。化学療法と放射線療法のどちらが原因か不明であるとしている。
pmid-9253126.summary_en: This case report describes a 44-year-old man who developed acute monocytic leukemia 11 years after orchiectomy for recurrent, metastatic testicular germ cell tumor. He had received 14 cycles of etoposide-based chemotherapy and radiotherapy, with a cumulative etoposide dose of 6,400 mg/m2. A literature review identified 25 other reported cases of secondary leukemia after testicular cancer treatment. The authors note that it remains unclear whether chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or both caused the secondary leukemia.

pmid-9255252.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に生じた原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍(PNET)29例を検討した研究である。免疫組織化学により、PNETは神経芽腫、髄上皮腫、末梢性神経上皮腫、上衣芽腫に分類された。精巣に限局したPNETは予後に影響せず、精巣外PNETは不良な予後因子で、多くは致命的であった。神経芽腫性転移の患者は生存期間が長かった。化学療法は転移性PNETに無効だった。
pmid-9255252.summary_en: This study of 29 young men with testicular germ cell tumors examined primitive neuroectodermal tumors (PNETs) arising within them. Immunohistochemistry classified PNETs as neuroblastoma, medulloepithelioma, peripheral neuroepithelioma, or ependymoblastoma types. PNETs confined to the testis did not affect prognosis, whereas extratesticular PNETs were an adverse factor and were usually fatal. Patients with neuroblastomatous metastases survived longer. Chemotherapy directed at germ cell tumors was ineffective against metastatic PNETs.

pmid-9255308.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ(病期I)に対する右精巣摘除術と放射線療法から約8年後に、S2神経根の悪性末梢神経鞘腫瘍を発症した症例を報告している。術後の放射線療法が二次性悪性腫瘍の発生に関与した可能性が高いとしている。胚細胞腫瘍治療後の長期的な晩期合併症として、フォローアップ中の注意が必要であることを示唆している。
pmid-9255308.summary_en: This case report describes a man who developed a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor of the S2 nerve root about eight years after treatment for stage I testicular seminoma. He had undergone right orchiectomy followed by periaortic irradiation including the sacrum. The authors suggest that postoperative radiation therapy likely contributed to this second malignancy. The report highlights a long-term late complication of germ cell tumor treatment that clinicians should monitor during follow-up.

pmid-9258096.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者232例を対象に、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の性腺機能をホルモン測定により評価した。卵胞刺激ホルモンの上昇が多く、精子形成障害が示唆された。テストステロンの低下は代償されていたが、60か月後も残存していた。生殖機能の障害は内分泌機能より重篤かつ長期にわたると結論された。
pmid-9258096.summary_en: In this cross-sectional and longitudinal study of 232 men treated for germ cell tumors, gonadal function was assessed by measuring LH, FSH and testosterone up to 153 months after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Elevated FSH, indicating impaired spermatogenesis, was common. Leydig cell function was compensated but remained reduced at 60 months. Impairment of germinative function was more severe and prolonged than endocrine impairment. Patients who had orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy without chemotherapy showed normal values.

pmid-9258097.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の陰嚢水腫液と血清で、hCGやAFPなどの腫瘍マーカーを測定した研究である。良性陰嚢水腫ではすべてのマーカーが基準値以下だった。セミノーマでは水腫液のhCGが高値を示すことが多く、血清が正常でもマーカー陽性と判明した非セミノーマ症例もあった。陰嚢腫脹の評価に有用な可能性がある。
pmid-9258097.summary_en: This study measured hCG, AFP and other tumor markers in hydrocele fluid and serum from patients with testicular cancer, comparing results with benign hydroceles. All markers were negative in benign hydroceles. In seminoma patients, hydrocele hCG was elevated in most cases while serum levels were normal, and three nonseminomatous tumors were reclassified as marker-positive. Cytokeratin-19 fragments were elevated in several cases. The authors suggest hydrocele fluid marker analysis may help evaluate uncertain scrotal swelling.

pmid-9258169.summary_ja: 米国小児科学会の思春期前精巣腫瘍レジストリに基づき、小児の精巣奇形腫の疫学を検討した研究である。診断時の中央値年齢は13か月で、多くは陰嚢内腫瘤として発見された。術前のAFPは34例中20例で上昇していた。根治的精巣摘除術で治療され、転移は報告されず、良性の性質が確認された。
pmid-9258169.summary_en: This registry-based study from the American Academy of Pediatrics Prepubertal Testis Tumor Registry describes the epidemiology of testicular teratoma in prepubertal children. Median age at presentation was 13 months, with equal right and left involvement, and most patients presented with a scrotal mass. Preoperative AFP was elevated in 20 of 34 patients. Most were treated with radical orchiectomy, and no metastatic disease was reported. The authors confirm the benign nature of this tumor and note that normal AFP levels should not be expected in infants.

pmid-9258780.summary_ja: 健康な若年男性が、気管支に浸潤した縦隔奇形腫により大量喀血を呈した症例を報告している。腫瘍は外科的に切除に成功した。縦隔奇形腫による喀血に関する文献をレビューし、大量喀血の鑑別診断と救急外来での初期対応を論じている。生命を脅かす気道症状として縦隔の腫瘍が現れうることを示している。
pmid-9258780.summary_en: This case report describes massive hemoptysis in a healthy young man caused by a mediastinal teratoma that had invaded a bronchus. The tumor was successfully resected surgically. The authors review the literature on hemoptysis due to mediastinal teratoma, present a differential diagnosis for massive hemoptysis, and discuss initial emergency department management and diagnostic options. The case shows that mediastinal germ cell tumors can present with life-threatening airway symptoms.

pmid-9259890.summary_ja: 妊娠中期の出生前超音波検査で、大きな1型嚢胞性仙尾部奇形腫を診断した症例報告です。超音波所見は予後不良の髄膜瘤に酷似していましたが、カラードプラ画像が正確な診断に役立ちました。1型は新生児期の切除により良好な経過をたどることが多いため、出生前の鑑別は相談や管理計画に重要であると述べています。
pmid-9259890.summary_en: This case report describes prenatal diagnosis of a large type 1 cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma in the midtrimester. The lesion closely resembled a meningomyelocele on ultrasonography, which carries a grave prognosis. Color Doppler imaging helped establish the correct diagnosis and distinguish the two conditions. Type 1 cystic sacrococcygeal teratomas generally have a good outcome after neonatal resection, so accurate prenatal differentiation is important for counseling and management planning.

pmid-9259903.summary_ja: 胎盤由来の絨毛癌が胎児に転移し、新生児に発症した稀な症例です。難治性貧血で発症し、肝・肺・脳へ急速に転移しました。超音波検査やCT、MRIなどの画像検査では診断できず、剖検で初めて確定しました。母体にも肝・肺腫瘍が見つかり、母体歴と尿中hCG測定が早期診断に有用と強調しています。
pmid-9259903.summary_en: This report describes a neonate with infantile choriocarcinoma arising in the placenta and metastasizing to the fetus. The infant presented with refractory anemia and rapidly developed metastases to liver, lungs and brain. Ultrasonography, CT, MRI, scintigraphy and hepatic arteriography were nondiagnostic, and the diagnosis was made only at postmortem. Maternal liver and lung tumors were later found. The authors emphasize that maternal history and urinary hCG measurement can enable rapid diagnosis.

pmid-9261521.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に残存腫瘤切除を受けた134例の解析です。一次化学療法後の標本では壊死が52%、分化型奇形腫が27%、未分化腫瘍が21%でした。未分化腫瘍は不完全切除や腫瘍マーカーの未正常化と関連していました。5年生存率は一次治療後80%、救援化学療法後44%でした。残存腫瘍切除の重要性と、PETによる手術回避の可能性を述べています。
pmid-9261521.summary_en: This study analyzed 134 patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent secondary resection of residual masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. After first-line therapy, 52% of specimens showed necrosis, 27% differentiated teratoma and 21% undifferentiated tumor. Incomplete resection and incomplete marker normalization were associated with undifferentiated tumor. Five-year survival was 80% after first-line chemotherapy but 44% after salvage chemotherapy. The authors conclude that residual tumor resection remains essential, and PET may help spare some patients from surgery.

pmid-9261524.summary_ja: スペイン3施設での後方視的検討。1978〜1995年にシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍27例を解析した。初回治療で11例(40.7%)が無病となったが、3例は再発した。救済療法では持続的な効果は得られず、5年生存率は31.7%であった。無病の達成が治癒につながるため、新たな初回治療戦略が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-9261524.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter series from three Spanish university hospitals reviewed 27 patients with primary mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumours treated with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy between 1978 and 1995. Eleven patients (40.7%) became disease-free after initial treatment, but three of them relapsed within seven months. Eleven salvage-treated patients achieved no durable response. Five-year actuarial survival was 31.7%. The authors conclude that only patients who achieve disease-free status are likely to be cured, and new up-front strategies are needed.

pmid-9261736.summary_ja: 正常胎盤50例、胞状奇胎95例(持続性疾患32例を含む)を対象に、EGFの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。EGFは、同週数の正常胎盤に比べて奇胎で強く発現していた。12週未満で症状が出現した奇胎は持続性疾患のリスクが高かった。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌ではEGFの強い染色性がみられ、高リスク病変の同定に有用な可能性がある。
pmid-9261736.summary_en: This study examined epidermal growth factor (EGF) expression by immunohistochemistry in placentae from normal pregnancies (50), molar pregnancies (95), and 32 patients with persistent disease. EGF was expressed more strongly in molar placentae than in normal placentae of similar gestational age. Moles presenting with symptoms before 12 weeks had a higher risk of persistent disease. Invasive moles and choriocarcinomas showed very strong EGF staining, suggesting EGF may help identify high-risk lesions.

pmid-9262575.summary_ja: 縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化した男性2例を報告する。化学療法後、縦隔奇形腫が著明に増大し呼吸器症状を呈した。臨床所見と画像所見、治療を検討し、腫瘍マーカー正常化後に縦隔で増大する腫瘤を認めた場合はgrowing teratoma syndromeを疑うべきと結論している。
pmid-9262575.summary_en: This report describes two male patients with growing teratoma syndrome in the mediastinum. One had a metastatic germ cell tumor of the retroperitoneum and mediastinum with elevated AFP, and the other a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor with elevated AFP and beta-hCG. After chemotherapy normalized their tumor markers, both developed pulmonary symptoms from massively enlarging mediastinal teratomas. The authors review the clinical and radiographic features and management, and conclude that a growing mediastinal mass after chemotherapy with normal markers may represent this syndrome.

pmid-9262617.summary_ja: 子宮内で大きな心膜内奇形腫と診断された双胎の一方の症例を報告する。もう一方の正常な児の安全を考慮して分娩と手術の時期を計画した。帝王切開で娩出後、隣室で心肺バイパスの待機下に腫瘤を切除した。奇形腫は出生直後に呼吸窮迫や心タンポナーデを起こすため、迅速な切除は救命につながる。
pmid-9262617.summary_en: This report describes a case of one of twins diagnosed in utero with a large intrapericardial teratoma. Because the unaffected co-twin's well-being had to be considered, delivery and operative timing required careful planning. The twins were delivered by cesarean section, and the mass was excised from the affected infant in an adjoining operating room with cardiopulmonary bypass standby. The authors emphasize that prompt excision is potentially lifesaving, since these lesions can cause respiratory distress and tamponade shortly after birth.

pmid-9263894.summary_ja: 1983〜1993年に2つの小児三次医療施設で診断された頭頸部先天性奇形腫9例を検討した。多くは頸部に発生し、未熟奇形腫は2例であった。生児は全例が生後1年以内に手術を受けた。1例で奇形腫組織の再発がコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で確認され、外科的に治療されて3年以上無腫瘍で経過している。
pmid-9263894.summary_en: This review analyzes nine congenital head and neck teratomas from two tertiary pediatric hospitals over a decade (1983 to 1993). Lesions were mostly cervical, with others in the nasopharynx and face. Two cases were immature and the remainder mature. All liveborn children underwent surgery within their first year, and only one required tracheotomy. One child had recurrence of teratomatous tissue detected by CT, treated surgically, and remained tumor-free for over three years.

pmid-9264351.summary_ja: 縦隔原発の胚細胞腫瘍322例を、奇形腫病変を中心に解析した。ほぼ全例が男性であった。奇形腫(138例)が最も多く、次いでセミノーマ(120例)であった。非セミノーマ性で奇形腫を含まない型では卵黄嚢腫瘍が多かった。病変の範囲と部位に基づく組織学的分類と臨床病期分類を提案し、予後予測や治療選択に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-9264351.summary_en: This analysis of 322 primary mediastinal germ cell tumors emphasizes teratomatous lesions. Nearly all patients were men, with a mean age of 40 years. Teratomas were most common (138 cases), followed by seminomas (120). Yolk sac tumors predominated among nonseminomatous, non-teratomatous types. Most patients with staging data were in stage I. The authors propose a histopathologic classification and a clinical staging scheme based on extent and location, which may help predict outcome and guide therapy.

pmid-9264352.summary_ja: 男性の縦隔原発セミノーマ120例を臨床病理学的・免疫組織化学的に検討した。組織像は性腺腫瘍に類似し、免疫染色例の80%で胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼが陽性であった。フォローアップ情報が得られた65例のうち49例は無病生存し、16例は遠隔転移で死亡した。病期III、縦隔外への進展、37歳超が予後不良と関連していた。
pmid-9264352.summary_en: This clinicopathologic and immunohistochemical study covers 120 primary mediastinal seminomas in men. Histology resembled gonadal tumors, and placental alkaline phosphatase was positive in 80% of immunostained cases. Among 65 patients with follow-up, 49 were alive and disease-free after 1 to 19 years, while 16 died with distant metastases. Clinical stage III, extension beyond the mediastinum, and age over 37 were associated with worse outcomes. Histopathologic features did not correlate with clinical behavior.

pmid-9264353.summary_ja: 男性の縦隔原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、絨毛癌、奇形腫成分を含まない複合型胚細胞腫瘍64例を検討した。純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も多かった(60%)。十分な追跡が得られた例の72%が、積極的治療にもかかわらず6〜36か月以内に死亡した。絨毛癌は特に攻撃的な経過を示した。初診時に縦隔に限局していない腫瘍は、概して攻撃的な挙動を示した。
pmid-9264353.summary_en: A clinicopathologic and immunohistochemical study of 64 primary mediastinal yolk sac tumors, embryonal carcinomas, choriocarcinomas, and combined germ cell tumors without teratomatous elements, all in men. Pure yolk sac tumors were most frequent (60%). Among patients with adequate follow-up, 72% died within 6 to 36 months despite aggressive therapy. Choriocarcinomas followed an especially aggressive course. Most tumors not confined to the mediastinum at diagnosis behaved aggressively, and staging was prognostically useful.

pmid-9266226.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者で、精巣摘除の前後およびフォローアップ中のhCG、LDH、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PlAP)を前向きに検討した。少なくとも1つのマーカーが上昇した例は84%であった。PlAPは転移性疾患の検出感度が最も高く(51%)、再発の指標として最も優れていた。ただし喫煙者では特異度が低下した。3つのマーカーはいずれも測定すべきと結論している。
pmid-9266226.summary_en: A prospective multicenter study measured hCG, LDH, and placental alkaline phosphatase (PlAP) in testicular seminoma patients before and after orchiectomy and during follow-up. Patients with elevated AFP were classified as nonseminomas. At least one marker was elevated in 84% of patients. PlAP had the highest incidence (56%) and the highest sensitivity for metastatic disease (51%), but its specificity was reduced in smokers. PlAP was the best indicator of relapse. The authors recommend determining all three markers in seminoma patients.

pmid-9266243.summary_ja: 50歳の原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の患者が、シスプラチン含有多剤併用化学療法の初回投与後に痙攣を発症した。本論文は、シスプラチンのまれな神経毒性という副作用について考察し、既報の神経毒性に関する文献を総説している。胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法を行う臨床医にとって、注意と監視が必要な重要な副作用の知見である。
pmid-9266243.summary_en: A 50-year-old patient with primary extragonadal germ cell tumor developed seizures after the first course of cisplatin-containing polychemotherapy. The authors discuss this very rare neurotoxic side effect of cisplatin and review previously reported neurotoxicity of the agent. The report is relevant to clinicians treating germ cell tumor patients with platinum-based chemotherapy, because it highlights a rare but important adverse event that warrants awareness and monitoring during treatment.

pmid-9267497.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法から37年後に、後腹膜の平滑筋肉腫が発生した症例を報告している。肉腫は傍大動脈の照射野内に生じ、周囲の臓器や軟部組織に広範に浸潤し、部分切除にとどまった。セミノーマ治癒後の放射線誘発性二次肉腫はまれだが、長期フォローアップ中に注意を払う必要があると論じている。
pmid-9267497.summary_en: A case report describes a retroperitoneal leiomyosarcoma that developed 37 years after radiotherapy for testicular seminoma. The sarcoma arose within the para-aortic radiation field, involved adjacent organs and soft tissues, and could only be partially resected. Although secondary sarcomas after seminoma treatment are rare, the authors emphasize that this risk warrants awareness during long-term follow-up of cured seminoma patients, since radiation-induced malignancies may appear decades later.

pmid-9267822.summary_ja: 17〜22歳の男性5例の前縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍を検討した。多房性の嚢胞変化が目立ち、良性の胸腺嚢胞と誤認されうる。腫瘍細胞はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。全例が1〜3年以内に腫瘍により死亡した。嚢胞性の縦隔病変では十分な検体採取が重要であると強調している。
pmid-9267822.summary_en: Five men aged 17 to 22 with anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumors showed prominent multilocular thymic-type cystic changes that could mimic benign thymic cysts. Histology revealed small neoplastic cells in a reticular or myxoid pattern with Schiller-Duval bodies, and the tumor cells were alpha-fetoprotein positive on immunohistochemistry. All patients died of disease within one to three years. The authors stress thorough sampling of cystic mediastinal lesions to avoid missing this distinctive variant.

pmid-9267877.summary_ja: 18か月の女児が、大量の心嚢液と心臓近傍の腫瘤により呼吸困難と心拡大を呈した。開胸探索で、完全に心膜内に存在する悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍が確認された。病期分類で骨転移が判明し、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は上昇していた。化学療法の後、治療終了1年後も寛解を維持している。小児における診断法とフォローアップについて総説している。
pmid-9267877.summary_en: An 18-month-old girl presented with respiratory distress and cardiomegaly due to a large pericardial effusion and an adjacent mass. Open exploration revealed a wholly intrapericardial malignant yolk sac tumor. Staging identified bone metastasis, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated. After chemotherapy she remained in remission one year after completion. The authors review diagnostic methods and follow-up strategies for children with these rare mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-9274531.summary_ja: 思春期・成人の正常精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、核ラミンのA型・B型の発現を免疫染色で検討した研究です。B型ラミンは全例で発現し、A型ラミンは組織型により異なりました。非セミノーマ内の胎児性癌成分の識別に役立ち、予後因子の評価に寄与する可能性が示されています。
pmid-9274531.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined nuclear lamin A- and B-type expression in normal testis and testicular germ cell tumours from adolescents and adults. B-type lamins were expressed in all germ cell tumours, whereas A-type lamins varied by histology. Differentiated non-seminomas were positive for lamins A and C, embryonal carcinomas were positive for lamin C only, and seminomas were negative unless they carried a Ras mutation. The authors suggest that lamin staining could help identify embryonal carcinoma components within non-seminomas, which may aid evaluation of this prognostic parameter.

pmid-9282301.summary_ja: 胎児期に超音波検査で右精巣の腫大と不均一なエコー像を認め、精巣腫瘍が疑われた乳児例の報告です。生後3か月で右高位精巣摘除術が行われ、成熟および未熟成分を伴う奇形腫と診断されました。超音波検査により胎児期に診断された症例としては、国内で2例目と報告されています。
pmid-9282301.summary_en: This case report describes a testicular tumor in an infant detected by ultrasonography during the prenatal period. Enlargement and a heterogeneous echo pattern of the right testis were noted at 32 and 38 weeks of gestation. Right high orchiectomy was performed at 3 months of age, and histology showed a teratoma with both mature and immature components. The authors note that this is the second case in Japan diagnosed prenatally using ultrasonography.

pmid-9282302.summary_ja: 26歳男性が右陰嚢内腫瘤と左精巣の小さな腫瘤で受診しました。右根治的精巣摘除術と左腫瘍核出術の後に放射線療法を行い、右はセミノーマ、左は成熟奇形腫と診断されました。術後にβ-hCGが正常化して病期Iと診断され、術後30か月の時点で再発はありません。HLA-A24との関連が示唆されています。
pmid-9282302.summary_en: A 26-year-old man presented with a right scrotal mass and a smaller left testicular mass. He underwent right radical orchiectomy and left tumor enucleation, followed by radiotherapy to the iliac and para-aortic lymph nodes. Histology showed seminoma on the right and mature teratoma on the left. Postoperative normalization of beta-hCG and imaging findings supported stage I disease. HLA-A24 was identified, suggesting a possible association with bilateral testicular tumors. No recurrence was seen at 30 months.

pmid-9284835.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍29例(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ)を対象に、p16INK4(MTS1)とCDK4の遺伝子異常を解析しました。変異は認められず、ヘテロ接合性の消失も1例のみでした。一方、解析された腫瘍の半数でp16INK4エクソン1のメチル化が認められ、mRNA発現の低下と相関しました。メチル化によるp16INK4の不活性化が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関与すると示唆されます。
pmid-9284835.summary_en: This study analyzed p16INK4 (MTS1) and CDK4 in 29 testicular germ cell tumors, including seminomas and nonseminomas. Neither gene showed mutations, and only one tumor had loss of heterozygosity. However, p16INK4 exon 1 hypermethylation was present in half of the analyzed tumors and correlated with reduced mRNA expression. The findings suggest that methylation-driven inactivation of p16INK4 contributes to the development of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-9285688.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍59例におけるTDGF-1(Cripto)の発現を解析し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の一部で顕著な発現上昇を認めました。非セミノーマ性の胎児性癌および悪性未分化奇形癌では、ほぼ全例で過剰発現していました。組換えTDGF-1は胎児性癌細胞株NTERA2/D1の増殖を促進しましたが、分化を抑制することはありませんでした。精巣腫瘍の発生における自己分泌性増殖因子としての役割が示唆されています。
pmid-9285688.summary_en: This study examined TDGF-1 (Cripto) expression in 59 human germ cell tumors and found marked elevation in a subset of testicular GCTs, with near-universal overexpression in non-seminomatous embryonal carcinomas and malignant teratocarcinomas. Exogenous TDGF-1 stimulated proliferation of NTERA2/D1 embryonal carcinoma cells but did not block retinoic acid- or HMBA-induced differentiation. The authors propose TDGF-1 as a possible autocrine growth factor in testicular neoplasia.

pmid-9288797.summary_ja: 胚細胞型およびプラセンタ型を含む4種類のアルカリホスファターゼ(AP)遺伝子の転写産物を識別する逆転写PCR法を開発した研究です。胚細胞腫瘍15例などを解析し、セミノーマでは組織非特異的APの異所性発現を認めました。純粋な胎児性癌では4種類すべてのアイソザイムが発現しており、AP発現は腫瘍の分化度に依存すると考えられます。腫瘍マーカーとしての評価に役立つ可能性があります。
pmid-9288797.summary_en: This study developed a reverse transcription-PCR method that distinguishes transcripts of all four alkaline phosphatase genes, including germ cell and placental forms. Analysis of 15 germ cell tumors, adjacent germinal epithelia, cell lines, and normal testes showed ectopic expression of tissue-nonspecific AP in seminomas. Pure embryonal carcinomas expressed all four isoenzymes, suggesting that AP expression depends on tumor differentiation. The approach may help evaluate AP isoenzymes as tumor markers.

pmid-9290165.summary_ja: 1975〜1991年に治療された病期I・IIの精巣セミノーマ161例を後方視的に解析し、放射線療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清術を比較した。照射野内後腹膜再発は郭清術後9.5%、放射線療法後2.0%で、統計学的に有意ではないものの郭清術後に高い傾向がみられた。病期が進むほど再発率は上昇した。
pmid-9290165.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 161 patients with stage I and II testicular seminoma treated from 1975 to 1991, comparing radiation therapy with retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy after high semicastration. In-field retroperitoneal relapse occurred in 9.5% after lymphadenectomy versus 2.0% after radiotherapy, a non-significant trend (p = 0.057). Relapses outside treatment fields were similar between groups. Relapse rates rose from 4.1% in stage I to 58.3% in stage IIC. Radiotherapy gradually replaced lymphadenectomy as the preferred approach in the later study period.

pmid-9290172.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍と対側の同時性良性腫瘍を有する3症例を報告する。良性腫瘍はライディッヒ細胞腫、平滑筋腫、類表皮嚢胞であった。1例は根治的精巣摘除術を、2例は腫瘍核出術を受けた。5年以上の追跡で全例無病であった。核出術を受けた患者では局所再発がなく、内因性テストステロン産生が維持された。著者らは、凍結切片検査により良性腫瘍での臓器温存的治療が可能かもしれないと示唆している。
pmid-9290172.summary_en: This report describes three patients with a nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor and a synchronous contralateral benign testicular tumor, namely a Leydig cell tumor, leiomyoma, or epidermoid cyst. One patient underwent radical orchiectomy, and two underwent enucleation resection of the benign or contralateral lesion. After more than five years of follow-up, all patients remained free of disease. No local recurrence occurred in patients treated with enucleation, and endogenous testosterone production was preserved. The authors suggest that frozen section examination may allow organ-sparing treatment of benign testicular tumors.

pmid-9290173.summary_ja: 混合性悪性精巣腫瘍と脾性精巣融合症が同時に発生した稀な症例を報告する。脾性精巣融合症は原発性悪性精巣腫瘍や腺腫様腫瘍と誤認されうる。本疾患を認識することで、手術時に精巣を温存できる可能性がある。
pmid-9290173.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a malignant mixed tumor of the testis coexisting with splenogonadal fusion. Splenogonadal fusion can mimic a primary malignant testicular tumor or an adenomatoid tumor, so recognizing this entity is important. Accurate recognition helps surgeons avoid unnecessary orchiectomy and preserve the testis. The authors emphasize that awareness of this rare condition supports organ-preserving surgical decisions when a testicular mass is encountered.

pmid-9291801.summary_ja: 1978〜1990年に化学療法を受けた転移性精巣セミノーマ302例を後方視的に解析した。白金製剤併用化学療法後は、放射線療法の有無による無増悪生存期間に差はなかった。BEP療法患者の無増悪生存率は88%で、放射線療法の影響は受けなかった。残存腫瘤への補助的放射線療法は不要と結論された。
pmid-9291801.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter analysis of 302 patients with metastatic testicular seminoma treated with chemotherapy from 1978 to 1990 evaluated the role of postchemotherapy radiotherapy. Progression-free survival was similar with or without radiotherapy after platinum-based chemotherapy. Patients receiving BEP had 88% progression-free survival regardless of radiotherapy. The absolute benefit of radiotherapy for residual abdominal masses was estimated at only 2.3%. The authors concluded that adjuvant radiotherapy to residual masses after platinum-based chemotherapy is unnecessary.

pmid-9291802.summary_ja: 新規診断の原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍16例にPOMB/ACE化学療法と残存腫瘤の外科的切除を行った。16例中15例で完全寛解が得られ、2年以降の再発は認めなかった。非セミノーマ性症例の5年全生存率は73%であった。化学療法と手術の併用は高い長期生存率をもたらすと結論づけられている。
pmid-9291802.summary_en: This study reports outcomes in 16 men with newly diagnosed primary mediastinal germ cell tumors treated with POMB/ACE chemotherapy and surgical resection of residual masses. Complete remission was achieved in 15 of 16 patients (94%), with no relapses beyond two years. The five-year overall survival for nonseminomatous tumors was 73%. Four patients with bulky or metastatic seminoma were also treated, with one treatment-related death. Four patients treated at relapse yielded one salvage. The authors conclude that combined chemotherapy and surgery achieve high long-term survival.

pmid-9291803.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍27例で、化学療法後に異なる部位の残存腫瘤を複数回切除した結果を検討した。30%の症例で部位により組織所見が異なり、後の手術では成熟奇形腫や未分化腫瘍など予後不良な所見がみられた。R0切除は無再発生存期間と全生存期間の改善と関連した。技術的に可能な限り全残存腫瘤の切除を推奨している。
pmid-9291803.summary_en: This study reviewed 27 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent multiple resections of residual masses at different sites after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. In 30% of patients, histology differed between sites, with less favorable findings such as mature teratoma or undifferentiated tumor found at later operations. Necrosis was more frequent at thoracotomy than at retroperitoneal resection. R0 resection and necrosis or differentiated teratoma were associated with better relapse-free and overall survival. The authors recommend excising all residual masses where technically feasible.

pmid-9291823.summary_ja: 成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍542例の診療記録を調べ、外科的治療を要した乳児肥厚性幽門狭窄症の既往を検討した。9例が認められ、期待値2.2例を大きく上回った（標準化比4.15、P < 0.001）。稀な関連の認識が、病因に関わる遺伝的・環境的要因の同定につながる可能性がある。
pmid-9291823.summary_en: This study screened records of 542 adult men with germ cell cancer from any site for a history of infantile pyloric stenosis requiring surgery. Nine cases were identified, far more than the 2.2 expected, with a standardized ratio of 4.15 (P less than 0.001). The authors suggest that recognizing rare associations of germ cell tumors may help identify genetic and environmental factors in their etiology. Cryptorchidism and hernia are already known risk factors, and this association is proposed as a further clue to etiology.

pmid-9292737.summary_ja: 男女19例の胚細胞腫瘍細胞診標本20例を検討し、大半は性腺外・頭蓋外の腫瘤であった。1例を除き悪性と正しく判定された。低分化悪性腫瘍と誤認すると有効な化学療法の機会を失う恐れがある。風乾ロマノフスキー染色スメアと細胞ブロックが診断の助けとなった。
pmid-9292737.summary_en: This study reviewed 20 cytology specimens of germ cell tumors, mostly extragonadal and extracranial, from 16 males and 3 females. All samples were correctly interpreted as malignant, and only one was misclassified as a non-germ cell malignancy. Clinical and cytologic findings were useful for diagnosis. Misinterpreting these tumors as poorly differentiated malignancies may deny patients effective chemotherapy. Air-dried Romanowsky-stained smears and cell block sections helped resolve diagnostic dilemmas.

pmid-9293455.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の頭蓋外非精巣奇形腫270例を対象に、切除不完全性・原発部位・組織学的悪性度から成るリスクスコアを提案した。高リスク群（6点以上）が再発と腫瘍死の大部分を占めた。補助化学療法群では高度悪性の再発がみられず、高リスク群でのランダム化試験の必要性が示された。
pmid-9293455.summary_en: This study of 270 extracranial non-testicular teratomas in children and adolescents from German MAKEI protocols proposed a risk score combining incomplete resection, primary site (coccyx or ovary), and histologic grade. High-risk patients (score 6 or more) accounted for most relapses and tumor deaths. Adjuvant chemotherapy was associated with the absence of highly malignant relapses, which supports a randomized trial to evaluate it in high-risk patients.

pmid-9293458.summary_ja: 局所再発した腹部胚細胞腫瘍の小児・思春期患者32例を検討した。PEI化学療法に局所深部温熱療法（RHT）を併用した9例では7例に腫瘍縮小がみられ、5例が無イベント生存中であった。対照群と比較して無イベント生存率が有意に高く、局所制御の改善が示唆された。
pmid-9293458.summary_en: Thirty-two children and adolescents with loco-regional abdominal recurrences of germ cell tumors were reviewed. Nine patients received PEI chemotherapy with or without radiation plus regional deep hyperthermia (RHT); seven achieved tumor response and five were event-free at 8 to 40 months. Compared with a matched cohort receiving conventional relapse therapy, the RHT group had significantly better event-free survival (0.41 vs 0.16, p=0.03), suggesting RHT may improve local control.

pmid-9293677.summary_ja: 1980〜1987年に治療された卵巣未分化胚細胞腫22例の後方視的解析である。病期I 15例は全例が無病生存し、中央値125か月の追跡で生存していた。保存的手術は9例に行われ、14例が補助放射線療法を受けた。10年実測生存率は81.8%であった。
pmid-9293677.summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 22 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated between 1980 and 1987. Fifteen patients had stage I disease, and all were alive and disease-free at a median follow-up of 125 months. Conservative surgery was performed in nine patients and fourteen received adjuvant radiotherapy. The 10-year actuarial survival was 81.8%. Four patients with advanced disease or recurrence died, while all seven patients aged 20 or younger survived.

pmid-9293897.summary_ja: 閉経後・肥満・糖尿病の女性3例（52〜67歳）の男性化を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を報告した。多毛、声の変化、陰核肥大を認め、テストステロンとアンドロステンジオンは腫瘍摘出後に低下した。組織学的に黄体化間質細胞を認め、糖尿病に関連した卵巣間質の黄体化が成因と考察している。
