pmid-9293897.summary_en: Three additional cases of virilizing mature benign ovarian cystic teratomas are reported, in postmenopausal, obese, diabetic women aged 52 to 67 years. Presentations included hirsutism, voice changes and clitoromegaly, with elevated testosterone and androstenedione that regressed after tumor removal. Histology showed luteinized stromal cells at the tumor-ovary interface, and the authors attribute virilization to luteinization of ovarian stroma related to diabetes mellitus.

pmid-9294957.summary_ja: イリノイ大学病院で治療された精巣セミノーマ87例を対象に、民族が生存率に影響するかを検討した。生命表法による調整生存率は白人84%、アフリカ系米国人80%に対し、ヒスパニック系は69%であった。予後不良は主に診断時の病期と関連し、文化的要因による診断遅延が示唆されている。
pmid-9294957.summary_en: Eighty-seven patients with testicular seminoma treated at the University of Illinois Hospitals were analyzed to determine whether ethnicity affects survival. Life-table adjusted survival was 84% for white and 80% for African-American patients, but 69% for Hispanic patients. The authors attribute the poorer outcome among Mexican-American patients largely to stage at diagnosis, and suggest delayed diagnosis related to cultural factors.

pmid-9296241.summary_ja: 心房細動でワルファリンを服用中の74歳男性が、右精巣の非セミノーマ性混合型胚細胞腫瘍（縦隔転移あり）に対するカルボプラチンとエトポシド投与16日後にINRが12.6へ上昇した。明らかな他の原因は認められなかった。著者らは、半減期の長い白金製剤によるワルファリンの置換を推測し、INRの密な監視を推奨している。
pmid-9296241.summary_en: A 74-year-old man on warfarin for atrial fibrillation developed a markedly elevated INR (12.6) sixteen days after starting carboplatin and etoposide for a right testicular non-seminomatous mixed germ cell tumor with mediastinal metastases. No other cause was identified. The authors suggest late displacement of warfarin by long-half-life platinum and recommend close INR monitoring during these chemotherapy regimens.

pmid-9298876.summary_ja: 前縦隔に原発した絨毛癌の8症例を、臨床病理学的および免疫組織化学的に検討した報告。全例が男性で、大きな縦隔腫瘤と多くの転移を伴い、全例が1〜2か月以内に死亡した。組織学的にはβ-hCGとケラチンが陽性で、剖検で精巣に腫瘍は認められなかったことから、性腺外原発が支持された。
pmid-9298876.summary_en: This study reports eight cases of primary choriocarcinoma of the anterior mediastinum, all in men aged 21 to 63. Patients presented with large mediastinal masses, often with thoracic and extrathoracic metastases. Histology showed cytotrophoblastic and syncytiotrophoblastic cells, with strong keratin and beta-hCG immunostaining. Autopsies found no testicular tumor or scar, supporting a primary extragonadal origin. All patients died within one to two months, highlighting the aggressive course of this rare entity.

pmid-9301175.summary_ja: 前縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍でリンパ節転移を伴った症例の報告。術前化学療法と外科的切除の併用が標準治療とされるが、リンパ節郭清の必要性はこれまで十分に議論されてこなかった。著者らは原発巣と領域リンパ節の一塊切除を推奨している。縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の外科的治療における節郭清の位置づけを考える上で重要な報告である。
pmid-9301175.summary_en: This report describes a case of anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor with nodal metastasis. The authors note that preoperative chemotherapy followed by surgical resection is the accepted standard treatment, but the role of lymph node dissection has received limited discussion. Based on their case, they recommend en bloc resection of the primary tumor together with regional lymph nodes. The paper argues for a more systematic nodal approach in the surgical management of mediastinal yolk sac tumors.

pmid-9301238.summary_ja: 35歳女性の前縦隔成熟奇形腫が心膜腔へ穿孔した症例の報告。入院6日目に発熱、心拡大、心嚢液貯留を認め、緊急手術で血性心嚢液を確認した。腫瘍は心膜とともに摘出された。穿孔の機序として感染と嚢胞内への大量の液体流入が考えられている。縦隔奇形腫の稀な合併症として、臨床上の注意が必要である。
pmid-9301238.summary_en: This report describes a 35-year-old woman with a mature teratoma of the anterior mediastinum that perforated into the pericardial cavity. On hospital day six she developed high fever, and imaging showed cardiomegaly and pericardial effusion. Emergency surgery revealed a bloody pericardial effusion, and the tumor was removed together with the pericardium. The authors attribute the perforation to infection and massive fluid influx into the cyst. This is an uncommon and potentially life-threatening complication of mediastinal teratoma.

pmid-9301449.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマまたは非セミノーマの患者15例を対象に、化学療法後の残存精巣がんをFDG-PETで確実に検出できるかを検討した。陽性9件のうち3件は炎症によるものであった。陰性と判定された1例では後腹膜リンパ節郭清で生存腫瘍が確認された。炎症組織への集積により、腫瘍と良性残存組織のSUVは大きく重なり、FDG-PETの有用性は限定的と結論づけられた。
pmid-9301449.summary_en: This study evaluated whether FDG-PET can reliably detect residual testicular cancer after chemotherapy in 15 patients with metastatic seminoma or nonseminoma. Of 20 scans, nine were positive, but three of these reflected inflammation rather than tumor. Eleven scans were negative, and one of these harbored viable tumor at retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Standardized uptake values overlapped considerably between metastatic and benign residual tumors because inflammatory tissue also accumulated FDG. The authors conclude that FDG-PET has limited value for assessing residual disease after chemotherapy.

pmid-9301718.summary_ja: 尿失禁で発症した失調性毛細血管拡張症（A-T）患者に、転移性ディスジャーミノーマが認められた症例の報告。A-Tは神経変性、染色体不安定性、がん好発を特徴とする稀な常染色体劣性疾患である。尿失禁を呈したA-T関連腫瘍としては初の報告であり、転移性ディスジャーミノーマを有するA-T患者の2年生存例も初めてとされる。文献レビューも含まれる。
pmid-9301718.summary_en: This report describes a case of ataxia-telangiectasia presenting with urinary incontinence and a metastatic dysgerminoma. Ataxia-telangiectasia is a rare autosomal recessive disorder marked by neurodegeneration, chromosomal instability, and cancer predisposition. The authors state that this is the first reported A-T-related tumor presenting as urinary incontinence, and the first case of two-year survival in an A-T patient with metastatic dysgerminoma. The paper also includes a review of the literature.

pmid-9302113.summary_ja: 片側性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者において対側精巣の生検が必要かを、文献を批判的に検討したレビューである。対側の上皮内癌は最大5%の患者にみられるが、大半の患者では生検は不要である。上皮内癌の治療には身体的・精神的な影響がありうるため、著者らは日常的な生検を支持しないと結論づけた。代わりに、患者教育と綿密なフォローアップを推奨し、介入は両側性腫瘍のリスクがある少数例に限るべきとしている。
pmid-9302113.summary_en: This literature review critically evaluates whether the contralateral testis should be biopsied in patients with unilateral testicular germ cell tumor. Carcinoma in situ is found in up to 5% of such patients, but routine biopsy is unnecessary for most. The authors argue that routine biopsy is not supported by the literature, since treating carcinoma in situ can cause physical and emotional harm. They recommend patient education and close follow-up as rational alternatives, reserving intervention for a small high-risk subset.

pmid-9302133.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対して化学療法を受けた155例の性機能を質問票で評価した研究。順行性射精の完全消失は18.7%に認められた。後腹膜残存腫瘍の切除を受けた患者で射精障害が多く、腫瘍容積が大きいことや右傍大静脈・大動脈間部の位置が関連していた。化学療法後の性的合併症は無視できないと結論づけられている。
pmid-9302133.summary_en: This questionnaire-based study assessed sexual function in 155 men treated with chemotherapy for disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor, comparing those who did or did not undergo resection of residual retroperitoneal tumor. Overall, 18.7% reported complete absence of antegrade ejaculation, while other dysfunctions occurred at similar rates in both groups. Loss of ejaculation was more frequent after resection, particularly with larger tumor volume and a right paracaval or interaortacaval location. The authors conclude that post-chemotherapy sexual morbidity is substantial and that tumor volume and location predict ejaculatory loss.

pmid-9303438.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞が、エストロゲン応答配列に結合する67kDaの機能的なエストロゲン受容体を発現することを示した。エストラジオールは細胞増殖を促進し、タモキシフェンは増殖を抑制するとともにエストラジオールの作用を拮抗した。エストロゲンが胎盤栄養膜細胞の増殖を制御する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9303438.summary_en: This study shows that human choriocarcinoma BeWo cells express a functional estrogen receptor, with a 67-kD isoform that binds the estrogen response element. Estradiol stimulates BeWo proliferation, while tamoxifen inhibits growth and antagonizes estradiol's effect. Tamoxifen also suppresses a thymidine kinase promoter reporter lacking an estrogen response element, indicating secondary estrogen-dependent effects. The authors propose that estrogens may regulate placental trophoblast growth. The work uses a gestational choriocarcinoma cell line as its primary model.

pmid-9306117.summary_ja: 帝王切開時に、両側の円靭帯と左卵巣から計3個の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が見つかった症例報告である。円靭帯は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の発生部位として極めてまれであり、卵巣外発生を術中に認識することの重要性が示されている。
pmid-9306117.summary_en: This case report describes an unusual presentation of mature cystic teratoma in which three mature cystic teratomas were found during cesarean section: one in each round ligament and one in the left ovary. Because the round ligament is among the rarest sites for this tumor, the authors highlight it as an unusual location. The brief report emphasizes that recognizing extraovarian presentations during surgery is diagnostically important.

pmid-9307193.summary_ja: ダウン症候群の患者120名と妊娠17例を8年間調査し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍3例（セミノーマ、胎児性癌、胎児の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍）を確認した。一般集団より高い頻度であり、文献レビューでも同様の過剰が示された。停留精巣だけではリスクを説明できず、ゴナドトロピンの変化やETS-2遺伝子の過剰発現が機序として提唱され、性腺のサーベイランスが推奨される。
pmid-9307193.summary_en: The authors describe three testicular germ cell tumors among 120 children and adults with Down syndrome and 17 pregnancies examined over eight years, including a seminoma, an embryonal carcinoma, and an intratubular germ cell neoplasm in a fetus. This incidence is markedly above the general population rate. A literature review also supports an excess of testicular germ cell tumors in Down syndrome. Cryptorchidism alone does not explain the risk, and altered gonadotropins and Ets-2 overexpression are proposed as mechanisms. Gonadal surveillance is recommended.

pmid-9307739.summary_ja: 本総説は若年男性に最も多い悪性腫瘍である精巣がんを扱い、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に分類して論じている。病期Iは外科的切除を基本とし、必要に応じて補助化学療法や放射線療法を行う。転移性疾患にはシスプラチン併用化学療法が治療の基軸で、治癒率は80%を超える。精巣症状のある患者は速やかに超音波検査で評価すべきと強調している。
pmid-9307739.summary_en: This review covers testicular cancer, the most common malignancy in young men, whose incidence has doubled over 25 years. It distinguishes seminoma from non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Stage I disease is managed surgically with adjuvant chemotherapy or radiotherapy as appropriate. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy is the cornerstone for metastatic disease, with cure rates above 80%. The authors emphasize prompt ultrasound evaluation of patients with testicular symptoms and consideration of germ cell tumor in young men presenting with metastatic disease.

pmid-9308448.summary_ja: 本研究は縦隔成熟奇形腫66例を後方視的に検討し、断面画像所見を特徴づけた。患者の年齢は1週間から67歳までで、症状は胸痛、呼吸困難、咳嗽が主であった。多くは前縦隔に発生し、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では軟部組織・液体・脂肪・石灰化の組み合わせを示す不均一な腫瘤であった。脂肪-液体ニボーは頻度は低いが成熟奇形腫に対する特異性が高く、評価にはCTが第一選択とされる。
pmid-9308448.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 66 patients with mediastinal mature teratoma to characterize cross-sectional imaging. Most lesions were in the anterior mediastinum and appeared as heterogeneous masses with soft tissue, fluid, fat, and calcium on CT. Soft tissue attenuation occurred in all tumors, fluid in 88%, fat in 76%, and calcification in 53%. Fat-fluid levels, though uncommon, are highly specific for mature teratoma. The authors conclude that CT is the imaging modality of choice for evaluating these lesions.

pmid-9308934.summary_ja: ドイツの25施設による前向き多施設共同研究で、病期IIA・IIBの精巣セミノーマ58例に縮小腸骨照射野による放射線療法を施行した。IIAは30Gy、IIBは36Gyを照射した。中央値37か月の観察で全例生存し、無再発生存率はIIAで100%、IIBで2年時点87%であった。再発は縦隔と肺にみられ、化学療法で救済された。骨盤内再発はなく、毒性は許容範囲であった。
pmid-9308934.summary_en: This prospective multicenter study from 25 German centers treated 58 patients with pure seminoma and stage IIA or IIB testicular seminoma using radiotherapy with reduced iliac portals. Patients received 30 Gy for IIA and 36 Gy for IIB. With a median follow-up of 37 months, all patients were alive, and recurrence-free survival was 100% in IIA and about 87% at two years in IIB. Recurrences were mainly in the mediastinum and lung and were salvaged with chemotherapy. No pelvic recurrence was observed, and toxicity was tolerable.

pmid-9309098.summary_ja: 本論文は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の病理学的病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療を扱う。ほぼ全例を治癒させる方法は2つあり、エトポシドとシスプラチンの併用による補助化学療法2サイクル(ブレオマイシンの併用の有無を問わない)と、再発時まで化学療法を控える厳重な経過観察である。選択は手術時の腫瘍浸潤範囲と患者の遵守度による。
pmid-9309098.summary_en: This review addresses treatment of pathologic stage II testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Two approaches cure nearly all patients: two cycles of adjuvant etoposide plus cisplatin with or without bleomycin, or close surveillance with chemotherapy reserved for relapse. The choice depends on the extent of tumor involvement at surgery and on patient compliance. The article is a brief overview of these two management strategies.

pmid-9310237.summary_ja: 本研究は、インプリンティング遺伝子H19のエクソン5にある2つのCpG部位のメチル化を、正常組織、思春期・成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍、およびNT2-D1細胞株で比較した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍は組織型にかかわらず両アレルでH19を発現していた。腫瘍のメチル化パターンは対応する非悪性組織に類似していた。メチル化はアレル特異的発現や総発現量と相関せず、分化に伴いH19発現は誘導されるがCpG部位は完全メチル化のままであった。
pmid-9310237.summary_en: This study compared methylation of two CpG sites in exon 5 of the imprinted gene H19 across normal tissues, testicular germ cell tumors from adolescents and adults, and the NT2-D1 cell line. TGCTs showed biallelic H19 expression regardless of histology. Methylation patterns of TGCTs resembled their nonmalignant counterparts, and methylation did not correlate with allelic or total expression. Upon differentiation, NT2-D1 cells induced H19 expression while the CpG sites remained methylated. The findings suggest tissue-dependent methylation that does not regulate H19 expression.

pmid-9310778.summary_ja: 本研究は進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の24例に対しPVB併用化学療法を施行し、治療効果と4つの予後リスク基準を評価した。完全奏効は50%、部分奏効は38%であった。病期IIAと後腹膜転移で奏効率が高く、肝・骨転移では奏効が得られなかった。平均88.5か月の観察で、MSKCC基準が82%と最も予後予測精度が高かった。
pmid-9310778.summary_en: This study treated 24 patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumor using cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB) combination chemotherapy. Complete response was achieved in 50% and partial response in 38%. Complete response rates were higher in stage IIA and retroperitoneal metastases, while no response occurred in liver or bone metastases. With a mean follow-up of 88.5 months, the authors compared four risk criteria, and the MSKCC criteria were most accurate at 82%.

pmid-9311009.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ約40例を対象に、血清β-hCG・LDHと組織中のβ-hCG発現を検討した。LDHは浸潤・転移・予後不良と相関した一方、血清β-hCGは転移の有無のみと相関し、悪性度とは関連しなかった。予後指標としてはhCGよりLDHが有用と結論している。
pmid-9311009.summary_en: This study examined 35–40 testicular seminomas, measuring serum beta-hCG and LDH and immunohistochemical beta-hCG expression. LDH correlated with invasion, metastasis, and poor outcome, whereas serum beta-hCG reflected only metastatic status and tumor volume, not malignant potential. Most seminomas express small amounts of hCG. The authors conclude that LDH is a better prognostic marker than hCG in seminoma.

pmid-9311177.summary_ja: 28歳女性が右下腹部の腫瘤で受診し、開腹術で大網原発の嚢胞性奇形腫と判明した。大網茎が捻転していた症例で、著者らの知る限り初の報告である。婦人科領域でまれな性腺外の奇形腫として文献を概観しており、症例報告の形式をとっている。
pmid-9311177.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman presented with a palpable right lower quadrant mass that proved at laparotomy to be a cystic teratoma arising in the greater omentum. The authors report that the omental pedicle was torsioned, which they believe is the first such documented case. The report also reviews the literature on this rare extragonadal site of teratoma in gynecologic practice.

pmid-9313327.summary_ja: ダウン症候群に伴う服薬コンプライアンス不良のため、再発した病期IIIBセミノーマの32歳男性にカルボプラチン単剤の用量調整療法を施行した。完全寛解が得られ、4年間のフォローアップでも維持された。標準的な併用療法が困難な症例に対する救済治療の一例として報告している。
pmid-9313327.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with Down's syndrome and relapsed stage IIIB seminoma was treated with a dose-modified single-agent carboplatin schedule because of poor compliance associated with his condition. Carboplatin monotherapy achieved complete remission, sustained through four years of follow-up. The report illustrates a salvage option for an advanced seminoma patient who could not follow standard combination treatment.

pmid-9314922.summary_ja: 直径6cm未満の卵巣類皮嚢腫86例を超音波で前向きに追跡した研究である。閉経前女性の嚢胞は年1.8mm程度増大したが、閉経後は縮小傾向であった。手術を受けた24例はすべて良性嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。特に妊娠を希望する閉経前女性では待機的管理が安全と結論している。
pmid-9314922.summary_en: This prospective study followed ovarian dermoid cysts under 6 cm by ultrasound in 86 women, comparing premenopausal (72) and postmenopausal (14) patients. Premenopausal cysts grew at about 1.8 mm/year, while postmenopausal cysts did not. Surgery was performed in 24 cases, all confirmed as benign cystic teratomas. The authors conclude that premenopausal women with small dermoid cysts, especially those wishing to conceive, can be safely managed expectantly.

pmid-9315068.summary_ja: 精巣がんの現在の治療戦略と長期毒性をまとめたレビューである。病期I非セミノーマでは監視療法、進行例にはBEP療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清などを概説している。放射線療法やシスプラチン併用化学療法の晩期毒性、生殖機能や生活の質への影響にも注意が必要と述べている。
pmid-9315068.summary_en: This review summarizes current management of testicular cancer, which has become curable with about 90% long-term survival. It covers surveillance for stage I non-seminoma, BEP chemotherapy for non-seminoma, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with nerve-sparing technique, radiotherapy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy for seminoma, and long-term toxicities including infertility and nephrotoxicity. It emphasizes careful follow-up and attention to quality of life.

pmid-9315175.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫が疑われた70例78病変をドプラ超音波で前向きに評価し、手術で確定した。血流は24.3%の病変でのみ、嚢胞周囲の卵巣組織から検出された。卵巣甲状腺腫と確定した4例では、中心部の充実成分からも血流が認められた。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の中心部に血流のある充実組織があれば、卵巣甲状腺腫を疑うべきと述べている。
pmid-9315175.summary_en: Doppler sonography was used prospectively in 70 women with 78 suspected ovarian dermoid cysts, all later confirmed surgically. Blood flow was detected in only 24.3% of lesions, and only from the surrounding ovarian tissue. In four cases proven to be struma ovarii, flow was also seen in the central solid area. The authors suggest that vascularized central solid tissue in a suspected benign cystic teratoma should raise suspicion of struma ovarii.

pmid-9315401.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者30例を対象に、術後放射線療法の照射野(dog-leg法と傍大動脈法)と制吐薬オンダンセトロンの予防投与が急性消化管毒性に及ぼす影響を検討した。dog-leg照射では悪心・嘔吐などが高頻度に見られ、オンダンセトロンは悪心を有意に軽減した。症例数が少ないため確定的な結論は得られておらず、大規模なMRC試験での検討が示されている。
pmid-9315401.summary_en: In this randomized pilot study of 30 patients with Stage I testicular seminoma, dog-leg versus para-aortic radiotherapy fields and prophylactic ondansetron were compared for acute gastrointestinal toxicity. Dog-leg radiotherapy caused substantial nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea and abdominal discomfort. Prophylactic ondansetron significantly reduced nausea and showed a trend toward less vomiting, while reduced field size showed a trend toward less diarrhoea. The authors note the sample is too small for definitive conclusions and refer to a larger MRC trial.

pmid-9315405.summary_ja: 悪性奇形腫の41歳患者において、シスプラチン投与後に重度の腎尿細管性塩分喪失が生じた症例報告である。多尿を伴ったが有意な低ナトリウム血症はなく、無症候性で短期間に経過した。早期に発見され完全に回復したことから、シスプラチン化学療法中の慎重な体液バランス管理の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-9315405.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old patient with malignant teratoma who developed severe cisplatin-induced renal tubular salt wasting. The episode was brief and largely asymptomatic, with polyuria but no significant hyponatraemia. Early recognition allowed full recovery. The authors emphasize that careful fluid balance monitoring is essential in patients receiving cisplatin chemotherapy, because early detection prevented lasting renal injury.

pmid-9316754.summary_ja: 乳児において、胃の嚢胞性奇形腫が茎で縦隔の嚢胞性奇形腫と連結していた稀な症例報告である。同一患者で胃と縦隔の奇形腫が同時に発生した例は報告がなく、胃奇形腫が縦隔へ進展した例も過去に2例のみである。画像所見と病理所見を示し、乳児の性腺外奇形腫に関する文献をレビューしている。
pmid-9316754.summary_en: This case report describes an infant with a gastric cystic teratoma connected by a pedicle to a mediastinal cystic teratoma, an unusual simultaneous occurrence. Gastric teratomas extending into the mediastinum had been reported only twice before. The authors present the imaging and pathological features of this rare presentation and review the literature on extragonadal teratomas in infants. The report highlights the diagnostic challenge of recognizing a conjoined benign lesion spanning two anatomical compartments.

pmid-9322252.summary_ja: Mos欠損マウスの卵巣奇形腫が、卵巣内で単為発生活性化した卵母細胞に由来するという仮説を検討した動物研究である。体外成熟させたMos-/-卵母細胞の約5%が胚盤胞期に到達し、生後60〜63日の変異マウスの卵巣内では着床前様および着床初期様の胚が観察された。卵巣奇形腫の発生起源を理解する上で意義がある。
pmid-9322252.summary_en: This animal study examined whether ovarian teratomas in Mos-deficient mice arise from parthenogenetically activated oocytes. Mos-/- oocytes matured in vitro were cultured in KSOM/AA medium, and about 5% reached the blastocyst stage. Preimplantation and early postimplantation-like embryos were also observed in the ovaries of 60-63-day-old mutant mice. These findings support the hypothesis that the teratomas derive from oocytes that undergo early embryonic development within the ovary. Aberrant meiotic divisions may reduce blastocyst formation even under optimal culture conditions.

pmid-9326912.summary_ja: 北米・欧州の人口ベース腫瘍登録に基づく約2万9千人の精巣がん生存者を対象に、二次悪性腫瘍のリスク上昇が診断後20年以上にわたり持続することを示した。白血病の増加は放射線療法と化学療法の両方に関連し、胃・膀胱・膵臓のがんは主に放射線療法と関連していた。固形腫瘍のリスクは診断からの経過とともに増加した。
pmid-9326912.summary_en: This population-based cohort of about 29,000 testicular cancer survivors from North American and European registries shows a persistently elevated risk of second malignancies, with an overall observed-to-expected ratio of 1.43. Excess leukemias were linked to both radiotherapy and chemotherapy, while excess stomach, bladder, and possibly pancreatic cancers were mainly associated with radiotherapy. Solid tumor risk rose with time since diagnosis, reaching an O/E of 1.54 among 20-year survivors. Seminoma and nonseminomatous histology carried similar overall risks.

pmid-9329598.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の147例を対象とした後方視的研究で、化学療法初期2サイクル中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とhCGの腫瘍マーカー半減期(MHL)が長期予後を予測するかを検討した。いずれかの半減期が延長した患者は、10年全生存期間および無増悪生存期間が有意に不良であった。大量化学療法の適応選択に用いるには前向き研究による検証が必要とされている。
pmid-9329598.summary_en: This retrospective study of 147 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors examined whether serum AFP and hCG marker half-life (MHL) during the first two chemotherapy cycles predicts long-term outcome. Prolonged half-life of either marker was linked to significantly worse 10-year overall survival (37% vs 75%) and progression-free survival (29% vs 69%) than normal half-life. The authors conclude that these findings need prospective confirmation before guiding selection for high-dose chemotherapy.

pmid-9331294.summary_ja: 成人男性4例の前縦隔原発肝様卵黄嚢腫瘍を報告した。いずれも既往の胚細胞腫瘍や肝異常はなかった。全例で腫瘍細胞はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)に強陽性を示した。フォローアップが得られた3例は全例が1年以内に肺転移を来し、2例が死亡した。縦隔の肝様病変の鑑別診断において本亜型の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-9331294.summary_en: This report describes four adult men with primary hepatoid yolk sac tumors of the anterior mediastinum, presenting with chest pain and dyspnea without a prior germ cell tumor or liver abnormality. Tumors were large and showed sheets of polygonal cells alongside conventional yolk sac tumor areas with hyaline globules and Schiller-Duval bodies. All stained strongly for alpha-fetoprotein. Among three patients with follow-up, all developed lung metastases within a year, and two died. The authors highlight this variant for the differential diagnosis of mediastinal lesions.

pmid-9332817.summary_ja: 倍数性が中間的な腫瘍のCGH解析法を改良した方法論の研究です。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株DNAを用いて検討しました。従来の中期像全体での正規化では比率が診断閾値付近に寄りました。個々の染色体ごとに複数の正規化を行うことで、2コピーと3コピーの染色体や範囲外の欠失・増幅を明確に区別できました。
pmid-9332817.summary_en: This cytometry methods paper refines comparative genomic hybridization (CGH) for tumors of intermediate ploidy, which often occur in testicular germ cell tumors. Using DNA from a testicular germ cell tumor cell line, the authors found that standard whole-metaphase normalization shifted ratios toward diagnostic thresholds. Evaluating single chromosomes with multiple normalization clearly distinguished two- and three-copy chromosomes and regions deleted or amplified outside that range.

pmid-9334609.summary_ja: 本報告は18年間の単施設経験で、導入化学療法後の巨大転移性胚細胞腫瘍の男性19例に対し、下大静脈合併切除を伴う後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った成績です。全例で完全切除が得られ、術後合併症の多くは消化器系や肺系でした。術前に腫瘍マーカーが正常化していなかった患者は予後不良でした。後腹膜再発は1例のみで、根治の機会をもたらす可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-9334609.summary_en: This 18-year single-center series describes vena caval resection combined with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 19 men with bulky metastatic germ cell tumors after induction chemotherapy. The inferior vena cava was resected in all patients, and complete resection of retroperitoneal disease was achieved. Morbidity was mostly gastrointestinal or pulmonary, and chronic edema persisted in some. Patients who had not normalized tumor markers before surgery had poorer outcomes. Only one patient had retroperitoneal recurrence, suggesting the procedure may offer a chance for cure.

pmid-9334657.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるnm23遺伝子とc-myc遺伝子の変化を解析したものです。nm23の対立遺伝子欠失は一部の腫瘍にみられ、いずれも転移を伴っていました。nm23 mRNAは多くの腫瘍で過剰発現し、主にセミノーマで認められました。c-mycの過剰発現はまれで、DNAレベルでの異常は検出されず、両遺伝子の共発現も認められませんでした。
pmid-9334657.summary_en: This study analyzed the metastasis suppressor genes nm23-H1 and nm23-H2 and the proto-oncogene c-myc in human testicular germ cell tumors. Allelic loss of nm23 occurred in a subset of tumors, and all of these had metastases. nm23 mRNA overexpression was found in most tumors, mainly due to nm23-H2, and was predominantly seen in seminomas. c-myc overexpression was rare, and no abnormalities of the c-myc gene were detected at the DNA level. Despite a reported link between nm23-H2 and c-myc, the two were not coexpressed.

pmid-9335189.summary_ja: 28歳女性が急性腹痛で受診し、超音波検査で両側卵巣腫瘤が認められた症例報告です。手術で両側の三胚葉性成熟奇形腫と診断されました。左卵巣には子宮内膜型間質を伴う子宮内膜症病巣があり、線維組織で奇形腫と隔てられていました。子宮内膜症が無症候性の奇形腫を発見する契機となり得る点が指摘されています。
pmid-9335189.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with sudden abdominal pain and a bilateral ovarian mass on ultrasound. Surgery revealed bilateral triphasic mature teratomas. An endometrioid focus with endometrial-type stroma was found in the left ovary, separated from the teratoma by fibrotic tissue. The authors note that this combination of endometriosis and teratoma has not been reported before. They suggest endometriotic disease may reveal an otherwise silent bilateral teratoma, which has clinical relevance.

pmid-9336757.summary_ja: 母体血清αフェトプロテインの上昇を契機に出生前診断された鼻咽頭奇形腫の症例報告です。超音波検査で胎児の口から突出する嚢胞が認められ、出生後には新生児の口腔を占める奇形腫が確認されました。奇形腫は退縮して見えることがあり、羊水中のαフェトプロテインなどが陽性となり得ると述べています。分娩時の気道確保の準備が周産期管理で重要です。
pmid-9336757.summary_en: This case report describes a nasopharyngeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally after elevated maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein. Ultrasound showed a cyst protruding from the fetal mouth. After birth, a teratoma was found filling the neonate's oral cavity. The authors note that teratomas may appear to regress and can yield positive amniotic fluid alpha-fetoprotein and acetylcholinesterase. Perinatal management should include preparation for securing the airway at delivery, given the risk of a potentially devastating disorder.

pmid-9337678.summary_ja: 欧州10施設の進行セミノーマ286例を対象に、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の3年無増悪生存期間の予後因子を検討した研究です。非肺臓器の内臓転移と、LDHの高値が独立した予後不良因子でした。2つの予後モデルを作成して外部検証し、モデル2が推奨されています。予後良好群の3年無増悪生存期間は94%、不良群は56%でした。
pmid-9337678.summary_en: This multicenter European study of 286 patients with advanced seminoma treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy identified prognostic factors for 3-year progression-free survival. Previously irradiated patients had lower PFS. Non-pulmonary visceral metastases and serum LDH at least twice the upper limit of normal were independent adverse factors. Two prognostic models were validated in 166 patients, and Model 2 is recommended. The good-prognosis group reached 94% 3-year PFS, while the poor-prognosis group reached 56%.

pmid-9337694.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な12p過剰を、等染色体i(12p)由来のコピー数としてPCRで定量する方法を開発した研究です。FISH法で確認した細胞株で妥当性を検証しました。原発腫瘍14例では、セミノーマ8例中3例で12p過剰がなく、非セミノーマ性腫瘍6例は全例で過剰があり、重症度がコピー数と相関しました。診断と予後評価への応用が提案されています。
pmid-9337694.summary_en: This study developed a PCR-based method to quantify additional copies of chromosome 12p, the hallmark of male germ cell tumors, typically caused by isochromosome i(12p). The method was validated in two cell lines using FISH. In 14 primary tumors, 3 of 8 seminomatous tumors lacked additional 12p, whereas all 6 non-seminomatous tumors had it, with severity correlating with copy number. The authors propose the assay as a routine diagnostic and prognostic tool for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-9338737.summary_ja: 1982〜1995年にオーストラリアの単一施設で、病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の77例に精巣摘除術後の積極的監視を行った。35%が再発し、多くは後腹膜リンパ節で、中央値5か月後だった。37か月と57か月の後期再発も認めた。再発例は化学療法と手術で寛解し、97%が生存し無病であった。積極的監視は安全で有効だが、後期再発に注意が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-9338737.summary_en: This series reviews 77 men with stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors managed by orchiectomy followed by active surveillance at a single Australian center from 1982 to 1995. Of these, 35% relapsed, mostly in retroperitoneal nodes, with a median time to relapse of 5 months. Two late relapses occurred at 37 and 57 months. All relapsing patients achieved remission with chemotherapy and surgery, and 97% remained alive and disease-free. The authors conclude that surveillance is safe and effective, while warning that late relapses can occur.

pmid-9339529.summary_ja: 出生前超音波で石灰化を伴う腹部腫瘤と右側停留精巣が見つかった正期産新生児の症例。開腹で深鼠径輪直上の捻転した後腹膜腫瘍が確認され、腹腔内精巣由来の成熟奇形腫と診断された。完全切除後、1年のフォローアップで再発はなかった。陰嚢に精巣がない場合は胎児腹部腫瘤として奇形腫を考慮すべきと述べ、出生前診断の可能性も示唆している。
pmid-9339529.summary_en: A full-term newborn with a calcified fetal abdominal mass and an undescended right testis was evaluated after the mass was seen on prenatal ultrasound. Laparotomy revealed a twisted retroperitoneal tumor just above the deep inguinal ring, which histology identified as a mature teratoma arising from an intra-abdominal testis. The tumor was completely removed, with no recurrence at one-year follow-up. The authors suggest that teratoma should be considered in fetal abdominal masses when testes are not found in the scrotum, and that prenatal diagnosis may be possible.

pmid-9342633.summary_ja: 精巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の86例、177検体で血清FSH、LH、LTH、テストステロン、β-hCGを測定した。RIA法では、FSHとβ-hCGの交差反応は認められなかった。β-hCGが100 U/lを超えるとFSH分泌は著明に抑制された。FSHが過剰に高値の場合、腫瘍由来でないβ-hCG上昇が生じうる。境界値のβ-hCGの解釈には同一検体のFSH測定が必要と結論している。
pmid-9342633.summary_en: Serum FSH, LH, LTH, testosterone and β-hCG were measured in 177 samples from 86 men with malignant testicular germ cell tumors. The RIA showed no cross-reaction between FSH and β-hCG. When β-hCG exceeded 100 U/l, FSH secretion was substantially suppressed. Markedly elevated FSH could also be accompanied by β-hCG rises not derived from the tumor. The authors conclude that FSH should be measured in the same sample to correctly interpret borderline or elevated β-hCG.

pmid-9345364.summary_ja: 14歳で頸部肉腫性ブドウ状腫瘍を発症し根治的子宮摘出術を受けた女性が、27歳で右卵巣セルトリ・ライディッヒ細胞腫を発症した。この腫瘍はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生する卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を含んでいた。両腫瘍の併存は既知で3例目であり、関連の機序は不明である。
pmid-9345364.summary_en: A woman first developed a cervical sarcoma botryoides at age 14, treated by radical hysterectomy. At age 27 she developed a right ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor with a heterologous yolk sac tumor component producing alpha-fetoprotein. She remained disease-free 16 years after the sarcoma and 3 years after the ovarian tumor. The authors report only the third known association of these two rare gynecologic tumors and note that its basis remains unknown.

pmid-9345366.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の患者が、エトポシド、メトトレキサート等による多剤化学療法中に呼吸不全を発症した。低一回換気量の標準的な人工呼吸管理により回復し、呼吸機能は正常で臨床的寛解を維持している。転移性絨毛癌による早期呼吸不全では、低一回換気量・圧目標式換気が考慮されるべきとしている。
pmid-9345366.summary_en: A patient with metastatic choriocarcinoma developed respiratory failure while receiving multiagent chemotherapy with etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, and vincristine. She recovered with conventional mechanical ventilation using low tidal volumes and has maintained clinical remission with normal respiratory function. The authors suggest that low tidal volume, pressure-targeted ventilation should be considered for early respiratory failure caused by metastatic choriocarcinoma.

pmid-9346229.summary_ja: パクリタキセルの胚細胞腫瘍に対するサルベージ療法での使用を報告する。精巣原発の再発症例を対象とした第I/II相試験では、イホスファミド、シスプラチンとの併用で63%が完全奏効した。予後不良因子を持つシスプラチン抵抗性症例では、幹細胞支持下の高用量化学療法により56%が完全奏効し、治療関連死はなかった。
pmid-9346229.summary_en: This report summarizes paclitaxel use in salvage therapy for germ cell tumors. In a phase I/II trial of relapsed testicular tumors, paclitaxel combined with ifosfamide and cisplatin produced complete responses in 63% of assessable patients. In a dose-intensive program for cisplatin-resistant tumors with poor-prognosis features, paclitaxel and ifosfamide followed by carboplatin and etoposide with stem cell support produced complete responses in 56%. Hematologic toxicity was moderately severe, with no treatment-related deaths.

pmid-9349991.summary_ja: 若年男性が上部消化管出血を初発症状として受診した。出血の原因は後腹膜リンパ節転移巣による十二指腸浸潤であった。当初は原発である精巣腫瘍を同定できなかった。転移性精巣腫瘍は上部消化管出血の稀な原因であり、若年男性では本疾患を精査すべきと述べている。
pmid-9349991.summary_en: A young man presented with upper gastrointestinal bleeding as his first symptom. The bleeding resulted from duodenal invasion by a metastatic lesion in a retroperitoneal lymph node, and the primary testicular tumor could not initially be found. The authors note that metastatic testicular tumor is a rare cause of upper gastrointestinal bleeding and that young men presenting with such bleeding should be evaluated for it.

pmid-9350571.summary_ja: 転移性頸部リンパ節腫脹で初発した患者で、精巣超音波検査により右精巣の片側性精巣微小石灰化と小さな低エコー性腫瘤が認められ、セミノーマと判明した。精巣微小石灰化は精巣悪性腫瘍と強く関連するため良性とはみなせず、超音波によるフォローアップが推奨されている。
pmid-9350571.summary_en: A patient presented with metastatic cervical lymphadenopathy. Sonography of the testes revealed unilateral right testicular microlithiasis and a small hypoechoic mass, which proved to be a seminoma. The authors emphasize that testicular microlithiasis is strongly associated with testicular malignancy and should not be considered benign. They recommend sonographic follow-up for patients with testicular microlithiasis.

pmid-9352707.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し化学療法を受けた256例を1978〜1994年に検討した。治療後20か月以内に57例が再発し、晩期胚細胞腫瘍再発は6例であった。対側精巣の胚細胞腫瘍4例と、第二の非胚細胞性がん6例が認められた。晩期事象は治療後29〜141か月に発生し、全体の6.2%であった。5・10・20年時点での超音波による後腹膜および精巣の監視を提案している。
pmid-9352707.summary_en: This single-centre study of 256 patients treated with chemotherapy for germ cell cancer of the testis (1978-1994) assessed late relapses and second cancers. Early relapse occurred in 57 patients, late germ cell relapse in six, and second germ cell tumours in four contralateral testes, alongside six second non-germ cell cancers. Late events arose 29-141 months after treatment, in 6.2% overall. Because late relapse (2.3%) was less frequent than the mature teratoma found at routine retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, the authors suggest ultrasound surveillance of the retroperitoneum and testis at 5, 10 and 20 years.

pmid-9352708.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん患者62例を対象とした研究である。凍結切片で壊死を示した37例には限定的郭清、胚細胞腫瘍または奇形腫を示した25例には両側郭清を行った。中央値6年の追跡で再発は23%だったが、後腹膜再発は1例のみであった。凍結切片と最終病理の一致率は89%、手術合併症は10%であった。著者らは、選択された患者では安全な方法と結論づけた。
pmid-9352708.summary_en: This study evaluated 62 patients with advanced testicular cancer who underwent complete resection of post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal masses. Limited lymph node dissection was performed when frozen sections showed necrosis (37 patients), and bilateral dissection when viable germ cell tumour or teratoma was seen (25). With median follow-up of six years, 23% relapsed, but only one retroperitoneal relapse occurred (teratoma after limited dissection). Frozen-section concordance with final histology was 89%, with four false-negatives all confined to the resected mass. Surgical complications occurred in 10%. The authors conclude that limited dissection after frozen-section necrosis is safe in selected patients.

pmid-9352797.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ精巣胚細胞腫瘍70例と化学療法後の残存成熟奇形腫31例の核型を細胞遺伝学的に比較した。両群とも三倍体域で、i(12p)の頻度や染色体の過剰・欠失パターンは同等であった。RMTもプライマリーのNSと同様に染色体異常を有していた。転移や治療関連分化に特異的な染色体変化は認められなかった。治療後の成熟は、細胞の分化誘導や分化能を持つ細胞の選択によると考察している。
pmid-9352797.summary_en: Karyotypes of 70 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours (NSs) and 31 residual mature teratomas (RMTs) after chemotherapy were compared by cytogenetics. Both groups were in the triploid range, with similar modal chromosome number, frequency and copy number of i(12p), and overall chromosomal over- and underrepresentation patterns. RMTs were thus as chromosomally abnormal as primary NSs. No specific alterations were linked to metastasis or therapy-related differentiation. The authors propose that induction of differentiation in selected cells, or selection of cells capable of differentiating, may underlie maturation of residual tumour after treatment.

pmid-9354734.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍や肝腫瘍の小児18例で、外科的切除後のAFP実測半減期を算出した。完全切除で再発のない13例は4.0日、不完全切除または再発の5例は24.8日と有意に延長していた。半減期の延長は残存腫瘍を示唆した。連続測定より早期の再発検出に有用な可能性があり、AFPクリアランスに基づく治療方針が提案されている。
pmid-9354734.summary_en: In this retrospective study of 18 children with malignant germ cell or hepatic tumours, the actual half-life (AHL) of serum alpha-fetoprotein was calculated after surgical resection. Patients with complete resection and no recurrence had an AHL of 4.0 days, whereas those with incomplete resection or recurrence had a markedly longer 24.8 days (P=0.0026). Prolonged AHL indicated residual active tumour. The authors suggest AHL may detect preclinical recurrence more sensitively than serial AFP monitoring, and that treatment could be guided by AFP clearance, pending prospective trials.

pmid-9354962.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化に奇形癌と精細管内胚細胞腫瘍が併存した症例を報告した。精巣微小石灰化は前がん性変化や精巣悪性腫瘍と関連することが多い。既報3例でもフォローアップ中に悪性胚細胞腫瘍が発生していた。著者らは、精巣微小石灰化は精巣腫瘍と強く関連し、併存は一般的であると論じている。
pmid-9354962.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with testicular microlithiasis coexisting with teratocarcinoma and intratubular germ cell neoplasia. Testicular microlithiasis has characteristic sonographic and histologic features and is often linked to premalignant change and testicular malignancy. Three prior reports had documented malignant germ cell tumour developing during follow-up in patients with microlithiasis. The authors argue that microlithiasis is strongly associated with testicular neoplasms and that coexistence with intratubular neoplasia and malignant germ cell tumours is common.

pmid-9354963.summary_ja: 34歳男性が左側腹部痛で受診し、後腹膜の腫瘤から性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が疑われた。陰嚢超音波検査で触知不能な7mmの低エコー病変が見つかり、組織学的に原発性の胎児性癌と判明した。一部の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は精巣原発に由来しうるため、治療計画では精巣を原発巣として考慮すべきと示唆している。
pmid-9354963.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man who presented with left flank pain and a retroperitoneal mass, initially presumed to be an extragonadal germ cell tumor. Scrotal ultrasonography detected a 7 mm hypoechoic lesion, which histology proved to be a primary embryonal carcinoma, an impalpable testicular tumor. The tumor appeared to have grown slowly and was well encapsulated. The authors suggest that some extragonadal germ cell tumors may originate from occult testicular primaries, so the testis should be considered as a possible primary site during treatment planning.

pmid-9358218.summary_ja: 単一施設で11例のgrowing teratoma syndromeを報告している。化学療法後に既存の転移巣が増大する病態で、大半は後腹膜に生じた。治療は外科的切除が第一選択だが再発が多く、8例が再発し、6例は成熟奇形腫、2例は癌であった。全例が生存しており、腫瘤の完全切除の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-9358218.summary_en: This single-institution study reports 11 patients with growing teratoma syndrome, in which teratoma lesions enlarge during or after chemotherapy despite favorable tumor markers. Lesions arose at previously involved metastatic sites, most often the retroperitoneum. Surgical resection was the treatment of choice, with 24 procedures performed. Recurrence was common: 8 patients relapsed, 6 with mature teratoma and 2 with cancer. All patients were alive at follow-up, and the authors stress the importance of complete resection of masses.

pmid-9358229.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者44例のうち24例で、治療前後に胸部CTにより前縦隔を評価した。再発した4例中3例に前縦隔腫瘤があり、1例は良性の胸腺過形成、2例は転移性腫瘍であった。CT所見は良性と悪性の鑑別の手がかりになりうるが、救済手術の適応がある症例では外科的探索が推奨されると結論している。
pmid-9358229.summary_en: This study evaluated anterior mediastinal masses in patients with testicular cancer, using chest CT before and after treatment in 24 of 44 patients. Among four patients with recurrence, three had anterior mediastinal masses: one had benign thymic hyperplasia, and two had metastatic tumor that enlarged and obstructed major vessels. The authors conclude that CT findings and treatment response may help distinguish benign from malignant masses, but surgical exploration is recommended for patients who are candidates for salvage surgery.

pmid-9358777.summary_ja: 前縦隔原発の進行性卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例で、化学療法に抵抗性であったため緩和的外科的切除を施行した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は希少な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が重要な腫瘍マーカーである。進行例でも、化学療法と残存腫瘍の外科的切除を組み合わせた治療の後に、緩和的切除が適応となりうると述べている。
pmid-9358777.summary_en: This report describes a patient with an advanced primary yolk sac tumor of the anterior mediastinum, a rare extragonadal germ cell neoplasm. The tumor was refractory to chemotherapy, and the patient underwent palliative surgical resection. The authors note that alpha-fetoprotein is an important tumor marker and that multimodal therapy is standard. They consider chemotherapy followed by surgical resection of residual tumor to be optimal, and they conclude that palliative resection is indicated even in advanced cases.

pmid-9359651.summary_ja: FIGO分類IV期、WHOスコア12の高リスク絨毛癌の症例で、膣と尿道からの持続的出血を認めた。多剤化学療法に加え、両側腸骨動脈のコイル塞栓術を行い全身状態が改善した。その後の開腹手術で子宮と付属器を摘出し、寛解が得られた。進行絨毛癌で出血がある場合、塞栓術が化学療法の補助として有用になりうることを示している。
pmid-9359651.summary_en: This report describes a patient with high-risk choriocarcinoma, FIGO stage IV with a WHO prognostic score of 12, who presented with persistent vaginal and urethral bleeding. Treatment comprised multiagent chemotherapy and bilateral iliac arterial embolization with Gianturco coils, which markedly improved the patient's general condition. Subsequent laparotomy with hysterectomy and adnexal extirpation achieved remission. The case suggests that embolization can be a useful adjunct to chemotherapy in advanced gestational choriocarcinoma with bleeding.

pmid-9361192.summary_ja: 本研究はマウス胎児性癌（F9テラトカルチノーマ）幹細胞を対象に、DFMOによるポリアミン枯渇とレチノイン酸による分化誘導の違いを検討した。両処理とも壁側内胚葉様細胞を生じるが、経路は異なる。RARα・β・γのmRNA発現とc-jun発現を比較し、RARβの誘導は分化に必須ではなく、c-jun上昇の直接の帰結でもないことを示した。
pmid-9361192.summary_en: This study examines differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells, a murine embryonal carcinoma model, induced either by polyamine depletion with DFMO or by all-trans-retinoic acid. Both treatments produce parietal endoderm-like cells, but they act through different pathways. The authors measured retinoic acid receptor alpha, beta, and gamma mRNA alongside c-jun expression. RAR beta induction proved unnecessary for differentiation and was not a direct consequence of elevated c-jun, suggesting that parietal endoderm differentiation can proceed without RAR beta changes.

pmid-9364928.summary_ja: 本研究はマウス胎児性癌細胞株P19を用い、レチノイン酸による神経分化過程を解析した。神経内分泌型コンベルターゼPC2とその結合蛋白7B2は共誘導され、他のコンベルターゼとは異なる発現パターンを示した。mRNA誘導後には成熟型のPC2と7B2が同時に検出され、脳発生の早い段階でプロセシングを受けることが示唆された。P19細胞は、このPC2と7B2の関係の制御を研究する有用なモデルとされる。
pmid-9364928.summary_en: This study uses the mouse embryonal carcinoma line P19 as a model of neuronal differentiation induced by retinoic acid. The neuroendocrine convertase PC2 and its binding partner 7B2 are co-induced during differentiation, while other convertases follow different expression patterns. Mature PC2 and 7B2 proteins are detected together by immunoblotting after mRNA induction, suggesting early processing during brain development. The authors propose P19 cells as a valuable model for studying regulation of this PC2-7B2 relationship in neural development.

pmid-9365168.summary_ja: 本研究はRNase保護法により、青年期・成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍（精母細胞性セミノーマを含む）におけるインヒビン・アクチビン・フォリスタチンのmRNAを解析した。全例でインヒビンβサブユニットが発現し、アクチビン受容体も発現していた。セミノーマと非セミノーマの間で受容体サブタイプと発現レベルに差がみられ、フォリスタチンは主に非セミノーマで発現した。アクチビンが腫瘍の増殖・分化を制御する傍分泌・自己分泌因子として働く可能性が示された。
pmid-9365168.summary_en: RNase protection assays examined inhibin/activin subunits, activin receptors and follistatin mRNA in testicular germ cell tumours of adolescents and adults, including spermatocytic seminomas. All tumours expressed inhibin beta-subunit transcripts, and activin type I and II receptors were present. Seminomas showed lower ActRIIA and higher ActRIA and ActRIB than non-seminomas. Non-seminomas had higher inhibin betaA levels, and follistatin was mainly expressed in non-seminomas and spermatocytic seminomas. The authors suggest activin acts as a paracrine or autocrine regulator of germ cell tumour growth and differentiation.

pmid-9366493.summary_ja: 本研究はヒトFGF-8遺伝子を単離し、腫瘍および正常組織での発現を調べた。精巣癌は7例中1例、卵巣癌は12例中1例でしかFGF-8は発現していなかった。一方、テラトカルチノーマ細胞株Tera-2は胎児ウシ血清によりFGF-8 mRNAの発現が誘導された。精巣や卵巣の腫瘍ではFGF-8発現が抑制されている一方、胎児性癌細胞では誘導されうることが示された。
pmid-9366493.summary_en: This study isolates the human FGF-8 gene and surveys its expression in tumour and normal tissues. FGF-8 was expressed in only one of seven testicular carcinomas and one of twelve ovarian carcinomas, while previously reported in normal adult testis and ovary. The teratocarcinoma line Tera-2 could be induced to express FGF-8 mRNA by fetal bovine serum. The findings suggest that FGF-8 is largely silenced in germ cell-related tumours, with serum-responsive induction possible in embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-9368730.summary_ja: 単独精巣に二次性の原発性セミノーマを発症した医師が、生殖能力温存のため根治的精巣摘除術を拒否し、カルボプラチン単剤化学療法を受けました。17か月後にMRIと超音波検査で腫瘍は認められず、精子形成も一部回復しました。前向き研究による安全性の検証が必要とされています。
pmid-9368730.summary_en: A physician developed a second primary seminoma in a solitary testis and declined radical orchidectomy to preserve fertility. He received single-agent carboplatin. Seventeen months later, MRI and ultrasound showed no tumour, and spermatogenesis partly recovered. The authors note that 13 of 14 patients with metastatic disease treated with chemotherapy alone, leaving the primary in situ, remained free of recurrence beyond five years. They call for prospective studies to clarify safety.

pmid-9371403.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者に対するBEP化学療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)の前後で精子核型を解析した研究です。精子の染色体異常頻度は治療前10.2%、治療後10.7%と差がありませんでした。治療後2年以上経過した患者で染色体異常のリスク上昇は認められないと結論づけられています。
pmid-9371403.summary_en: The authors performed sperm karyotype analysis in men with testicular cancer before and after BEP chemotherapy, comprising bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Among 788 sperm complements, chromosomal abnormality frequencies were similar before (10.2%) and after treatment (10.7%), with no significant change in numerical or structural abnormalities or X-bearing sperm proportion. Results matched control donors. The authors conclude that men receiving BEP are not at increased risk of chromosomal abnormalities at least two years after treatment.

pmid-9375481.summary_ja: 10代患者に生じた転移性脳内絨毛癌の症例報告です。脳内転移性癌は中枢神経系で最も多い腫瘍の一つですが、脳内絨毛癌はまれで、絨毛癌の初発症状となることがあります。本報告では、この患者の治療経過と転帰を記述しています。絨毛癌の転移であるため、対象に含まれます。
pmid-9375481.summary_en: This J Natl Med Assoc case report describes a teenager with metastatic intracerebral choriocarcinoma. Intracerebral metastatic carcinoma is among the most common central nervous system tumors, but intracerebral choriocarcinoma is rare. It may present as the initial manifestation of choriocarcinoma. The report details the treatment course and clinical outcome of this adolescent patient. Because the lesion is a metastasis of choriocarcinoma, it falls within the site's scope.

pmid-9376184.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍250名を、血管浸潤と精巣摘除時の血清AFPに基づき3リスク群に分けて前向きに解析した。低リスク群は観察され、中間リスク群は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、高リスク群は補助化学療法を受けた。観察期間中央値40か月で死亡例はなかった。再発率は低リスク群22%、病理学的病期Iの中間リスク群18%、高リスク群3%であった。著者らは、後腹膜リンパ節郭清による病理学的病期分類は不要かもしれないと結論づけている。
pmid-9376184.summary_en: This prospective multicentre study stratified 250 clinical stage 1 non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients into risk groups using vascular invasion and serum AFP at orchiectomy. Low-risk patients were observed, intermediate-risk patients underwent RPLND, and high-risk patients received adjuvant PEB chemotherapy. Median follow-up was 40 months with no deaths. Relapse rates were 22% for low-risk and 18% for pathologically stage 1 intermediate-risk patients, with 3% relapse in high-risk patients. The authors conclude pathological staging by RPLND may be unnecessary.

pmid-9377960.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍で、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に肺残存腫瘍を切除した31例を解析した研究です。成熟奇形腫が半数を占め、後腹膜病変と組織像が異なる例が50%でした。10年生存率は82.2%でした。後腹膜の組織型にかかわらず、肺残存病変は全て外科的切除すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-9377960.summary_en: This Chest study reviewed 31 patients who underwent 32 thoracotomies for resection of pulmonary residual tumor masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Pathology showed mature teratoma in 52%, viable cancer in 13%, and necrosis or fibrosis in 35%. Histology differed between retroperitoneal and pulmonary residues in half of patients. The 5-year and 10-year survival rates were 86.8% and 82.2%. The authors conclude that all pulmonary residual disease should be resected regardless of retroperitoneal histology.

pmid-9385938.summary_ja: 掻爬材料から得られた胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）1例の免疫組織化学的検討である。p53、EGF受容体、Ki-67（MIB-1）の発現が高く、bcl-2は陰性であった。p53の異常とEGF-Rの高発現がPSTTの発生と増殖に関与する可能性が示唆された。分子生物学的所見の予後的意義は今後の検討課題とされる。
pmid-9385938.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry was performed on curettage material from a placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT). The tumor showed high expression of p53, epidermal growth factor receptor (EGF-R), and Ki-67 (MIB-1), while bcl-2 was not expressed. The authors conclude that p53 inactivation or dysregulation and EGF-R upregulation are probably involved in PSTT tumorigenesis and proliferation. They note that the prognostic significance of these molecular findings remains to be established.

pmid-9388060.summary_ja: 両側性1例を含む性腺芽腫2例で、ミュラー管抑制物質、インヒビン、WT1、p53の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。インヒビンは性索成分のみ、WT1は性索領域のみに陽性で、p53は胚細胞に発現していた。WT1とインヒビンは発生初期に関与し進行に伴い消失する可能性があり、性腺芽腫は悪性の潜在能を持つ上皮内胚細胞性腫瘍と解釈された。
pmid-9388060.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examines two gonadoblastomas, one bilateral, both with germinomatous areas. Inhibin was expressed in sex-cord cells but not germ cells, MIS was present in both components, and p53 was found in germ cells. WT1 was restricted to the sex-cord region. The authors propose that WT1 and inhibin are involved early in gonadoblastoma initiation but are lost during progression, and that p53 expression supports the view of gonadoblastoma as in situ germ cell neoplasia with malignant potential.

pmid-9389577.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の4細胞株を用い、シスプラチンによるアポトーシスとp53状態、Bcl-2ファミリー蛋白の関係を検討した研究。p53変異・欠失株は感受性が高く、p53機能を保持する2102 EPは抵抗性を示した。細胞内蓄積やDNA白金化の差では説明されず、アポトーシス経路はp53非依存的でBcl-2/Baxバランスとは関連しないと結論された。
pmid-9389577.summary_en: This study examined whether p53 status and Bcl-2 family proteins explain cisplatin-induced apoptosis in four testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Cisplatin readily killed the p53-mutant and p53-null lines, while the p53-competent 2102 EP line was resistant despite similar drug accumulation and DNA platination. Bax, Bcl-2, Bcl-x and Bak expression was not modulated by cisplatin. The authors conclude the apoptotic pathway is p53-independent and unrelated to the Bcl-2/Bax balance.

pmid-9392334.summary_ja: 先天性副腎過形成の44歳男性に両側精巣腫瘤が生じた症例報告。停留した左精巣(腹腔内)にはセミノーマと骨髄脂肪腫が併存していた。副腎皮質ホルモン補充に加え、後腹膜への外照射が行われた。ホルモン治療に反応せず増大する精巣腫瘍では、悪性腫瘍の併存を考慮すべきと警告している。
pmid-9392334.summary_en: A 44-year-old man with congenital adrenal hyperplasia developed bilateral testicular masses. The right testis contained nodules of polygonal cells, while the cryptorchid left testis contained both myelolipoma and a seminoma. The patient received corticosteroids for adrenal insufficiency and external beam irradiation to the retroperitoneum for the seminoma. The authors caution that testicular tumors in adrenogenital syndrome that keep growing despite hormonal treatment may hide a potentially fatal neoplasm.

pmid-9396264.summary_ja: 27歳男性の原発性縦隔絨毛癌の症例報告。胸痛と呼吸困難で受診し、前縦隔の巨大腫瘤と女性化乳房、β-hCG 500 ng/ml超を認めた。化学療法と残存腫瘍切除を行ったが肺転移が出現し、大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を施行したものの脳転移が生じ、発症後9か月で死亡した。
pmid-9396264.summary_en: A 27-year-old man presented with chest pain and dyspnea and was found to have a bulky anterior mediastinal mass, gynecomastia and beta-hCG above 500 ng/ml. Needle biopsy confirmed choriocarcinoma. After four chemotherapy cycles and partial resection, lung metastases developed. High-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplantation was given, but brain metastasis appeared, and he died nine months after symptom onset.

pmid-9399660.summary_ja: 精巣がん148例と対照315例を対象に、自己記入式質問票で職業性曝露を評価した症例対照研究である。ポリ塩化ビニル(PVC)への曝露はオッズ比6.6と有意に高く、停留精巣や精巣炎の既往を除外すると上昇した。曝露例の多くはセミノーマであった。他種のプラスチックへの曝露では有意な関連は認められなかった。曝露例数は少ないものの、PVCが精巣胚細胞腫瘍の職業的リスク因子となり得ることを示唆する。
pmid-9399660.summary_en: This case-control study of 148 testicular cancer cases and 315 controls assessed occupational exposures by questionnaire. Occupational exposure to polyvinyl chloride was associated with an odds ratio of 6.6, which rose further after excluding cases with self-reported cryptorchidism or orchitis. Most exposed cases had seminoma. Exposure to other plastics showed no significant association. The findings suggest PVC may be an occupational risk factor for testicular germ cell tumors, although the number of exposed cases is small.

pmid-9402482.summary_ja: 2歳未満の健常乳児163例を対象に免疫放射定量法で血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を測定し、より精密な正常範囲グラフを作成した研究である。得られた正常範囲はTsuchidaらの基準よりやや広く、偽陽性例の減少が期待される。正常乳児期のAFP半減期も提示され、判定が難しい場合の評価に有用とされる。AFPは小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍および肝芽腫の腫瘍マーカーである。
pmid-9402482.summary_en: This study establishes an updated reference range for serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) in healthy infants under two years of age, measured by immunoradiometric assay in 163 children. The authors' range is slightly wider than the widely used Tsuchida graph, which should reduce false-positive results during evaluation. They also provide AFP half-life values in normal infancy to help interpret levels when the reference range is hard to apply. AFP is a tumor marker for yolk sac tumor and hepatoblastoma in children.

pmid-9402495.summary_ja: 腹部膨満を主訴に受診した5歳の結合双生児の女児で、右卵巣に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。右卵管卵巣摘出術の後、病期IAと診断された。UK-CCSGに準じてビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミドによる化学療法を施行した。術後3年の時点で再発はみられず、双子の姉妹に腫瘍は認められなかった。結合双生児における卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の初報告とされる。
pmid-9402495.summary_en: This case report describes a 5-year-old girl, one of conjoined twins, with a yolk sac tumor of the right ovary presenting with abdominal distension. After right salpingo-oophorectomy, pathology showed stage IA disease. She received postoperative chemotherapy with vincristine, actinomycin-D, and cyclophosphamide per the UK-CCSG protocol. She remained free of recurrence three years after surgery, while her twin had no tumor. The authors note this is the first reported ovarian yolk sac tumor in a conjoined twin.

pmid-9404920.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍150例に対する高用量CEI療法後の急性腎毒性を解析した。29%に急性腎毒性が生じ、8%が血液透析を要したが、多くは退院までに離脱できた。腎毒性は造血回復を遅らせなかったものの、輸血量と入院期間を増加させた。奏効率と生存率に差はなく、多くは可逆的であった。
pmid-9404920.summary_en: This study analyzed 150 consecutive germ cell tumor patients treated with high-dose carboplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide followed by stem cell rescue. Acute nephrotoxicity occurred in 29%, and 8% required hemodialysis, though most were weaned before discharge. After adjustment, nephrotoxicity did not delay hematologic recovery, but it increased transfusion needs and hospital stay. Response rates and survival were similar with or without nephrotoxicity, and the toxicity was generally reversible.

pmid-9408759.summary_ja: セミノーマ16例を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で解析した。約94%に特徴的な染色体の欠失と増加が認められた。染色体異常は臨床病期とは相関しなかった。病期II例や再発例のみに出現する稀な異常があり、腫瘍の進行や浸潤性、両側性疾患との関連が示唆された。本研究は胚細胞腫瘍の発生機序の解明に寄与する。
pmid-9408759.summary_en: Comparative genomic hybridization was applied to 16 seminomas to characterize chromosomal alterations in male germ cell tumors. About 94% of tumors showed a characteristic pattern of losses and gains, with frequent changes on chromosomes 4, 5, 11, 13q, 18q, and recurrent aberrations at 12p and 21q. The aberrations did not correlate with clinical stage. Rare changes appeared only in stage II and relapsed tumors, suggesting a link to progression, invasiveness, and possibly bilateral disease.

pmid-9408879.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎と正常胎児が併存した双胎と三つ子の2症例を報告した。双胎は健康な単胎児を正期産で出産した。一方、三つ子は17週で中絶され、その後絨毛癌が発生した。著者らは、完全胞状奇胎には良性の経過をたどり保存的に管理できるものがある一方、侵襲的な経過をたどるものもあるとし、より大規模な症例集積の必要性を指摘した。
pmid-9408879.summary_en: Two cases of complete hydatidiform mole coexisting with normal fetuses are reported: a twin and a triplet pregnancy conceived with clomiphene citrate. The twin pregnancy delivered a healthy singleton at term, whereas the triplet pregnancy was terminated at 17 weeks and subsequently developed choriocarcinoma. The authors suggest that some complete moles follow a benign course and can be managed conservatively, while others are aggressive, and that larger case series are needed.

pmid-9412977.summary_ja: 胃原発の絨毛癌に肝転移を伴った稀な症例の報告です。組織像は腺癌、未分化癌、絨毛癌が混在していました。β-hCG免疫染色では腫瘍細胞と正常粘膜腺の両方が陽性を示し、血清hCG値は有意に上昇していました。腺癌の脱分化または粘膜腺からの直接発生が考えられています。文献的考察も含まれます。
pmid-9412977.summary_en: The authors report a rare primary gastric choriocarcinoma with mixed histology, including adenocarcinoma, undifferentiated carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma, and liver metastasis. Immunohistochemistry for the beta subunit of hCG was positive in the choriocarcinoma, the adenocarcinoma, and normal mucosal glands, with varying intensity. Serum hCG was significantly elevated. The authors suggest the tumor arose either from dedifferentiation of a primary adenocarcinoma or directly from mucosal glands. The report includes a literature review of such unusual tumors.

pmid-9413462.summary_ja: 英国およびウェールズの癌登録データを用いた双生児研究です。二卵性双生児は一卵性双生児より精巣がんのリスクが有意に高く、その主な要因はセミノーマでした。精巣がんの男性の一卵性双生児では相対リスクが顕著に上昇していました。結果は、出生前の母体エストロゲン曝露と遺伝的要因の関与を示唆します。
pmid-9413462.summary_en: This England and Wales registry-based twin study examined breast and testicular cancer risk in young adults. Dizygotic twins had a significantly higher risk of testicular cancer than monozygotic twins, driven mainly by seminomas. Monozygotic twins of men with testicular cancer showed a markedly elevated relative risk. The findings support a prenatal aetiology, possibly related to raised maternal unbound oestrogen, together with a genetic component. The authors discuss implications for clinical management of monozygotic co-twins of affected probands.

pmid-9413767.summary_ja: 前思春期の小児に生じた精巣の類表皮嚢胞を、精巣を温存して摘出した症例報告です。小児の精巣腫瘍は通常良性であり、類表皮嚢胞に含まれる奇形腫成分も前思春期では一般に良性とされています。このため、小児の類表皮嚢胞には精巣温存手術が適切と考察されています。稀な小児精巣病変における外科的判断に焦点を当てています。
pmid-9413767.summary_en: This case report describes a prepubertal child with an epidermoid cyst of the testis, excised with testicular preservation. The authors note that childhood testicular tumours are usually benign, and that epidermoid cysts may contain a teratomatous component, which is generally benign in prepubertal children. They conclude that testis-sparing surgery may be appropriate for childhood epidermoid cysts. The brief report focuses on surgical decision-making for a rare paediatric testicular lesion.

pmid-9419968.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞に各種ヒト染色体を導入するマイクロセル融合法で、腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在部位を検討しました。7番染色体の導入で腫瘍形成能が抑制され、ほかの染色体では影響がありませんでした。腫瘍形成能を回復した株では7番染色体が減少していました。7p12-7q11.23領域が絨毛癌組織や細胞株で高頻度に欠失しており、この領域に腫瘍抑制遺伝子があると示唆されています。
pmid-9419968.summary_en: The authors used microcell-mediated chromosome transfer into choriocarcinoma cells to map a tumour suppressor gene. Introducing human chromosome 7 suppressed tumorigenicity, while chromosomes 1, 2, 6, 9, and 11 had no effect. Tumorigenic revertants had lost chromosome 7 material. Deletion analysis defined a critical region at 7p12-7q11.23 that is frequently lost in choriocarcinoma tissues and cell lines, suggesting a tumour suppressor gene within this region, outside the ERV3 and H-plk loci.

pmid-9420627.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株577LMにおけるMHCクラスI抗原提示機構を解析した研究です。対照のリンパ芽球様細胞と比べ、LMP-7、TAP-1、HLAクラスI等の発現が低下していました。低温や外因性ペプチドでは表面発現は回復しませんでした。IFN-γ処理により、TAPやLMP、MHCクラスIの発現と表面発現が増加しました。胎児性癌細胞はMHCクラスI低発現の表現型を安定して示し、IFN-γで修飾可能と考えられます。
pmid-9420627.summary_en: The authors studied MHC class I antigen presentation in the human embryonal carcinoma cell line 577LM. Compared with control lymphoblastoid cells, these cells showed poor constitutive expression of LMP-7, TAP-1, HLA class I, and beta-2-microglobulin, but not of TAP-2 or LMP-2. Surface MHC class I could not be restored by low temperature or exogenous peptides. IFN-gamma treatment increased surface MHC class I along with TAP, LMP, and MHC class I transcripts. The findings suggest a stable MHC class I-low phenotype in embryonal carcinoma cells that can be modified by IFN-gamma.

pmid-9424001.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマ患者23例を対象に、術後腹部放射線療法中の制吐薬を比較した無作為化試験です。トロピセトロン群は、メトクロプラミド群より悪心が有意に少ないことが示されました。嘔吐は全体の30%に生じ、両薬剤とも忍容性は良好でした。ただし、コストを考慮すると第一選択の制吐薬とするには課題があると結論されています。
pmid-9424001.summary_en: This randomised open trial compared prophylactic tropisetron 5 mg with metoclopramide 30 mg in 23 patients with stage I seminoma receiving adjuvant abdominal radiotherapy of 30 Gy. Nausea was significantly lower with tropisetron (median 0.14 vs 1.32; P=0.03). Vomiting occurred in 30% of patients, with fewer emetic events in the tropisetron group, though this difference was not statistically significant. Both drugs were well tolerated. The authors conclude that tropisetron reduced nausea, but its cost may limit its use as a first-line antiemetic.

pmid-9426730.summary_ja: 初回化学療法後も腫瘍マーカーが上昇した転移性精巣がん23例を検討しました。奇形腫のみ、または壊死のみであった9例は無病生存を続けました。切除標本にがんが残った6例の予後は不良でした。選択された患者では、救援化学療法を避けて手術のみで治癒が得られる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-9426730.summary_en: This study reviews 23 patients with metastatic testicular cancer and elevated tumor markers after cisplatin-based induction chemotherapy who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection instead of salvage chemotherapy. Seven had teratoma only and two had necrosis only; nine of these remained disease-free. Among six with cancer in the resected specimen, outcomes were poorer, though some were cured. The authors conclude that selected patients may avoid salvage chemotherapy with surgery alone.

pmid-9427433.summary_ja: デンマークの症例対照研究で、精巣がんと停留精巣に共通する出生前の危険因子を検討しました。母親の年齢30歳超は停留精巣とセミノーマのリスク上昇と関連しました。出生体重の異常も精巣がんのリスクを高めました。停留精巣と精巣がんの関連は、母親の年齢と出生体重で調整した後も残りました。
pmid-9427433.summary_en: This Danish case-control study examined prenatal and birth factors shared by testicular cancer and cryptorchidism. Maternal age over 30 was associated with cryptorchidism and seminoma, with the strongest effect when the boy was the first child. Birthweights below 3,000 g or above 4,000 g increased testicular cancer risk. The association between cryptorchidism and testicular cancer persisted after adjustment for maternal age and birthweight. The authors conclude that seminoma and non-seminoma likely share similar causes.

pmid-9427780.summary_ja: 病期Iおよび病期IIの精巣セミノーマ94例に対する精巣摘除後放射線療法の長期成績を後方視的に検討しました。10年疾患特異的生存率は91.7〜100%でした。胃潰瘍が16%に生じましたが、多くは軽症でした。第二がんは9.5%に発生し、中央値13年後でした。子どもを希望した患者の79%が父親になりました。
pmid-9427780.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 94 patients with stage I and II testicular seminoma treated with postorchiectomy radiation therapy. Ten-year cause-specific survival was 91.7 to 100%, and disease-free survival was 83.3 to 98.5%. Peptic ulcer developed in 16% of patients, mostly mild. Second malignancies occurred in 9.5% after a median of 13 years, not significantly above expected rates. Of patients wishing to have children, 79% fathered them, and no fatal complications were observed.

pmid-9427793.summary_ja: 精巣の正常組織と精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるFasとFasリガンドの発現を免疫組織化学的に調べた研究です。セミノーマ23例、胎児性癌8例、卵黄嚢腫瘍3例のすべてで両者が発現していました。正常精巣でも間質細胞、セルトリ細胞、胚細胞で発現が確認されました。細胞死シグナル以外の役割が示唆されています。
pmid-9427793.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined Fas and Fas ligand expression in normal human testis and testicular germ cell tumors. Both proteins were detected in Leydig, Sertoli and germ cells, and in epididymal epithelium. All 23 seminomas, 8 embryonal carcinomas and 3 yolk sac tumors also expressed both. Western blotting showed a single major band near 47.5 kDa. The authors conclude that the Fas-Fas ligand system in these cells likely has functions beyond signaling apoptosis.

pmid-9428443.summary_ja: 1968〜1993年に北イスラエルの施設で放射線療法を受けた病期Iの精巣セミノーマ81例を後方視的に解析しました。5例(6%)が再発し、いずれも初回照射野の外で、中央値6.6か月でした。3例はシスプラチン併用化学療法による救援化学療法で救済されました。照射野外での再発が多く、適切な照射では早期再発はまれであると結論されています。
pmid-9428443.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 81 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy at a northern Israeli center between 1968 and 1993. Five patients (6%) relapsed, all outside the initial treatment volume, at a median of 6.6 months. Three were salvaged with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The authors conclude that adjuvant radiotherapy gave high cure rates and reduced relapse, that early relapse is rare, and that recurrences tend to occur outside the irradiated field.

pmid-9435729.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫9例について、超音波検査、ドプラ法、MRIを出生後および手術所見と比較した研究です。骨盤内の成分は超音波では描出できず、MRIで描出できました。充実成分の多い大きな腫瘍は未熟型や悪性型が多い傾向でしたが、出生前に成熟型と未熟型を確実に区別することはできませんでした。
pmid-9435729.summary_en: This study compared ultrasonography, Doppler and MRI in nine fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas with postnatal and operative findings. Ultrasound missed intrapelvic components that MRI detected. Doppler resistance indices were similar across histologic types. Large tumors with solid components were often immature or malignant, but antenatal MRI could not reliably distinguish mature from immature histology. The authors conclude that antenatal MRI is useful for evaluating fetal SCT.

pmid-9436024.summary_ja: 右精巣腫大を呈した39歳男性の両側同時性精巣セミノーマの症例報告である。超音波検査とMRIで両側に腫瘍を認め、両側高位鼠径精巣摘除術と予防的な傍大動脈・骨盤領域への放射線療法が施行された。5か月以上のフォローアップ中、転移は認めなかった。著者らは、本邦で報告された両側精巣腫瘍186例を併せてレビューした。
pmid-9436024.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with bilateral synchronous testicular seminomas diagnosed by ultrasonography and MRI. He underwent bilateral high inguinal orchiectomy and prophylactic para-aortic and pelvic radiotherapy, with no metastasis during more than five months of follow-up. The authors also reviewed 186 cases of bilateral testicular tumors reported in Japan. Bilateral synchronous involvement is rare, so the paper provides a useful regional literature summary.

pmid-9436034.summary_ja: 肺転移巣から樹立された精巣癌細胞株KU-MTに対するレチノイン酸(ATRA)の作用を検討した研究です。ATRAはαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の産生を増加させ、増殖を抑制し、G1期での細胞周期停止と一部でアポトーシスを誘導しました。RAR-α特異的作動薬は内胚葉分化マーカーであるラミニンの産生を誘導しました。レチノイドはRAR-αを介して精巣腫瘍の分化を調節すると結論づけています。
pmid-9436034.summary_en: This study examined all-trans-retinoic acid (ATRA) effects on KU-MT cells, a testicular carcinoma line established from a lung metastasis that continuously secretes AFP. ATRA increased AFP levels, inhibited growth, arrested the cell cycle in G1, and induced some apoptosis in a wild-type p53 context. RAR-alpha-specific agonists induced laminin, an endodermal differentiation marker, whereas arotinoid did not. The authors conclude that retinoids act through RAR-alpha to regulate testicular tumor differentiation.

pmid-9437811.summary_ja: ENNGを子宮内投与された49週齢の未経産Donryuラットに生じた子宮絨毛癌の報告です。腫瘍は小型の細胞性栄養膜細胞様細胞と巨大栄養膜細胞様細胞から成り、後者は3β-HSDが陽性でした。β-hCGなどの免疫染色は陰性または非特異的でした。それでも絨毛癌としての性質を持ち、弱い乳腺刺激ホルモン様作用を示すホルモンを分泌すると結論づけています。
pmid-9437811.summary_en: This report describes a uterine choriocarcinoma that developed in a virgin Donryu rat after intrauterine ENNG administration. The tumor consisted of cytotrophoblast-like small cells and giant trophoblast-like cells, and the giant cells were positive for 3-beta-HSD. Immunostaining for beta-hCG, hPL, SP-1 and placental alkaline phosphatase was negative or nonspecific. The authors nevertheless concluded that the tumor has choriocarcinoma features and secretes a weakly mammotrophic hormone.

pmid-9438217.summary_ja: 妊娠17週の23歳女性で、母体血清AFPスクリーニングが中央値の3.88倍(MOM)と上昇した症例報告です。13歳時から卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の治療歴があります。妊娠中のAFPは通常のプラトーや低下を示さず上昇を続け、分娩時の手術でAFP産生腫瘍の再発が確認されました。原因不明の母体AFP上昇は再発の徴候となりうると示唆しています。
pmid-9438217.summary_en: This report describes a 23-year-old woman at 17 weeks' gestation whose maternal serum AFP screen was 3.88 MoM. She had been treated for primary and recurrent mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary since age 13, and her serum AFP had been negative afterward. Monthly AFP rose through pregnancy without the usual plateau, and surgery at delivery confirmed a recurrent AFP-secreting tumor. The authors suggest that unexplained rising maternal AFP in pregnancy may signal recurrence.

pmid-9443010.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の1症例について、経膣カラードプラ・パルスドプラ超音波検査の所見を報告した症例報告です。化学療法後にβ-hCGが陰性となった時点でも、子宮血流の増加と低拡張期血流が持続していました。経時的な経膣カラードプラ超音波検査は化学療法のモニタリングや残存腫瘍の検出に有用で、PSTTの診断精度向上に役立つと結論づけています。
pmid-9443010.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with placental site trophoblastic tumor evaluated by transvaginal color and pulsed Doppler sonography. Serial imaging showed marked uterine vascularity with low-resistance diastolic flow that persisted after chemotherapy, even though beta-hCG had become negative. The authors conclude that serial transvaginal color Doppler sonography is valuable for monitoring chemotherapy and detecting residual tumor, and may improve the accuracy of PSTT diagnosis.

pmid-9443030.summary_ja: 1970〜1991年にクラクフ腫瘍センターで治療された純粋未熟卵巣奇形腫22例の後方視的検討です。病期Iが大半で、14例が術後化学療法を受けました。5年無病生存率は全体で81.8%、病期Iで93.8%、病期II・IIIで50%でした。グレード1は全例治癒しましたが、グレード3の2例は死亡しています。
pmid-9443030.summary_en: This retrospective series from the Center of Oncology in Krakow reviewed 22 women treated for pure immature ovarian teratoma between 1970 and 1991. Most patients had stage I disease, and 14 received postoperative chemotherapy. Five-year NED survival was 81.8% overall, 93.8% for stage I, and 50% for stages II and III. All grade 1 patients were cured, but two grade 3 patients died. All six stage Ia patients treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy were cured.

pmid-9443566.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、胎盤部結節）の組織学的特徴を総説する。病期分類は持続例にのみ適用すべきとし、FIGO、NIH、WHOスコア、TNMの各分類を比較している。いずれの分類も高リスク患者の同定が可能であると述べる。
pmid-9443566.summary_en: This review classifies gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), covering complete and partial hydatidiform moles, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and placental site nodule. It describes their histologic features and notes that persistent disease after moles is rare. Staging should be applied only to persistent cases. The review compares the FIGO, NIH, WHO scoring, and TNM staging systems, all of which can identify high-risk patients.

pmid-9443568.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の遺伝学的背景を概説する。胞状奇胎では父親由来DNAの過剰の程度が組織像の差を生む。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍や絨毛癌は正常妊娠、流産、胞状奇胎後に生じ、起源妊娠を反映した遺伝的組成を示す。分子生物学的手法により起源判定が可能になったと述べる。
pmid-9443568.summary_en: This review examines the genetic basis of gestational trophoblastic diseases. Complete and partial hydatidiform moles show varying degrees of excess paternal DNA, which shapes their histopathologic forms. Placental site trophoblastic tumors and choriocarcinomas can arise after normal pregnancy, abortion, or molar pregnancy, so their genetic composition reflects the gestation of origin. Molecular methods now allow determination of gestational versus non-gestational origin.

pmid-9443570.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌を、本来侵襲性を持つ絨毛細胞の悪性転化として論じる。正常の絨毛は着床時に制御された浸潤を示すが、絨毛癌では制限なく増殖し転移する。腫瘍は父親由来の異種DNAを含むという特異性があり、移植免疫や遺伝学の理解が必要だと述べる。
pmid-9443570.summary_en: This review discusses gestational choriocarcinoma as a malignant transformation of trophoblast. Trophoblasts normally show controlled invasion during implantation and are shed into maternal circulation, but in choriocarcinoma they grow without limit and metastasize. The tumor uniquely contains paternal, foreign DNA. Studying it requires understanding graft rejection, immunology, genetics, and the mechanisms of invasion and metastasis.

pmid-9443571.summary_ja: 胎盤部の絨毛外（中間型）トロホブラストに由来する病変を総説する。過剰胎盤部、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、胎盤部結節を対象に、臨床・病理学的特徴、鑑別診断、治療、予後因子を扱う。中間型トロホブラストの起源と定義についても論じている。
pmid-9443571.summary_en: This review covers trophoblastic lesions of the placental site, which arise from extravillous intermediate trophoblast. It addresses the exaggerated placental site, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and placental site nodule. Clinical and pathologic features, differential diagnosis, treatment, and prognostic factors are discussed, after an account of the origin and definition of intermediate trophoblast.

pmid-9443572.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療を概説する。境界悪性の胞状奇胎から高度侵襲性の絨毛癌まで幅広い病態を含む。過去45年間に開発された化学療法レジメンは、個々のリスクに応じて調整できる。統合的管理により、現在では死亡例はわずかであると述べる。
pmid-9443572.summary_en: This review describes management of gestational trophoblastic disease, which spans from borderline-malignant hydatidiform mole to highly aggressive choriocarcinoma. Historically many women died, but chemotherapy regimens developed over the past 45 years can be tailored to each patient's risk of resistance. The author argues that integrated management has made GTD a success story in oncology, with few deaths today.

pmid-9443573.summary_ja: 158例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の臨床病理学的特徴を報告する。内訳は完全胞状奇胎110例、侵入奇胎13例、絨毛癌32例などである。搔爬後に約64％が自然退縮し、36％が持続性または転移性となった。完全寛解率は約91％で、血清hCGの連続測定と専門施設での治療を推奨する。
pmid-9443573.summary_en: This report describes 158 cases of gestational trophoblastic disease, including 110 complete moles, 13 invasive moles, 32 choriocarcinomas, and placental site lesions. About 64 percent regressed spontaneously after curettage, while 36 percent became persistent or metastatic, most often to the lung. Complete remission was about 91 percent. Serial serum hCG monitoring is recommended, and persistent disease should be treated at specialized centers.

pmid-9443575.summary_ja: 27例の完全胞状奇胎と9例の持続例を対象に、c-erbB-2の増幅と発現を後方視的研究として検討した。増幅・発現とDNA過倍数性を併せ持つ例は増殖が高く、転移を伴うなど侵襲性が強かった。XY核型は絨毛癌と進行例の胞状奇胎2例で認められた。
pmid-9443575.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated c-erbB-2 oncogene amplification and expression in 27 complete hydatidiform moles and 9 persistent gestational trophoblastic disease cases. Tumors with c-erbB-2 amplification and expression combined with DNA hyperploidy showed higher proliferation and more aggressive behavior, including metastases. An XY karyotype was found in a choriocarcinoma and in two advanced moles with hyperploidy.

pmid-9443576.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌が子宮頸部扁平上皮癌と誤診された2症例を報告する。1例は産後の絨毛癌で、メトトレキサート療法にもかかわらず肺転移により死亡した。もう1例は多剤併用化学療法により完全寛解に至った。非典型的な頸部搔爬標本では絨毛癌を疑い、hCGの免疫組織化学が有用だと述べる。
pmid-9443576.summary_en: This case report describes two women with gestational choriocarcinoma initially misdiagnosed as cervical squamous cell carcinoma. One died after postpartum choriocarcinoma with diffuse pulmonary metastases despite methotrexate. The other achieved complete remission after radical hysterectomy and multiagent chemotherapy. The authors advise considering choriocarcinoma for atypical cervical curettage specimens and note that hCG immunohistochemistry is helpful.

pmid-9449027.summary_ja: 正常妊娠、糖尿病妊娠、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌から精製したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のα・βサブユニットの糖鎖とペプチド構造を比較した研究。悪性疾患では高分岐型糖型が増加し、βサブユニットの変化は正常妊娠から胞状奇胎、絨毛癌へと段階的に増加した。腫瘍マーカーとしてのhCGの理解に関連する知見である。
pmid-9449027.summary_en: This study compared the carbohydrate and peptide structures of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) purified from normal pregnancy, diabetic pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma. Hyperglycosylated and hyperbranched glycoforms of both alpha and beta subunits increased in malignant disease, and beta-subunit oligosaccharide changes rose stepwise from normal pregnancy to hydatidiform mole to choriocarcinoma. Peptide-bond nicking also increased with malignancy. The authors suggest these subunit-specific glycosylation patterns reflect local protein structure effects on Golgi processing enzymes, and may be relevant to hCG as a tumour marker.

pmid-9451341.summary_ja: オーストラリアGeelong地域の15年間で、胚細胞腫瘍61例を後方視的に検討した研究。発生率は男性10万人あたり年間約4例、がん特異的生存率は95%であった。セミノーマは30%を占め、非セミノーマより進行期で受診する傾向があった。三次施設外でも良好な予後で管理可能と結論づけている。
pmid-9451341.summary_en: This 15-year retrospective review from the Geelong region of Victoria, Australia, identified 61 patients with germ cell neoplasm. The incidence was about four cases per 100,000 men per year, with cancer-specific survival of 95%. Seminoma accounted for 30% of cases, and seminoma patients presented at later stages than those with non-seminoma. The authors conclude that the increasing incidence has an excellent prognosis and can be managed outside a tertiary referral centre.

pmid-9455863.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍または対側精巣の上皮内癌(CIS)を有する男性14例を対象に、抗がん治療前の精液所見、血清ホルモン値、精巣容積を検討した。10例は正常または低下した精子濃度を示し、4例は無精子症であった。血清FSHは精子濃度と負の相関を示した。精巣がんでも妊孕性が保たれうるため、精子凍結保存を含む生殖医学的評価を提供すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-9455863.summary_en: This study assessed fertility in 14 men with bilateral testicular tumour, unilateral tumour with contralateral carcinoma in situ, or a tumour in a single testis, before further anticancer treatment. Ten of 14 had normal or reduced sperm concentrations, and four were azoospermic. Serum FSH correlated negatively with sperm concentration, and testicular volume correlated positively with semen parameters in CIS-affected testes. The authors conclude that testicular cancer does not necessarily preclude fertility, so andrological evaluation and sperm cryopreservation should be offered before treatment.

pmid-9455864.summary_ja: セミノーマで精巣摘除と放射線療法を受ける前に精子凍結保存を希望した夫婦で、夫は受診時に無精子症であった。摘除したセミノーマ精巣から精子を採取し、顕微授精(ICSI)に用いた。凍結融解胚移植により臨床的妊娠に至り、出産に至った。閉塞性無精子症の新たな原因であり、ICSIで治療に成功したと報告している。
pmid-9455864.summary_en: In a couple seeking sperm cryopreservation before orchidectomy and radiotherapy for seminoma, the husband was found to be azoospermic. Sperm was retrieved from the removed seminoma-bearing testis and used for intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI). Frozen-thawed embryos were transferred, resulting in a clinical pregnancy and a live birth. The authors describe this as a new aetiology of obstructive azoospermia successfully treated with ICSI.

pmid-9458520.summary_ja: 腹痛を訴えた23歳男性の馬蹄腎に生じた腫瘍の症例報告。腫瘍内の骨組織を腎杯結石と誤認し、体外衝撃波砕石術と経皮的砕石術を試みたが奏効しなかった。奇形腫内に発生した原発性カルチノイドであった。馬蹄腎など先天性腎発生異常を有する例で多いと指摘している。
pmid-9458520.summary_en: A 23-year-old man presented with abdominal pain, and a renal tumour was found in a horseshoe kidney. Bone within the mass was initially mistaken for a calyceal stone, leading to unsuccessful shock-wave and percutaneous lithotripsy. The tumour was a primary carcinoid arising within a teratoma. The authors note that this unusual tumour is over-represented in patients with horseshoe kidney and other congenital renal developmental defects.

pmid-9465624.summary_ja: 胸部X線異常を指摘された25歳男性。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で前縦隔の嚢胞性病変を認め、嚢胞性奇形腫が疑われた。開胸手術で右葉胸腺とともに摘出され、病理学的に嚢胞変性を伴うセミノーマと診断された。術後に20Gyの放射線療法を施行し、術後33か月で明らかな再発は認めていない。縦隔セミノーマが極端な嚢胞変性を来しうると述べている。
pmid-9465624.summary_en: A 25-year-old man had an abnormal shadow on chest radiography. CT and MRI showed a cystic anterior mediastinal lesion with irregular nodules, initially suspected to be a cystic teratoma. Surgery through an antero-axillary thoracotomy removed the lesion along with the right thymic lobe. Pathology revealed seminoma with extensive cystic degeneration. Postoperative irradiation of 20 Gy was given, and no apparent recurrence was seen 33 months after surgery. The authors suggest mediastinal seminomas may undergo marked cystic degeneration, unlike the usual solid pattern.

pmid-9473736.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性がん患者の腫瘍浸潤リンパ球から、HLA-A2拘束性かつ腫瘍特異的な細胞傷害性T細胞株を樹立した報告です。自己腫瘍細胞やHLA-A2陽性の癌細胞株を傷害しましたが、HLA-A2陰性の標的は傷害しませんでした。腫瘍局所に特異的なT細胞が存在することが示唆され、T細胞を用いた免疫療法への応用が期待されます。
pmid-9473736.summary_en: This study established an HLA-A2-restricted, tumor-specific CD8-positive cytotoxic T lymphocyte line from interleukin-2-activated tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes of a patient with testicular embryonal cancer. The CTL lysed autologous tumor cells and HLA-A2-positive adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma lines, but not HLA-A2-negative targets. The findings suggest that tumor-specific cytotoxic T cells exist at the tumor site of testicular embryonal cancer, supporting the potential of T cell-based immunotherapy.

pmid-9474880.summary_ja: 正常の栄養膜細胞の分化経路と、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の各病変がどの分化段階の異常に対応するかを解説した総説です。新たな栄養膜マーカー、特にホルマリン固定後も抗原性を保つ抗体の、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の研究と鑑別診断における有用性を論じています。病理診断の実務への応用も示されています。
pmid-9474880.summary_en: This review describes normal trophoblast differentiation, including the pathways to villous syncytiotrophoblast and extravillous intermediate trophoblast, and how gestational trophoblastic lesions correspond to specific differentiation stages. It highlights newer trophoblastic markers, especially antibodies that recognize formalin-resistant epitopes, and their value in the study and differential diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-9486052.summary_ja: 左肺動脈に原発した絨毛癌の1例の症例報告です。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で肺塞栓症が疑われましたが、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)により肺動脈閉塞が腫瘍性であることが確認されました。肺動脈原発腫瘍は稀で塞栓症と誤診されやすく、手術や根治的化学療法の機会を逃す恐れがあると警告しています。
