pmid-8933826.summary_ja: 卵巣の再発性悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の女性患者に対し、ビンクリスチン、カルボプラチン、フルオロウラシル、イホスファミドによる救済療法を行い、寛解を得た症例報告である。卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍の再発時救済療法の報告は少ない。標準的な救済療法は精巣腫瘍の経験に基づくものであり、患者は6年間寛解を維持している。
pmid-8933826.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with recurrent malignant mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary who achieved remission after salvage therapy with vincristine, carboplatin, fluorouracil and ifosfamide. The authors note that mixed germ cell tumors make up about 8 percent of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors and that salvage data are limited. The standard salvage regimen, derived from testicular cancer studies, is etoposide, vinblastine, ifosfamide and cisplatin. This combination had not previously been reported for this setting, and the patient remained in remission for six years.

pmid-8933827.summary_ja: 卵巣の明細胞癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍は組織学的に類似するが、生物学的挙動は異なる。本研究は両者の細胞学的特徴を比較し、鑑別指標を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は細胞の結合性が低く、多形性や多核巨細胞が目立つ。詳細な細胞診は、臨床情報を補完する鑑別診断の手段になると結論づけている。
pmid-8933827.summary_en: This cytology study compared clear cell carcinoma and yolk sac tumor of the ovary, two histologically similar but biologically distinct tumors. Imprint smears and ascites or metastatic-site samples from 20 clear cell carcinomas and 3 yolk sac tumors were examined. Clear cell carcinoma cells were more cohesive, less pleomorphic and had well-preserved borders, while yolk sac tumor cells were dyscohesive, markedly pleomorphic and often showed nucleoli and multinucleated giant cells. The authors propose detailed cytology as a useful aid for differential diagnosis.

pmid-8934051.summary_ja: 病理学的に確定された精母細胞性セミノーマの10例を後方視的に検討した研究である。全例が病期Iで、5例は放射線療法、5例はサーベイランスを受けた。追跡期間中央値8年で再発例はなかった。予後は良好であり、この亜群では放射線療法を省略できる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8934051.summary_en: This review describes ten patients with pathologically confirmed spermatocytic seminoma of the testis, all presenting at stage I. Five received radiotherapy and five were managed with surveillance. Median age was 56.5 years and median follow-up was eight years, with no relapses and two deaths from intercurrent disease. The authors conclude that spermatocytic seminoma has a good prognosis and low metastatic potential, and that radiotherapy may be safely omitted in this subgroup since only one relapse has been reported in the literature.

pmid-8934053.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍で上昇したAFPを、コンカナバリンAへの結合性によって奇形腫由来と肝由来に区別できるかを論じた報告である。精巣腫瘍の再発例では、この検査の高い特異度を過信したため再発診断が遅れ、患者は死亡した。レクチン結合検査の臨床的有用性は未確立であり、さらなる検証が必要である。
pmid-8934053.summary_en: This clinical discussion examines whether AFP heterogeneity, assessed by concanavalin A lectin binding, can distinguish teratoma-derived from liver-derived AFP elevation in germ cell tumor patients. The authors present a patient with relapsed testicular germ cell tumor whose management decisions relied on ConA binding results. Overreliance on the presumed high specificity of the test delayed diagnosis of recurrence, and the patient died. They conclude that the clinical utility of lectin binding assays remains uncertain and needs further evaluation.

pmid-8934401.summary_ja: 腹腔鏡下に摘出された卵巣腫瘤の後、腹部トロカール部位に局所的な腫瘍播種が生じた症例報告である。病理学的には成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌であった。悪性卵巣腫瘍の腹腔鏡下切除では、ポート部位への播種の危険性に留意すべきことを指摘し、文献的な検討も併せて行っている。
pmid-8934401.summary_en: This case report describes a localized tumor implant at an abdominal trocar site after laparoscopic removal of an ovarian mass. Histology showed squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. The authors highlight the risk of tumor seeding at port sites when malignant ovarian tumors are excised laparoscopically, and briefly review the literature on this complication. Surgeons should consider this possibility when managing malignant ovarian masses with pelviscopic techniques.

pmid-8935344.summary_ja: 2歳男児に、腰仙部の先天性皮膚病変として脂肪腫、毛細血管拡張、多毛、皮内の類皮嚢腫が併存した症例を報告。潜在性二分脊椎と椎体の裂隙を伴い、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で脂肪腫は硬膜と連続せず、外科的治療を要する脊髄病変は認めなかった。類皮嚢腫の皮内局在は異例であり、脊髄係留症候群との関連を考察している。
pmid-8935344.summary_en: Describes a 2-year-old boy with congenital lumbosacral skin lesions combining lipoma, telangiectasia, hypertrichosis and an intradermal dermoid cyst, with occult spina bifida and a vertebral cleft. MRI showed the lipoma extending into the spina bifida region without dural connection and no other spinal lesion requiring surgery. The authors note the unusual intradermal location of the dermoid and discuss lumbosacral dermoid cysts associated with spinal dysraphism.

pmid-8935748.summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併し播種性精巣セミノーマを発症した患者を報告。先天性停留精巣により精巣がんのリスクが高い。シスプラチンを含むレジメンは毒性があり入院を要することが多いが、本症例は併用化学療法を外来で完遂し成功した。外来治療の実現可能性を示した点に意義がある。
pmid-8935748.summary_en: Reports a patient with Down syndrome and disseminated testicular seminoma successfully treated with combination chemotherapy on an outpatient basis. The authors note that undescended testes raise the risk of testicular cancer in Down syndrome. Cisplatin-containing regimens are effective but toxic and usually require hospitalization, so outpatient delivery of this treatment is a notable finding.

pmid-8936997.summary_ja: 小児の原発性縦隔腫瘍20例の外科治療成績を報告。悪性10例中3例が胚細胞腫瘍で、未熟奇形腫の1例を除き術後化学療法と放射線療法の後に生存。良性腫瘍は全例完全切除された。気管支原性嚢胞の乳児2例も呼吸窮迫に対する緊急手術で救命された。
pmid-8936997.summary_en: Reports surgical outcomes in 20 children with primary mediastinal tumors, half benign and half malignant. Among malignant cases, seven were neurogenic and three were germ cell tumors. Benign tumors were completely resected, and most malignant patients survived after postoperative chemotherapy and radiotherapy, except one with immature teratoma. Two infants with bronchogenic cysts underwent emergency surgery for respiratory distress and survived.

pmid-8944752.summary_ja: 小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍（胎児性癌）の染色体解析。従来法と蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーションを用い、2本の12p等染色体（i(12)(p10)）と母性由来の1p36欠失を一貫して確認した。小児精巣胎児性癌におけるi(12)(p10)の初報告であり、小児胚細胞腫瘍の遺伝学的異常の理解に寄与する。
pmid-8944752.summary_en: This cytogenetic study of a pediatric testicular germ cell tumor with embryonal carcinoma histology combined conventional karyotyping and fluorescence in situ hybridization. It consistently identified two isochromosomes 12p, i(12)(p10), along with loss of the maternal 1p36 band and other numerical and structural changes, mostly from paracentromeric breaks. The authors report the first description of i(12)(p10) in a pediatric testicular embryonal carcinoma, which may aid understanding of genetic alterations in pediatric germ cell tumors.

pmid-8944842.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫が両側の下顎骨頭に転移した症例の報告。全身性悪性腫瘍の既往がある患者に原因不明の顎関節部痛がみられた場合は、局所転移を鑑別に挙げるべきだと提言している。臨床所見と画像所見の特徴を示し、まれな転移様式を報告する。
pmid-8944842.summary_en: A patient with a known systemic malignancy presented with unexplained pain in both temporomandibular joints. Imaging revealed bilateral metastatic spread of a testicular teratoma to the mandibular condyles. The authors suggest that local metastatic deposits should be considered as a cause of unexplained temporomandibular pain in patients with prior systemic malignancy, and they describe the clinical and radiological features of this rare presentation.

pmid-8946542.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌）の画像診断をまとめた総説。初期診断には超音波検査が適し、胞状奇胎は嚢胞性と充実性組織の混在として描出される。CTとMRIは筋層浸潤や転移の検出に有用であり、病態の理解が精査・治療方針の判断に役立つと述べている。
pmid-8946542.summary_en: This review describes the radiologic spectrum of gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma. Ultrasonography is the preferred initial examination, showing molar gestations as alternating cystic and solid tissue filling the uterus. CT and MR imaging are useful for detecting myometrial invasion, parametrial extension, and metastases. The authors emphasize that understanding the pathophysiology and natural history of each modality helps radiologists guide workup and management decisions.

pmid-8946871.summary_ja: 1958〜1992年にUCLAで治療された純粋卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ25例の後方視的解析。保存的手術と非保存的手術の間で再発率に有意差はなく、再発は補助療法を受けなかった例に多かった。全生存期間や病期との関係も検討され、妊孕性を希望する患者には保存的手術を推奨している。
pmid-8946871.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 25 pure ovarian dysgerminomas treated at UCLA from 1958 to 1992 examined recurrence and overall survival by type of primary surgery, adjuvant therapy, and stage. Fourteen patients underwent conservative surgery preserving the contralateral ovary. Recurrence rates did not differ significantly between conservative and nonconservative surgery, and most recurrences occurred in patients who received no adjuvant chemotherapy or radiotherapy. The authors recommend conservative surgery for patients desiring fertility.

pmid-8946873.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌26例の治療成績。病期Iは手術のみで管理され、進行例は減量手術後にシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた。最適な減量と低い病期が無病生存の良好な予後因子であった。SCC抗原の連続測定は再発の早期発見に有用とされる。
pmid-8946873.summary_en: This series analyzed 26 patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Stage I patients were managed with surgery alone, while advanced cases underwent cytoreductive surgery followed by cisplatin-based chemotherapy with or without radiotherapy. Optimal cytoreduction and lower stage were associated with better disease-free survival. Serum SCC antigen rose in recurrences, suggesting that serial monitoring may aid early detection.

pmid-8948559.summary_ja: 28歳女性が毛髪の喀出を主訴に受診し、肺原発の良性嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された症例報告。病理組織学的所見、臨床所見、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を示す。肺の良性嚢胞性奇形腫は極めてまれで、文献上の報告は約30例に限られる。
pmid-8948559.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman presented with expectoration of hair and was found to have a benign cystic teratoma of the lung. The authors describe the histopathological, clinical, and CT features of this case. Benign cystic teratomas of the lung are extremely rare, with only about 30 cases previously reported in the literature. The report adds one more example to this limited body of evidence.

pmid-8949302.summary_ja: 新生児に生じた先天性中耳奇形腫の症例報告。頸部まで進展し、末梢性の先天性顔面神経麻痺で発見された。小児の奇形腫はまれで、頭頸部発生はさらに珍しい。過去20年で英語文献に報告された2例目とされ、胚細胞腫瘍の頭頸部発生例として位置づけられる。
pmid-8949302.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a congenital middle ear teratoma extending into the cervical region. The tumor presented as a peripheral congenital facial palsy. The authors note that teratomas are rare in children and that head and neck location is unusual. They report only the second such case in the English literature in the past 20 years.

pmid-8949993.summary_ja: 精巣がんの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍モデル（ヌードマウス異種移植）を用い、細胞保護薬アミフォスチンがシスプラチンの抗腫瘍効果を妨げるかを検討した。アミフォスチン単独では腫瘍抑制効果はなく、併用群と単独シスプラチン群の腫瘍体積に有意差は認められなかった。腫瘍保護作用はなく、抗腫瘍効果を損なわずに併用できる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8949993.summary_en: This preclinical study tested whether amifostine, a cytoprotective agent, protects against cisplatin antitumor activity in nude mouse xenografts derived from an alkaline phosphatase-positive embryonal carcinoma cell line (H12.1), modeling non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Mice received amifostine alone, amifostine plus cisplatin, or cisplatin alone at maximally tolerated doses. Amifostine alone had no antitumor effect, and tumor volumes with the combination did not differ significantly from cisplatin alone at days 14 or 30. The authors conclude amifostine provides no tumor protection, supporting its use alongside cisplatin in testicular cancer without compromising efficacy.

pmid-8951468.summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併した20歳男性が、左陰嚢の無痛性腫瘤を主訴に来院した。高位鼠径精巣摘除術が施行され、病理診断は混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。本症例を含め、ダウン症候群に精巣腫瘍を合併した報告17例を文献的に検討した症例報告である。
pmid-8951468.summary_en: A 20-year-old man with Down syndrome presented with a painless, swollen left scrotal mass and underwent high inguinal orchiectomy. Pathology revealed a mixed germ cell tumor. The authors reviewed 17 previously reported cases of testicular tumor in patients with Down syndrome, including this one, in this case report from a Japanese urology journal. The review highlights the association between Down syndrome and germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-8952049.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARおよびJEG-3を用い、hCG βサブユニット遺伝子の発現調節を細胞融合とRT-PCRで解析した。HeLa細胞との融合クローンではhCG-β発現がほとんど消失し、JAR×JEG-3融合クローンでは高発現が維持された。転写産物の多くはβ5遺伝子に由来した。著者らは、非胎盤組織への分化に伴って現れる抑制因子による負の制御を想定している。
pmid-8952049.summary_en: This cell biology study examined regulation of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) beta subunit genes using choriocarcinoma cell lines JAR and JEG-3, which express high hCG-beta levels, compared with HeLa cells that express little. Cell fusion experiments and RT-PCR showed that hybrids of HeLa with choriocarcinoma cells largely lost hCG-beta expression, whereas JAR x JEG-3 hybrids retained it. Most transcripts came from the beta-5 gene. The authors propose that hCG-beta expression depends on negative control by specific inhibitors that appear as embryonic cells differentiate into nonplacental tissues.

pmid-8955658.summary_ja: 片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者1,954例で対側精巣を生検し、精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN）は4.9％に認められた。TINは精巣萎縮と強く関連し（リスク4.3倍）、停留精巣の既往も関連したが、多変量解析で独立した因子は萎縮のみであった。TINの多くは萎縮のない精巣に存在し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変とする仮説を支持する結果である。
pmid-8955658.summary_en: This study screened the contralateral testis by biopsy in 1,954 consecutive patients with unilateral testicular germ cell tumors, finding testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) in 4.9%. TIN was associated with testicular atrophy (4.3-fold risk) and a history of undescended testis, though only atrophy remained independent on multivariate analysis. Most TIN cases occurred without atrophy and in normal-appearing testes, and patients with TIN were younger. The results support TIN as a precursor of testicular germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-8958682.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の2例を報告。1例目は血清AFP高値の26歳男性で、左上葉の一括切除後に術後化学療法を行い、10年間無病生存。2例目は腫瘍マーカー正常の25歳男性で、術前化学療法2コース後の切除標本に生存腫瘍細胞を認めず、術後3か月時点で無病。いずれも良好な経過をたどった。
pmid-8958682.summary_en: This report describes two patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors. The first, a 26-year-old man with elevated AFP, underwent en-bloc resection of the left upper lobe followed by postoperative combination chemotherapy and has remained disease-free for ten years. The second, a 25-year-old man with normal AFP and hCG, received two cycles of combination chemotherapy before residual tumor resection, and the resected tumor contained no viable tumor cells. Both patients had favorable outcomes.

pmid-8958689.summary_ja: 33歳男性の縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。右上葉や心膜に浸潤する大型腫瘍で、組織学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍の特徴を認め、血清AFPも高値であった。部分心膜切除と右上葉楔状切除に加え、術中低張シスプラチン投与、術後のシスプラチン・エトポシド併用化学療法を行い、8か月後に合併症なく退院した。
pmid-8958689.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with a large mediastinal tumor invading the right upper lobe, pericardium, and diaphragm. Histology showed endodermal sinus structures, Schiller-Duval bodies, and eosinophilic hyaline globules consistent with yolk sac tumor, and serum AFP was elevated. Treatment combined partial pericardiectomy and right upper lobe wedge resection with intraoperative hypotonic cisplatin, followed by postoperative cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy. The patient was discharged uneventfully eight months later.

pmid-8961486.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋の精巣腫瘍と非腫瘍性精巣を用い、フローサイトメトリーで核DNA倍数性を測定した。腫瘍32例のうち59.4%が異数体で、セミノーマは非セミノーマより異数体のDNA指数が高かった。根治的精巣摘除術後、異数体腫瘍の21.1%に転移を認めたが、二倍体・四倍体腫瘍では転移はなかった。
pmid-8961486.summary_en: This study measured nuclear DNA ploidy by flow cytometry in paraffin-embedded testicular tumors and nontumorous testes. Of 32 tumors, 25% were diploid, 15.6% tetraploid, and 59.4% aneuploid. Among aneuploid tumors, seminomas had a higher DNA index than nonseminomas. After curative orchiectomy, metastases occurred in 21.1% of aneuploid tumors but in none of the diploid or tetraploid tumors. Clinicopathological findings were less predictive than ploidy, and the authors conclude that flow cytometry is useful for characterizing testicular tumors.

pmid-8961487.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍123例を対象に、化学療法後の後腹膜手術の成績を比較した。平均72か月の追跡で、交互療法群の生存率は50%、PEB療法群は79%であった。後腹膜壊死や成人型奇形腫では生存率が高く、残存活性癌では47%にとどまった。残存腫瘍の組織型が予後を予測し、PEB療法が優れると結論された。
pmid-8961487.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 123 patients with advanced non-seminomatous germ cell cancer who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal surgery after either a sequential alternating cisplatin-based regimen (1979-1985) or the PEB regimen (1985-1991). After a mean follow-up of 72 months, survival was 50% with the alternating regimen and 79% with PEB. Patients with necrosis or adult teratoma had high survival, while residual active carcinoma had only 47% survival. PEB chemotherapy was judged superior, and residual tumor histology predicted outcome.

pmid-8961500.summary_ja: 32歳の不妊男性において、セミノーマに精巣微小石灰化を伴う症例を報告した。グレースケールおよびカラードプラ超音波所見を示し、文献を簡単に考察した。精巣微小石灰化は精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク因子として知られており、超音波検査による評価の重要性が示された。
pmid-8961500.summary_en: The study reports a 32-year-old infertile man in whom testicular microlithiasis was found together with a seminoma. The authors present the gray-scale and color Doppler ultrasound findings of this case and discuss them in relation to the existing literature, which they briefly review. Because microlithiasis is an established risk marker for testicular germ cell tumors, the report underscores the value of ultrasonography in identifying patients who may need closer follow-up.

pmid-8961501.summary_ja: 精巣がんが腹腔内に播種し腹水を生じた症例の報告です。腹水細胞診では腫瘍細胞を認めませんでしたが、β-hCGとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は高値でした。病理学的診断がないままシスプラチンを含む併用化学療法を2コース行い、マーカーは正常化し、腹水もCTで消失しました。腹水は播種した精巣がん細胞に由来すると考察されています。
pmid-8961501.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with intraperitoneal testicular cancer presenting with ascites. Cytology of the ascites showed no tumor cells, but serum beta-hCG and AFP were elevated. Without a pathological diagnosis, the patient received two cycles of cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy, after which both markers normalized and ascites resolved on CT. The authors concluded that the ascites likely originated from disseminated testicular cancer cells in the peritoneum, suggesting that marker-guided treatment can be considered when histology is unavailable.

pmid-8962128.summary_ja: ヒト栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞では、内在性レトロウイルスの挿入により生じたPTN転写産物HERV-PTNが発現していました。奇形癌細胞株など他系統の細胞では認めません。リボザイムでHERV-PTN mRNAを抑制すると、マウスで絨毛癌の増殖、浸潤、血管新生が抑制されました。HERV-PTNが絨毛癌の攻撃的な増殖を支え、治療標的となりうることが示唆されています。
pmid-8962128.summary_en: This study shows that human trophoblast and choriocarcinoma cells express HERV-PTN, a pleiotrophin transcript generated by an endogenous retrovirus insertion that creates a trophoblast-specific promoter. HERV-PTN was detected in normal trophoblast and term placenta and in choriocarcinoma cell lines, but not in teratocarcinoma or other lineages. Ribozyme depletion of HERV-PTN mRNA blocked choriocarcinoma growth, invasion, and angiogenesis in mice, suggesting that this transcript supports the aggressive behavior of choriocarcinoma and may be a therapeutic target.

pmid-8962655.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎または絨毛癌の女性とそのパートナー16組と、対照の健康な夫婦30組でHLA型を比較しました。HLA-AおよびBでは差はなく、HLA-DR6の頻度が上昇し、DR座の抗原共有も対照より有意に多くみられました。Bw35-DR5の組み合わせもパートナーで高頻度でした。MHC連鎖遺伝子が妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発症に関与する可能性が示唆されましたが、症例数は少数です。
pmid-8962655.summary_en: This study compared HLA class I and II antigen typing between 16 couples in which the woman had an invasive mole or choriocarcinoma and 30 fertile control couples. No differences were found for HLA-A and HLA-B antigens, but HLA-DR6 frequency was increased, and HLA-DR antigen sharing between partners was significantly higher in gestational trophoblastic tumor couples. A higher frequency of the Bw35-DR5 combination was also found in partners. The authors concluded that an MHC-linked gene likely influences gestational trophoblastic tumor development, although the sample size was small.

pmid-8963620.summary_ja: 染色体21トリソミーの22週胎児の精巣に精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を認めた症例報告で、この所見は2例目です。ダウン症で精巣胚細胞腫瘍が多いとされる機序が、胎児期早期からすでに働いている可能性が示唆されました。ダウン症の新生児では精巣胚細胞腫瘍の報告がないことから、この上皮内病変は妊娠中に退縮する可能性があると考察されています。
pmid-8963620.summary_en: This report describes a 22-week-old fetus with trisomy 21 showing intratubular germ cell neoplasia in the testis, the second such fetal case reported. The findings support the idea that the mechanism behind the excess of testicular germ cell tumors in Down syndrome is already active in early fetal life. No neonatal testicular germ cell tumor in trisomy 21 has been reported, so the authors suggest the in situ lesion may regress during gestation, possibly through a controlled mechanism similar to that of transient myeloproliferative syndrome.

pmid-8971527.summary_ja: 25歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に扁平上皮癌が生じた症例を報告し、診断と治療上の課題を考察しています。悪性転化は通常50～60歳代に多く、扁平上皮癌がこの奇形腫で最も多い悪性腫瘍です。若年の妊孕性のある女性では、この稀な合併症の管理が難しいことが示されています。
pmid-8971527.summary_en: This report describes a 25-year-old woman with squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, a rare complication usually seen in the fifth and sixth decades. The authors review the epidemiology of malignant transformation, noting that squamous cell carcinoma is the most common malignancy in these teratomas, and discuss the diagnostic and management challenges in a young patient. The paper highlights the difficulty of managing this rare event in reproductive-age women.

pmid-8971529.summary_ja: 18歳女性の巨大な卵巣腫瘍の症例報告で、基本的な検査を省いたため診断が遅れた経過が示されています。付属器の胚細胞腫瘍は若年女性に比較的多く、まず身体診察、次いで超音波検査で評価すべきと強調されています。大きな付属器腫瘤の診療における診断の落とし穴を示す報告です。
pmid-8971529.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with a massive ovarian tumor whose diagnosis was delayed because basic diagnostic steps were skipped. The authors emphasize that germ cell tumors of the adnexa are relatively common in young women and that evaluation should start with physical examination and proceed to ultrasonography. The report highlights diagnostic pitfalls in managing a large adnexal mass and the importance of using simple, reliable tools before more advanced investigations.

pmid-8971530.summary_ja: 死産後の正期胎盤に生じた絨毛癌の症例です。初回の病理組織検査では診断に至らず、11週後の持続する性器出血で行われた搔爬で絨毛癌と確定しました。保存されていた胎盤標本を再検討して診断を確認しています。分娩から治療開始までの期間が予後に大きく影響するため、早期の認識が重要と強調されています。
pmid-8971530.summary_en: This report describes choriocarcinoma arising in a term placenta after a stillborn delivery, where the initial histological examination failed to make the diagnosis. Eleven weeks later, persistent vaginal bleeding led to curettage that established choriocarcinoma. Reviewing the original placental material confirmed the diagnosis. The authors stress that the interval between delivery and treatment strongly influences prognosis and that mature placentas can be diagnostically difficult to interpret.

pmid-8973685.summary_ja: プラチナ系併用化学療法で完全寛解に至った転移性精巣がん190例中4例に、治療終了後2〜5か月で女性化乳房が生じた。血中hCGβとテストステロンは正常範囲であったが、FSH、LH、エストラジオールは上昇していた。ゴナドトロピン上昇による精巣性エストロゲン分泌の増加が原因と考えられ、再発を意味しないことを認識する重要性が示された。
pmid-8973685.summary_en: This clinical report examines gynecomastia in 4 of 190 patients with metastatic testicular cancer who achieved complete remission after platinum-based combination chemotherapy. Affected patients had normal beta-hCG and testosterone but elevated FSH, LH, and estradiol, suggesting gonadotropin-driven testicular estrogen secretion. The authors conclude that this treatment-related gynecomastia, appearing months after chemotherapy, does not necessarily indicate relapse, and recognizing it can prevent unnecessary investigations that distress young patients.

pmid-8973860.summary_ja: 両側性の卵巣ディスジャーミノーマと精巣セミノーマの各1例を報告。病変の軽い側の生殖腺を臓器温存手術で残し、化学療法を併用した。両者とも妊孕性を回復したが、男性例では残存精巣に新たな胚細胞腫瘍が発生した。若年者の両側性腫瘍における本治療戦略の利点と注意点が考察されている。
pmid-8973860.summary_en: This report describes two patients with bilateral germ cell tumors: a woman with bilateral dysgerminoma and a man with bilateral testicular seminoma. In both, the less affected gonad was preserved by organ-sparing surgery, followed by chemotherapy. Both regained fertility, but the man later developed a new germ tumor in the remaining testicle. The authors discuss the benefits and potential pitfalls of this gonad-preserving approach in young adults, where fertility and hormone production are important.

pmid-8973947.summary_ja: 1970〜1994年に治療された精巣腫瘍109例を検討。胚細胞腫瘍106例のうち純粋セミノーマは61例、非セミノーマ性成分を含むものは45例であった。5年生存率は全体で79.6%であり、1981年以降はCTとシスプラチンを含む化学療法の導入により有意に改善した。
pmid-8973947.summary_en: This Japanese clinical study reviewed 109 patients with testicular tumors treated between 1970 and 1994. Of 106 germ cell tumors, 61 were pure seminomas and 45 contained non-seminomatous elements, with three non-germinal tumors. Clinical stage I accounted for 80 cases. The 5-year survival was 79.6% overall, and survival improved significantly after 1981, when CT and cisplatin-containing chemotherapy were introduced, compared with before 1980.

pmid-8976882.summary_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌(CIS)を含む24検体で、AgNOR面積を画像解析により定量した。CISはセルトリ細胞や精原細胞より有意に高値を示し、セルトリ細胞指数1.0が両者の鑑別に有用であった。非セミノーマに伴うCISはセミノーマ由来のものより高値で、形質転換能に亜クローン性の差がある可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8976882.summary_en: This pathology study applied AgNOR silver staining to 24 testicular specimens containing carcinoma in situ (CIS). AgNOR area per nucleus was significantly higher in CIS cells than in Sertoli cells and spermatogonia. A Sertoli cell index above 1.0 helped distinguish CIS from spermatogonia. CIS associated with non-seminoma showed higher AgNOR levels than CIS associated with pure seminoma, suggesting subclonal variation in transformation potential.

pmid-8978793.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の初の治癒例から妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の第一選択治療に至るまで、婦人科腫瘍におけるメトトレキサートの役割を総説。作用機序と耐性機構を解説し、非転移例や低リスク転移例の治癒率、高リスク転移性GTDでの多剤併用療法の有用性を示す。子宮頸がんへの併用化学療法にも触れる。
pmid-8978793.summary_en: This review traces methotrexate's use in gynecologic oncology, from its early role in curing choriocarcinoma to its use in gestational trophoblastic disease. It describes mechanisms of action and resistance, reports cure rates for nonmetastatic and low-risk metastatic disease, and notes the benefit of early multiagent therapy in high-risk metastatic GTD. It also briefly discusses combination chemotherapy in cervical carcinoma.

pmid-8978799.summary_ja: 卵巣・子宮内膜・子宮頸部のがんに加え、妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるエトポシド(VP-16)の臨床応用を総説。妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対する最も有効な薬剤の一つとされ、単剤または多剤併用で用いられる。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍ではブレオマイシンおよびシスプラチンとの併用で有効性を示し、現在の化学療法で重要な役割を果たしている。
pmid-8978799.summary_en: This review summarizes the clinical use of etoposide (VP-16) in gynecologic malignancies, including trophoblastic disease and ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancer. Etoposide is described as one of the most effective agents for trophoblastic disease, used alone or in multidrug regimens. It is also active in combination with bleomycin and cisplatin for ovarian germ cell tumors, where it plays an important role in current chemotherapy.

pmid-8978807.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の3例を報告。全例でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値で、G-CSF支持下にBEP化学療法6コース後、残存腫瘍を肺と心膜を含めて一塊に切除した。切除標本に生存腫瘍細胞はなく、術後5か月から3年9か月の時点で3例とも無病生存している。AFPは著明に低下したものの正常化はしなかった。
pmid-8978807.summary_en: Three patients with primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor, all with markedly elevated AFP, received six courses of BEP chemotherapy with G-CSF support before resection. CT showed anterior mediastinal masses infiltrating adjacent tissue, and one patient had multiple pulmonary nodules. AFP fell substantially but did not normalize. Residual masses were removed with en-bloc resection of lung and pericardium, and no viable tumor cells were found in the specimens. All three remained disease-free 5 to 45 months after surgery.

pmid-8978809.summary_ja: 再発または難治性の胚細胞腫瘍2例に対し、シスプラチンとカルボプラチンによる救済化学療法を施行した。1例は精巣原発の胎児性癌とセミノーマの2回目再発例、もう1例は縦隔原発の難治性胎児性癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍例である。2例中1例で完全奏効が得られ、非血液毒性は許容範囲であった。本療法は胚細胞腫瘍の再発に有用である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8978809.summary_en: Two young men with recurrent or refractory germ cell tumors were treated with salvage combination chemotherapy of cisplatin, carboplatin, and vinblastine. One patient had a testicular tumor with embryonal carcinoma and seminoma after a second relapse. The other had primary refractory mediastinal embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor. One of two patients achieved complete response. Non-hematologic toxicity was tolerable. The authors suggest this regimen may be useful for germ cell tumor recurrence.

pmid-8979209.summary_ja: 25歳女性が巨大腹部腫瘤と男性化徴候で受診し、テストステロンの上昇を認めた。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では脂液面形成と石灰化を伴う腫瘤が確認された。30cmの左卵巣腫瘤を摘出したところ、卵巣静脈血中のテストステロン値は著明に高値で、病理学的には成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。術後にテストステロン値は正常化した。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が男性化を来す例はまれである。
pmid-8979209.summary_en: A 25-year-old woman with virilism and a large abdominal mass had elevated testosterone and creatinine, along with anemia and right kidney obstruction. CT showed a mass with fat-fluid levels and calcifications. Surgery removed a 30-cm left ovarian mass, and left ovarian vein testosterone was markedly elevated. Pathology showed a mature cystic teratoma, and testosterone normalized after surgery. The authors note that androgen production and virilization are rare but possible with mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-8979475.summary_ja: 閉経後の50歳女性に生じた卵巣絨毛癌の1例。開腹時に大きな壊死性卵巣腫瘤として認められた。妊娠関連と非妊娠関連の卵巣絨毛癌の鑑別の難しさを論じ、両者の予後の違いを説明するため細胞遺伝学的検討の必要性を指摘している。本稿は症例報告である。
pmid-8979475.summary_en: A 50-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with choriocarcinoma of the ovary, which appeared at laparotomy as a large necrotic ovarian mass. The report focuses on the difficulty of distinguishing gestational from non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma. The authors note that these two entities may differ in prognosis and call for cytogenetic studies to clarify the reasons for this difference.

pmid-8980410.summary_ja: シリビニンをシスプラチン投与前に与えたラットでは、糸球体および尿細管の腎毒性が有意に軽減された。ヒト由来の胚細胞腫瘍細胞株3種では、シリビニンはシスプラチンと4-ヒドロペルオキシイホスファミドの抗腫瘍活性を阻害しなかった。著者らは、精巣がん患者を対象とした無作為化臨床試験の基礎になると結論している。
pmid-8980410.summary_en: This study tested whether the flavonoid silibinin protects against cisplatin-induced kidney injury in rats without reducing anti-tumour activity. When given before cisplatin, silibinin reduced glomerular and tubular toxicity markers, and it had no effect alone. In three human testicular cancer cell lines, silibinin did not blunt the cytotoxicity of cisplatin or 4-hydroperoxy-ifosfamide. The authors conclude that these findings support a randomised clinical trial of silibinin in patients with testicular cancer receiving cisplatin.

pmid-8982245.summary_ja: セミノーマ6例と混合型腫瘍1例について、接着分子ICAM-1、VCAM-1、ELAM-1の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。ICAM-1は精細管内胚細胞腫瘍のセルトリ細胞に発現し、腫瘍性胚細胞には発現しなかった。VCAM-1とELAM-1は主に内皮細胞に限局していた。これらの所見を、リンパ球浸潤、免疫監視、精細管上皮に対するT細胞寛容の観点から論じている。
pmid-8982245.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry was used to examine ICAM-1, VCAM-1 and ELAM-1 in six seminomas and one mixed seminoma/embryonal carcinoma, along with surrounding testicular tissue. ICAM-1 was expressed by Sertoli cells in intratubular germ cell neoplasia but not by neoplastic germ cells, while inflammatory cells and endothelium also expressed it. VCAM-1 and occasionally ELAM-1 were confined to endothelial cells. The authors relate these patterns to lymphocytic infiltration, immune surveillance, and T-cell tolerance in the immunoprivileged seminiferous epithelium.

pmid-8983268.summary_ja: 低腫瘍量(5cm以下)の後腹膜転移を有する病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の初期治療を論じている。北米では後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)が、欧州では化学療法が主流である。精巣摘除術後に腫瘍マーカーが正常の場合は初回RPLNDが適切と考えられる。治療選択は毒性や患者の希望を含めた費用対効果とリスク対効果に基づくと述べている。
pmid-8983268.summary_en: This paper discusses primary treatment for low-volume (5 cm or less) retroperitoneal metastases in stage II non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. North American practice favors primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, while Europe favors chemotherapy. After orchiectomy with normal tumor markers, primary RPLND seems most appropriate for staging. Roughly one-third of patients in each approach need the other, so decisions weigh cost, risk, toxicity and patient preference.

pmid-8983598.summary_ja: 35歳女性の甲状腺悪性奇形腫の症例報告である。全甲状腺摘出術の直後に局所再発を来し、化学療法と局所放射線療法で局所制御は得られたものの、その後遠隔再発に至った。稀な疾患であり、術後の局所再発と転移の頻度が高い点が強調されている。
pmid-8983598.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with malignant teratoma of the thyroid gland, a rare and highly aggressive tumour. Local recurrence occurred immediately after total thyroidectomy. Local control was achieved with chemotherapy and local radiotherapy, but distant relapse developed later. The authors emphasise the high frequency of local recurrence and metastasis after surgery in this rare entity, illustrating its aggressive clinical course.

pmid-8986035.summary_ja: パクリタキセルの泌尿器悪性腫瘍における役割を総説したもの。膀胱がんでは一次治療として高い奏効率が示され、シスプラチン抵抗性の精巣がんでは単剤の奏効率は約26%であった。TIP療法の後に末梢血幹細胞救援を伴う大量化学療法を行う救済療法として用いられている。
pmid-8986035.summary_en: This review examines paclitaxel in chemosensitive urological malignancies, focusing on bladder cancer and testicular germ cell tumours. In bladder cancer, paclitaxel combinations achieve high response rates as first-line therapy for metastatic disease. In cisplatin-refractory testicular cancer, single-agent response rates were about 26 percent. Paclitaxel combined with cisplatin and ifosfamide (TIP) is used for salvage therapy, followed by high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue.

pmid-8986471.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の掻爬直後の悪性度評価法として、ジャックフルーツレクチン結合性を検討した研究。GTDでは正常胎盤より強い結合を示し、遺残病変では細胞異型を伴って強く拡散性に結合した。血清β-hCGの下降パターンと相関し、ハイリスク病変の同定や治療計画への応用が期待される。
pmid-8986471.summary_en: This study evaluated jackfruit lectin binding as a rapid, inexpensive marker of aggressiveness in gestational trophoblastic disease immediately after evacuation. Lectin binding was higher in GTD than in normal placentae, and persisting lesions showed intense, diffuse binding with cytological atypia. The lectin score correlated with the regression pattern of serum beta-hCG rather than initial levels, suggesting it may identify high-risk lesions and guide early treatment planning.

pmid-8987325.summary_ja: 膣出血で受診した55歳女性の子宮頸部腫瘍で、明細胞腺癌と絨毛癌の2成分からなる症例報告。組織学的所見から、絨毛癌成分は既存の明細胞腺癌から化生過程を経て生じたと考えられた。胚細胞腫瘍以外の癌の中に絨毛癌成分が生じる稀な混合型腫瘍である。
pmid-8987325.summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old woman who presented with vaginal bleeding and a cervical tumour composed of two components: clear-cell adenocarcinoma and choriocarcinoma. Histology suggested that the choriocarcinomatous component arose from the pre-existing clear-cell adenocarcinoma through a metaplastic process. The case illustrates a rare mixed tumour in which a choriocarcinoma element develops within a non-germ cell carcinoma.

pmid-8987329.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた、肉腫様の壁在結節を伴う粘液性嚢胞腺癌の極めて稀な症例報告。奇形腫の悪性転化の多くは扁平上皮癌であり、本例の組織型は非典型的である。卵巣奇形腫の悪性転化の多様性と非典型例の認識の重要性が示されている。
pmid-8987329.summary_en: This case report describes a very rare mucinous cystadenocarcinoma with sarcoma-like mural nodules arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Most reported malignant transformations of ovarian teratomas are squamous cell carcinomas, so this histological type is unusual. The authors highlight the diversity of malignant transformation patterns in ovarian teratoma and the importance of recognising atypical variants.

pmid-8989940.summary_ja: 精巣の純粋型絨毛癌を有する22歳日本人男性で、多発する紅色皮膚結節が転移と確認された症例。皮疹出現から3か月後に死亡した。文献的検討では絨毛癌の皮膚転移は既報が7例のみで、結節型を呈し予後不良とされている。
pmid-8989940.summary_en: This report describes a 22-year-old Japanese man with pure testicular choriocarcinoma who developed multiple reddish cutaneous nodules, confirmed as metastases with the typical histology of the primary tumour. He died three months after the onset of skin metastasis. A literature review identified only seven previous cases of cutaneous choriocarcinoma metastasis, which usually present as nodular lesions and carry a poor prognosis.

pmid-8994332.summary_ja: 1988〜1993年に国立台湾大学病院で手術を受けた卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫283例の後方視的研究です。原発性卵巣腫瘍の32.6%を占め、平均年齢は35.4歳でした。主訴は疼痛が最多で、16.6%は無症状で発見されました。合併症では捻転が9.2%と最も多く、悪性転化は0.7%（扁平上皮癌）でした。悪性転化は閉経後女性に多く、予後は不良とされています。
pmid-8994332.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution series reviewed 283 consecutive mature cystic teratomas of the ovary treated at National Taiwan University Hospital from 1988 to 1993. Mature cystic teratoma accounted for 32.6% of primary ovarian neoplasms, with a mean age of 35.4 years. Pain was the most common complaint, and 16.6% of cysts were found incidentally. Torsion (9.2%) was the most frequent complication. Malignant transformation, usually to squamous cell carcinoma, occurred in 0.7% of cases, and the authors note it is more common in postmenopausal women with a poorer prognosis.

pmid-8996073.summary_ja: 停留精巣に発生したセミノーマの5例を、文献レビューとともに報告しています。思春期後の停留精巣患者では、年齢にかかわらず精巣摘除術を推奨すると述べています。フォローアップが困難であること、また腫瘍治療が奏効しない可能性があることが理由です。腹部腫瘤を呈する患者では、停留精巣を念頭に置くよう注意を喚起しています。
pmid-8996073.summary_en: Five patients presenting with seminoma arising in an undescended testis are described, alongside a literature review. The authors advocate orchidectomy for post-pubertal patients with cryptorchidism regardless of age. Their rationale is that follow-up can be difficult and that treatment of the tumour may be unsuccessful. The report warns clinicians to consider an undescended testis in patients who present with an abdominal mass.

pmid-8996556.summary_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍24例を対象に、カルボプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン（CEB）の併用療法でカルボプラチンを増量する第I/II相試験を行いました。骨髄抑制のため推奨用量は500 mg/m²で、完全奏効率は71%でした。治療成績は標準的なシスプラチン併用化学療法を上回らず、今後は糸球体濾過量に基づく用量設定が必要とされています。
pmid-8996556.summary_en: This phase I/II trial tested dose escalation of carboplatin combined with etoposide and bleomycin, with GM-CSF support, as initial therapy for poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors in 24 patients. Myelosuppression limited the dose to 500 mg/m2, and the complete response rate was 71%. Response was higher at carboplatin doses above 400 mg/m2 (92% vs 50%). However, the authors concluded that outcomes were no better than standard cisplatin-based chemotherapy. They recommend that future carboplatin dosing be calculated from glomerular filtration rate.

pmid-9001806.summary_ja: ダウン症候群の患者に後腹膜奇形腫とモルガーニヘルニアが合併した症例を報告した短報です。ダウン症候群に関連する悪性腫瘍としては白血病が最も多いと述べています。詳しい治療経過やフォローアップの記載はありません。性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍と先天性横隔膜欠損が併存した稀な例として参考になります。
pmid-9001806.summary_en: This brief case report describes a patient with Down syndrome who had both a retroperitoneal teratoma and a Morgagni hernia. The authors note that leukaemia is the most common malignancy associated with Down syndrome. The report gives no detailed treatment course or follow-up data. It is relevant because it documents an extragonadal germ cell tumour coexisting with a congenital diaphragmatic defect in a patient with Down syndrome.

pmid-9007148.summary_ja: 良性卵巣類皮嚢腫の女性38例を、腹腔鏡手術群18例と開腹手術群20例に分けて比較した。腹腔鏡手術は手術時間が長かったが、入院期間は有意に短かった。両群とも合併症はみられず、腹腔鏡手術は安全で有効な方法と結論づけられている。
pmid-9007148.summary_en: This study compared laparoscopy with laparotomy for removing benign ovarian dermoid cysts in 38 women, allocated 18 to laparoscopy and 20 to laparotomy. Operating time was longer with laparoscopy (93.6 ± 23.8 min), while hospitalization was significantly shorter (22.4 ± 6.6 h). No complications occurred in either group. The authors conclude that operative laparoscopy is a safe and effective alternative to laparotomy for removing ovarian dermoid cysts.

pmid-9013229.summary_ja: 1986年から1995年にかけて登録された精巣胚細胞腫瘍148例を前向きに検討した。内訳はセミノーマ99例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍49例であった。病期I・IIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍などでは5年生存率が高かったが、病期IIIのセミノーマでは5年生存率が0%であり、進行例では新たな治療法の導入が必要と結論づけられた。
pmid-9013229.summary_en: This prospective study from the Nara Uro-Oncology Research Group enrolled 148 patients with germ cell tumor of the testis between 1986 and 1995, including 99 seminomas and 49 nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Five-year survival was 100% for stage I seminoma and for stage I and II NSGCT, 75% for stage II seminoma, 0% for stage III seminoma, and 66.7% for stage III NSGCT. The authors conclude that new treatment modalities should be introduced for advanced disease.

pmid-9021046.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの早期段階ごとに有糸分裂頻度を比較した研究である。上皮内癌の0.65%から充実性セミノーマの3.59%へと、腫瘍の発育とともに増加した。組織の区画により増殖挙動が異なり、微小環境への適応と解釈されている。早期セミノーマの増殖動態に関する知見を補うものである。
pmid-9021046.summary_en: This study examines mitotic frequency across defined early stages of testicular seminoma: carcinoma in situ, intratubular seminoma, intratubular seminoma with interstitial cells, and solid seminoma. Mitotic frequency rose progressively with tumor development, from 0.65% in carcinoma in situ to 3.59% in solid seminoma. Tumor cells in different tissue compartments showed different proliferation behavior. The authors interpret these differences as adaptation to changing tissue microenvironments, adding to limited data on early seminoma kinetics.

pmid-9021367.summary_ja: 右精巣セミノーマに対する摘除術と放射線療法後に無精子症となった男性の凍結保存精液を用い、ICSIによる妊娠・出産に至った症例報告である。放射線療法前の精液による人工授精は3回失敗していた。融解後の運動性が極めて低かったためICSIを選択し、12個中8個の卵子で正常受精が得られた。治療前の精子凍結保存の重要性を強調している。
pmid-9021367.summary_en: This report describes a successful pregnancy after intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) using cryopreserved semen from a man treated for right testicular seminoma with orchidectomy and radiotherapy. He was azoospermic after treatment. Earlier intrauterine insemination failed three times with pre-radiotherapy semen, and IVF with ICSI was then performed because post-thaw motility was poor. A healthy male infant was delivered at 39 weeks. The authors advise cryopreserving sperm before cancer treatment regardless of quality.

pmid-9021701.summary_ja: HIV感染血友病患者に生じた転移性セミノーマの、知られている限り初の症例報告である。頸部・腋窩リンパ節腫脹が悪性リンパ腫に類似していた。頸部リンパ節の穿刺吸引生検と切除生検により確定診断された。HIV関連リンパ節腫脹の鑑別診断では転移性胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきと強調している。
pmid-9021701.summary_en: This report describes the first known case of metastatic seminoma in an HIV-infected hemophiliac. Cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy simulated malignant lymphoma. Fine needle aspiration of a cervical node showed a mixture of lymphocyte-like cells and loosely cohesive large tumor cells in a tigroid background. Immunocytochemistry and excisional biopsy confirmed the diagnosis. The authors emphasize that metastatic germ cell tumors should be included in the differential diagnosis of HIV-related lymphadenopathy.

pmid-9022320.summary_ja: 胸部X線で縦隔陰影を指摘された42歳女性の、縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例報告である。嚢胞液では癌胎児性抗原が550 ng/mlと著明に高値で、8種類の腫瘍マーカーが上昇していた。免疫組織化学で腫瘍マーカーの局在を確認した。術後2週間で血清の癌胎児性抗原は正常化し、奇形腫の多様な細胞成分との関連が示唆された。
pmid-9022320.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with a mediastinal abnormality on chest X-ray. Resection revealed an 11 cm mature teratoma containing pancreatic tissue, collagen, squamous epithelium and hair follicles. Cystic fluid showed markedly elevated carcinoembryonic antigen (550 ng/mL) and high levels of eight tumor markers, including CA125, CA19-9 and NSE, which were localized by immunohistochemistry. Serum carcinoembryonic antigen normalized within two weeks after surgery, suggesting the markers reflected the tumor's various cellular components.

pmid-9025885.summary_ja: 以前に奇形腫と診断された先天性仙尾部腫瘤3例について、X染色体不活化を用いたPCRでクローン性を解析した。充実性未熟奇形腫1例は単クローン性であった。主に嚢胞性で組織学的に成熟した腫瘤は多クローン性であった。仙尾部の未熟奇形腫は単クローン性の腫瘍であり、一部の成熟奇形腫は過誤腫とみなすのが適切と結論している。
pmid-9025885.summary_en: This study uses a PCR-based assay for nonrandom X chromosome inactivation to determine the clonality of three congenital sacrococcygeal masses previously diagnosed as teratomas. One solid immature teratoma was monoclonal. A predominantly cystic, histologically mature mass was polyclonal, and a third immature teratoma was noninformative. The authors confirm that sacrococcygeal immature teratomas appear to be monoclonal neoplasms and suggest that some mature teratomas may be better classified as hamartomas.

pmid-9027325.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株4種でEGFとEGF受容体の発現を調べ、NaUCC-4で自己分泌性の増殖経路が働くことを示した。抗EGF・抗EGFR抗体は増殖を抑制したが、hCG産生には影響せず、EGFは分化よりも増殖を促すことが示唆された。
pmid-9027325.summary_en: This study examined EGF and EGFR expression in four choriocarcinoma cell lines, including NaUCC-4, which showed the highest EGF binding and immunoreactive EGF. Exogenous EGF stimulated DNA synthesis, and anti-EGF or anti-EGFR antibodies inhibited it, indicating an autocrine loop promoting proliferation. The antibodies did not affect hCG production, suggesting EGF drives proliferation rather than differentiation. The findings point to EGF/EGFR signaling as a potential therapeutic target in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-9037356.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する幹細胞支持下の大量化学療法を総説し、再発例の救援療法と予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍への初回地固め療法を検討した。予後因子として病勢、原発部位、前治療効果、治療前血清hCGを挙げ、難治例では効果が乏しいと述べる。
pmid-9037356.summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell support in germ cell tumors, covering salvage use in relapsed disease and first-line consolidation in poor-risk non-seminomatous tumors. Prognostic factors include disease status, primary site, prior response, and pretreatment serum hCG. Patients without adverse factors had over 50% cure rates, while refractory disease did not benefit. Ongoing randomized trials and new strategies such as repeated cycles and paclitaxel are discussed.

pmid-9037359.summary_ja: 予後良好な転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍54例を対象に、PEB療法とCEB療法をランダム化比較した。完全寛解率に差はなかったが、再発率はCEBで高く、早期中止となった。カルボプラチンはシスプラチンの代替にならず、PEBが標準であると結論づけた。
pmid-9037359.summary_en: This randomized German trial compared cisplatin-etoposide-bleomycin (PEB) with carboplatin-etoposide-bleomycin (CEB) in 54 patients with good-risk metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Complete response rates were similar (81% vs 76%), but relapse was more frequent after CEB (32% vs 13%), and CEB-treated patients had more deaths from progression. The trial was stopped early for excess negative events. The authors conclude carboplatin cannot replace cisplatin, and PEB remains the standard.

pmid-9037948.summary_ja: 妊娠中の母体に生じた妊娠性絨毛癌が新生児に転移した症例を報告した。新生児は貧血と肝腫大で発症し、38日齢で死亡し剖検で診断された。母体は産後に肺と肝臓への広範な転移を来した。新生児の貧血や肝腫大では母児のhCG測定が有用と指摘する。
pmid-9037948.summary_en: This case report describes gestational choriocarcinoma in a pregnant woman with metastases to her infant. The neonate presented with severe anemia and hepatomegaly, progressed rapidly despite treatment, and died at 38 days; autopsy established the diagnosis. The mother later developed widespread lung and liver metastases. The authors advise checking maternal and infant hCG levels when a neonate has anemia or hepatomegaly, to detect an occult maternal tumor.

pmid-9038609.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんで、経過観察と補助化学療法のどちらが適切かを意思決定分析で比較した。患者では再発率50%超、医師では73%超で補助化学療法が優先された。患者の選好を考慮すると補助化学療法をより多く検討すべきと結論づけた。
pmid-9038609.summary_en: This decision analysis compared surveillance with adjuvant chemotherapy for stage I non-seminomatous testicular cancer, using probabilities from the literature and expert input. Utilities were obtained from 68 patients and 50 clinicians. Adjuvant chemotherapy was preferred at relapse rates above 50% using patient utilities and above 73% using clinician utilities. Stated preference questions yielded lower thresholds, suggesting patient preferences should be considered when choosing adjuvant treatment.

pmid-9042205.summary_ja: 未治療の精巣胚細胞腫瘍48例でP-糖タンパク質の発現を免疫染色で評価した。非セミノーマ性腫瘍の53%が陽性で、セミノーマの14%より多かった。発現は進行病期と化学療法抵抗性に相関し、治療前の評価が予後不良例の同定に有用と考えられた。
pmid-9042205.summary_en: This study measured P-glycoprotein expression by immunostaining in 48 untreated primary germ cell testicular tumors. P-gp was found in 53% of non-seminomatous tumors but only 14% of seminomas. Expression correlated with advanced stage and with chemotherapy resistance. The authors propose that pretreatment P-gp assessment could identify patients with worse prognosis and less chemosensitivity.

pmid-9048494.summary_ja: 完全奇胎妊娠140例を後方視的に解析し、奇胎後絨毛性疾患(PMTD)の危険因子を低・中等度・高リスク群に分類した。高リスク群では予防的化学療法により寛解までの期間が短縮し、PMTD発症も有意に減少した。低・中等度リスク群では効果は認められず、高リスク患者への予防的化学療法の有用性が示唆された。
pmid-9048494.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 140 complete molar pregnancies treated at Yonsei University College of Medicine. Risk factors for postmolar trophoblastic disease (PMTD) were ranked by frequency and patients were stratified into low-, medium-, and high-risk groups. In high-risk patients, prophylactic chemotherapy significantly shortened time to remission and reduced PMTD occurrence. No benefit was seen in low- or medium-risk groups, supporting prophylactic chemotherapy for patients meeting high-risk criteria.

pmid-9050641.summary_ja: 良性卵巣奇形腫の腹腔鏡下摘出を、5cm以下にはポーチ法、5cm超には温水による吸引洗浄を併用する方法で行った。内容物の漏出は腹腔の洗浄と歯などの固形物の除去で対処した。両手技とも合併症は報告されておらず、手技の詳細を示す臨床報告である。
pmid-9050641.summary_en: This study describes two laparoscopic techniques for extracting benign ovarian teratomas. For cysts up to 5 cm, a pouch technique with partial extraction and stab incisions to empty contents was used; for larger cysts, endoscopic aspiration with hot water irrigation preceded partial extraction. Spillage was managed by extensive peritoneal lavage and removal of debris, including teeth. No complications were reported with either method.

pmid-9050650.summary_ja: 8cmの成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有する10歳女児に対し、卵巣温存を目的とした外来での腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術を施行した症例報告である。患者は24時間で完全に回復した。小児の適切に選択された症例において、腹腔鏡手術が保存的治療として有効である可能性が示された。
pmid-9050650.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old girl diagnosed with an 8-cm mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. She underwent an outpatient ovary-conserving laparoscopic cystectomy and recovered fully within 24 hours. The authors suggest that laparoscopy can be an effective conservative approach for selected gynecologic disorders in children. The report highlights the feasibility of ovary-sparing surgery in pediatric patients with benign ovarian teratoma.

pmid-9050664.summary_ja: 妊孕性温存を希望する41例の卵巣類皮嚢腫に対し、腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出の剥離法を比較した。アクアディセクションは鈍的剥離とハサミより手術時間が短く、術中の内容物漏出も有意に少なかった。両法とも合併症はなく、腹腔鏡手術は安全で有効な管理法と結論された。
pmid-9050664.summary_en: This study compared two dissection methods for laparoscopic cystectomy of ovarian dermoid cysts in 41 women aged 17 to 38 who wished to preserve fertility. Aquadissection shortened operative time (59.3 vs 78.4 minutes) and significantly reduced intraoperative spillage compared with blunt dissection and scissors. Neither method caused complications, and hospital stay was similar. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is a safe and effective approach for managing ovarian dermoid cysts.

pmid-9051423.summary_ja: セミノーマと上皮内がんに特異的なモノクローナル抗体M2Aを用いた免疫磁気法で、精液からCIS細胞を濃縮する方法を開発した。CIS患者では対照者より大型円形細胞が有意に多く回収された。精巣CISの非侵襲的スクリーニングへの応用が期待される。
pmid-9051423.summary_en: The authors developed an immunomagnetic method using monoclonal antibody M2A, specific for seminoma and carcinoma-in-situ (CIS), to enrich CIS cells from semen. Spiked HEY cells were recovered selectively in preliminary experiments. Applied to ejaculates from five CIS patients and 22 controls, large round cells were recovered in significantly higher numbers from CIS patients, with no overlap between groups (p < 0.001). The approach could support future non-invasive screening for testicular CIS.

pmid-9065118.summary_ja: 妊娠9〜17週で腹腔鏡下に良性嚢胞性奇形腫を摘出した12例を後方視的に検討した。嚢胞破裂は93%で生じたが、慎重な操作と骨盤内の十分な洗浄で化学性腹膜炎を回避できた。母体・胎児の合併症はなく、妊娠中の腹腔鏡下摘出の安全性が示された。
pmid-9065118.summary_en: This retrospective review examined 12 pregnant women who underwent laparoscopic removal of benign cystic teratomas at 9 to 17 weeks of gestation. Cysts measured 5 to 13 cm, and rupture occurred intraoperatively in 93% of patients. Careful technique and copious pelvic irrigation prevented chemical peritonitis. Mean operating time was 87 minutes, and no maternal or fetal complications occurred, supporting the safety of laparoscopic removal of ovarian cystic teratoma during pregnancy.

pmid-9081388.summary_ja: 再発またはシスプラチン抵抗性の転移性精巣がん患者24例にパクリタキセルを投与した第II相試験である。25%で奏効が得られ、完全奏効は2例であった。主な毒性は顆粒球減少症と末梢神経障害であった。パクリタキセルは有意な抗腫瘍活性を示し、併用療法の検討に値すると結論された。
pmid-9081388.summary_en: This phase II trial evaluated paclitaxel in 24 men with relapsed or cisplatin-refractory metastatic testicular cancer, most of whom had prior platinum-based chemotherapy. Six patients (25%) responded, including two complete responses, and five had stable disease. Median response duration was 8 months. Main toxicities were granulocytopenia and grade II or higher peripheral neuropathy. The authors conclude that paclitaxel has meaningful activity and that combination regimens may be worth exploring.

pmid-9119640.summary_ja: 本報告は、精索静脈瘤と精巣上体嚢胞の精査中に、精巣の超音波検査所見が不明瞭であった24歳男性の症例である。後に精巣微小石灰化と判明した。精巣微小石灰化は精巣胚細胞腫瘍と関連するため、著者らは外観が正常な精巣であっても、精巣生検による上皮内癌の除外を検討すべきだと提案する。この観点から管理の在り方を論じている。
pmid-9119640.summary_en: A 24-year-old man was evaluated for unclear testicular ultrasonographic findings, later identified as testicular microlithiasis, during workup for varicocele and epididymal cysts. Because testicular microlithiasis is associated with testicular germ cell tumours, the authors recommend considering testis biopsy to exclude intratubular neoplasia (carcinoma in situ) even when the testis appears normal. The paper discusses management in this context.

pmid-9119644.summary_ja: 本報告は、治療への恐怖と予後に関する知識不足のため治療が遅れた、巨大胚細胞腫瘍の症例である。著者らはこの症例をもとに、精巣腫瘍に対する自己検査プログラムの落とし穴と限界を考察する。治療の遅れを防ぐため、精巣腫瘍に関する一般の知識を向上させることを勧めている。
pmid-9119644.summary_en: The authors report a giant germ cell tumour whose treatment was delayed because the patient feared therapy and lacked knowledge of prognosis. Using this case, they discuss pitfalls and limitations of self-detection programmes for testicular tumours. They recommend improving general knowledge of testicular tumours to help prevent such delays in treatment.

pmid-9132264.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理報告書に記載すべき項目を論じた総説。組織型（セミノーマか非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍か）と非セミノーマ性の胚細胞成分割合、脈管侵襲、精索・精巣上体浸潤、断端の状態、化学療法後の転移検体における生存癌や奇形腫成分の有無を含めるべきとする。治療方針や追加療法の判断に役立つ情報である。
pmid-9132264.summary_en: This commentary on pathology reporting for testicular germ cell tumors argues that reports should specify histology (seminoma vs. nonseminomatous germ cell tumor), including the percentage of germ cell components in the latter. It also recommends documenting vascular or lymphatic invasion, spermatic cord or epididymal involvement, cord margin status, and whether viable carcinoma or teratomatous elements remain in metastatic specimens after chemotherapy. For nonseminomatous tumors, the report should state whether the tumor is pure or mixed and the proportion of each component. These details guide initial treatment and the need for and type of additional therapy.

pmid-9132475.summary_ja: 大腸に発生した良性成熟奇形腫の症例報告。奇形腫が大腸に生じることは極めてまれで、英語文献では従来2例のみが報告されていた。本報告は3例目にあたるとされる。性腺外に発生した奇形腫の稀な症例として、この病変の症例記録を補うものである。小児外科領域からの報告である。
pmid-9132475.summary_en: This case report describes a benign mature teratoma arising in the large bowel, an extremely rare site for teratoma. The authors note that only two cases had previously been reported in the English-language literature, and present what they believe is the third. Teratoma affecting the colon is an unusual extragonadal presentation of germ cell-derived tumor, and the report adds to the limited case documentation of this entity. It is a pediatric surgery report published in 1996.

pmid-9152975.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫の治療後に髄芽腫を発症した二次性悪性腫瘍の症例報告。卵巣未熟奇形腫は化学療法で治癒可能となったが、化学療法後の中枢神経系腫瘍発生への感受性が議論されている。胚細胞腫瘍患者の晩期合併症や長期フォローアップの重要性を示す症例である。
pmid-9152975.summary_en: This case report describes medulloblastoma occurring as a secondary malignancy in a patient successfully treated for immature teratoma of the ovary. Immature ovarian teratoma is a rare but curable tumor treated with combination chemotherapy. The authors note that long-term follow-up of such patients has been limited, and the case raises the question of whether prior chemotherapy increases susceptibility of the central nervous system to tumors. It is relevant to survivorship and late-effect monitoring in germ cell tumor patients treated with chemotherapy.

pmid-9162192.summary_ja: 小児卵黄嚢腫瘍10例を二色FISH法で解析し、染色体1p36欠失を検出した研究。8例で欠失が確認され、多くはすべてのサブクローンに欠失を認めたことから早期に生じたと考えられた。神経芽腫より高頻度である可能性があり、予後との関連は今後の検討課題とされる。
pmid-9162192.summary_en: This study used two-color fluorescence in situ hybridization on interphase nuclei to assess chromosome 1p36 deletion in 10 childhood endodermal sinus tumors, which arise in the testis and extragonadal sites in children under 4. Eight of ten tumors showed 1p36 deletion, and most had multiple subclones all carrying the deletion, suggesting it occurred early, before chromosome 1 aneusomy. The authors conclude that 1p36 deletion occurs in CEST at a frequency probably higher than in neuroblastoma. Prognostic significance and overlap with neuroblastoma deletion regions require further study.

pmid-9208488.summary_ja: 中国の単施設で卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍63例を解析した研究。VACまたはPVBによる十分な化学療法を受けた群は持続寛解率81.8%と、不十分な群(23.5%、11.8%)より有意に良好であった。完全治療例では手術範囲による予後差は明らかでなく、適時かつ適切なサイクル数の化学療法が予後を左右すると結論している。
pmid-9208488.summary_en: This Chinese single-institution series of 63 patients with ovarian endodermal sinus tumor compared outcomes by the number of cycles of postoperative chemotherapy. Patients receiving full courses of VAC (vincristine, actinomycin-D, cyclophosphamide) or PVB (cisplatin, vincristine, bleomycin) had markedly higher sustained remission rates (81.8%) than those with incomplete or alternative regimens (23.5% and 11.8%). Among fully treated patients, the extent of surgery, including adnexectomy laterality, lymphadenectomy, or residual tumor size, did not clearly affect outcome. The authors conclude that timely, optimal-cycle combination chemotherapy is the key determinant of prognosis, while appropriate surgery remains important.

pmid-9363207.summary_ja: 正常絨毛・絨毛外栄養膜細胞、SV40 Tag不死化浸潤性栄養膜細胞、絨毛癌細胞株(JAR、JEG-3、BeWo)でp53発現を比較した研究。絨毛癌細胞株はいずれも変異型p53を過剰発現し、不死化細胞と絨毛癌細胞ではmdm2も増加していた。TGF-βの抗増殖効果は不死化細胞で減弱し、絨毛癌株では認められなかった。p53の不活化と変異が異常増殖とTGF-β抵抗性に関与すると考察している。
pmid-9363207.summary_en: This study examined p53 expression in normal villous and extravillous trophoblast, SV40 Tag-immortalized invasive trophoblast, and choriocarcinoma cell lines (JAR, JEG-3, BeWo) using ELISA and immunoblotting. Normal villous trophoblasts expressed low wild-type p53, syncytiotrophoblast expressed more, and immortalized cells showed high wild-type p53 complexed with Tag. All choriocarcinoma lines overexpressed mutant p53, with mdm2 increased in immortalized and choriocarcinoma cells. TGF-beta antiproliferative effects were diminished in immortalized cells and absent in choriocarcinoma lines. The authors propose that p53 inactivation and mutation contribute to aberrant proliferation and TGF-beta resistance.

pmid-9816247.summary_ja: まれな妊娠性絨毛性疾患の一型である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の17例を報告しています。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は80%で、前回妊娠からの間隔が2年を超えることが独立した予後不良因子でした。PCR解析により、解析した11例すべてが妊娠由来と確認され、原因妊娠を8例で特定しています。
pmid-9816247.summary_en: This paper reports placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare variant of gestational trophoblastic disease, based on 17 patients treated at Charing Cross Hospital. The 5-year overall survival was 80%, and an interval of more than 2 years since the preceding pregnancy was an independent adverse prognostic factor. PCR allelotyping confirmed gestational origin in all 11 tumors studied, and the causative pregnancy was identified in eight, including androgenetic tumors after complete moles.

pmid-9816268.summary_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍の患者25例で、シスプラチン療法中の白血球白金-DNA付加体量と予後の関係を検討しました。投与5日目の付加体量は、死亡または進行例で有意に高値でした(153.5対62.1 fmol/µg)。従来の報告とは異なり、付加体量が高いことが良好な予後と相関しないと結論づけています。
pmid-9816268.summary_en: This study examined whether platinum-DNA adduct levels in peripheral leukocytes during cisplatin-based chemotherapy predict outcome in 25 patients with advanced germ cell cancer. Adduct levels at 24 hours showed no difference between groups. Day 5 adduct levels were significantly higher in patients who died or progressed (153.5 vs 62.1 fmol/µg; P = 0.02). The authors conclude that high adduct levels do not correlate with favorable outcome, contrary to previous reports.

pmid-21544372.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera-2において、FGF-4遺伝子の発現が血清により制御されることを示した研究。血清飢餓で抑制され、血清添加で再活性化し、初期応答遺伝子の可能性が示唆された。腫瘍そのものより、細胞分化段階に関連した遺伝子制御が主題である。
pmid-21544372.summary_en: The authors show that FGF-4 expression in the Tera-2 human embryonal carcinoma cell line is regulated by serum. It is repressed in serum-deprived quiescent cells and reactivated by serum, with superinduction after cycloheximide, suggesting an early response gene. They propose that this reflects the differentiation stage of Tera-2 cells. The study is primarily about developmental gene regulation using a cell line model and only indirectly concerns germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-7501968.summary_ja: 正常および悪性(絨毛癌細胞)の栄養膜細胞が顆粒状子宮間質細胞(GMG細胞)を誘導するかを、異所性と子宮内投与の両条件で検討した1996年の基礎研究。絨毛癌細胞は正常栄養膜細胞と同様の挙動を示した。GMG細胞の分化には脱落膜の形成が必要と結論された。腫瘍そのものを主題とした研究ではない。
pmid-7501968.summary_en: This 1996 experimental study examined whether normal and malignant trophoblast recruit granulated metrial gland (GMG) cells. Normal trophoblast implanted ectopically did not induce decidua or GMG cells, whereas injection in utero did. Choriocarcinoma cells behaved similarly to normal trophoblast in both settings. The authors conclude that decidua formation, rather than conceptus development or trophoblast outgrowth, is required for GMG cell differentiation. The malignant component is a secondary comparison within a reproductive biology question rather than a study of the tumor itself.

pmid-8592062.summary_ja: in situ hybridization法により、皮膚内の細胞でERV3 env mRNAの発現を検討した研究です。皮脂腺と卵巣類皮嚢腫で高発現が認められました。卵巣類皮嚢腫は検討組織の一つで、主題は皮脂腺のERV3発現です。皮脂腺はホルモン依存性に制御されるため、ERV3の発現もホルモン依存性である可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-8592062.summary_en: This study uses in situ hybridisation to localise ERV3 (HERV-R) env mRNA in specific cell types of human skin. High expression was found in sebaceous glands of normal skin and in ovarian dermoid cysts, with maximal signal at the lobular periphery. Because sebaceous gland regulation is largely hormonal, the authors suggest ERV3 expression may be hormone dependent. Ovarian dermoid cysts, a mature teratoma type, appear as one of the examined tissues rather than the main focus.

pmid-8601395.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞株と雌の体細胞との細胞融合を用い、Xist遺伝子の5'領域のメチル化変化を調べた。再活性化能をもつEC細胞は部分的メチル化を示し、融合により不活性X染色体の新たなメチル化と他方のX染色体の脱メチル化が生じた。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく細胞株を用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-8601395.summary_en: This study examines Xist gene methylation in mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines and their hybrids with female somatic cells. Reactivating-competent EC cells carry partial methylation of the Xist 5' region, and fusion with female lymphocytes induces de novo methylation on the inactive X and demethylation on the other X. Reactivating-incompetent lines show no such changes. The authors propose this methylation pattern underlies reactivation potential and random X inactivation in EC hybrids in vitro and epiblast cells in vivo. The work uses cell lines rather than patient tumors.

pmid-8606002.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞が壁側内胚葉様細胞へ分化する際に、核内システインプロテアーゼ活性が出現することを示した基礎研究です。この活性はATF-1、Sp1、Oct-1などの転写因子を分解します。カルパスタチンやEGTAでは阻害されず、カルパインとは区別されます。臨床的な腫瘍研究ではありません。
pmid-8606002.summary_en: This study shows that differentiation of mouse embryonal carcinoma cells into parietal endoderm-like cells induces a nuclear cysteine protease activity. This activity cleaves several transcription factors, including ATF-1, Sp1, NF-YA and B, and Oct-1 and Oct-3. It is absent in the visceral endoderm-like line PSA-5E and in cells derived from embryonic stem cells or the human NT2/D1 line. The protease is not inhibited by calpastatin or EGTA, distinguishing it from calpains. The authors suggest that it regulates transcription factor turnover during embryonic cell differentiation. The work is basic developmental biology rather than clinical tumor research.

pmid-8610142.summary_ja: 組換えヒトユテログロビンは、トロホブラストとNIH 3T3細胞の浸潤を抑制したが、絨毛癌細胞には影響しなかった。絨毛癌細胞では結合タンパク質が欠如しており、この結合部位を介して浸潤性が調節される可能性が示された。絨毛癌は主に比較対象として扱われ、主題は正常トロホブラストの浸潤制御である。
pmid-8610142.summary_en: This study shows that recombinant human uteroglobin (hUG) suppresses Matrigel invasion of human trophoblasts and NIH 3T3 cells but has no effect on human choriocarcinoma cells. The authors identified a high-affinity, approximately 190 kDa hUG-binding protein present on trophoblasts and NIH 3T3 cells but absent from choriocarcinoma cells. The work suggests uteroglobin regulates invasiveness through this binding site, and that dysregulated trophoblast invasion may contribute to choriocarcinoma pathogenesis. Choriocarcinoma serves mainly as a comparison model.

pmid-8621547.summary_ja: F9奇形癌幹細胞が、形態形成因子（モルフォゲン）により原始内胚葉へ進展する過程を検討した。Gialpha2の減少がホスホリパーゼC、PKC、MAPキナーゼを活性化し、Gialpha2機能獲得変異体やPKC阻害剤で進展が阻害されることを示した。主に細胞シグナル伝達研究であり、臨床的な関連は間接的である。
pmid-8621547.summary_en: This study used the F9 embryonal teratocarcinoma stem cell line to examine how morphogen-induced progression toward primitive endoderm is controlled. The authors show that a decline in Gialpha2 activates phospholipase C, protein kinase C, and MAP kinase, which drives differentiation. Gain-of-function Gialpha2 mutants and protein kinase C inhibitors block this progression, even in the presence of retinoic acid. The work is a cell-signaling study. Its relevance to clinical germ cell tumor management is indirect.

pmid-8629420.summary_ja: 口腔底に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告です。CTではリンパ管腫と誤診されましたが、穿刺吸引細胞診で扁平上皮が確認され正診に至りました。その結果、適切な術式が選択されました。著者らは口腔底病変の初診断として細胞診を第一選択とすべきと結論づけています。
pmid-8629420.summary_en: This case report describes a dermoid cyst of the floor of the mouth, a rare benign lesion, diagnosed preoperatively by fine needle aspiration cytology. A massive swelling had been initially misread as lymphangioma on CT. Cytology revealed anucleated and nucleated squamous cells, establishing the correct diagnosis and guiding appropriate surgery. The authors conclude that FNA should be the first-choice diagnostic procedure for lesions of the floor of the mouth, and they observed no complications from the procedure.

pmid-8662786.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株Tera2において、転写因子Oct-4が血小板由来増殖因子αレセプター(PDGFαR)遺伝子の別のプロモーターを活性化することを示した研究。未分化細胞でのみ働くこのプロモーターは、オクタマーモチーフを介してOct-4により制御される。Oct-4は胎児性癌細胞の未分化状態の維持に関与すると考えられる。
pmid-8662786.summary_en: This study examines how the transcription factor Oct-4 controls an alternative promoter of the PDGF alpha-receptor gene in the human embryonal carcinoma cell line Tera2. The promoter, located in intron 12, is active in undifferentiated cells, where Oct-4 is expressed. Mutating its octamer motif reduces activity, and ectopic Oct-4 expression in differentiated cells enhances it. The authors propose that Oct-4 helps maintain the undifferentiated state of embryonal carcinoma cells by activating this promoter.

pmid-8663260.summary_ja: 胚性転写因子Oct-3/4が絨毛癌細胞株JArにおいて、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニット遺伝子のプロモーターを強力に抑制することを示した研究。結合部位は-270付近に同定され、変異導入により抑制は消失した。栄養外胚葉でのOct-3/4の不活化は、初期胚におけるhCG発現の上昇、すなわち妊娠認識に必要と考えられる。
pmid-8663260.summary_en: This study shows that the embryonic transcription factor Oct-3/4 strongly represses the human chorionic gonadotropin beta-subunit (hCGbeta) promoter in JAr choriocarcinoma cells. Reporter assays and footprinting localized the Oct-3/4 binding site near position -270, and mutating this site abolished repression. In stably transfected JAr cells, Oct-3/4 reduced endogenous hCGbeta mRNA and hCG protein to less than 10% of controls. The authors propose that silencing of Oct-3/4 in trophectoderm is required for hCG up-regulation during early embryogenesis and maternal recognition of pregnancy.

pmid-8732669.summary_ja: マウスF9胎児性癌細胞の分化過程で、レチノイン酸がプロテインキナーゼC(PKC)アイソザイムの発現を変化させることを検討した。PKC βからαへの移行が生じ、壁側内胚葉の形成にはPKC αの増加が関与した。PKCの変化が遺伝子発現を変えると結論している。
pmid-8732669.summary_en: The study examined how retinoic acid alters protein kinase C (PKC) isozyme expression during differentiation of F9 murine embryonal carcinoma cells. Retinoic acid induced a shift from PKC beta to PKC alpha, and dibutyryl cAMP further increased PKC alpha for parietal endoderm formation. Phorbol esters induced c-fos, c-jun, and junB in stem cells, with PKC beta involved in c-fos induction and PKC alpha in type IV collagen induction. The authors conclude that changes in conventional PKC alter gene expression during parietal endoderm formation.

pmid-8756564.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3と正常分娩胎盤を比較し、hCG/LH受容体遺伝子の転写が前者で高い機序を検討した基礎研究である。負の制御領域や、Ap2様I、Sp1、Ap2などの転写因子の関与が示された。絨毛癌の臨床的な診療を扱うものではない。
pmid-8756564.summary_en: This basic molecular study examines why the hCG/LH receptor gene is transcribed more strongly in human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells than in normal term placenta. Deletion analysis identified three negative control regions and a promoter, and gel shift and footprinting assays revealed transcription factors including Ap2-like I, Sp1, and Ap2. Lower levels of repressive proteins and higher Ap2-like I in JEG-3 cells likely explain the elevated expression. The choriocarcinoma line is the central model, but the work addresses receptor gene regulation rather than clinical management.

pmid-8761963.summary_ja: 正常栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞株(JAr、BeWo)におけるセロトニントランスポーターの発現を検討した研究。両細胞とも、Na+依存性の細胞膜セロトニン輸送活性を示し、抗うつ薬で阻害された。一方、小胞モノアミントランスポーターの活性とmRNAはJAr細胞と栄養膜細胞で検出されなかった。RBL 2H3細胞を比較対照として用いた。研究の対象は胎盤の生理機能に関する基礎的知見であり、絨毛癌の臨床的な病態を扱ったものではない。
pmid-8761963.summary_en: This study examined serotonin and vesicular monoamine transporter expression in normal human trophoblasts and two choriocarcinoma cell lines, JAr and BeWo, using RBL 2H3 cells as a comparator. Both choriocarcinoma lines and trophoblasts showed Na+-dependent plasma membrane serotonin transport sensitive to antidepressants. Vesicular monoamine transporter activity and mRNA were absent in JAr cells and trophoblasts. The authors conclude that trophoblasts and choriocarcinoma cells express the plasma membrane serotonin transporter but not the vesicular monoamine transporter.

pmid-8766010.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来の栄養膜細胞株BeWo、JAr、Jeg-3を用い、ギャップ結合チャネルの性質を電気生理学的に解析した。BeWoとJArではCx40が内在的に発現し、JArではCx43も発現していた。Cx40を導入したJeg-3と内在性Cx40を持つBeWoは、類似した電位感受性と単一チャネルコンダクタンス（約175 pS）を示した。
pmid-8766010.summary_en: The authors studied gap junction channels in three human choriocarcinoma-derived trophoblast lines, BeWo, JAr and Jeg-3, including Jeg-3 cells transfected with rat connexin40. Connexin40 was endogenously expressed in BeWo and JAr cells, and JAr cells also expressed connexin43. Recordings showed that exogenous Cx40 in Jeg-3 cells and endogenous Cx40 in BeWo cells had similar voltage sensitivity and unitary conductance of about 175 pS. Coexpression of Cx43 and Cx40 in JAr cells produced a macroscopic conductance with mixed properties.

pmid-8790944.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌由来のNCR-G3細胞は、レチノイン酸処理によりヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を産生する栄養外胚葉様細胞へ分化する。cDNAライブラリーのスクリーニングで、Bcl-2関連遺伝子mcl1/EATが分化初期に上昇することを見いだした。熱ショックでも発現は増加した。本研究は臨床ではなく分化モデルとして胚細胞腫瘍由来株を用いている。
pmid-8790944.summary_en: NCR-G3 cells were established from a testicular embryonal carcinoma and differentiate into trophectoderm-like cells, including human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG)-producing cells, after retinoic acid exposure. A cDNA library screen identified mcl1/EAT, a Bcl-2 family member, whose expression rises early in differentiation, preceding cytokeratin and hCG induction. Heat shock also upregulated mcl1/EAT. The study uses this germ cell tumour-derived line as a differentiation model rather than investigating patients or clinical management.

pmid-8806447.summary_ja: ラットの正常トロホブラスト細胞株(HRP-1)と絨毛癌細胞株(Rcho-1)を用い、コネキシン発現を比較した基礎研究である。レチノイン酸処理により、Rcho-1ではコネキシン31が不可逆的に消失し、増殖が抑制された。両細胞株で浸潤能は同程度に抑制された。コネキシンの変化は浸潤よりも増殖と分化の制御に関与すると結論づけている。絨毛癌は臨床疾患ではなくモデル細胞として用いられた。
pmid-8806447.summary_en: This study investigates connexin expression in a rat trophoblast line (HRP-1) and a rat choriocarcinoma line (Rcho-1) as models of invasive versus differentiated trophoblast. Retinoic acid irreversibly suppressed connexin 31 and reduced proliferation in Rcho-1 cells, without altering HRP-1 cells. Invasion was similarly suppressed in both lines. The authors conclude that connexin switching regulates proliferation and differentiation rather than invasiveness. The choriocarcinoma line serves mainly as an in vitro trophoblast model rather than a clinical disease study.

pmid-8829214.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株(b30クローン)を栄養膜分化のモデルとして用い、インスリン様成長因子(IGF)受容体の発現変化を解析した研究です。フォルスコリン処理により合胞体栄養膜への分化が誘導され、I型IGF受容体が増加しました。I型受容体は分化した栄養膜の機能や分化過程の調節に関与する可能性が示されました。
pmid-8829214.summary_en: This study used the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line (b30 clone) as a model to examine insulin-like growth factor (IGF) receptor expression during trophoblast differentiation induced by forskolin. Forskolin increased type I IGF receptors in a time-dependent manner, with changes detectable by 24 hours and sustained through 72 hours. IGF-II bound to both type I and type II receptors, and the proportion bound to type I receptors rose after treatment. The cells lacked insulin receptors at all stages. The authors suggest that type I IGF receptors may regulate differentiated trophoblast function and possibly the differentiation process itself.

pmid-8861943.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株F9を用いて、レチノイン酸による分化とRXRアルファの役割を解析した基礎研究です。RXRアルファを欠損させると原始内胚葉・壁側内胚葉への分化や抗増殖・アポトーシス応答が障害されました。RAR-RXRヘテロ二量体がレチノイドの作用を伝達する単位であることを示しています。
pmid-8861943.summary_en: This basic research study uses the murine F9 embryonal carcinoma cell line, a model of retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Knocking out both RXRalpha alleles impaired differentiation into primitive and parietal endoderm and blocked anti-proliferative and apoptotic responses to retinoic acid. Visceral endoderm differentiation was largely preserved. The findings support RAR-RXR heterodimers as the functional units that transduce retinoid effects in these cells.

pmid-8865778.summary_ja: 咽頭の「有毛ポリープ」(類皮)は咽頭奇形腫の変種と考えられることがあるが、本論文は乳児の中耳類皮ポリープ症例、AFIPの症例、文献を検討した。第一鰓裂由来の異所性副耳(コリストーマ)と結論づけ、奇形腫のような増殖能はないとしている。奇形腫は主に比較対象として扱われている。
pmid-8865778.summary_en: The authors examine so-called hairy polyps or pharyngeal dermoids, often considered a variant of pharyngeal teratoma. They report an infant with a dermoid polyp in the middle ear, review AFIP consultation cases of pharyngeal dermoid polyps and teratomas, and survey the literature. They conclude these lesions are choristomatous developmental anomalies from the first branchial cleft, representing heterotopic accessory auricles without the growth potential of a teratoma. Teratomas serve mainly as comparators.

pmid-8869109.summary_ja: 高麗人参由来のジンセノサイドRh1・Rh2が、F9奇形癌幹細胞を壁側内胚葉様細胞へ分化させることを培養細胞で示した基礎研究です。ラミニンB1などの分化マーカーの発現が増加し、抗グルココルチコイド剤RU486で効果が阻害されたことから、グルココルチコイド受容体の関与が示唆されています。
pmid-8869109.summary_en: This in vitro study examined whether ginsenosides Rh1 and Rh2 from Panax ginseng induce differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells into parietal endoderm-like cells. Treatment increased laminin B1 and type IV collagen expression, and the effect was blocked by the glucocorticoid antagonist RU486, implicating the glucocorticoid receptor. Ginsenosides bound the receptor more weakly than dexamethasone, and GRE-driven transactivation was enhanced by ginsenosides and dbcAMP. The authors propose that the effect is mediated via a glucocorticoid receptor or a related nuclear receptor.

pmid-8871634.summary_ja: 単純ヘルペスウイルス（HSV）が、絨毛癌細胞株においてHLA-Gを含むクラスI分子の発現を消失させることを示した研究です。その原因はウイルスの阻害因子ICP47による抗原提示関連輸送体の阻害です。HSV感染と自然流産を結ぶ機序の可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-8871634.summary_en: This study shows that herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection abrogates HLA class I expression, including HLA-G, in choriocarcinoma cells. The effect is mediated by the viral inhibitor ICP47, which blocks the transporter associated with antigen presentation. HLA-G is normally expressed on extravillous cytotrophoblast and may help silence NK cells. The authors propose that this mechanism could link HSV infection to spontaneous fetal loss.

pmid-8875981.summary_ja: 本研究は、レチノイン酸によりF9胎児性癌細胞が原始内胚葉細胞へ分化する過程におけるWilms腫瘍抑制遺伝子WT1の発現変化を検討したものである。WT1発現は分化初期に一過性に上昇し、その後消失した。WT1を恒常的に発現させた細胞はレチノイン酸下で分化できず、36時間後にアポトーシスに陥った。WT1の発現低下が正常な分化に必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-8875981.summary_en: This study examined WT1, the Wilms tumor suppressor gene, during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells into primitive endoderm. WT1 expression rose transiently early in differentiation and then disappeared as cells matured. Cell lines constitutively expressing a WT1 splice variant failed to differentiate under retinoic acid and instead underwent apoptosis within 36 hours. The authors conclude that WT1 downregulation is required for normal F9 differentiation.

pmid-8892963.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株P19と、レチノイン酸に反応しないRAC65を比較した研究。9-cis-レチノイン酸はRAC65で神経分化を強く誘導し、その活性はレチノイン酸受容体よりレチノイドX受容体(RXR)の発現パターンと対応した。RXR-γ mRNAの低下は両細胞株の神経分化に伴い、RXRに選択的な合成レチノイドも神経細胞を誘導した。
pmid-8892963.summary_en: This study compares two murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines, P19 and the retinoic acid-nonresponsive RAC65, for neuronal differentiation induced by retinoids. In RAC65 cells, 9-cis-retinoic acid induced neurons about tenfold more effectively than all-trans-retinoic acid, with activity tracking retinoid X receptor (RXR) rather than retinoic acid receptor. Downregulation of RXR-gamma mRNA accompanied neuronal differentiation in both lines, and a synthetic RXR-selective retinoid also induced neurons. The findings implicate the 9-cis-retinoic acid/RXR system in neural differentiation.

pmid-8904981.summary_ja: 本研究は、エタノールがトロホブラスト細胞に与える影響を検討したものである。エタノールは、正期および妊娠初期の胎盤由来トロホブラストと絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3において、DNAおよびタンパク質量を減少させる一方、hCG産生を増加させた。メトトレキサートなどの抗増殖薬でも同様の結果が得られた。増殖と分化の変化がhCG産生増加に関与する可能性があると考察している。
pmid-8904981.summary_en: This study examines how ethanol affects trophoblastic cells. Ethanol increased hCG production while reducing total DNA and protein in term trophoblasts, first-trimester placental cells and JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. Antimitogenic agents methotrexate and cytosine arabinoside produced similar effects, with growth inhibition accompanied by increased hCG. The authors suggest that ethanol may enhance hCG production through changes in growth and differentiation, which may also occur in other proliferating fetal cells.

pmid-8940046.summary_ja: F9奇形癌細胞が原始内胚葉へ分化する過程を、Gialpha2とGsalphaのシグナル伝達から解析。キメラ蛋白と活性型変異体を用い、Gsalphaの N末端領域がホスホリパーゼCの制御スイッチとして働くことを示した。疾患そのものより細胞モデルを用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-8940046.summary_en: Investigates how Gialpha2 and Gsalpha signaling via phospholipase C and protein kinase C regulates differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells into primitive endoderm. Using chimeric G-protein constructs and activated mutants, the authors identify the N-terminal region of Gsalpha as a dominant switch controlling phospholipase C activation and progression. The study is mechanistic G-protein signaling research in a cell model.

pmid-8941706.summary_ja: マウスF9奇形癌細胞において、全トランス型レチノイン酸によるコネキシン43の発現誘導を検討。mRNAは増加したが、核内ランオン解析では転写変化は認められず、転写後調節機構が示唆された。細胞間連絡の基礎研究であり、胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではない。
pmid-8941706.summary_en: Examines how all-trans retinoic acid induces connexin43 expression and gap junction communication in mouse F9 teratocarcinoma cells. Northern blotting shows increased connexin43 mRNA alongside collagen IV, a differentiation marker. Nuclear run-on assays show no transcriptional change, leading the authors to propose a post-transcriptional mechanism. The work is basic gap junction biology rather than tumor research.

pmid-8955505.summary_ja: ヒト子宮内膜におけるG-CSFとその受容体の発現と、IL-1βによるG-CSF産生の誘導を検討した。さらにG-CSFは絨毛癌細胞株3株のうち2株の増殖を抑制した。主題は子宮内膜の生理であり、絨毛癌細胞は実験標的として用いられている。
pmid-8955505.summary_en: This study examined G-CSF and its receptor in human endometrium, finding mRNA expression throughout the menstrual cycle and G-CSF protein production in vitro. Interleukin-1 beta stimulated endometrial G-CSF production in a time- and dose-dependent manner. G-CSF also inhibited proliferation of two of three choriocarcinoma cell lines. The authors suggest G-CSF may mediate local actions of interleukin-1 beta and modulate trophoblast proliferation. Choriocarcinoma cells served as experimental targets rather than the disease focus.

pmid-8955506.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株（BeWo、JEG-3、JAR）と正期（term）トロホブラストのサイトカイン発現を半定量RT-PCRで比較した。IL-1、TNF-α、IFN-γは絨毛癌細胞で弱いか欠如していたが、正期トロホブラストでは発現していた。主題は生殖に関わる正常トロホブラストのサイトカイン生物学である。
pmid-8955506.summary_en: This study assessed cytokine mRNA expression in choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, JEG-3, JAR) and term trophoblast using semiquantitative RT-PCR. IL-1, TNF-alpha, and IFN-gamma were weakly expressed or absent in choriocarcinoma cells but were expressed in term trophoblast. IL-6, IL-10, IFN-alpha, IFN-beta, and GM-CSF were detected in all trophoblast cells, except for low IL-10 in JEG-3. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma cells and term trophoblast express cytokines that may regulate reproductive events. The focus is normal trophoblast biology.

pmid-8957072.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9が壁側内胚葉へ分化する過程で、p53がmdm-2遺伝子を制御するかを検討した。分化に伴いp53は減少したが、mdm-2は恒常的に発現した。p53は無傷の細胞ではmdm-2を活性化せず、紫外線照射後にのみ誘導された。胎児性癌細胞株は分化モデルとして用いられており、臨床腫瘍の検討ではない。
pmid-8957072.summary_en: This study examined whether p53 regulates mdm-2 during differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells into parietal endoderm. As F9 cells differentiated, p53 mRNA and protein decreased, while mdm-2 expression remained constitutive. p53 did not transactivate mdm-2 in undamaged cells, but it did stimulate mdm-2 after UV irradiation, indicating that the p53-Mdm-2 autoregulatory loop operates mainly in DNA-damage pathways. The embryonal carcinoma cell line serves as a differentiation model rather than a clinical tumor study.
