pmid-8977160.summary_ja: 着床期の栄養膜細胞におけるコネキシン発現を、腫瘍浸潤との類似性の観点から検討。生体内ではコネキシン31が浸潤性栄養膜細胞に限局した。絨毛癌細胞ではレチノイン酸によりコネキシン31が消失し、浸潤能と増殖の両方が低下した。コネキシン31は増殖能の維持に関与し、浸潤能には影響しないと考えられている。
pmid-8977160.summary_en: This study compares connexin expression in trophoblast during embryo implantation with tumor invasion. Connexin 31 marks the invasive trophoblast population in vivo, while rat HRP-1 trophoblast cells express connexin 43 and malignant choriocarcinoma cells express connexin 31. Retinoic acid reduced connexin 31 and invasion in choriocarcinoma cells, and suppressed growth of malignant trophoblast, suggesting cx31 supports proliferation but not invasion.

pmid-8978473.summary_ja: ヌードマウスの尾状核被殻に移植したヒト胎児性癌細胞NTera-2を1年以上追跡。移植細胞は致死的腫瘍を形成せず、シナプスを有する成熟神経細胞へ分化し、TH陽性細胞は経時的に増加した。成体マウス被殻の抽出物は腫瘍形成を抑制し、カテコールアミン作動性の神経表現型を誘導する因子の存在を示唆した。
pmid-8978473.summary_en: This study followed human embryonal carcinoma NTera-2 cells transplanted into the caudoputamen of nude mice for over one year. Grafted cells differentiated into mature neurons with synapses and myelinated processes, and tyrosine hydroxylase-positive cells increased over time instead of forming lethal tumors. Extracts from the adult mouse caudoputamen promoted tyrosine hydroxylase expression in retinoic acid-treated cells, suggesting tissue-derived factors suppress tumor formation.

pmid-9119595.summary_ja: 著者らは、進行性の気道狭窄を引き起こした口腔底の奇形腫様嚢胞に対し、外科的切除を受けた生後2か月の男児を報告する。口腔底嚢胞は類表皮性、類皮性、奇形腫様に分類され、奇形腫様嚢胞は最もまれで、乳児期に発症することは極めてまれである。治療は外科的切除が第一選択である。画像所見と病理所見、および文献的考察を示す。
pmid-9119595.summary_en: The authors describe a 2-month-old boy who underwent surgical excision of a teratoid cyst of the floor of the mouth causing progressive airway compromise. Floor-of-mouth cysts are classified as epidermoid, dermoid, or teratoid, and teratoid cysts are the least common and rarely present in infancy. Surgical excision was the treatment of choice. Radiographic and histopathologic evidence and a literature review are presented.

pmid-7490825.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の良性病変である腺腫様腫瘍3例と悪性腫瘍10例の超音波所見を比較した1996年の研究。腺腫様腫瘍は等エコーまたは正常エコーを示したが、悪性腫瘍では該当例はなかった。小型で等エコーの病変は、直ちに根治的精巣摘除術を行うのではなく、鼠径切開による生検と凍結切片診断を行うべきと結論づけている。症例数が少ない点が限界である。
pmid-7490825.summary_en: This 1996 study compared three men with testicular adenomatoid tumors to ten men with testicular malignancies, examining ultrasonographic features. Adenomatoid tumors appeared isoechoic or normal on ultrasound in most cases, whereas none of the malignant tumors did. The authors conclude that small, isoechoic testicular lesions should be biopsied via an inguinal incision with frozen section assessment rather than undergoing immediate radical orchiectomy. The small sample size limits generalizability, but the findings highlight a diagnostic pitfall in testicular mass evaluation.

pmid-8624281.summary_ja: デンマークの登録データに基づくターナー症候群女性597例のコホート研究である。全悪性腫瘍の相対危険度は約1.1だった。Y染色体を持つ女性を含め、性腺芽腫や未分化胚細胞腫は認められず、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクは従来の推定より低い可能性が示された。大腸癌のリスク上昇も報告されている。
pmid-8624281.summary_en: This registry-based cohort study followed 597 women with Turner syndrome and compared observed cancers with expected rates in the general population. Twenty-one neoplasms occurred, with an overall relative risk of about 1.1, and Wilms tumor was the only childhood cancer. Notably, no gonadoblastoma or dysgerminoma was found, suggesting that the risk of ovarian germ cell tumors may be lower than previously estimated. Colon cancer showed a significantly elevated risk, and the authors call for further studies.

pmid-8677077.summary_ja: 初回手術が不十分だった早期卵巣癌疑い45例を対象に、再病期分類のための開腹術の所見と合併症を検討した。胚細胞腫瘍は7例含まれた。16%が上位病期に再分類されたが治療変更は1例のみで、33%に合併症があった。予後情報は得られるものの、既に化学療法が必要な患者への利益は乏しいと結論づけている。
pmid-8677077.summary_en: Forty-five patients with presumed early ovarian cancer who had incomplete initial staging underwent restaging laparotomy. Histology included invasive epithelial, borderline epithelial, and germ cell tumors, with germ cell tumors comprising seven cases. Seven patients (16%) were reclassified to a higher stage, changing treatment in one. Fifteen patients (33%) had complications. The authors conclude restaging provides prognostic information with minimal morbidity but offers little benefit for patients already requiring chemotherapy based on original findings.

pmid-8740138.summary_ja: Currarino症候群の乳児2例を報告し、家族スクリーニングで8例を追加発見。文献48例では仙骨前部腫瘤は髄膜瘤47%、良性奇形腫40%。慢性便秘の小児には肛門直腸診と骨盤画像検査を推奨し、根治的切除が常に必要とは限らないと述べている。
pmid-8740138.summary_en: Two infants with Currarino syndrome (anorectal, sacral, and presacral anomalies) are reported, and family screening identified eight additional cases. A literature review of 48 patients found that the presacral mass was most often an anterior meningocele (47%) or a benign teratoma (40%). The authors recommend anorectal examination and pelvic imaging in children with chronic constipation, and note that radical excision is not always required.

pmid-8786211.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞81例の穿刺細胞診の有用性を検討した研究である。悪性嚢胞12例中9例を正しく診断し偽陽性はなかった。一方、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を含む良性腫瘍は非腫瘍性と誤分類されやすかった。細胞診単独では不十分で、陰性結果も臨床的なフォローアップを行うべきと結論している。
pmid-8786211.summary_en: This study evaluated aspiration cytology in distinguishing neoplastic from non-neoplastic ovarian cysts, using 81 aspirates from 80 women. Cytology correctly diagnosed nine of twelve cystadenocarcinomas, including two low malignant potential tumours, with no false-positive results. Benign neoplasms, including seven mature cystic teratomas, were often classified as non-neoplastic. Diagnostic accuracy improved when cyst size was considered. The authors conclude that aspiration cytology alone is insufficient and that negative results should be followed clinically. Teratomas form only a minor subgroup of the analysis.

pmid-8809884.summary_ja: 胎盤に生じた稀な成熟奇形腫の症例報告である。羊膜と絨毛膜の間に存在し、皮膚と付属器、骨、軟骨、脂肪、神経節を含んでいた。臍帯は確認されなかった。本例を成熟奇形腫と結論づけ、胎児無心体（fetus acardius amorphus）との鑑別と、この部位における腫瘍の起源について文献的に考察している。
pmid-8809884.summary_en: This case report describes a rare mature teratoma of the placenta. The tumor lay between the amnion and chorion and contained skin with appendages, bone, cartilage, fat and ganglia, without recognizable organization. No umbilical cord was identified. The authors conclude the lesion is a true mature teratoma rather than a fetus acardius amorphus. They discuss how to distinguish these entities and the possible origin of the tumor at this site, with a brief literature review.

pmid-8824551.summary_ja: ヒト腫瘍細胞株でHSP発現とシスプラチン感受性の関係を調べた。胚細胞腫瘍由来の3株を含み、その中ではHSP27の発現量が感受性と並行した。全体では相関は認められなかったが、一部の腫瘍種ではHSP27の高発現が感受性と関連すると結論づけている。
pmid-8824551.summary_en: This study examined whether heat-shock protein (HSP) expression relates to cisplatin sensitivity across human tumor cell lines. The panel included three germ-cell tumor lines, one small-cell lung carcinoma line, and three colon carcinoma lines. No overall correlation was found. Among the three germ-cell lines, however, HSP27 levels tracked with cisplatin sensitivity. Two acquired-resistance models also showed reduced HSP27. The authors conclude that high HSP27 expression in vitro is linked to cisplatin sensitivity in some tumor types, consistent with clinical data.

pmid-8832941.summary_ja: 小児5例に対して行った腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術の経験を報告した研究です。適応は卵巣捻転、良性奇形腫、充実成分を伴う奇形腫などでした。全例で腹腔鏡下に完遂され、平均2日で退院しています。乳児・小児でも実施可能で、回復が早く整容性にも優れると結論づけています。
pmid-8832941.summary_en: This report describes five children who underwent laparoscopic oophorectomy over one year, mainly for ovarian torsion, benign teratoma, or teratoma with a solid component. All procedures were completed laparoscopically, with two requiring enlargement of a trocar site for specimen removal. Patients were discharged after an average of two days. The authors conclude that laparoscopic oophorectomy is feasible and effective in infants and children, offering good visualization, rapid recovery, and cosmetic benefit.

pmid-8892196.summary_ja: 成人の前縦隔腫瘤128例について、胸部X線写真とCTによる組織診断の予測能を比較した。第一選択診断の正答率はX線写真36%、CT 48%であった。CTでは良性胚細胞腫瘍の診断精度が高かったが、縦隔腫瘤の複数の疾患群の一つとして扱われている。CTは胸部X線写真より優れるものの、確信をもった予測には限界があると結論づけた。
pmid-8892196.summary_en: This study compares chest radiography and CT in predicting histologic diagnoses of 128 adults with anterior mediastinal masses, with two observers ranking their top three diagnoses. The correct first-choice accuracy was 36% for radiographs and 48% for CT, and CT produced more high-confidence diagnoses. Benign germ cell tumors were among the entities most accurately diagnosed on CT, with all 10 cases correct. Discriminant radiographic and CT findings are identified. The authors conclude that CT is superior but still limited for confident prediction. Germ cell tumors form only one subgroup among several mediastinal entities.

pmid-8914805.summary_ja: HIV感染者におけるAIDS指標外の悪性腫瘍を概説した総説。胚細胞腫瘍とホジキン病は、一般人口より高頻度に報告されると指摘されている。胚細胞腫瘍は重点的に取り上げられた2疾患の1つだが、論文全体は多様な悪性腫瘍を扱っている。
pmid-8914805.summary_en: This review examines non-AIDS-defining malignancies in HIV-infected individuals. Germ cell tumors and Hodgkin's disease are highlighted as occurring more frequently than in the general population. Other reported cancers include lung cancer, skin squamous and basal cell carcinomas, anal carcinoma, and pediatric leiomyosarcoma. Germ cell tumors are one of two featured malignancies, but the paper covers a broad range of cancers rather than focusing on GCT specifically.

pmid-9017961.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘍18例に対し超音波ガイド下経皮的針生検を実施し、組織診断の有用性を検討した。生検診断は術後診断と89%で一致し、合併症は認められなかった。ジャーミノーマは5例含まれた。簡便かつ高精度で、縦隔鏡検査や開胸術に代わる安全な方法として外来患者にも有用と結論づけている。
pmid-9017961.summary_en: This study of 18 patients evaluates ultrasound-guided percutaneous needle biopsy for histological diagnosis of mediastinal tumors. Preoperative diagnoses included thymoma, germinoma (5 patients), neurogenic tumors and others. The biopsy diagnosis matched the postoperative diagnosis in 89% of patients, and no complications occurred. The authors conclude that this simple, accurate technique is a safe alternative to mediastinoscopy or thoracotomy, particularly suitable for outpatients.

pmid-9074245.summary_ja: 55例の卵巣嚢胞に対する腹腔鏡手術と経膣超音波検査の所見を組織診断と比較した。奇形腫は漿液性嚢胞などと並ぶ組織型の一つとして扱われた。超音波所見はすべて良性組織診断と一致し、術後合併症もなかった。良性卵巣嚢胞には腹腔鏡手術が適すると結論された。
pmid-9074245.summary_en: This study evaluated laparoscopic management of ovarian cysts and how well transvaginal ultrasound findings matched histologic diagnoses in 55 women. Teratoma was one of several histologic groups, alongside serous cysts and paraovarian cysts. All ultrasound evaluations agreed with benign histology, and no postoperative complications occurred. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is the preferred surgical approach for benign ovarian cysts.

pmid-10846534.summary_ja: 精巣摘除後にサーベイランスのみで管理した臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の58例を報告する。17例(29.3%)が再発し、多くは2〜18か月以内であった。再発患者はシスプラチンを基本とする化学療法で治療され、その後は疾患の所見を示さなかった。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢成分の欠如、陰嚢内侵襲は再発予測因子とならなかった。適切に選択され十分に協力する患者では、サーベイランスは安全で合理的な方針と結論している。
pmid-10846534.summary_en: This report describes 58 patients with clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis managed with a surveillance-only protocol after orchiectomy. Seventeen patients (29.3%) relapsed, typically within 2 to 18 months, and were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy with no later evidence of disease. Risk factors including embryonal carcinoma, absence of yolk sac elements, and scrotal violation did not predict relapse. Patients with elevated markers that declined slowly were prone to relapse. The authors conclude surveillance is safe in carefully selected, compliant patients.

pmid-11173571.summary_ja: 純粋セミノーマ31例を核画像細胞計測法でDNA倍数性解析し、長期予後と比較した。大多数は四倍体だったが、22.6%は異数体であった。一部の異数体例では血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇しており、形態学的所見がなくても非セミノーマへの移行が示唆された。異数体例は予後がやや不良だったが有意差はなく、より大規模な検討が必要とされる。
pmid-11173571.summary_en: This study analyzed DNA ploidy in 31 pure seminomas using nuclear image cytometry, with 5 to 10 years of follow-up. Most tumors were tetraploid, but 22.6% were aneuploid. Some aneuploid cases had elevated serum AFP, raising the possibility of nonseminomatous transformation without morphological evidence. Aneuploid tumors tended toward worse prognosis, though the difference was not statistically significant. The authors call for larger studies to confirm these findings.

pmid-11578456.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の原因妊娠が直前の正常分娩ではなく胞状奇胎であった症例を報告。保存された奇胎組織の短鎖反復配列(STR)多型をPCRで増幅し、両親および腫瘍DNAと比較して原因妊娠を確定した。絨毛癌が妊娠由来かどうかを分子遺伝学的手法で迅速に判定できることを示し、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の臨床管理に有用である。
pmid-11578456.summary_en: This report describes a choriocarcinoma case in which the causative pregnancy was a hydatidiform mole rather than the immediately preceding normal term pregnancy. Using PCR amplification of short tandem repeat polymorphisms from archived molar tissue, the authors compared DNA from the mole, parental samples and the tumor. This confirmed the mole as the causative pregnancy. The study highlights that molecular genetic methods can rapidly determine whether a choriocarcinoma is gestational and identify its causative pregnancy, which matters for clinical management of gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-11578458.summary_ja: 77歳女性で、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の内部に皮脂腺癌が生じた症例を報告。腹部膨満を主訴に子宮全摘・両側付属器切除・大網切除が行われた。まれな卵巣悪性腫瘍で挙動の報告が乏しく、治療経過とフォローアップを検討している。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化に関する限られた文献を補うものである。
pmid-11578458.summary_en: A 77-year-old woman with an ovarian mature cystic teratoma developed sebaceous cell carcinoma within it. Presenting with abdominal swelling, she underwent total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and omentectomy. The authors note that this rare form of ovarian malignancy has poorly documented behavior. They discuss the treatment and follow-up of this case, adding to the limited literature on malignant transformation of mature teratoma.

pmid-11578517.summary_ja: 17年間に治療された純粋悪性未熟卵巣奇形腫15例を検討。11例で術後化学療法、4例で救援治療として化学療法が行われた。セカンドルック開腹術を受けた8例中3例は腫瘍を認めなかった。死亡3例はいずれもGrade 3の未熟奇形腫であった。保存的手術とシスプラチン併用化学療法を基本とし、画像異常が残る場合はセカンドルック手術が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-11578517.summary_en: Fifteen patients with pure malignant immature ovarian teratoma treated over 17 years are reviewed. Chemotherapy was given as primary postoperative therapy in 11 patients and as salvage in 4. Second-look laparotomy in eight patients showed no tumor in three. Twelve patients remained disease-free after 24 to 228 months. All three deaths involved grade 3 immature teratoma. The authors conclude that conservative surgery plus cisplatin-based chemotherapy is appropriate, and second-look surgery is needed when radiologic abnormalities persist.

pmid-12114813.summary_ja: 45,X型ターナー症候群の2例の性腺組織でY染色体由来配列を検討。1例は大きなディスジャーミノーマを伴っていた。両例でSRYが検出され、もう1例では他のY特異的プローブも陽性だった。ターナー症候群と混合性性腺異形成は連続したスペクトラムの可能性があり、性腺腫瘍のリスク評価には前向きな検討が必要とされる。
pmid-12114813.summary_en: Gonadal tissue from two 45,X Turner syndrome patients was examined for Y chromosomal material. One patient had a large dysgerminoma and the other had clitoromegaly. SRY was detected by Southern blot in both. Other Y-specific probes were positive only in patient 2, and FISH was negative in patient 1 and rarely positive in patient 2. The authors suggest Turner syndrome and mixed gonadal dysgenesis may form a continuum and call for prospective study of Y material mosaicism and gonadal neoplasm risk.

pmid-16695981.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍21例(奇形腫12例、古典的セミノーマ9例)を対象にEBER in situハイブリダイゼーションを実施。全例でシグナルは検出されず、対照は陽性だった。EBVが精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症に直接関与する可能性は低いと結論づけられた。疫学・血清学的関連の説明には別の要因の検討が必要とされる。
pmid-16695981.summary_en: Twenty-one germ cell tumours, including 12 teratomas and nine classic seminomas, were examined by in situ hybridisation for Epstein-Barr virus-encoded RNA (EBER-1 and -2). No EBER signal was detected in any tumour, though control sections stained strongly. The authors conclude that a direct pathogenic role for EBV in testicular germ cell tumours is unlikely. They suggest that the epidemiological and serological associations between EBV and germ cell tumours require other explanations.

pmid-16695997.summary_ja: ヒト多能性奇形腫由来のTera 2細胞(胎児性癌型モデル)で、血清除去によるアポトーシスとそれに対するIGF-IIの抑制作用を検討。c-mycの発現はアポトーシス開始と並行して低下しなかった。セミノーマと胎児性癌ではインスリン様成長因子が上昇しているとも報告。IGF-IIの抗アポトーシス作用が生体内での腫瘍促進作用を説明する可能性がある。
pmid-16695997.summary_en: The authors studied the human pluripotent teratoma line Tera 2, an embryonal carcinoma-type model. Serum withdrawal induced apoptosis, with nuclear fragmentation at 12 hours and a nucleosome ladder. IGF-II counteracted this apoptotic response, while c-myc expression did not fall in parallel. The paper also reports raised insulin-like growth factor levels in human seminoma and embryonal carcinoma. The authors suggest IGF-II's anti-apoptotic effect may explain its tumor-promoting actions in vivo.

pmid-21224112.summary_ja: 17歳男性の後腹膜絨毛癌・肺転移例。DMP 840を4コース投与し、原発巣と肺転移の縮小が得られた。手術後8か月時点で再発はなく、胚細胞腫瘍患者におけるDMP 840のさらなる評価が示唆されている。
pmid-21224112.summary_en: A 17-year-old male with retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma and pulmonary metastases received four courses of DMP 840, with shrinkage of both the primary tumor and lung metastases. Serum β-hCG was normal before resection of the necrotic primary tumor and one remaining necrotic pulmonary metastasis. The patient remained free of recurrence eight months after surgery. The authors suggest further evaluation of DMP 840 in patients with germ cell tumors.

pmid-21556551.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍3例の細胞遺伝学的解析。3例に共通する異常はなく、成人で多い12p獲得とは異なり、小児では1q獲得などの不均衡な再構成が多いことを報告している。
pmid-21556551.summary_en: The authors performed cytogenetic analysis of three pediatric germ cell tumors: a mediastinal mature teratoma with a balanced t(8;22), an intrathoracic immature teratoma with a complex karyotype, and a congenital presacral endodermal sinus tumor. No aberration was shared among these tumors or among 13 previously reported pediatric cases. Recurrent changes included gain of 1q, 8q, and 12p, and loss of distal 1p, 7q22-32, and others. Pediatric karyotypes appear more heterogeneous than adult karyotypes, which are dominated by 12p gain.

pmid-21556569.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌JAR細胞において、ボンベシン/GRP拮抗薬RC-3095およびRC-3940-IIは用量・時間依存的に増殖を抑制した。RC-3940-IIの方が強力で、cAMP低下を伴うことから細胞内cAMP経路の関与が示唆されている。
pmid-21556569.summary_en: Bombesin/GRP antagonists RC-3095 and RC-3940-II were tested on JAR human choriocarcinoma cells in vitro. Both inhibited proliferation in a dose- and time-dependent manner, with RC-3940-II more potent than RC-3095. JAR cells bound bombesin, and the antagonists decreased medium cAMP by 70-80%. The authors suggest the antiproliferative effect may involve the intracellular cAMP pathway.

pmid-21556626.summary_ja: JAR絨毛癌細胞に対するLH-RHおよびその拮抗薬セトロレリクスの作用を検討。両者とも増殖を抑制し、拮抗薬はhCGとcAMP産生を低下させた。絨毛癌に対するホルモン療法の可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-21556626.summary_en: The effects of LH-RH and its antagonist cetrorelix (SE-75) were examined on JAR choriocarcinoma cells. Both inhibited growth, and the combined effects depended on LH-RH dose. The antagonist reduced hCG and cAMP release, with a larger effect on cAMP. Low-affinity LH-RH receptors were identified on JAR cells. The authors suggest that cetrorelix-based hormonal therapy could be considered for developing new approaches to treating choriocarcinoma.

pmid-21597681.summary_ja: 精巣女性化症候群患者の卵黄嚢腫瘍・セミノーマ由来の新規胚細胞腫瘍細胞株を樹立。倍加時間は36.1時間、染色体数の最頻値は102。メトトレキサートとアクチノマイシンDの効果を検討した。
pmid-21597681.summary_en: The authors established and characterized a new cell line from a tumor in a patient with testicular feminization syndrome, an endodermal sinus tumor with seminoma. The line had a doubling time of 36.1 hours and a modal chromosome number of 102. MTT assays showed sensitivity to methotrexate and actinomycin D. Methotrexate effects were schedule dependent, while actinomycin D effects were both schedule and dose dependent.

pmid-21597786.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍30例のGST-pi発現を免疫組織化学で検討。組織型により発現が異なり、セミノーマと成熟奇形腫で強い染色がみられた。病期や治療反応との相関は認められなかった。
pmid-21597786.summary_en: The authors used immunohistochemistry to examine glutathione S-transferase pi (GST-pi) expression in 30 primary testicular germ cell tumors, including 12 pure seminomas and 18 mixed GCTs. Expression varied across histologic components and between examples of the same type. Seminomas and mature teratomas showed the strongest staining, and choriocarcinoma was negative in its only case. Staining showed no apparent correlation with stage or therapy response.

pmid-21597787.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた76か月後に、精巣がんの晩期再発を生じた症例報告である。左閉鎖窩の嚢胞性腫瘤が見つかり、腫瘍マーカーは正常だったが、穿刺液からαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が検出された。組織学的に分化型奇形腫で、完全外科的切除が行われた。著者らは、化学療法後の精巣がんの晩期再発の頻度、予後不良性、臨床的意義について考察した。
pmid-21597787.summary_en: The authors report a patient with late relapse of testicular cancer, histologically a differentiated teratoma, 76 months after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell cancer. A cystic left obturator fossa mass was found with normal tumor markers, and AFP was detected in fluid aspirate. Complete surgical resection was performed. The paper reviews the incidence, poor prognosis, and clinical implications of late relapses after chemotherapy for testicular cancer.

pmid-21597797.summary_ja: 絨毛癌JAr細胞のアロマターゼ活性に対するカルシウムの作用を検討。カルシウムイオノフォアは細胞内芳香化を最大75%抑制し、遊離Ca2+は膜画分の酵素活性を非競合的に阻害した。細胞内カルシウム上昇がエストロゲン産生を調節し、絨毛癌の増殖制御につながる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21597797.summary_en: The authors examined how calcium regulates aromatase activity in JAr choriocarcinoma cells. Calcium ionophore A23187 reduced cellular aromatization by up to 75%. In microsomal fractions, free Ca2+ noncompetitively inhibited aromatase, with about 50% maximal inhibition. The findings suggest that increased intracellular calcium modulates estrogen production by JAr cells and may offer a means of controlling choriocarcinoma proliferation.

pmid-21597850.summary_ja: LT/Svマウスに生後16日目にシスプラチンを投与し、卵巣奇形腫の発生と移植性を対照群と比較。対照群では移植可能な奇形腫が7例みられたのに対し、投与群では移植不能な腫瘍が2例のみだった。
pmid-21597850.summary_en: The authors examined the incidence and transplantability of ovarian teratomas in LT/Sv mice after cisplatin treatment at 16 days of age, compared with controls. Cisplatin did not affect egg cleavage. Seven transplantable teratomas developed in control mice over 30 days, whereas only two non-transplantable tumors arose in treated mice by 120 days. The authors suggest cisplatin may affect tumorigenesis after egg cleavage or the transplantability of teratoma.

pmid-7473436.summary_ja: 1991〜1993年に単一施設で手術された良性嚢胞性奇形腫20例を対象に、腹腔鏡手術と開腹手術を後方視的に比較した。腹腔鏡下手術は入院期間と費用を減らす一方、手術時間は長かった。妊孕性の希望に応じて嚢腫摘出術と卵巣摘出術を選択し、重大な合併症は認められなかった。腹腔鏡下手術は妥当な選択肢と結論づけられている。
pmid-7473436.summary_en: This retrospective case series compared laparoscopic and laparotomy approaches for surgical management of benign cystic teratomas in 20 patients treated at one hospital from 1991 to 1993. Eight underwent laparoscopy and twelve laparotomy. Laparoscopic oophorectomy and cystectomy were associated with shorter hospital stays and lower costs, though operative time was longer. Fertility status guided the choice between cystectomy and oophorectomy. No serious complications occurred, including with intraperitoneal spill. The authors conclude that laparoscopic oophorectomy and cystectomy are reasonable options.

pmid-7474580.summary_ja: 28歳男性の縦隔腫瘍で、未熟奇形腫と絨毛癌の混在が剖検で確認された症例。化学療法後に上前縦隔の腫瘍を切除したが、術後も化学療法を繰り返した。その後hCGが再上昇し、胸部X線で両肺に転移影を認めた。肺転移巣はすべて絨毛癌成分のみであった。
pmid-7474580.summary_en: This autopsy report describes a 28-year-old Japanese man with a mediastinal tumor combining immature teratoma and choriocarcinoma. The superior-anterior mediastinal tumor was removed after chemotherapy. Chemotherapy was repeated after surgery, but serum hCG rose again and chest radiographs showed metastatic shadows in both lungs. Autopsy showed that the pulmonary metastases consisted only of the choriocarcinoma component. The case illustrates the aggressive course of mixed mediastinal germ cell tumors with choriocarcinoma elements.

pmid-7474604.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍45例と正常精巣10例で、PCNA免疫染色とAgNOR銀染色による増殖能を評価し、臨床経過と比較した。PCNA陽性率は原発巣の増殖速度と相関した。病期Iの非セミノーマで経過観察を行った10例のうち、PCNA陽性率75%超の6例中4例が再発した一方、75%未満の4例では再発はなかった。PCNAが再発予測に有用と結論している。
pmid-7474604.summary_en: This study assessed proliferative activity in 45 testicular tumors (seminomas and non-seminomas) using PCNA immunohistochemistry and AgNOR silver staining, comparing results with 10 normal testes and with clinical course. PCNA positivity was highest in non-seminomas and correlated with the growth rate of the primary tumor. Among stage I non-seminoma patients under surveillance, four of six with PCNA above 75% relapsed, while none of four below that threshold did. The authors conclude PCNA reflects growth potential better than AgNOR and may predict relapse.

pmid-7474641.summary_ja: 27歳男性で血尿を契機に前立腺生検を行い、当初は横紋筋肉腫と診断され骨盤内臓全摘術を受けた。3年後に胸部X線で肺の結節が見つかり、左精巣の胎児性癌と肺転移と診断された。胎盤型ALP染色の陽性から前立腺病変はセミノーマと再診断された。PVB療法後20か月再発なく生存している。前立腺原発セミノーマの初例と述べている。
pmid-7474641.summary_en: A 27-year-old man presented with hematuria and was initially diagnosed with prostatic rhabdomyosarcoma, undergoing pelvic exenteration and chemotherapy. Three years later, chest radiographs revealed lung nodules, and the left testicular tumor was diagnosed as embryonal carcinoma with pulmonary metastasis. Placental-type ALP staining led to re-diagnosis of the prostatic lesion as seminoma. The patient received PVB chemotherapy and remained free of recurrence 20 months later. The authors report what they believe is the first case of primary prostatic seminoma.

pmid-7474934.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍31例で32座位を解析し、ヘテロ接合性の消失（LOH）とアレル不均衡を検討した。2q、3p、3q、11p、12p、18q、22qで高頻度に認められ、複数の癌抑制遺伝子の不活化が示唆された。TP53は変異を認めなかったが、免疫染色で14例中9例が陽性であった。マイクロサテライト不安定性は認めなかった。
pmid-7474934.summary_en: This study analyzed 32 loci across 31 primary testicular germ cell tumors for loss of heterozygosity and allelic imbalance, and examined TP53 mutations and expression, Ki-67 proliferation, and microsatellite instability. Frequent LOH or allelic imbalance was found at 2q, 3p, 3q, 11p, 12p, 18q and 22q, consistent with inactivation of several tumor suppressor genes. No TP53 hot-spot mutations were detected, although 9 of 14 tumors showed TP53 immunopositivity. Microsatellite instability was absent. The 12p gain likely reflects i(12p), and TP53 does not appear to play a major pathogenic role.

pmid-7483018.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の類内膜様亜型で、カルチノイド巣を伴う稀な症例を電子顕微鏡で解析した報告。この亜型は既報が9例のみである。主成分は類内膜癌に類似した腺上皮、少量の腸型粘液性腺癌、神経内分泌細胞を認めた。電子顕微鏡は光学顕微鏡や免疫組織化学を補完しうると結論付けている。
pmid-7483018.summary_en: The authors describe an endometrioid-like variant of ovarian yolk sac tumor with foci of carcinoid, a rare neoplasm previously reported in only nine cases. Electron microscopy was used to characterize the tumor, which showed glandular cells resembling endometrioid adenocarcinoma, a minor component of intestinal-type mucinous adenocarcinoma with microvilli, and neuroendocrine cells with dense-core granules. The study suggests electron microscopy can supplement light microscopy and immunohistochemistry in diagnosing this yolk sac tumor variant.

pmid-7483019.summary_ja: 妊娠19週に発見された10cmの左卵巣腫瘤が、篩状の基底細胞型（単形性）唾液腺腺腫と診断された症例報告。奇形腫や胚細胞腫瘍の成分は認めなかった。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の唾液腺型組織が由来と考えられている。妊娠は順調に満期まで経過し、診断10か月後も無症状。卵巣発生の唾液腺型腫瘍として初の報告とされる。
pmid-7483019.summary_en: A 26-year-old pregnant woman had a 10-cm left ovarian mass, found at 19 weeks gestation, that proved to be a cribriform basal cell (monomorphic) salivary adenoma. No teratomatous or germ cell tumor elements were present. The authors suggest the lesion arose from salivary-type tissue within a mature cystic teratoma. Pregnancy continued to term uneventfully, and the patient was symptom-free 10 months after diagnosis. This is thought to be the first reported salivary-type neoplasm arising in the ovary.

pmid-7490797.summary_ja: 起源不明の卵黄嚢腫瘍が頭蓋内および脊髄に転移した6歳男児の症例報告。尿閉と対麻痺で発症し、画像では第3腰椎以下の髄腔内腫瘍と側頭部・小脳の病変を認めた。松果体部と性腺には異常がなかった。手術と放射線療法を行ったが、術後3か月で再発し死亡した。原発巣は特定されなかった。
pmid-7490797.summary_en: This case report describes a 6-year-old boy with a yolk sac tumor of unknown origin that had spread to the intracranial and spinal regions. He presented with urinary retention and paraparesis. Imaging showed an intrathecal tumor below L3 plus temporal and cerebellar lesions, while the pineal region and gonads were normal. Surgery and postoperative radiotherapy were given, and histology confirmed metastatic yolk sac tumor. Multiple seeding recurred, and the patient died of recurrent tumor and pneumonia three months after surgery. The primary site was never identified.

pmid-7492382.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者において、血清乳酸脱水素酵素アイソエンザイム1(S-LD-1)が再発の早期指標となるかを検討。27例を経時的に評価し、7例では再発検出の中央値2か月前にS-LD-1が上昇していた。S-LD-1はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と併用する有用な指標とされる。
pmid-7492382.summary_en: This study evaluated serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 (S-LD-1) as an early indicator of relapse in testicular germ cell tumor patients. Twenty-seven patients, nine with seminoma and 18 with nonseminomatous tumors, had repeated measurements from diagnosis to relapse. Of 21 patients with relapse, eleven had raised S-LD-1. Seven of all 27 patients had elevated levels a median of two months before clinical detection. The authors conclude that S-LD-1 complements clinical examination, AFP and hCG measurement, and CT scanning for monitoring relapse.

pmid-7492383.summary_ja: 血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇を示す109例について、免疫電気泳動による鑑別診断を検討。卵黄嚢腫瘍では顕著なL2バンドが認められ、肝細胞癌ではL1バンドが優位であった。妊娠時のパターンは肝細胞癌に類似していた。AFPの由来を区別する有用な方法と結論づけている。
pmid-7492383.summary_en: This study used immunoelectrophoresis of alpha-fetoprotein to distinguish the origins of elevated serum AFP. It analyzed 109 patients, including eight with yolk sac tumor, along with hepatocellular carcinoma, gastric cancer, chronic hepatitis, and normal pregnancy. Each condition produced a characteristic pattern. Yolk sac tumor showed a prominent L2 band, hepatocellular carcinoma a prominent L1 band, gastric cancer only L1, and chronic hepatitis a light L1 band with a prominent L3 band. Pregnancy resembled hepatocellular carcinoma. The method helps differentiate the sources of AFP.

pmid-7498038.summary_ja: 1972年から1991年にナイジェリア・ザリアの施設で治療された、1日齢から10歳までの小児奇形腫88例を後方視的に検討した。仙尾部が53%と最も多く、性腺由来は19%で、大半が卵巣由来であった。悪性率は9%で、血清AFPは測定された悪性例で上昇していた。
pmid-7498038.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 88 teratomas of diverse sites in children aged one day to 10 years, treated at a Zaria, Nigeria institution between 1972 and 1991. Sacrococcygeal teratomas were most common (53%), followed by gonadal tumors (19%), mostly ovarian. Sex ratios varied by site, and 61 patients were infants. Malignancy occurred in 9% of cases, mostly sacrococcygeal and ovarian. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was not consistently measured but was elevated in malignant cases where it was tested.

pmid-7498039.summary_ja: 1979年から1983年にラゴス大学教育病院で精巣腫瘍8例を前向きに検討した。平均年齢は32.7歳で、4例が胚細胞腫瘍（胎児性癌、セミノーマ、未分化悪性奇形腫）、4例が非胚細胞腫瘍であった。ナイジェリアの報告発生率は10万人あたり年0.1と最も低いことが再確認された。
pmid-7498039.summary_en: This prospective study of eight patients with testicular tumors was conducted at the Urology Unit of Lagos University Teaching Hospital from 1979 to 1983. The mean age was 32.7 years. Four patients had germ cell tumors: embryonal carcinoma (25%), seminoma (12.5%), and undifferentiated malignant teratoma (12.5%). The other four had non-germ cell tumors, including paratesticular sarcomas. The authors reaffirm that testicular tumors are rare in Black patients and that Nigeria has the lowest reported incidence, at 0.1 per 100,000 per year.

pmid-7498177.summary_ja: セミノーマの腫瘍マーカー候補である胚細胞特異的アルカリフォスファターゼ（GCAP）を、胎盤型（PLAP）と分離する二次元電気泳動法を報告した。両者は98%の配列相同性を持ち、特異抗体がないため従来はGCAPだけを測定できなかった。シグモイド型pH勾配による分離と、組織抽出物の精製法も示された。
pmid-7498177.summary_en: The authors address the germ-cell-specific alkaline phosphatase isoenzyme (GCAP) as a potential seminoma tumor marker. GCAP is 98% homologous to placental ALP (PLAP), and no specific antibody has been produced, so GCAP cannot be measured in the presence of PLAP. They show that two-dimensional electrophoresis with a sigmoid immobilized pH gradient of 3 to 10 separates the two isoenzymes and their phenotypic variants. Because malignant transformation alters glycosylation, the method is of interest. They also present a chromatographic purification method for raw tissue extracts.

pmid-7499580.summary_ja: 23歳男性で、皮膚転移を初発とした絨毛癌を報告。皮膚生検では合胞体栄養膜細胞がhCGに強陽性を示した。精査で精巣腫瘍と肺・脳・肝・腎への転移が判明し、血清hCGも上昇していた。化学療法にもかかわらず、診断直後に死亡した。
pmid-7499580.summary_en: This case report describes choriocarcinoma presenting as a cutaneous metastasis in a 23-year-old man. Biopsy showed two cell populations, syncytiotrophoblasts strongly positive for human chorionic gonadotropin, and cytotrophoblasts. Subsequent evaluation revealed a testicular tumor with metastases to the lungs, brain, liver, and kidney, along with elevated serum hCG. Despite chemotherapy, the patient died shortly after diagnosis from complications of metastatic disease.

pmid-7500433.summary_ja: 胎児の顔面腫瘤10例の超音波所見と予後を検討。死亡例のうち3例は頭蓋内奇形腫で、いずれも致死的であった。頭蓋外病変の死亡は7例中1例であった。羊水過多は予後不良と関連していた。
pmid-7500433.summary_en: The authors review ten fetuses with facial masses diagnosed by antenatal ultrasound over six years. Four died, including three with intracranial teratomas, which were uniformly fatal. Among fetuses with extracranial masses, one of seven died. Survivors underwent neonatal excision of teratomas of the nose, thyroid, and palate or other lesions. Polyhydramnios was associated with poor outcome. The study shows that the prognosis of fetal facial masses depends largely on their location and the presence of polyhydramnios.

pmid-7500863.summary_ja: 37歳男性が、未診断の精巣胚細胞腫瘍による肺腫瘍塞栓で突然死した症例。腫瘍は下大静脈に浸潤しており、若年の健康な成人ではまれな死因である。文献上の類似症例4例もレビューされ、若年男性の突然死の法医学的評価では胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきことが示されている。
pmid-7500863.summary_en: A 37-year-old man died suddenly from pulmonary tumour embolism caused by an undiagnosed testicular germ cell tumour. The tumour had invaded the inferior vena cava, a mechanism of death that is rare in young, apparently healthy adults. The authors describe this unusual case of sudden unexpected death and review four previously reported cases with a similar mechanism. The report highlights that undiagnosed germ cell tumours can present as sudden death and should be considered in forensic evaluation of young males.

pmid-7502125.summary_ja: 22歳男性の精巣悪性奇形腫(非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍)の症例。術前の超音波検査で診断が示唆された。神経温存型のテンプレート後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行し、切除標本に顕微鏡的な転移は認められなかった。術前の超音波検査が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断に有用であることを示す症例報告。
pmid-7502125.summary_en: A 22-year-old man was diagnosed with a malignant teratoma of the testicle, a nonseminomatous germ cell tumour, after preoperative ultrasonography suggested the diagnosis. He underwent modified template retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy with nerve sparing. Pathological examination showed no microscopic metastatic tumour in the resected nodes. The report illustrates the value of ultrasonography in identifying testicular germ cell tumours before surgery, and the role of nerve-sparing template dissection in staging with preserved function.

pmid-7502431.summary_ja: 生後7か月男児の腹腔内停留精巣に生じた精巣奇形腫の捻転例。文献検索で思春期前の停留精巣胚細胞腫瘍14例を集めた。半数が腹腔内精巣由来で、いずれも捻転を伴っていた。組織型は奇形腫が最多で、思春期後の症例とは組織型が異なる。予後は良好とされるが、過小報告の可能性が指摘されている。
pmid-7502431.summary_en: A 7-month-old male infant presented with torsion of an intra-abdominal cryptorchid testis, and pathology confirmed a testicular teratoma. The authors reviewed MEDLINE and bibliographies to identify 14 prepubertal cryptorchid germ cell neoplasms. Half arose in an abdominal testis, all of which were associated with torsion, and teratoma was the most common histology. These tumours differ histologically from post-pubertal cases. Outcome appeared good, although follow-up was incompletely reported, and the authors suggest these lesions are underreported.

pmid-7502438.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の若年男性で、下大静脈から右心系へ進展する腫瘍栓と硬膜外脊髄圧迫を認めた。塞栓リスクが高いため、人工心肺と低体温循環停止下で腫瘍栓摘出術を施行し、その後全身化学療法を行った。周術期合併症はなく、24か月後も再発なく生存している。
pmid-7502438.summary_en: A young man with advanced nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumour had tumour thrombus extending from the inferior vena cava into the right heart, with a free-floating thrombus in the right ventricle and epidural spinal cord compression. Because of high embolization risk and the urgent need for systemic therapy, he underwent tumour thrombectomy with cardiopulmonary bypass and hypothermic circulatory arrest, followed by systemic chemotherapy. He had no perioperative complications and remained alive without recurrence 24 months after four cycles of chemotherapy.

pmid-7528272.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対しプラチナ併用化学療法を受けた183例で、早期の血清腫瘍マーカー(αフェトプロテイン(AFP)・hCG)の半減期を解析した。半減期延長は両マーカーとも約35%に認められた。しかし初回治療後の再発や進行の予測能は低く、長期予後の指標としても不十分と結論された。
pmid-7528272.summary_en: This analysis of 183 patients receiving platinum-based chemotherapy for germ cell tumours examined whether early regression rates of serum AFP and beta-hCG predict outcome. Prolonged marker half-life was observed in about 35% of patients for each marker. However, it did not identify relapse after first-line therapy, and its positive predictive value for progression was only about 18 to 20%. A prolonged half-life was associated with higher mortality, but its positive predictive value was only 23%, so early marker half-life is a poor guide to prognosis.

pmid-7529130.summary_ja: セミノーマまたは非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者29例で、治療後中央値31か月のNK細胞活性とADCCを測定した。BEP併用化学療法群はカルボプラチン単剤群に比べNK細胞活性が低下していたが、細胞数は変化せず、時間経過とともに正常化した。非セミノーマ例では初診時の転移が持続的なNK細胞活性の亢進と関連した。
pmid-7529130.summary_en: Natural killer cell activity and antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity were measured in 29 long-term survivors of seminoma or nonseminomatous germ cell tumour, a median of 31 months after treatment. Patients given BEP polychemotherapy showed reduced NK cell activity compared with those given carboplatin monotherapy, although NK cell numbers were unaffected. This reduction was time-dependent and normalized over time. Initial metastases in nonseminomatous patients were associated with persistently stimulated NK cell activity. The authors conclude that chemotherapy caused a transient functional defect rather than lasting immune compromise.

pmid-7529338.summary_ja: 正常およびがん化した精巣組織でc-kitとそのリガンドSCFの発現を検討した。正常では胚細胞にc-kit、セルトリ細胞にSCFが認められ、精子形成の局所的な栄養調節系が示唆された。精巣胚細胞腫瘍では、c-kitはセミノーマで発現し、非セミノーマでは発現しなかった。
pmid-7529338.summary_en: The expression of the c-kit proto-oncogene and its ligand stem cell factor was studied in normal and malignant human testicular tissue by Northern blot and immunohistochemistry. c-kit was detected in normal germ cells and SCF in Sertoli cells, suggesting a local trophic regulatory system in spermatogenesis. In testicular germ cell tumours, c-kit expression was found in seminoma but not in nonseminoma. SCF mRNA was not detected in either subtype, although rare tumour cells showed cytoplasmic SCF protein. The findings point to a possible role of c-kit signalling in certain germ cell tumour subtypes.

pmid-7529524.summary_ja: 著者らは、マウス原始生殖細胞を支持する培養条件をヒトのセミノーマ21例に適用した。大半の腫瘍は接着が乏しくday 10を超えて生存しなかったが、2例は25～30日間の初期増殖と生存を示した。ある細胞株では、幹細胞因子が初期のコロニー形成に必要かつ十分であり、血清含有培地で細胞数が増加した。しかし、セミノーマ細胞は多能性幹細胞へ再プログラムされなかった。著者らは、セミノーマはマウス原始生殖細胞とは異なる不均一な集団を形成すると結論づけている。
pmid-7529524.summary_en: The authors applied culture conditions that support murine primordial germ cells to 21 human seminomas. Most tumours attached poorly and did not survive beyond day 10, but two showed initial proliferation and survival for 25 to 30 days. In one line, stem cell factor was necessary and sufficient for early colony formation, and cell numbers rose in serum-containing medium. However, the seminoma cells did not reprogram into pluripotent stem cells. The authors conclude that seminomas form a heterogeneous population unlike murine primordial germ cells.

pmid-7529741.summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対するEMA/CO療法にG-CSFを併用した3症例の報告である。各周期の特定日にG-CSFを皮下投与した。有害事象は認められず、全例が治療遅延なく全用量の化学療法を受けられた。G-CSFの併用は用量強度の維持に有用である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-7529741.summary_en: This report describes using granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF) to support EMA/CO chemotherapy, a regimen for high-risk gestational trophoblastic disease, in three patients. G-CSF was given on specified days of each cycle. No adverse effects were observed, and all patients received full chemotherapy doses without treatment delays. The authors suggest that adding G-CSF may help maintain dose intensity in high-risk gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-7531223.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍(病期分類で軽度～中等度)の178例を対象に、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる3サイクル療法へのブレオマイシン追加の有無を比較した無作為化試験である。ブレオマイシン併用群で治療失敗が少なく、全生存期間も有意に良好であった。このような症例では、ブレオマイシンは不可欠な要素と結論された。
pmid-7531223.summary_en: This randomized ECOG trial compared three cycles of cisplatin plus etoposide with or without bleomycin in 178 patients with minimal- or moderate-stage disseminated germ cell tumors. Patients receiving bleomycin had fewer treatment failures, including persistent carcinoma in resected residual disease and relapses from complete remission. Failure-free and overall survival were significantly higher with bleomycin. The authors conclude that bleomycin is an essential component of three-cycle PVP16B therapy for these patients.

pmid-7531835.summary_ja: まず絨毛癌細胞でG-CSFの増殖促進作用がないことを確認した。次に侵入奇胎22例と絨毛癌9例に併用化学療法を行い、白血球数が2,000/mm3未満になった時点でG-CSFを投与した。好中球減少期間は3～4日短縮し、副作用は認められなかった。妊娠性絨毛性疾患における化学療法の補助療法としての安全性と有用性が示された。
pmid-7531835.summary_en: The authors first tested human G-CSF on choriocarcinoma cells in vitro and found no growth-stimulating effect. They then treated 22 patients with invasive mole and 9 with choriocarcinoma receiving combination chemotherapy, giving G-CSF when white cell counts fell below 2,000/mm3. G-CSF shortened neutropenia by 3 to 4 days without side effects. The findings support its safety and usefulness as a chemotherapy adjunct in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-7533544.summary_ja: 原発性セミノーマ型胚細胞腫瘍に対する多剤併用化学療法の13か月後に、急性単球性白血病を発症した若年患者の症例である。前駆症状のない急激な発症で、免疫グロブリン重鎖遺伝子の再構成と細胞質内免疫グロブリンの発現を認めた。潜伏期間の短さからポドフィロトキシン関連白血病に類似し、治療関連の二次性悪性腫瘍が示唆される。
pmid-7533544.summary_en: A young patient developed acute monocytic leukemia 13 months after receiving multidrug chemotherapy for primary seminomatous germ cell tumor. The leukemia had an abrupt onset without prodrome and showed immunoglobulin heavy-chain gene rearrangement with cytoplasmic immunoglobulin expression. The short latency and presentation resemble podophyllotoxin-related leukemias, suggesting a treatment-related secondary malignancy after germ cell tumor therapy.

pmid-7534118.summary_ja: 組織学的に未熟奇形腫と分類された悪性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍2例を染色体解析した。両例とも擬二倍体核型で複雑な構造異常を示したが、12p由来の異常は認めなかった。共通の切断点を持つことから、成人の性腺外未熟奇形腫の新たな病型として提唱された。後腹膜や後縦隔に発生し、血行性転移をきたしやすいとされる。
pmid-7534118.summary_en: Two malignant extragonadal germ cell tumors, classified histologically as immature teratomas, were analyzed by karyotyping and chromosome painting. Both had pseudodiploid karyotypes with complex rearrangements but lacked 12p involvement, and shared breakpoints at 6p21, 6p22, 6q23 and 11q13. The authors propose these as a new entity of extragonadal immature teratomas in adults, which may arise in the retroperitoneum or posterior mediastinum and metastasize hematogenously.

pmid-7534740.summary_ja: 薬剤抵抗性絨毛癌の患者26例にPEBA療法(シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン、アドリアマイシン)を行った報告である。必要に応じて子宮摘出や放射線療法を併用した。完全寛解は96.2%で、73.1%が1年以上持続した。再発は7例にみられた。副作用は中等度で許容範囲であり、薬剤抵抗性絨毛癌に最適なレジメンと考察された。
pmid-7534740.summary_en: This study reports 26 patients with drug-resistant choriocarcinoma treated with the PEBA regimen (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin and adriamycin), with radiotherapy or surgery as needed. Complete remission was achieved in 96.2% of patients, and 73.1% remained in sustained remission for at least one year, although seven patients relapsed. Side effects were moderate and tolerable. The authors consider PEBA an optimal regimen for drug-resistant choriocarcinoma.

pmid-7534839.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘤とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、LDHの高値を示した20歳男性の症例である。針生検で原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍が疑われた。シスプラチン、VP-16、ブレオマイシン、アドリアマイシンによる3コースの併用化学療法の後、根治的な外科的切除を施行した。術後病理では完全壊死が確認され、6か月間再発は認めなかった。化学療法と外科的切除により治療に成功した症例である。
pmid-7534839.summary_en: A 20-year-old man with a mediastinal mass and elevated serum AFP and LDH underwent needle biopsy suggesting primary mediastinal germ cell tumor. After three courses of cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin and adriamycin, curative resection was performed. Postoperative histology showed total necrosis. He remained free of recurrence for six months. The case shows successful treatment of a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor with chemotherapy followed by surgery.

pmid-7535083.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍100例（セミノーマ40例、非セミノーマ60例）のN-RAS・KRAS変異を解析した研究。コドン12などで計6例（セミノーマ5例、非セミノーマ1例）に変異を検出し、感度を高めた解析で1例が追加された。変異頻度は低く、腫瘍の発生や進展に必須ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-7535083.summary_en: This study examined N- and KRAS mutations in codons 12, 13, and 61 in 100 snap-frozen primary testicular germ cell tumors (40 seminomas, 60 nonseminomatous). Mutations were found in six tumors (five seminomas, one nonseminomatous), all in codon 12. A more sensitive KRAS-enriched PCR assay on seminomas detected one additional mutation. Given discordant prior reports, the authors concluded that RAS mutations are rare and apparently not essential for the initiation or progression of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-7535510.summary_ja: 縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍が分泌するヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)により思春期早発を来した、モザイク型クラインフェルター症候群の男児の症例報告。腫瘍摘出後も思春期の発来が続き、治療後に自然停止した。著者らは、思春期早発や精巣の正常発育を示すクラインフェルター症候群の男性に、β-hCGやαフェトプロテイン(AFP)などの腫瘍マーカーによるスクリーニングを勧めている。
pmid-7535510.summary_en: A boy with mosaic Klinefelter syndrome developed precocious puberty caused by chorionic gonadotropin secreted by a mediastinal germ cell tumor. After tumor removal, he had spontaneous precocious sexual development that was treated and later arrested spontaneously. Investigation of the arrested puberty revealed mosaic Klinefelter syndrome. The authors note this is the first reported mosaic Klinefelter case with a mediastinal germ cell tumor and recommend screening males with Klinefelter syndrome and early puberty or normal testicular growth using germ cell tumor markers.

pmid-7536027.summary_ja: 1979～1992年にエトポシド含有化学療法を受けた男性胚細胞腫瘍患者679例中6例が急性骨髄性白血病を発症し、相対リスクは150であった。発症までの期間の中央値は27か月。著者らは、中間リスクおよび高リスクの患者ではエトポシド含有療法の利益が危険性を上回るとし、予後良好な患者では非エトポシド療法の検討を勧めている。
pmid-7536027.summary_en: This study of 679 men with germ cell cancer treated with etoposide-containing chemotherapy between 1979 and 1992 found that six developed acute myeloid leukemia, a relative risk of 150. None had a primary mediastinal tumor, and only one had prior radiotherapy. The median interval from treatment to leukemia was 27 months, and FAB M4 morphology was common. The authors conclude that etoposide-containing protocols still benefit patients with intermediate or high risk disease, but non-etoposide protocols should be explored for good-risk disease.

pmid-7537800.summary_ja: インディアナ大学で1979～1992年に治療された、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発患者81例の後方視的研究。完全寛解後2年以上経過して再発した症例を対象とした。外科的切除により無病生存を得た症例が多く、化学療法の奏効は限定的であった。著者らは晩期再発が想定より多いとし、生涯にわたる年1回のフォローアップを勧めている。
pmid-7537800.summary_en: This review analyzed 81 patients treated at Indiana University between 1979 and 1992 for late relapse of testicular germ cell cancer, defined as relapse more than two years after completing treatment. Surgery produced most continuous disease-free survivors, while chemotherapy achieved complete responses in 26% but durable disease-free survival in only two patients. Late relapse is more common than previously thought, and the authors recommend lifelong annual follow-up for patients treated for testicular germ cell cancer.

pmid-7537801.summary_ja: 6つの研究グループの556例の個々のデータを用いて、著者らは転移性NSGCTに対する化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘤の組織型(壊死、成熟奇形腫、癌)を予測するロジスティック回帰モデルを構築した。壊死が最も多く(45%)、予測因子には原発腫瘍での奇形腫成分の欠如、正常なAFPおよびhCG、LDH上昇、化学療法中の腫瘤縮小が含まれた。モデルは壊死をよく識別したが、癌と成熟奇形腫の識別は中程度にとどまった。検証された予測は、切除とフォローアップの選択の判断に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-7537801.summary_en: Using individual data from 556 patients in six study groups, the authors built logistic regression models predicting the histology of residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy for metastatic NSGCT: necrosis, mature teratoma, or cancer. Necrosis was most common (45%). Predictors included absence of teratoma in the primary tumor, normal AFP and hCG, elevated LDH, and mass shrinkage during chemotherapy. The models discriminated necrosis well but cancer from mature teratoma only moderately. Validated predictions may guide decisions between resection and follow-up.

pmid-7537802.summary_ja: 臨床病期I NSTGCTの患者154例を対象とした前向き単施設研究では、精巣摘除後に経過観察を行い、27.3%で再発が認められた。その大半は2年以内に出現し、主に腹部リンパ節に生じた。再発の多くは腫瘍マーカーとCTで検出された。血管侵襲のみが独立した危険因子であった。再発に対する救済的多剤化学療法後の全生存率は98.7%であった。著者らは、経過観察方針は信頼できるとし、胸部X線の省略と5年後の追跡中止を提案している。
pmid-7537802.summary_en: In a prospective single-center study of 154 patients with clinical stage I NSTGCT managed by orchidectomy and wait-and-see surveillance, recurrence occurred in 27.3%, nearly all within two years, mostly in abdominal lymph nodes. Most recurrences were detected by tumor markers and CT. Vascular invasion was the only independent risk factor. Salvage polychemotherapy gave a 98.7% overall survival rate. The authors conclude that wait-and-see surveillance is reliable, suggest omitting chest X-rays, and propose possibly stopping follow-up after five years.

pmid-7537809.summary_ja: 1971～1994年に9施設で治療された頸部顔面奇形腫の新生児20例の後方視的研究。35%で致死的な気道閉塞を来し、2例は気道確保前に死亡した。18例で腫瘍が切除され、組織型は成熟奇形腫8例、未熟奇形腫7例。全生存率は85%で、生存者の多くは機能的・整容的に良好な結果を得た。
pmid-7537809.summary_en: A Children's Cancer Group retrospective study of 20 neonates with cervicofacial teratomas treated at nine institutions between 1971 and 1994. Life-threatening airway obstruction occurred in 35%, and two infants died before their airway was secured. Eighteen had primary tumor resection; histology showed eight mature and seven immature teratomas, and four were clearly malignant. Overall survival was 85%, and most survivors had good functional and cosmetic outcomes. Some cases were diagnosed by prenatal ultrasound.

pmid-7538002.summary_ja: 乳癌、胚細胞腫瘍、悪性リンパ腫の成人29例に、通常用量化学療法と低用量G-CSFを併用して末梢血幹細胞を採取した。数回のアフェレーシスで十分な採取が可能と示唆された。その後大量化学療法を受けた12例では、自家骨髄移植単独例と比べ好中球・血小板の回復が早く、血小板輸血量も減少した。
pmid-7538002.summary_en: This study collected peripheral blood stem cells from 29 adults with breast cancer, germ cell tumor, or malignant lymphoma after conventional-dose chemotherapy plus low-dose G-CSF. Median CFU-GM yields suggested a few leukaphereses could suffice. Among 12 patients who later received high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation, PBSC rescue shortened neutrophil and platelet recovery compared with autologous bone marrow transplantation alone in 20 patients, and reduced platelet transfusion requirements.

pmid-7538045.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマに対する化学療法が奏効した49歳男性に、自然気胸が生じた症例報告である。胸腔ドレナージで肺は速やかに再膨張し、症状は消失した。化学感受性腫瘍の急速な縮小や破裂が気管支胸膜瘻の原因と考えられた。肺・縦隔転移を有する化学感受性固形腫瘍では、化学療法関連有害事象として自然気胸に留意すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-7538045.summary_en: A 49-year-old man developed spontaneous pneumothorax after successful chemotherapy for metastatic seminoma. Chest tube drainage led to rapid lung re-expansion and full symptom resolution. The authors propose that rapid regression or rupture of chemosensitive subpleural metastases may cause a bronchopleural fistula. This is only the second reported seminoma case with pneumothorax during chemotherapy-induced regression of lung and mediastinal metastases. Spontaneous pneumothorax should be recognized as a chemotherapy-related complication in chemosensitive solid tumors with lung metastases.

pmid-7538556.summary_ja: 再発または難治性の胚細胞腫瘍患者47例を、骨髄採取群と化学療法とG-CSFで動員した末梢血前駆細胞採取群に無作為に割り付けた。両群ともカルボプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミドによる大量化学療法を受けた。末梢血前駆細胞による救援では好中球・血小板の回復や輸血離脱が有意に速かった。一方、輸血必要量や全生存期間には差がなかった。
pmid-7538556.summary_en: In this randomized trial, 47 patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors were assigned to bone marrow harvest or to peripheral blood progenitor cell collection after chemotherapy plus G-CSF. All then received high-dose carboplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide. PBPC rescue led to faster neutrophil and platelet recovery and earlier transfusion independence. Transfusion requirements and overall survival did not differ between arms. The authors conclude that PBPC rescue gives faster hematopoietic reconstitution than bone marrow after high-dose chemotherapy.

pmid-7538557.summary_ja: 1980〜1993年の胚細胞腫瘍294例を後方視的に検討し、HIV感染男性15例を解析した。低病期の割合は同程度で、セミノーマの割合はHIV感染例で高かった。精巣摘除術、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、放射線療法、化学療法は良好に耐容され、奏効も得られた。抗腫瘍療法でHIV病態の分類は変わらず、自然経過はHIV感染男性と非感染男性で同等であった。
pmid-7538557.summary_en: This retrospective review of 294 germ cell tumor cases from 1980 to 1993 included 15 HIV-infected men. The proportion of low-stage tumors was similar in HIV-infected and uninfected men, while seminomas were more common among HIV-infected patients. Orchiectomy, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, radiotherapy, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy were well tolerated and produced favorable responses. HIV classification was not altered by antitumor therapy. The natural history of germ cell tumors was comparable in HIV-infected and uninfected men.

pmid-7540039.summary_ja: 予後不良の転移性精巣非セミノーマ234例を対象に、導入化学療法としてPVB/BEP交替療法とBEP療法4サイクルを比較した無作為化試験。完全奏効率は76%対72%で差はなく、約6年の追跡で再発率や全生存期間(全生存率)にも有意差は認められなかった。PVB/BEP群では骨髄毒性と神経障害が多く、交替療法はBEPより優れないと結論づけられた。
pmid-7540039.summary_en: This randomized EORTC trial compared four cycles of alternating PVB/BEP with four cycles of BEP as induction chemotherapy in 234 patients with poor-prognosis metastatic testicular non-seminoma. Complete response rates were similar (76% vs 72%), with no significant differences in relapse, disease-free, or overall survival at about six years of follow-up. Five-year progression-free and survival rates were roughly 80% in both arms. PVB/BEP caused more myelotoxicity and neuropathy. The authors concluded that alternating PVB/BEP is not superior to BEP and is more toxic.

pmid-7540057.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎42例、絨毛癌24例、対照23例で血清GM-CSFを酵素免疫測定法により測定した研究。寛解した絨毛癌および胞状奇胎では対照と差がなかったが、進行性の絨毛癌では血清GM-CSFが有意に上昇し、症例の80%で異常高値を示した。血清GM-CSFは高リスク絨毛癌を識別する予後バイオマーカーとなり、早期の治療とフォローアップの強化に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-7540057.summary_en: This study measured serum GM-CSF by enzyme immunoassay in 42 vesicular mole patients, 24 choriocarcinoma patients, and 23 controls. Serum GM-CSF was normal in vesicular mole and in choriocarcinoma patients who achieved remission. In contrast, choriocarcinoma patients with progressive disease and an abnormal hCG beta regression curve had significantly elevated GM-CSF, about 2.55-fold the control mean, in 80% of cases. The authors suggest serum GM-CSF may serve as a prognostic biomarker to identify high-risk choriocarcinoma that needs early specific treatment and intensive follow-up.

pmid-7540400.summary_ja: 1985〜1993年にトロムソ大学病院の一般腫瘍科で治療された精巣がん98例（セミノーマ47例、非セミノーマ51例）の成績。中央値4年の追跡で進行病変による死亡は2例のみで、成績は専門施設と同等だった。共同研究や治療プロトコルの下であれば、小規模な一般腫瘍科でも精巣がんを安全に治療できると結論づけている。
pmid-7540400.summary_en: This Norwegian report describes 98 testicular cancer patients (47 seminoma, 51 non-seminoma) treated at a general oncology department in Tromsø between 1985 and 1993. With a median follow-up of four years, only two patients died of progressive disease. Outcomes resembled those of major specialized centers. The authors argue that, within multicentre cooperative studies or defined treatment protocols, testicular cancer can be treated safely in small general oncology centers, with comparable cure rates and treatment-related morbidity and mortality.

pmid-7540420.summary_ja: 転移性奇形腫の患者でgrowing teratoma syndromeと脳転移を生じた症例報告。シスプラチンを含む化学療法と、残存病変に対する外科的切除など多様な治療を組み合わせた。growing teratoma syndromeの早期認識と速やかな手術が重要であった。全身化学療法中に中枢神経系が避難部位となり孤立性再発が起こりうるが、長期無病生存は得られうると述べている。
pmid-7540420.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastatic teratoma who developed growing teratoma syndrome and a cerebral metastasis. The case illustrates the multimodal management needed, including cisplatin-based chemotherapy, risk-adapted treatment intensity, and surgical excision of residual disease. Early recognition of growing teratoma syndrome and prompt surgery were key. The authors note the central nervous system can act as a sanctuary site during systemic chemotherapy, causing isolated CNS relapse, which does not preclude long-term disease-free survival.

pmid-7543237.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍6例の穿刺吸引細胞診所見を検討した研究。セミノーマのみ特徴的な所見と胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼ染色により確定診断が可能だった。卵黄嚢腫瘍で有用な硝子様小体やαフェトプロテイン染色は、穿刺材料では必ずしも得られなかった。胸腺腫は検討したいずれの胚細胞腫瘍とも容易に鑑別できた。
pmid-7543237.summary_en: This study describes fine needle aspiration cytology in six primary mediastinal germ cell tumors: one seminoma, one embryonal carcinoma, one yolk sac tumor, and three mixed germ cell tumors containing teratoma. A definitive cytologic diagnosis was possible only for seminoma, based on characteristic features and germ cell alkaline phosphatase staining. Hyaline globules and AFP immunostaining, useful for yolk sac tumor on tissue, were often absent on aspirates. All thymoma types were readily distinguished from the four germ cell tumor types examined.

pmid-7543657.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍から培養した線維芽細胞様の腫瘍細胞におけるα2マクログロブリン受容体(α2MR)の発現を検討した。ノーザン解析でα2MR mRNAを検出し、免疫蛍光法で本細胞によるα2Mの取り込みを確認した。形態とビメンチン発現から線維芽細胞由来と同定され、奇形腫由来の腫瘍細胞における受容体の役割が考察されている。
pmid-7543657.summary_en: This study examined alpha-2-macroglobulin receptor (alpha2MR) expression in fibroblast-like cells cultured from human germ cell tumors. Northern blotting detected alpha2MR mRNA, and immunofluorescence showed endocytosis of alpha2-macroglobulin by these cells. Identity as fibroblasts was confirmed by morphology and vimentin expression. The authors discuss the receptor's potential role in these neoplastic cells of teratomatous origin.

pmid-7543866.summary_ja: 子宮内膜がんの術後5年に、非妊娠性・非性腺性の絨毛癌と甲状腺機能亢進症を発症した女性の症例報告である。集中的な多剤化学療法を行ったが、患者は死亡した。本腫瘍は子宮内膜がんの再発か、絨毛癌成分を伴う新たな性腺外胚細胞腫瘍のいずれかと結論されている。
pmid-7543866.summary_en: The authors describe a woman who developed non-gestational, non-gonadal choriocarcinoma with hyperthyroidism five years after hysterectomy and bilateral adnexectomy for endometrial carcinoma. Despite intensive multiagent chemotherapy, she died. The authors conclude the tumor was either a recurrence of the endometrial carcinoma or a new extragonadal germ cell tumor with choriocarcinoma component.

pmid-7543967.summary_ja: 低腫瘍量の病期II非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍28例に対する初回化学療法の成績を報告した。完全奏効は96%で、中央値72か月の追跡で96%が無病生存であった。71%が後腹膜リンパ節郭清を回避でき、約半数にシスプラチン関連の知覚異常や耳鳴が生じた。
pmid-7543967.summary_en: This series of 28 patients with low-volume stage II nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors treated with primary chemotherapy found complete response in 96% and disease-free status in 96% at median 72 months follow-up. Seventy-one percent avoided retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Cisplatin-associated paresthesias or tinnitus occurred in 46%, and 73% of those attempting conception succeeded. The authors suggest primary chemotherapy can spare RPLND in selected patients.

pmid-7544087.summary_ja: 初回化学療法後に再発した非セミノーマ性精巣がん8例に、高用量メトトレキサート、ビンクリスチン、シスプラチンによる救援化学療法を行った。部分奏効2例、完全奏効2例が得られ、完全奏効の2例は43か月および53か月以上無病で経過した。毒性の多くはロイコボリン救援で管理可能であった。
pmid-7544087.summary_en: Eight patients with non-seminomatous testicular cancer relapsing after primary chemotherapy received salvage treatment with high-dose methotrexate, weekly vincristine, and then cisplatin. Two achieved partial and two complete responses; both complete responders remained disease-free for 43 and 53+ months. Methotrexate-related toxicity was largely manageable with leucovorin rescue. The authors conclude this regimen is effective with acceptable toxicity.

pmid-7544720.summary_ja: 男性患者16例のセミノーマに対する穿刺吸引細胞診(FNA)の細胞所見を検討した。対象は性腺原発2例、縦隔原発2例、転移12例である。大型の散在性細胞と目立つ核小体、混在するリンパ球・形質細胞が特徴であった。6例では胚細胞由来と同定でき、治療方針の決定が早まった。
pmid-7544720.summary_en: The authors reviewed fine-needle aspiration cytology of 16 seminomas from male patients, including gonadal, mediastinal, and metastatic lesions. Aspirates showed dispersed large cells with prominent nucleoli, admixed lymphocytes and plasma cells, and only occasional tigroid background. Metastatic cytology was distinctive enough for diagnosis. In six cases, FNA identified germ cell origin rather than other differential diagnoses, expediting treatment.

pmid-7545220.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対しPVP16B化学療法を2～4コース受けた男性30例について、治療後24～78か月の精液所見を評価した。乏精子症が43%、無精子症が20%で、精子形態異常も多く認められた。8例が子どもをもうけていた。持続的な精液異常のリスクは高いが、一部は回復する。
pmid-7545220.summary_en: Thirty men treated with two to four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin for germ cell tumors were assessed by semen analysis 24 to 78 months later. Oligospermia was present in 43%, including 20% azoospermia, and abnormal sperm morphology was common. Eight men had fathered children. The authors conclude that these patients are at substantial risk for persistent semen abnormalities, although some recover.

pmid-7545401.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞に、hCG-αサブユニットのアンチセンスcDNAを安定導入した研究です。hCG分泌は著明に低下し、原因はmRNAの転写低下ではなく分解亢進でした。hCGが減少してもhCG受容体の発現や増殖速度は対照と同等で、in vitroの増殖にhCG産生は必須でない可能性が示されました。
pmid-7545401.summary_en: This study stably transfected JAR human choriocarcinoma cells with an antisense hCG-alpha cDNA expression vector. hCG secretion fell markedly because steady-state hCG-alpha and -beta mRNA levels decreased through increased degradation, not reduced transcription. Unexpectedly, hCG-beta transcripts were also reduced. Despite lower hCG, the transfected cells kept normal hCG receptor levels, responded to epidermal growth factor, and proliferated at the same rate as control cells, suggesting that hCG output is not required for in vitro growth.

pmid-7545427.summary_ja: 本報告は、再発性精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と骨髄浸潤を有する患者の症例である。腫瘍細胞は他の造血関連抗原を欠いてCD33とCD34を発現していた。骨髄抑制とG-CSF治療による幹細胞動員の後、正常な前駆細胞とともにCD34陽性腫瘍細胞が末梢血に出現し、白血球除去産物では減少していた。後方視的には、動員後の末梢血中の腫瘍細胞の出現が再発の最初の徴候であり、この所見が再発の早期マーカーとして役立つ可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-7545427.summary_en: This report describes a patient with recurrent testicular mixed germ cell tumour and bone marrow infiltration. The tumour cells expressed CD33 and CD34 without other haematopoiesis-associated antigens. After myelosuppression and G-CSF treatment for stem cell mobilisation, CD34-positive tumour cells appeared in the peripheral blood alongside normal progenitors. The tumour cells were reduced in the leukapheresis product. Retrospectively, their appearance in peripheral blood after mobilisation was the first indication of impending relapse, suggesting a possible role for this finding as an early marker of recurrence.

pmid-7545430.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性111例で、化学療法後の残存腫瘤切除の転帰を後方視的に検討しました。生存完遂の不完全切除や術後3か月以内の再増悪は予後不良と関連しました。成熟奇形腫の切除も治療的意義があり、生存腫瘍を認めた場合は追加の化学療法が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-7545430.summary_en: This single-institution study reviewed 111 men with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent post-chemotherapy resection after tumour marker normalisation. Viable cancer was found in 12% and mature teratoma in 41%. Only 54% of patients with viable cancer remained continuously disease-free. Incomplete surgery and a progression-free interval of 3 months or less after surgery were each associated with worse survival. The authors conclude that post-chemotherapy surgery remains essential, and that viable cancer at resection indicates need for further chemotherapy.

pmid-7545806.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJArおよびJEG-3細胞株でH19発現を比較し、JEG-3を用いたヌードマウスでは腫瘍内のH19 RNAが5倍に増加しました。H19高発現の細胞は腫瘍形成能が高く、腫瘍形成の過程で高発現細胞が選択されると考察されています。H19の腫瘍抑制遺伝子としての役割は支持されませんでした。
pmid-7545806.summary_en: This study compared H19 transcript levels in two choriocarcinoma-derived cell lines, JAr (high) and JEG-3 (low, below normal trophoblast). After subcutaneous injection into nude mice, JEG-3 tumours showed a fivefold rise in H19 RNA. This increase did not change clonogenicity or growth rate in vitro, but cells retaining high H19 expression were more tumorigenic. The authors propose selection of H19-high cells during tumour formation. The findings do not support a tumour suppressor role for H19 in these tumours.

pmid-7545814.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍62例で、MIB-1などの増殖マーカーが隠れた転移を予測できるかを検討しました。転移例でMIB-1が高値で、感度82%、特異度69%でした。MIB-1が52%未満の患者には転移がなく、潜在的転移の予測に有用な可能性があります。
pmid-7545814.summary_en: This study examined whether immunohistochemical markers of proliferation (MIB-1, PCNA), p53 accumulation and angiogenesis predict occult metastasis in clinical stage A non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. Orchiectomy specimens from 62 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection were analysed. MIB-1 was higher in metastatic cases and predicted metastasis with 82% sensitivity and 69% specificity. No patient with MIB-1 below 52% had metastasis. PCNA and p53 correlated with MIB-1 but not with metastatic status, and angiogenesis was not predictive.

pmid-7547217.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法中または後に再発した転移性胚細胞腫瘍の男性67例の救済治療の転帰を検討しました。5年生存率は全体で37%でした。35歳以下、初回治療での完全奏効、3か月超の無再発期間が予後良好因子で、良好群の5年生存率は72%、それ以外は11%でした。
pmid-7547217.summary_en: This study reviewed 67 men whose metastatic germ cell tumours relapsed during or after primary cisplatin-based chemotherapy and who received salvage treatment. Thirty-five (52%) responded, and 5-year survival from salvage was 37%. Age of 35 or younger, complete response to primary treatment, and relapse-free interval over 3 months predicted favourable outcome. Patients with all three good-risk factors (42%) had 72% five-year survival, versus 11% for the rest, indicating that more aggressive approaches are needed for the poor-risk group.

pmid-7547632.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍33例を対象に、21染色体腕の39マーカーでヘテロ接合性の消失(LOH)を解析した。5q(19%)をはじめ11p、11q、13q、16pに高頻度の欠失を認め、5q上の腫瘍抑制遺伝子の関与が示唆された。セミノーマ成分と未分化成分を併せ持つ症例では、セミノーマから未分化型へ進展した可能性が示された。
pmid-7547632.summary_en: This study screened tumors from 33 patients with testicular germ cell tumors for loss of heterozygosity across 39 polymorphic markers on 21 chromosome arms. Recurrent losses were found on 5q (highest, 19%), 11p, 11q, 13q, and 16p, suggesting candidate tumor suppressor regions, including on 5q. No losses occurred on 12q or 17p. Allelic imbalance was frequent on 1q, 7p, and 12p. In a tumor with seminomatous and less differentiated components, the authors provide evidence of a common origin, suggesting progression from seminoma.

pmid-7547762.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の専門施設で、非奇胎妊娠後の絨毛癌100例を後方視的に検討した。主症状は膣出血で、生産後では転移性疾患による症状が目立った。多剤併用化学療法は生産後の82%、非奇胎流産後の60%に必要で、死亡率は生産後で有意に高かった(21%対6%)。持続する出血では妊娠反応の検査が勧められる。
pmid-7547762.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 100 women with choriocarcinoma at a trophoblastic disease referral centre compared presentation and outcomes by antecedent pregnancy type. Choriocarcinoma after nonmolar pregnancy accounted for 17% of gestational trophoblastic tumours requiring treatment. Vaginal bleeding was the most common symptom, while metastatic symptoms were prominent after live birth. Multi-agent chemotherapy was needed in 82% after live birth and 60% after nonmolar abortion. Mortality was higher after live birth (21% vs 6%), leading the authors to recommend a pregnancy test for persistent bleeding.

pmid-7547763.summary_ja: 香港の三次施設で妊娠性絨毛性疾患32例を対象に、カラードプラ超音波と骨盤動脈造影を比較した。腫瘍血管の局在は両法で一致し、腫瘍径もよく相関した(r=0.93)。非侵襲的なカラードプラ超音波は、骨盤動脈造影の代替となりうると結論された。
pmid-7547763.summary_en: This observational study of 32 women with gestational trophoblastic disease at a Hong Kong tertiary centre compared colour Doppler sonography with pelvic arteriography for localising tumour vessels and measuring tumour size. Of 21 patients undergoing both tests, tumour vessel location was concordant, and size measurements correlated strongly (r = 0.93). Arteriography overestimated size in two patients but did not change risk categories. The authors conclude that colour Doppler sonography is a noninvasive technique that can replace pelvic arteriography.

pmid-7547802.summary_ja: バレンシア小児腫瘍科で21年間に経験した新生児期の非悪性腫瘍40例を検討した。奇形腫が15例で、うち10例は仙尾部に生じていた。追跡期間中央値約8年で39例中38例が生存し、後遺症はごくわずかであった。治療方針が異なるため、悪性腫瘍との鑑別が重要と強調された。
pmid-7547802.summary_en: This 21-year review from a Valencia pediatric oncology unit evaluated non-malignant tumours in neonates that can mimic cancer. Among 40 cases, 15 were teratomas, mostly sacrococcygeal, with solid hemangiomas and mesoblastic nephromas also common. Congenital malformations and easily recognized lesions were excluded. Over a median follow-up of about eight years, 38 of 39 neonates were alive with few sequelae, and 36 were free of tumour. The authors emphasise distinguishing these benign lesions from cancer because management differs.

pmid-7549572.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎から絨毛癌までを含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患の最近の動向をまとめた総説である。完全胞状奇胎と部分胞状奇胎の染色体の違い、初期治療としての吸引除去術、予後スコアに応じた化学療法を解説した。ほぼ全例が治癒可能であるが、その機序の解明は今後の課題とされた。
pmid-7549572.summary_en: This review summarises current trends in gestational trophoblastic diseases, spanning from hydatidiform mole to choriocarcinoma. It describes the cytogenetic differences between complete and partial moles, first-line suction evacuation for molar pregnancy, and single or multiagent chemotherapy for persistent disease or choriocarcinoma, selected by prognostic score. The authors note that nearly all patients can be cured with careful follow-up. They highlight apoptosis and multidrug resistance gene expression as possible explanations for the unusual chemosensitivity of GTD.

pmid-7551166.summary_ja: 妊娠24週の羊水過少の胎児で、超音波により口腔奇形腫(エピグナトス)を出生前に診断した症例報告である。無眼球症、単一鼻孔、前脳胞症、四肢欠損、両側腎異形成、内反足を伴い、染色体解析で13トリソミーが確認された。奇形腫は通常は単独の良性異常だが、多発奇形を伴いうることが示された。
pmid-7551166.summary_en: This case report describes prenatal sonographic diagnosis of an epignathus (oral teratoma) in a 24-week fetus with oligohydramnios. The fetus also had anophthalmia, a single nostril, holoprosencephaly, meromelia, bilateral renal dysplasia, and club foot. Chromosome analysis revealed trisomy 13. The authors note that epignathus is usually an isolated anomaly with benign histology, and this case shows it can occur alongside multiple malformations.

pmid-7551890.summary_ja: 1975〜1989年にスコットランド西部でNSGCTと診断された442例を後方視的に検討した。陰嚢切開や診断遅延が予後に与える影響を評価した。陰嚢切開群の局所再発は78例中1例で、鼠径切除群の318例中0例と比べて差は小さかった。診断遅延は単変量解析で予後不良と関連したが、多変量解析では独立した予後因子ではなかった。有効な化学療法が遅延の影響を減じたと考えられる。
pmid-7551890.summary_en: This retrospective review of 442 men in west Scotland diagnosed with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors between 1975 and 1989 examined whether diagnostic delay or scrotal orchidectomy affected outcome. Scrotal surgery was performed in 10.4% of patients, but loco-regional recurrence was rare: one of 78 scrotal cases versus none of 318 inguinal cases. Diagnostic delay over three months was associated with worse survival in univariate analysis, but not after adjustment for prognostic factors. The authors conclude that scrotal incision is unlikely to raise loco-regional recurrence risk, and effective chemotherapy has likely reduced the prognostic impact of delay.

pmid-7553288.summary_ja: 3歳の男児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍で、肺および後腹膜に巨大転移(病期IIIB2)を伴う症例を報告する。PVB化学療法3サイクル後、肺病変は完全奏効、後腹膜リンパ節は部分奏効を示した。4か月時点でAFPが再上昇したため、修正VAB-6レジメンによる救援化学療法を行い、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を実施した。組織学的には壊死組織のみで、24か月時点で再発はなかった。著者らは、小児精巣腫瘍における化学療法後残存腫瘤の管理に関する文献が乏しいことに言及している。
pmid-7553288.summary_en: We report a 3-year-old boy with testicular yolk sac tumor and bulky lung and retroperitoneal metastases (stage IIIB2). After three cycles of PVB chemotherapy, the lung lesions achieved complete response and the retroperitoneal nodes partial response. A re-elevated AFP at four months prompted salvage chemotherapy with a modified VAB-6 regimen, followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Histology showed only necrotic tissue, and there was no recurrence at 24 months. The authors note the limited literature on managing postchemotherapy residual masses in pediatric testicular tumors.

pmid-7556294.summary_ja: 病期II〜IVの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者21例に18FDG-PETを施行した。セミノーマや悪性奇形腫の転移巣に強い集積を認めた。分化した奇形腫や壊死・線維化組織では集積は低かった。治療前後で腫瘍対正常組織比が低下した例は治療反応と関連した。症例数は少なく、今後の検証が必要である。転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の検出と治療効果判定に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-7556294.summary_en: Twenty-one patients with stage II–IV testicular germ cell tumors underwent 18FDG PET imaging. Metastases from seminoma and malignant teratoma showed avid uptake, while differentiated teratoma and necrotic or fibrotic tissue generally did not. Malignant tissue had a mean SUV of 6.0 and a tumor-to-normal tissue ratio of 1.7. A decline in this ratio from pre- to on-treatment scans predicted response in three patients, whereas non-responders showed no significant reduction. The authors conclude that 18FDG PET may aid detection and management of metastatic testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-7556861.summary_ja: 本報告は症例報告である。24歳女性の右卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ症例で、左卵巣は低形成であった。口腔上皮とリンパ球でトリプルX症候群が確認されたが、腫瘍組織は正常なXX核型であった。両者は偶然の合併と考えられた。悪性胚細胞腫瘍で外性器異常を伴う女性では、Y染色体を含む異常を除外するため染色体検査が勧められる。
pmid-7556861.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with right ovarian dysgerminoma and a hypoplastic left ovary. Chromosomal analysis of oral epithelium and lymphocytes revealed triple-X syndrome, whereas in situ hybridization of the tumor showed a normal XX karyotype. The authors consider the two findings coincidental. They recommend chromosomal screening for women with malignant germ cell tumors and abnormal genitalia to exclude anomalies carrying a Y chromosome.

pmid-7558804.summary_ja: アメリカ領サモアの女性で、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に悪性成分を認めた症例を報告した。外科的病期分類によりFIGO病期IIIの播種性扁平上皮癌と判明した。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化はまれであり、根治的な一塊切除が推奨される。補助療法は、特に播種性病変では転帰を改善しなかったとされる。
pmid-7558804.summary_en: This case report describes a woman from American Samoa whose mature cystic teratoma of the ovary contained a malignant component. Staging surgery revealed disseminated squamous cell carcinoma, FIGO stage III. Malignant transformation of benign cystic teratoma is rare, and the authors advise a high index of suspicion and radical en bloc resection. Adjuvant radiotherapy or chemotherapy has not been shown to improve outcomes, especially in disseminated disease.

pmid-7562856.summary_ja: 精巣の成熟奇形腫の再発患者にαインターフェロン療法を行い、完全寛解が得られた症例報告である。インターフェロンは多様な固形腫瘍や血液悪性腫瘍に抗腫瘍効果を示す一方、成熟奇形腫には一般に有効でないと考えられてきた。単一症例の結果であり有効性の一般化はできないが、治療選択肢となりうる可能性を示唆する。
pmid-7562856.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with recurrent mature testicular teratoma who achieved complete remission after treatment with alpha-interferon. The authors note that alpha-interferons have antitumour activity across various solid and haematological malignancies but are generally not considered effective for mature testicular teratomas. The single case suggests a possible role for interferon therapy in this setting, although one patient cannot establish efficacy.

pmid-7563341.summary_ja: 低病期の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍143例のCTを後方視的に再検討し、後腹膜リンパ節径と病理学的病期の関係を解析した研究である。リンパ節径は0〜25mmの範囲で病理学的病期Bの確率と連続的に相関した。3mmを非転移性の閾値とすると、CTによる病期分類の感度と陰性的中率は90%であった。従来法より病期分類精度が向上すると結論づけられた。
pmid-7563341.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 143 CT scans from patients with low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, comparing retroperitoneal lymph node diameters with pathological stage. Node size correlated continuously with the likelihood of pathological stage B disease across a 0 to 25 mm range. Using a 3 mm threshold to define nonmetastatic nodes, CT-based staging achieved 90% sensitivity and negative predictive value. The authors conclude that size-based criteria improve staging accuracy over conventional CT interpretation.

pmid-7564144.summary_ja: 本報告は、小児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を治療した3つのGPO共同研究(MAHO-82、-88、-92)を要約したものである。137例のうち卵黄嚢腫瘍が多くを占め、次いで分化型奇形腫と悪性奇形腫であった。大半は病期Iであり、半去勢術後に経過観察または化学療法で管理された。標準療法はビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンを用い、生存腫瘍が疑われる場合には遅延開腹術を、必要に応じて救済療法を行った。観察期間中央値60か月における全体の無病生存率は97%であった。
pmid-7564144.summary_en: This report summarizes three cooperative GPO pediatric studies (MAHO-82, -88, -92) treating childhood testicular germ cell tumors. Among 137 patients, yolk sac tumors predominated, followed by differentiated teratomas and malignant teratomas. Most patients had stage I disease managed by semicastration with surveillance or chemotherapy. Standard therapy used vinblastine, bleomycin and cisplatin, with delayed laparotomy for suspected viable tumor and salvage therapy when needed. Overall disease-free survival was 97% at a median follow-up of 60 months.

pmid-7565312.summary_ja: 出生時に胎児母体間出血による重度の貧血を呈した乳児が、生後3週で肝腫瘍と肺転移を伴い死亡した症例報告である。剖検で絨毛癌と診断され、これにより同時期に肺転移を有していた母親の診断に至った。母親は治療に成功した。母児同時発症の報告例の文献的考察も加えられている。
pmid-7565312.summary_en: This case report describes a male infant who was severely anaemic at birth from feto-maternal haemorrhage and died at three weeks with a liver tumour and lung metastases. Postmortem examination revealed choriocarcinoma, which prompted diagnosis in the mother, who also had pulmonary metastases. The mother was successfully treated. The authors present the case in detail and review reported cases of simultaneous choriocarcinoma in mother and infant, highlighting the rarity and clinical significance of this presentation.

pmid-7566760.summary_ja: 1980年代にウェリントンの消防士で精巣がんが4例集積した事例を調査した研究である。4例はいずれも精巣胚細胞腫瘍と確認されたが、共通のリスク因子は見出されなかった。相対リスクは8.2（95%信頼区間2.2〜21）と高値であったが、偶然の可能性は除外できないとされた。ニュージーランドの他地域では上昇は認められなかった。
pmid-7566760.summary_en: This New Zealand cluster investigation examined four testicular cancer cases among Wellington fire fighters in the 1980s. All four were verified as germ cell testicular tumours, but no common risk factors emerged from medical records or interviews. The standardised incidence ratio was 8.2 (95% CI 2.2 to 21), indicating an unusually high risk, though chance could not be excluded. The authors found no evidence that fire fighters elsewhere in New Zealand had elevated rates, and noted that a separate investigation would be needed for the 1990s.

pmid-7567273.summary_ja: 小児の腹部に触知される腫瘤として発見された、極めてまれな胃奇形腫の症例報告である。CTで奇形腫に特徴的な嚢胞性成分と脂肪成分が確認され、胃由来であることが示された。胃奇形腫は良性で男性に多く、奇形腫全体の2%未満とされる。小児の固形腫瘤では、より悪性度の高い病変を除外する必要がある。
pmid-7567273.summary_en: This case report describes an extremely rare gastric teratoma presenting as a palpable abdominal mass in a child. CT demonstrated cystic and fatty components characteristic of teratoma and revealed the rare gastric origin of the lesion. The authors note that gastric teratomas are benign, predominantly occur in males, and account for less than 2% of teratomas. Clinicians should exclude more aggressive solid childhood masses when evaluating such presentations.

pmid-7567663.summary_ja: 15歳男児が胸痛と心雑音で受診し、心エコーで肺動脈狭窄と診断された。超音波検査で前縦隔の被膜を有する大型の嚢胞性腫瘤が主肺動脈を圧迫していた。切除により良性奇形腫と確定した。術後の超音波検査で流出路閉塞は消失した。
pmid-7567663.summary_en: A 15-year-old boy presented with chest pain and a new heart murmur, which echocardiography attributed to pulmonary stenosis. Ultrasonography revealed a large, encapsulated, partly solid and cystic anterior mediastinal mass compressing the main pulmonary artery. Surgical resection confirmed a benign teratoma. Postoperative ultrasound showed no outflow obstruction. The authors conclude that ultrasonography can make catheterization unnecessary and that removing an extrinsic cause can be curative.

pmid-7571033.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺性女性の14歳患者で、性腺芽腫と混合性胚細胞-性索間質腫瘍が同一腫瘍内に共存した。対側にディスジャーミノーマを伴い、子宮体部に播種を認めた。治療後7年の時点で生存して健康である。
pmid-7571033.summary_en: The authors describe a 14-year-old 46,XY phenotypically female patient with a gonadal tumor showing gonadoblastoma and mixed germ cell-sex cord stroma tumor features together. A contralateral dysgerminoma was also present. A subserosal implant of the mixed pattern was found in the uterine body. After therapy, the patient remained alive and well at 7-year follow-up. The paper discusses how to distinguish gonadoblastoma from mixed germ cell-sex cord stroma tumor.

pmid-7571184.summary_ja: 双生児でない2人の兄弟に、精巣胚細胞腫瘍が家族内で発生した。両側性で、発症間隔は16年と4年である。双生児でない兄弟における異時性・両側性精巣腫瘍の初報告とされる。文献的考察を含む。
pmid-7571184.summary_en: The authors report familial bilateral testicular germ cell tumors in two non-twin brothers. The tumors developed metachronously, after intervals of 16 and 4 years. The paper states that this is the first report of metachronous, bilateral testicular tumors in non-twin brothers. It includes a literature review on familial testicular germ cell tumor occurrence.

pmid-7571185.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣の既往を持つ性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告した。この併存がまれである点を考察する。転移性胚細胞腫瘍では停留精巣の徹底的な精査が不可欠と強調する。
pmid-7571185.summary_en: The authors report a patient with an extragonadal germ cell tumor and a history of bilateral cryptorchidism. The rarity of this combination in one patient is discussed. The paper stresses that cryptorchid testes must be thoroughly investigated in patients with metastatic germ cell cancer. This case-based report highlights the importance of examining the testes in such patients.

pmid-7571973.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍7例の穿刺吸引細胞診標本を検討した。好酸性の硝子様細胞質小体と基底膜様物質が特徴として認められた。組織所見と良好に相関した。細胞学的な予備診断は、その後の検査と治療計画に有用である。
pmid-7571973.summary_en: Fine needle aspiration biopsies from seven patients with yolk sac tumors were reviewed.
