The findings indicate that upregulation of RARγ specifically induces terminal differentiation of these embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-7733548.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた2例を報告。両例とも下大静脈と周囲リンパ組織の間に強い線維性反応があり、節群の切除が困難であった。下大静脈切除の2つの術式を検討し、難症例に対する手術戦略を示した。
pmid-7733548.summary_en: This report describes two patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy after chemotherapy for non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. In both cases, dense desmoplastic reaction between the infrarenal vena cava and perivascular lymphatic tissue prevented removal of the nodal packet from the vena cava. The authors discuss two surgical techniques for vena cava resection in these technically difficult cases, relevant to post-chemotherapy management of residual retroperitoneal disease.

pmid-7734313.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の細胞株4種を用い、テモゾロミドの感受性を検討した。そのうち2株は極めて高い感受性を示した。シスプラチン耐性亜株ではほぼ交差耐性を認めなかった。再発例や脳転移への応用の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-7734313.summary_en: This study tested temozolomide against four cell lines derived from non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors and three pairs of cisplatin-resistant sublines. Two of the four parental lines were exceptionally sensitive to temozolomide, and cisplatin-resistant sublines showed little cross-resistance. The authors propose that temozolomide may be active against relapsed non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors after cisplatin-based chemotherapy, including metastatic brain lesions, given its ability to cross the blood-brain barrier in mice.

pmid-7736433.summary_ja: 42歳の妊娠4回・分娩4回の女性で、先天性トリソミー8モザイクと妊娠性絨毛性疾患が併存した症例を報告。既報例と異なり、他の既知の染色体異常は認めなかった。ゲノムの不均衡があると組織ががんになりやすいという仮説を支持する所見とした。英文文献で同様の報告は他にないとしている。
pmid-7736433.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with both constitutional trisomy 8 mosaicism and gestational trophoblastic disease. Unlike previously reported cases, she had no other known chromosomal abnormalities. The authors interpret the association as further support for the hypothesis that constitutional genomic imbalance predisposes tissues to cancer. They note it is the only such report in the English literature.

pmid-7738621.summary_ja: サルベージ療法後の胚細胞腫瘍患者に対し、経口エトポシドを維持療法として投与した第II相試験である。完全寛解で開始した23例の74%が中央値36か月の追跡で無病生存を維持した。主な毒性は白血球減少症で、予後不良群でも忍容性は良好であった。
pmid-7738621.summary_en: This phase II trial evaluated maintenance daily oral etoposide (VP-16) in germ cell tumor patients who responded to salvage therapy, most of whom were heavily pretreated. Patients received 50 mg/m2 daily for 21 days every 4 weeks for three cycles. The main toxicity was leukopenia. Among 23 patients who started in complete remission, 74% remained continuously disease-free at a median follow-up of 36 months. Patients in partial remission rarely converted to complete remission, and all who did later relapsed. Oral maintenance was well tolerated and encouraging in this poor-risk population.

pmid-7738756.summary_ja: 出生前に仙尾部奇形腫と診断された26週の早産児の症例報告である。過剰な心拍出状態を抑えるため、まず血管遮断を行い、その後に段階的切除を実施した。この方法により成功したと報告されている。超早産児の巨大仙尾部奇形腫に対する治療選択肢を示した報告である。
pmid-7738756.summary_en: This report describes a premature infant born at 26 weeks' gestation with a prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma. Because hyperdynamic cardiac failure and related complications threaten fetal survival, the infant was first treated by devascularization to control the hyperdynamic state. The tumor was then removed in staged resections. The authors report that this approach was successful. The case highlights an option for managing giant sacrococcygeal teratoma in an extremely premature neonate, where immediate complete resection may be hazardous.

pmid-7741072.summary_ja: 1982〜1992年に治療された精巣腫瘍78例の後方視的検討である。74例は胚細胞腫瘍で、非セミノーマは受診が遅く進行例が多かった。2年生存率はセミノーマ81%、非セミノーマ70%であった。病期別では病期Iの100%から最進行例の22%まで差があった。
pmid-7741072.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 78 patients with testicular tumors treated between 1982 and 1992, of whom 74 had germ cell tumors (47 seminoma, 27 nonseminoma). Nonseminoma patients presented later and at more advanced stages than seminoma patients. Symptoms such as pain or fever were associated with worse prognosis. Treatment consisted of inguinal orchiectomy followed by radiotherapy, chemotherapy, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, or thoracotomy. The 2-year survival rates were 81% for seminoma and 70% for nonseminoma. Survival by stage ranged from 100% in stage I to 22% in the most advanced stage.

pmid-7742719.summary_ja: 本症例対照研究は、3つのエストロゲン受容体遺伝子多型が胚細胞腫瘍の感受性に影響するかを検討したものである。ノルウェーの精巣がん患者454例と対照672例を比較したが、対立遺伝子頻度に差はなかった。精巣下降障害、不妊症、両側性または家族性の精巣がんを有する高リスク患者のサブグループでも差は認められなかった。著者らは、エストロゲン受容体遺伝子の5'末端の変異が精巣がんの感受性を与えるとは考えにくいと結論している。
pmid-7742719.summary_en: This case-control study examined whether three estrogen receptor gene polymorphisms influence susceptibility to germ cell cancer. It compared 454 Norwegian testicular cancer patients with 672 controls. Allele frequencies did not differ between patients and controls. Subgroup analyses of high-risk patients, including those with maldescent, infertility, bilateral disease, or familial disease, also showed no differences. The authors conclude that variation in the 5' end of the estrogen receptor gene does not appear to confer susceptibility to testicular cancer.

pmid-7743467.summary_ja: 83歳男性の胃に生じた大型の有茎性腫瘍で、奇形腫成分と浸潤性腺癌が併存していた症例報告である。リンパ節転移の奇形腫巣にも腺癌成分が認められた。未熟奇形腫から腺癌が発生したと結論づけられ、胃奇形腫の悪性転化としては初の報告とされる。文献レビューも付されている。
pmid-7743467.summary_en: This report describes an 83-year-old Japanese man with a large gastric tumor containing mature and immature teratomatous components and invasive adenocarcinoma. Metastatic teratomatous foci in lymph nodes also contained adenocarcinoma. Immunohistochemistry confirmed the immature components and helped distinguish atypical neuroepithelial cells from adenocarcinoma. The authors conclude that the adenocarcinoma arose from an immature gastric teratoma, which they believe is the first reported malignant transformation of gastric teratoma. A literature review identified this as the oldest reported case of gastric teratoma in the authors' knowledge.

pmid-7746517.summary_ja: 15か月の女児に左開胸術を行った縦隔奇形腫の放射線・病理カンファレンス報告である。単純X線で左半胸郭の大部分を占める大きな腫瘤が認められた。病理では被膜に包まれた軟部組織様の腫瘤で、良性縦隔奇形腫と診断された。小児の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の画像・病理所見を示す症例である。
pmid-7746517.summary_en: This radiology-pathology conference report describes a 15-month-old girl who underwent left thoracotomy. Radiographs showed a large mass occupying most of the left hemithorax. Pathology revealed a well-encapsulated, soft tissue mass with red and white areas. The final diagnosis was a benign mediastinal teratoma. The report highlights the imaging and pathologic features of this mediastinal germ cell tumor in a young child.

pmid-7747357.summary_ja: 10歳男児が精巣腫瘍を疑われて受診し、術中迅速凍結切片で精巣類皮嚢腫と診断され、局所切除が行われた症例報告である。小児例の報告は従来5例に限られていた。著者らは本疾患の病因、診断、治療について考察している。小児の精巣腫瘍として悪性腫瘍との鑑別が必要となる病変である。
pmid-7747357.summary_en: A 10-year-old boy presented with a presumed testicular neoplasm, which was confirmed on frozen section to be a testicular dermoid cyst. Local excision was performed. The authors note that only five pediatric testicular dermoid cysts had been reported previously. They discuss the etiopathogenesis, diagnosis, and treatment of this lesion, which must be distinguished from malignant testicular neoplasms in children.

pmid-7747802.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、悪性絨毛癌におけるRasGAPタンパクの発現を免疫組織化学染色で検討した。正常胎盤と非侵入性胞状奇胎では栄養膜細胞に強い染色が認められ、侵入奇胎と絨毛癌では認められなかった。RasGAP発現は浸潤能および悪性表現型と逆相関しており、その低下が栄養膜細胞の悪性転化に関与する可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-7747802.summary_en: This study examined RasGAP protein expression by immunohistochemistry in normal placentas, hydatidiform moles, invasive moles, and malignant choriocarcinomas. Normal placentas and noninvasive moles showed strong staining confined to trophoblasts, whereas invasive moles and choriocarcinomas showed none. RasGAP expression inversely correlated with invasive potential and malignant phenotype. The authors suggest RasGAP regulates trophoblast proliferation and that its loss may contribute to malignant transformation of these cells.

pmid-7749293.summary_ja: 39歳女性が少量の肛門出血で受診し、直腸に硬い腫瘤が触知された症例報告である。組織学的に嚢胞を伴わない充実性類皮腫瘍で、成熟奇形腫の変異型と診断された。内視鏡的ポリペクトミーで切除された。1914年以降、日本での同様の報告は本例を含め12例のみであり、臨床像や診断・治療法が考察されている。
pmid-7749293.summary_en: A 39-year-old woman presented with a small amount of anal bleeding and was found to have a hard rectal tumor about 9 cm from the anal verge. Histology showed a solid dermoid tumor without a cyst, considered a variant of mature teratoma. The lesion was removed by endoscopic polypectomy. The authors note that only 12 such cases, including this one, have been reported in Japan since 1914, and they discuss clinical features and diagnostic and therapeutic approaches.

pmid-7749434.summary_ja: 正常精子形成、Sertoli細胞のみ症候群、精子形成停止、Leydig細胞過形成、Leydig細胞腫瘍、セミノーマの精巣生検において、FSH、インヒビン、セロトニン、オキシトシンなどのペプチドホルモン分布を免疫組織化学で比較した。FSHを除き、多くのペプチドは正常精巣より不妊精巣で染色が強かった。インヒビンはLeydig細胞腫瘍で最も強く染色された。
pmid-7749434.summary_en: This study compared immunohistochemical distribution of inhibin, FSH, serotonin, oxytocin, and other peptide hormones in testicular biopsies showing normal spermatogenesis, Sertoli-cell-only syndrome, spermatogenic arrest, Leydig cell hyperplasia, Leydig cell tumor, or seminoma. Most peptides, except FSH, stained more intensely in subfertile than in normal testes. Inhibin staining was strongest in Leydig cell tumor. The authors suggest these regulatory peptides may be involved in testicular pathophysiology.

pmid-7752333.summary_ja: 1989年から1993年の間に、病期B3および/またはCの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍97例が導入化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。うち6例では腫瘍が大動脈外膜に進展し、大動脈の一括切除と人工血管再建が行われ、血管合併症はなかった。残存病変は奇形腫や悪性成分を含み、2例は救援化学療法を受けた。4例は無病生存、2例は転移性疾患で死亡した。
pmid-7752333.summary_en: Between 1989 and 1993, 97 patients with stage B3 and/or C nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis received induction chemotherapy followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Six patients had tumor extending into the aortic adventitia, requiring en bloc aortic resection, with iliac artery resection in three, and graft reconstruction without vascular complications. Residual pathology showed mature or immature teratoma and, in two patients, yolk sac, embryonal, or choriocarcinoma elements. Two received salvage chemotherapy. Four were disease-free at 4 to 55 months, and two died of metastatic disease.

pmid-7753322.summary_ja: 35か月男児の大泉門部に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告。MRIで頭蓋内進展はなく、骨膜下に被膜を保って摘出された。組織学的に重層扁平上皮、皮脂腺、毛包を伴い、術前に頭蓋内進展を確認するため正中矢状断またはコロナルMRIが有用と述べている。
pmid-7753322.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-month-old Japanese boy with a dermoid cyst over the anterior fontanelle, presenting as a soft, well-circumscribed scalp mass. MRI showed no intracranial extension, and the lesion was excised beneath the pericranium. Histology revealed a cyst wall lined by stratified squamous epithelium, with sebaceous glands, hair follicles, and hair within the contents. The authors emphasize confirming preoperatively whether an extracranial mass extends intracranially, and state that midsagittal or coronal MRI is most useful for this purpose.

pmid-7756689.summary_ja: 悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対し、ATP細胞生存率測定法による化学感受性試験の有用性を検討した。JARとJEG-3の2種の栄養膜細胞株ではVP-16、パクリタキセル、ビンクリスチンが最も有効であった。新鮮腫瘍4例では胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が in vitro で抵抗性を示し、他の3例は感受性であった。細胞株での再現性は示されたが、臨床的有用性は今後の検討が必要である。
pmid-7756689.summary_en: This study evaluates an ATP cell viability assay for chemosensitivity testing in malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasms. Ten chemotherapeutic agents were tested in JAR and JEG-3 trophoblastic cell lines, with VP-16, paclitaxel, and vincristine proving most active. The assay was then applied to four fresh tumors: one placental site trophoblastic tumor, one choriocarcinoma, and two invasive moles. The placental site tumor was chemoresistant in vitro, while the others were chemosensitive. The authors conclude the assay is repeatable for cell lines, but its value for fresh tumor testing remains to be defined.

pmid-7762340.summary_ja: 37歳男性の原因不明の後腹膜腫瘤の症例報告。穿刺吸引細胞診でセミノーマに高度に一致する悪性細胞が確認され、免疫染色でリンパ腫や黒色腫、上皮性悪性腫瘍は否定的であった。超音波検査で左精巣に境界明瞭な腫瘍が見つかり、摘出により典型的セミノーマと確定した。細胞診が早期の精査と適切な治療につながった点が強調されている。
pmid-7762340.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man with an undiagnosed retroperitoneal mass. Needle aspiration cytology showed malignant cells highly consistent with seminoma, and immunostaining excluded lymphoma, melanoma, and epithelial malignancy. Clinical examination and ultrasonography then identified a well-demarcated testicular tumor, which was removed and confirmed as typical seminoma. The report highlights how cytology prompted timely investigation and correct management of a retroperitoneal lesion arising from a testicular seminoma.

pmid-7771726.summary_ja: 頭頸部に生じる奇形腫の特徴をまとめた論文です。新生児や乳児に多く、生物学的には良性ですが、腫瘤による圧迫や閉塞のため死亡率が高いとされています。一方、成人の頸部や副鼻腔の奇形腫は組織学的にも生物学的にも悪性で、治療への反応が予測しにくいと述べています。小児と成人の違いを強調しています。
pmid-7771726.summary_en: This review describes teratomas of the head and neck. Most occur in neonates and infants and are biologically benign, but they carry high mortality due to space-occupying and obstructive effects. In adults, teratomas of the neck and sinonasal tract are histologically and biologically malignant, with unpredictable responses to therapy. The paper highlights the clinical differences between pediatric and adult head and neck teratomas and the need to recognize malignancy in adults.

pmid-7773940.summary_ja: 臨床的に腫瘍量の少ない病期II非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍に対し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と化学療法の初回治療を比較した費用対効果の解析です。5年間の直接医療費は後腹膜リンパ節郭清の方が有意に低い結果でした。生存率やQOLは同等で、妊孕性、毒性、晩期再発では郭清群に利点がみられました。治療選択には費用や患者の希望も考慮すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-7773940.summary_en: This analysis compares the costs and risk-benefit of two treatments for clinical low-volume stage II nonseminomatous testicular tumors: primary RPLND and primary chemotherapy. Five-year direct costs, including adjuvant and salvage chemotherapy and follow-up, were significantly lower for RPLND. Survival and quality of life were similar, while RPLND showed advantages in fertility, toxicity, and late relapse. The authors conclude that cost, morbidity, and patient preference should guide treatment choice.

pmid-7773953.summary_ja: 同時性両側セミノーマの1症例について行った細胞遺伝学的解析です。両側の腫瘍はいずれも低四倍体型の核型を示し、染色体の増減と構造異常del(1p)およびi(12p)が認められました。これらは左右それぞれで二次的な変化と考えられています。この所見から、2つの腫瘍が単一起源か独立起源かを判別できたと報告しています。
pmid-7773953.summary_en: This cytogenetic study analyzed a case of synchronous bilateral seminoma. Each tumor showed a hypotetraploid karyotype with chromosomal gains and losses and one structural change, del(1p) and i(12p), which were secondary events in the left and right tumors respectively. These findings allowed the authors to determine whether the two tumors arose from a single origin or independently. The study provides genetic evidence bearing on the clonal relationship of bilateral testicular seminomas.

pmid-7774838.summary_ja: 子宮の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍10例(絨毛癌4例、侵入奇胎6例)のMR所見を、病理組織学的所見と対比して検討した研究です。絨毛癌は境界明瞭な出血性腫瘤で中心壊死を伴いました。侵入奇胎は境界不明瞭な浸潤性の腫瘤で、造影効果の強い充実部と小さな嚢胞を示しました。MRは形態評価に有用な非侵襲的検査であると結論づけています。
pmid-7774838.summary_en: This study evaluated MR imaging findings of gestational trophoblastic tumors in ten patients, including four choriocarcinomas and six invasive moles, and correlated them with histopathology. Choriocarcinomas appeared as well-defined hemorrhagic masses with central necrosis. Invasive moles showed ill-defined permeative masses with densely enhancing solid areas and tiny cysts. The authors conclude that MR imaging is a promising noninvasive tool for morphologic assessment of these tumors.

pmid-7774839.summary_ja: ヒト細胞栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞株JArを共培養し、相互作用を検討した基礎研究です。共培養により大型細胞が増加し、主に細胞栄養膜細胞によるCGとhPLの合成が高まりました。その画分ではJArのDNA合成がほぼ完全に抑制され、異核細胞の形成もみられました。両細胞とも相互作用により生物学的性質が変化すると結論づけています。
pmid-7774839.summary_en: This study examined interaction between human cytotrophoblasts and the choriocarcinoma cell line JAr in coculture. The interaction increased the number of large cells and their synthesis of CG and hPL, mainly from cytotrophoblasts. In those fractions, JAr DNA synthesis was almost completely inhibited, and heterokaryons formed, suggesting a factor inhibiting DNA synthesis may be responsible. The findings show that both cell types change their biological properties through contact.

pmid-7774849.summary_ja: 46,XX核型で性腺異形成を伴う症例にディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が認められた。Y染色体DNAプローブを用いたサザンブロット解析では、11か所のいずれからもY特異的DNAは検出されなかった。性腺異形成におけるディスジャーミノーマ発生に、Y染色体関連因子が必須かどうかについて疑問を呈する希少例である。
pmid-7774849.summary_en: A 46,XX female with dysgenetic gonads developed a dysgerminoma. Southern blot hybridization using Y-chromosome DNA probes at 11 loci across the short arm, centromere, and long arm detected no Y-specific sequences. The authors conclude that the absence of Y-DNA leaves open whether Y-chromosome-related influence is strictly required for dysgerminoma development in dysgenetic gonads. The report is a rare case suggesting that gonadal germ cell tumors may arise in individuals without Y-chromosome material.

pmid-7776444.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株由来の糖タンパク質gp200について、正常胚細胞と精巣腫瘍での糖型を比較した。正常胚細胞は末端ガラクトースを持つ230 kD型を発現し、セミノーマはこの型を示すが末端ガラクトースを欠く。非セミノーマでは高度にシアル酸修飾された糖型を発現する。胚細胞腫瘍の発生機序の理解に寄与すると考察している。
pmid-7776444.summary_en: The authors characterized gp200, a 200 kD peanut agglutinin-binding glycoprotein originally purified from the embryonal carcinoma cell line HT-E (833K), using Western blotting and the monoclonal antibody GCTM-2. Normal germ cells express a 230 kD membrane-bound glycoform with terminal galactose. Seminomatous tumors show this glycoform without terminal galactose, whereas nonseminomatous tumors express a heavily sialylated form that retains terminal galactose. The differing glycoforms may help clarify the ontogeny of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-7777241.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌に対し、血清SCC抗原の腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した。悪性例の56%、良性例の16%が陽性であった。病期Iでは陽性率が30%にとどまり、腫瘍径500cm3超では全例が陽性であった。小さい腫瘍の早期発見には適さないと結論している。
pmid-7777241.summary_en: This study assessed serum squamous cell carcinoma antigen (SCC) as a tumor marker for squamous cell carcinoma arising in ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Sixteen patients with malignant transformation were compared with 56 patients with benign mature cystic teratoma. SCC exceeded 2.0 ng/ml in 56% of malignant cases versus 16% of benign cases. Positivity was only 30% in stage I cancer, and all tumors larger than 500 cm3 were SCC-positive. The authors conclude SCC is useful but depends on tumor volume, limiting early detection of small tumors.

pmid-7778434.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍67例を後方視的に解析し、予後因子を検討した。全生存期間(全生存率)は60.6%で、組織型が最も強い独立した予後因子であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の生存率は12.0%と特に不良であった。病期分類や化学療法が進歩しても、予後は組織型に依存すると結論している。
pmid-7778434.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 67 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated at Hacettepe Hospital to identify prognostic factors. Overall survival was 60.6%, with histologic type the strongest independent predictor. Survival was 78.5% for dysgerminoma, 53.3% for immature teratoma, 12.0% for endodermal sinus tumor, and 33.3% for mixed germ cell tumor. Endodermal sinus tumors had significantly poorer survival. The authors conclude that histologic type remains the key determinant despite advances in staging and chemotherapy.

pmid-7778673.summary_ja: ホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、組織学的表現型と遺伝子コピー数異常を対応づける手法を開発した。腫瘍部と隣接する正常精細管から細胞を選別し、ユニバーサルDNA増幅後に比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションを行った。腫瘍では多数の染色体の増加と減少が確認され、連続切片で間期細胞遺伝学を実施した。
pmid-7778673.summary_en: The authors developed a strategy to link microscopic phenotype with genotype in formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissue. Cells from a testicular germ cell tumor and adjacent normal seminiferous tubules were selected separately and DNA was universally amplified before comparative genomic hybridization. Normal tissue showed balanced copy numbers, while the tumor showed numerous chromosomal gains and losses. These findings guided interphase cytogenetics on serial sections, enabling direct comparison of phenotype and genotype within a single tumor.

pmid-7782733.summary_ja: 蛋白尿を認めた56歳男性が、腎生検で膜性糸球体腎炎と診断された。ステロイド療法は奏効しなかったが、11か月後に精巣腫瘤が見つかり、病期I精巣セミノーマと判明した。精巣摘除と所属リンパ節への放射線療法後、蛋白尿は速やかに正常化した。傍腫瘍症候群として生じた例である。
pmid-7782733.summary_en: A 56-year-old man with proteinuria was diagnosed with presumed idiopathic membranous glomerulonephritis on renal biopsy. Prednisone did not resolve the proteinuria. Eleven months later, a testicular mass was found to be a stage I seminoma. Proteinuria normalized rapidly after orchiectomy and regional lymph node radiotherapy. The authors report this as the first known case of membranous glomerulonephritis associated with testicular seminoma, representing a paraneoplastic syndrome.

pmid-7782834.summary_ja: 9歳女児で鞍上部胚細胞腫瘍に放射線療法を施行後、異時性に卵巣未分化胚細胞腫を発症した症例を報告している。著者らは両腫瘍を互いの転移ではなく二重原発と考察した。頭蓋内胚腫の患者では、初回治療の前後に神経系外病変の検索を行うことを推奨している。
pmid-7782834.summary_en: This report describes a 9-year-old girl with a suprasellar germ-cell tumor treated with radiation therapy who later developed an ovarian dysgerminoma. The authors propose a double-primary tumor rather than metastasis between the two sites. They recommend that patients with intracranial germinoma be evaluated for extraneural lesions both before and after initial therapy.

pmid-7783824.summary_ja: 36歳男性が女性化乳房、肺結節、後腹膜腫瘤、著明なhCG高値を呈し、絨毛癌症候群と診断された。腫瘍は化学療法に明確に反応したが、治療の遅れなどから患者は死亡した。著者らは病理学的確定診断がなくても速やかな治療開始が重要だと強調している。
pmid-7783824.summary_en: A 36-year-old man presented with gynaecomastia, pulmonary nodules, a retroperitoneal mass and a markedly elevated hCG level, consistent with choriocarcinoma syndrome. Although the tumor responded clearly to chemotherapy, the patient died, partly because of treatment delay. The authors emphasize that prompt treatment should begin even without cytological or histological confirmation. This case highlights the emergency nature of this presentation.

pmid-7787155.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対し腹部放射線照射を受けた15例を、健常者18例と比較して消化管機能を評価した。患者では消化管症状の頻度が高く、胃排出は速かった。15例中11例で少なくとも1項目に異常を認め、右側発生例では排便回数が多かった。軽度の消化管機能異常が高頻度に生じると結論づけられている。
pmid-7787155.summary_en: Fifteen patients treated with abdominal irradiation for stage I testicular seminoma 2 to 10 years earlier were compared with 18 healthy volunteers using extensive gastrointestinal function tests. Patients reported more gastrointestinal symptoms and faster gastric emptying, and 11 of 15 had at least one abnormal parameter. Right-sided tumors were associated with greater bowel frequency. The authors conclude that mild gastrointestinal abnormalities are common after abdominal irradiation for stage I seminoma.

pmid-7789879.summary_ja: 46XX核型の10歳女児で、一側卵巣に性腺芽細胞腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、対側卵巣に性腺芽細胞腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、卵黄嚢腫瘍が認められた。Y染色体を伴わない性腺芽細胞腫は極めてまれである。非ディスジャーミノーマ性の胚細胞腫瘍を伴う例は予後不良とされてきたが、本例は初回手術後25か月時点で良好である。
pmid-7789879.summary_en: A 10-year-old girl with a 46XX karyotype had gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma in one ovary and gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma and yolk sac tumor in the contralateral ovary. Gonadoblastoma without a Y chromosome is very rare. Prognosis was historically poor when gonadoblastoma coexisted with germ cell tumors other than dysgerminoma, but this patient remained well 25 months after the first operation.

pmid-7795977.summary_ja: 1974年から1989年にエディンバラで放射線療法を受けた病期I・IIの精巣セミノーマ238例を後方視的に解析しました。5年の原因特異的生存率は病期Iで98.7%、病期IIで96.1%でした。再発は5.9%で、多くは救済療法で治療されました。腹部照射に伴う晩期障害（主に消化性潰瘍）が9.2%に認められ、対側精巣腫瘍や他部位の悪性腫瘍も報告されています。
pmid-7795977.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 238 patients with Stage I and II testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy in Edinburgh from 1974 to 1989 evaluated survival and morbidity. Cause-specific survival at 5 years was 98.7% for Stage I and 96.1% for Stage II. Fourteen patients (5.9%) relapsed, and most were salvaged. Acute grade 3 or 4 gastrointestinal or hematological toxicity occurred in a small proportion, and 9.2% developed late morbidity from abdominal irradiation, mainly peptic ulcer disease. Contralateral testicular tumors and second malignancies at other sites were also observed.

pmid-7796754.summary_ja: タンザニアで出生した女児は、生後早期に腹部膨満を呈し、ヒルシュスプルング病と推定されて生後4週で横行結腸人工肛門造設を受けました。1歳時の受診で骨盤内仙尾部奇形腫と低位の肛門直腸奇形が判明しました。両者の合併はまれで、初期誤診の原因となった点が報告の意義とされています。
pmid-7796754.summary_en: This case report describes a female infant born in Tanzania who had an anal opening abnormality and progressive abdominal distension. She initially underwent a transverse colostomy for presumed Hirschsprung's disease at four weeks of age. At one year, she was found to have an entirely intrapelvic sacrococcygeal teratoma with a low anorectal malformation. The authors highlight this rare association, which led to the initial misdiagnosis of Hirschsprung's disease, as the reason for reporting the case.

pmid-7799031.summary_ja: 原発不明低分化癌40例に対し、i(12p)のFISHや12p染色体コピー数解析などを行いました。12例で胚細胞腫瘍が示唆され、5例では他の特異的診断が得られました。胚細胞腫瘍型の染色体異常を持つ症例はシスプラチン療法への奏効率が75%で、診断がつかなかった症例の18%より高値でした。i(12p)の検出は診断と治療反応の予測に有用とされています。
pmid-7799031.summary_en: This study applied cytogenetic and molecular techniques, including FISH for i(12p) and 12p copy number analysis, to 40 patients with poorly differentiated carcinoma of unknown primary site. Genetic studies suggested a germ cell tumor in 12 patients, and a specific non-germ cell diagnosis in five others. Patients whose tumors showed germ cell-type chromosomal abnormalities responded to cisplatin therapy in 75% of cases, compared with 18% of those without a diagnosis. The authors conclude that i(12p) detection helps diagnose and predicts cisplatin response.

pmid-7799032.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に生じる二次性悪性腫瘍を、文献をもとに総説しています。放射線療法では固形腫瘍のリスクが2〜3倍、照射野内では3〜7倍に上昇しました。シスプラチンやイホスファミドを含む化学療法では固形腫瘍リスクの有意な上昇は認められませんでした。エトポシドによる二次性白血病リスクが指摘されていますが、絶対リスクは小さいとされています。
pmid-7799032.summary_en: This review synthesizes the international literature on secondary neoplasia after chemotherapy or radiotherapy for malignant germ cell tumors. Patients with testicular germ cell tumors have roughly twice the risk of secondary neoplasia. Radiotherapy increases solid tumor risk two- to threefold, with three- to sevenfold risk in irradiated fields. No significant solid tumor risk was seen after chemotherapy, including cisplatin and ifosfamide regimens. Chemotherapy with etoposide, especially conventional doses, is linked to secondary leukemia, although the absolute risk is small.

pmid-7799046.summary_ja: 進行性または再発の胚細胞腫瘍104例を対象に、VIPまたはVeIPによるイホスファミド含有化学療法へのrhGM-CSFの効果を無作為化試験で検討しました。第1コースでは感染症が減少（24%対45%）したものの、第2コースでは差がありませんでした。rhGM-CSF関連の毒性により14%のコースで投与を中止しました。結果から、日常的な予防投与は推奨されないと結論づけられています。
pmid-7799046.summary_en: This randomized trial enrolled 104 patients with advanced or relapsed germ cell tumors receiving ifosfamide-based chemotherapy with VIP or VeIP. Patients were randomized to receive recombinant human GM-CSF during either cycles 1–2 or cycles 3–4. GM-CSF reduced clinically relevant infections in cycle 1 (24% vs 45%) but not in cycle 2. Growth factor-related toxicity led to discontinuation in 14% of cycles. The authors concluded that routine GM-CSF prophylaxis after ifosfamide-based chemotherapy for germ cell tumors is not recommended.

pmid-7800309.summary_ja: 経腟超音波検査で類皮嚢腫と診断された19例に腹腔鏡検査を行い、18例で腹腔鏡補助下経腟的摘出術を実施しました。術中合併症はなく、術後3・6か月の超音波検査で卵巣像は正常でした。付属器の可動性が確認でき経腟的摘出が可能な症例では、開腹手術や腹腔鏡手術の代替として考慮できるとされています。
pmid-7800309.summary_en: This series of 19 women with dermoid cysts diagnosed by transvaginal sonography underwent laparoscopy to confirm the lesion and assess adnexal mobility. Eighteen patients then had laparoscopically assisted vaginal removal after the ovary was exteriorized through a posterior colpotomy. No intraoperative complications occurred, and sonographic follow-up at 3 and 6 months showed normal ovarian patterns. The authors suggest this approach as an alternative to laparotomy or operative laparoscopy when adnexal mobility is proven and vaginal extraction is feasible.

pmid-7800323.summary_ja: 閉経前の女性376例を対象に、経腟超音波検査による嚢胞性奇形腫のスクリーニングと卵巣腫瘤の鑑別能を前向きに評価しました。スクリーニングの感度は57.9%、特異度は99.7%（卵巣単位）でした。他の卵巣腫瘤との鑑別では感度84.6%、特異度98.2%（嚢胞単位）でした。鑑別能のほうがスクリーニング能より優れていると結論づけられています。
pmid-7800323.summary_en: This prospective study evaluated transvaginal ultrasonography for screening cystic teratoma and distinguishing it from other ovarian masses. Among 376 premenopausal women undergoing surgery, sensitivity for screening was 57.9% and specificity 99.7% per ovary. For differentiating cystic teratoma from other ovarian masses, sensitivity was 84.6% and specificity 98.2% per cyst. The authors conclude that the modality discriminates cystic teratoma better than it screens for it, with kappa values of 0.84 versus 0.69.

pmid-7802134.summary_ja: 30例の卵巣甲状腺腫を検討し、びまん性・偽管状・好酸性または明るい細胞など非典型的な組織像が、他種の卵巣腫瘍と誤認されやすいことを示した。甲状腺濾胞が乏しいため診断が難しく、類皮嚢腫の合併が多い。診断にはサイログロブリン免疫染色が有用である。問題症例では濾胞の丹念な探索とサイログロブリン染色の実施を勧めている。
pmid-7802134.summary_en: This series of 30 struma ovarii cases, ovarian thyroid tumors in women aged 23 to 71, describes unusual microscopic patterns such as diffuse, pseudotubular, oxyphilic, or clear-cell areas that often mimic other ovarian neoplasms. Thyroid follicles were scarce in cellular areas, so the diagnosis was frequently missed. Associated dermoid cysts were common, and thyroglobulin immunostaining confirmed the diagnosis. The authors advise a careful search for follicles and thyroglobulin staining in problematic cases.

pmid-7802566.summary_ja: 精巣に生じた初めての毛母腫症例を報告した。毛包性分化と続発性異所性骨化を示す単一胚葉性奇形腫で、特徴的な「影」細胞が診断の手がかりとなる。精巣の良性・悪性骨化性病変との鑑別診断を考察し、文献をレビューしている。単一胚葉性奇形腫は精巣腫瘍の1%未満と極めて稀である。
pmid-7802566.summary_en: This report describes the first pilomatricoma of the testis, a monodermal teratomatous tumor with follicular hair matrix differentiation and secondary heterotopic ossification. Characteristic shadow cells are a key diagnostic feature. The authors discuss the differential diagnosis from other benign and malignant ossifying lesions of the testis and review the relevant literature. Monodermal teratomas account for less than 1 percent of testicular tumors, underscoring the rarity of this presentation.

pmid-7819056.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株8種についてp53遺伝子を解析した。サザン解析では全株で遺伝子異常は検出されず、p53 mRNAは全株で発現していた。SSCPと塩基配列解析により3株で異常が認められた（JEG-3とNUC-1の点変異、SCHの挿入）。p53遺伝子異常が絨毛癌細胞株と関連することを示した。
pmid-7819056.summary_en: The authors analyzed p53 in eight human choriocarcinoma cell lines using Southern and Northern blotting, SSCP, and cDNA sequencing. No gene abnormality was detected by Southern blotting, and p53 mRNA was present in all lines. Abnormalities were found in three of eight lines, including point mutations in JEG-3 and NUC-1 and an insertion in SCH. The findings indicate that p53 gene abnormalities are associated with choriocarcinoma cell lines.

pmid-7821855.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と正常胎児が共存した症例で、形態学的には部分奇胎との鑑別が困難だった。PCRによる3つのVNTR解析で、臍帯・胎盤と奇胎組織はそれぞれ両親由来と雄性発生由来と遺伝学的に区別された。この結果は奇胎後管理に重要であった。転移性栄養膜疾患に対して化学療法が行われた。
pmid-7821855.summary_en: A case of complete hydatidiform mole coexisting with a live fetus was difficult to diagnose morphologically, since it resembles partial mole. PCR-based analysis of three VNTR loci showed that the cord and placenta and the molar tissue had distinct genetic origins, parental and androgenetic respectively. This genetic confirmation was crucial for postmolar management. The patient was subsequently treated with chemotherapy for metastatic trophoblastic disease.

pmid-7821857.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫2例に、全層を備えた腸管壁構造が認められた。1例には良性の虫垂型粘液性嚢胞腺腫が、もう1例には腸型腺癌が腸管壁に浸潤していたが卵巣実質には及んでいなかった。癌の症例は術後5年無事に経過している。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じる続発性腫瘍の範囲を広げる報告である。
pmid-7821857.summary_en: Two ovarian mature cystic teratomas contained complete segments of intestinal wall, a rare finding. One harbored a benign appendiceal-type mucinous cystadenoma, while the other showed an intestinal-type adenocarcinoma infiltrating the neoplastic bowel wall but not the surrounding ovary. The patient with carcinoma remained well five years after surgery. The report expands the spectrum of benign and malignant secondary neoplasms arising in mature cystic teratomas.

pmid-7821917.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫15例の免疫組織化学的解析では、全例でビメンチン陽性、10例でサイトケラチン18陽性、12例で胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ陽性であった。一部の腫瘍はデスミン、GFAP、hCG、S-100、CEAなどを発現していた。精巣セミノーマに類似したこの多様な形質から、未熟ながら分化能を有することが示唆される。低分化癌、リンパ腫、他の胚細胞腫瘍との鑑別診断に有用である。
pmid-7821917.summary_en: An immunohistochemical study of 15 ovarian dysgerminomas showed vimentin positivity in all cases, with cytokeratin 18 in ten and placental alkaline phosphatase in twelve. Individual tumors expressed desmin, glial fibrillary acidic protein, hCG, S-100, or CEA. These heterogeneous profiles resemble testicular seminomas, suggesting dysgerminomas can differentiate at a primitive level. The findings aid differential diagnosis from poorly differentiated carcinoma, lymphoma, and other germ cell tumors.

pmid-7824709.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の病期I患者40例を対象に、リンパ管造影とCTを組み合わせて骨盤リンパ節の正常サイズを検討した研究です。4か所の骨盤部位で短径の最大値を測定したところ、中央値は5mm以下で、10mm超の節は2%未満でした。正常節の上限を小さく設定することで、CTによる骨盤リンパ節転移の感度向上が期待されると結論づけています。
pmid-7824709.summary_en: This 1995 Radiology study establishes normal size criteria for pelvic lymph nodes by correlating CT with lymphangiography in men treated for stage I testicular tumors. Forty patients underwent CT 3-4 months after lymphangiography, and maximum short-axis diameters were measured at four pelvic sites. Median values were 5 mm or less, and fewer than 2% of nodes exceeded 10 mm. The authors conclude that nearly all normal pelvic nodes are under 10 mm, so the low sensitivity of CT for pelvic nodal metastases might be improved by adopting these lower upper limits of normal. The study is directly relevant to staging of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-7824738.summary_ja: 72名の女性の付属器腫瘤80例について、経膣超音波と造影前後のMRIの診断精度を比較した研究です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と子宮内膜症性嚢胞はMRIで診断精度が高く、良悪性の鑑別では造影MRIが最も読影者の確信度を高めました。造影MRIは付属器腫瘤の性状診断で優れると結論づけています。
pmid-7824738.summary_en: This 1995 Radiology study compares transvaginal ultrasound with precontrast and contrast-enhanced MR imaging for characterizing 80 adnexal masses in 72 women, confirmed at surgery or laparoscopy. Five blinded readers interpreted each modality in separate sessions. MR imaging was more accurate for mature cystic teratomas and endometriomas, while contrast-enhanced MR and ultrasound performed better for simple cysts, cystadenomas, and malignant tumors. Contrast-enhanced MR gave significantly higher observer confidence in distinguishing benign from malignant masses. The authors conclude that contrast-enhanced MR is superior for adnexal mass characterization.

pmid-7828136.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍90例を対象に、増殖マーカーMIB-1と病理所見の組み合わせで潜在性転移を予測できるかを検討した研究です。胎児性癌の体積2ml未満とMIB-1陽性細胞80%以下を組み合わせると、約30%の患者が極めて低リスクと判定されました。ただし高リスク群は同定できず、前向き試験による検証が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-7828136.summary_en: This 1995 Cancer study assessed whether MIB-1 (Ki-67) proliferation staining, combined with histopathology, can predict occult metastasis in patients with clinical Stage A nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Ninety patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection were evaluated. MIB-1 staining was significantly higher in pathologic Stage B than Stage A cases. A cut-off of 80% or less gave a negative predictive value of 87%. Combining MIB-1 with embryonal carcinoma volume under 2 ml identified about 30% of patients at extremely low risk. The markers helped define a low-risk group but failed to identify high-risk patients, so prospective testing is needed.

pmid-7828139.summary_ja: 予後不良の成人胚細胞腫瘍および転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患39例に、イホスファミド、カルボプラチン、エトポシドによる二段階の大量化学療法と自家骨髄移植を行った第I-II相試験です。奏効率は46%、完全奏効は35%でした。精巣腫瘍では47%が完全奏効に達しましたが、抵抗性の性腺外例では完全奏効はありませんでした。
pmid-7828139.summary_en: This 1995 Cancer phase I-II trial assessed tandem high-dose chemotherapy with ifosfamide, carboplatin, and etoposide, followed by autologous bone marrow reinfusion, in 39 adults with poor-prognosis germ cell tumors or metastatic trophoblastic disease. The overall response rate was 46%, with complete response in 35%. Among testicular tumors, 47% achieved complete response, while no refractory extragonadal tumors did. Nine patients (23%) survived beyond 18 months. Renal toxicity and enterocolitis were the main side effects, and seven patients died of therapy-related causes. The authors conclude the regimen can overcome platinum resistance and cure some patients.

pmid-7837793.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ22例を、フローサイトメトリーとイメージサイトメトリーで比較解析した研究である。イメージサイトメトリーではすべて異数性であった。フローサイトメトリーで二倍体と判定された症例は、腫瘍浸潤リンパ球の多さによる偽陽性であった。セミノーマは非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に先行する段階とする仮説を支持する結果である。
pmid-7837793.summary_en: This study re-examined the ploidy of classic testicular seminomas using DNA flow cytometry and image cytometry on 22 tumors, both fresh and formalin-fixed. All tumors were aneuploid by image cytometry. Apparent diploid cases detected by flow cytometry were attributed to extensive tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, which distorted the DNA histograms. The findings support the view that seminoma is aneuploid, consistent with its proposed role as a precursor stage of nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, and suggest that earlier reports of diploid seminomas may reflect methodological artifact.

pmid-7841056.summary_ja: ニューデリーの癌専門病院で診療した精巣胚細胞腫瘍成人164例の後方視的解析である。24例（14%）が未矯正の停留精巣を有し、多くは腹腔内精巣で受診が遅れ進行例が多かった。36か月全生存期間(全生存率)は0.65で、正常位置の精巣の症例と差はなかった。途上国では未矯正停留精巣の問題が依然として大きいと指摘している。
pmid-7841056.summary_en: This retrospective study from a cancer hospital in New Delhi reviewed 164 adult patients with primary testicular germ cell tumors, of whom 24 (14%) had cryptorchidism, mostly uncorrected. Affected testes were often intra-abdominal, and patients presented late with advanced stage. Overall survival at 36 months was 0.65, similar to patients with normally descended testes. Treatment included initial resection with radiation or chemotherapy, and in late-presenting patients, initial chemotherapy followed by resection. The authors highlight that uncorrected cryptorchidism remains a major problem in developing countries.

pmid-7841064.summary_ja: デンマークの登録データを用いた解析で、クラインフェルター症候群の男性696例の癌発生を一般集団と比較した。全体の癌リスクは増加していなかったが、縦隔腫瘍4例はすべて悪性胚細胞腫瘍で、相対リスクは67と著しく高かった。リスクは15〜30歳に集中していた。
pmid-7841064.summary_en: This Danish registry-based cohort study followed 696 men with Klinefelter syndrome and compared observed cancer incidence with expected rates from the general population. Overall cancer risk was not increased (relative risk 1.1). However, four mediastinal tumors were observed, all malignant germ cell tumors, with a markedly elevated relative risk of 67. The excess risk was concentrated in men aged 15 to 30 years. The authors concluded that routine cancer screening is not justified, but mediastinal germ cell tumor risk is substantially elevated from adolescence to age 30.

pmid-7841065.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症年齢と両側性発生率に関する既報データを統計的に再解析した論文である。両側例は家族例と同じ遺伝的素因を持つと推定され、精巣がん患者の約3分の1が素因を持つとされた。兄弟のリスク2.2%は、単一の劣性遺伝子のホモ接合で説明できるとしている。
pmid-7841065.summary_en: This article statistically reanalyzes previously published data on age at onset of testicular germ cell tumors and the prevalence of bilateral disease in familial and general cases. The authors infer that bilateral patients share the same genetic predisposition as familial cases, and that about one-third of testicular cancer patients are genetically predisposed. Among predisposed males, roughly 55% develop no tumor, 38% unilateral tumors, and 7% bilateral tumors. The 2.2% risk to brothers can be explained by homozygous recessive inheritance of a single predisposing gene. This is a theoretical genetic model rather than a clinical study.

pmid-7842403.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対して化学療法後に遅延精巣摘除術を受けた24例の検討である。全例で線維性瘢痕を認め、3例に持続性腫瘍、6例に成熟奇形腫があった。超音波検査では残存腫瘍と瘢痕を区別できなかった。化学療法後の精巣摘除術は依然として適切と結論している。
pmid-7842403.summary_en: This clinicopathologic review of 24 patients who underwent delayed orchiectomy after chemotherapy for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors compared testicular pathology with resected extragonadal masses and with blinded postchemotherapy ultrasound findings. All testes showed dense fibrous scarring, with three persistent germ cell tumors, six mature teratomas, and one carcinoma in situ. Testicular and extragonadal pathology were strongly concordant, and all three patients with persistent tumor later progressed at extragonadal sites. Ultrasound could not distinguish residual tumor from scar. The authors conclude that orchiectomy after chemotherapy remains appropriate.

pmid-7850331.summary_ja: セミノーマに対して作成されたモノクローナル抗体M2Aを99mTcで標識し、ヌードマウスの移植腫瘍（HEY細胞）を用いて前臨床評価を行った研究です。99mTc-M2Aは対照抗体と比べて腫瘍へ特異的に集積し、0.5〜1.0gの皮下腫瘍もガンマシンチグラフィで描出できました。セミノーマ転移のイメージング試薬としての臨床応用の可能性が示唆されていますが、臨床での検証はこれからです。
pmid-7850331.summary_en: This preclinical study evaluated monoclonal antibody M2A, raised against seminoma and labeled with technetium-99m for radioimmunoscintigraphy. In nude mice bearing HEY cell xenografts, 99mTc-M2A localized specifically to tumors compared with control antibodies. Subcutaneous tumors of 0.5 to 1.0 g were visualized by gamma scintigraphy 24 hours after injection. The authors conclude that 99mTc-M2A may be useful as a clinical imaging agent for seminoma metastases, although clinical validation is still needed.

pmid-7850777.summary_ja: 胎児性癌由来のF9細胞を用いて、シスプラチン（CDDP）の細胞分化への影響を検討したin vitro研究です。CDDP処理により細胞形態が速やかに変化し、複数の分化マーカーのmRNA発現が増加するとともに、腫瘍形成能が失われました。CDDPが胚細胞腫瘍モデルの分化を誘導することを示しており、白金製剤の作用機序の理解に関連する知見ですが、研究はすべて培養細胞によるものです。
pmid-7850777.summary_en: This study examined the effects of cisplatin (CDDP) on F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, a model of germ cell tumor. In vitro exposure to CDDP induced rapid morphological change and increased mRNA expression of several differentiation markers, while tumorigenicity was lost. The authors conclude that CDDP induces differentiation of F9 cells. This suggests a mechanism beyond direct cytotoxicity that may be relevant to platinum treatment of germ cell tumors. All findings come from cultured cells.

pmid-7853561.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの治療から10年後に傍脊椎の血管肉腫を発症した症例の報告です。治療には縦隔を含む領域への放射線照射が行われていました。著者らは治療的照射による腫瘍誘発が最も考えられる原因とし、セミノーマと血管肉腫の自然な関連や化学療法の関与の可能性にも言及しています。セミノーマ治療後の晩期の二次癌リスクと長期フォローアップの重要性を示す報告です。
pmid-7853561.summary_en: The authors describe a patient who developed paravertebral angiosarcoma 10 years after treatment for testicular seminoma. Treatment had included irradiation of fields including the mediastinum. The authors consider therapeutic irradiation the most likely cause of tumor induction, while also mentioning a possible natural association between seminoma and angiosarcoma and a possible role for chemotherapy. The report highlights the late risk of second malignancies after seminoma therapy and the need for long-term follow-up.

pmid-7853562.summary_ja: 病期I相当の精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に対し精巣摘除術を受けた後、6年後にサーベイランス中に後腹膜へセミノーマ成分のみの再発をきたした症例の報告です。4cmの転移性腫瘍はCTで描出されず、腫瘍マーカーも陰性で、紛らわしい症状のため診断が遅れました。セミノーマは非セミノーマより晩期に再発しやすく、CTを初期2年間に限定する監視法では晩期再発を見逃すおそれがあると警鐘を鳴らしています。
pmid-7853562.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with apparent stage I mixed germ cell tumor of the testis who developed a pure seminomatous retroperitoneal relapse six years after orchiectomy, during surveillance. The 4 cm metastatic mass was not seen on CT, tumor markers were negative, and confounding symptoms delayed diagnosis. Seminomatous tumors relapse later than nonseminomatous tumors. The authors argue that surveillance programs relying on CT only for the first two years may miss late relapse and delay curative treatment.

pmid-7853563.summary_ja: 著者らは、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し左根治的精巣摘除術を受けた後、経過観察のみで管理されていた患者が9年後に再発した症例を報告している。本論文では、不十分なフォローアップ、画像検査の限界、遅発性再発による死亡率上昇の可能性、長期プロトコルの費用と労力の増加など、経過観察プロトコルの問題点を論じている。低リスク患者と高リスク患者を区別する方法はなお発展途上であり、最適な経過観察戦略を明らかにするためのさらなる研究が必要であると著者らは述べている。
pmid-7853563.summary_en: The authors report a patient treated with left radical orchiectomy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who was managed with surveillance alone and recurred nine years later. The report discusses weaknesses of surveillance protocols, including inadequate follow-up, limitations of imaging, the possibility of higher mortality from late relapse, and increased cost and labor for prolonged protocols. Methods to distinguish low- and high-risk patients are still evolving. The authors call for further studies to define optimal surveillance strategies.

pmid-7853565.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の男性に発生した、前立腺原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告です。治療として併用化学療法4コース後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清、膀胱前立腺全摘除術、回腸導管による尿路変更が行われました。クラインフェルター症候群と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の関連についても文献的に考察しています。前立腺卵黄嚢腫瘍の報告は過去に2例のみであり、極めてまれな疾患の管理に関する貴重な知見です。
pmid-7853565.summary_en: The authors describe a rare primary yolk sac tumor of the prostate in a man with Klinefelter syndrome. Treatment consisted of four courses of combination chemotherapy, followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, cystoprostatectomy, and ileal conduit urinary diversion. The report reviews the association between Klinefelter syndrome and extragonadal germ cell tumors. Only two prior cases of prostatic yolk sac tumor had been reported, so this case adds to limited data on the management of this very rare disease.

pmid-7853567.summary_ja: 乳児の両側精巣腫瘍の症例報告で、左精巣に奇形腫、右精巣に類表皮嚢胞が同時に認められた。奇形腫は乳児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍で卵黄嚢癌に次いで多く、24か月未満では一般に良性とされる。類表皮嚢胞は単皮性奇形腫と考えられる稀な病変で、両側性は稀である。小児例の適切な治療法について考察している。
pmid-7853567.summary_en: This case report describes an infant with bilateral testicular tumors: a synchronous teratoma in the left testis and an epidermoid cyst in the right. The authors note that teratoma is the second most common testicular germ cell tumor in infants after yolk sac carcinoma, and that teratomas in children under 24 months are uniformly benign. Epidermoid cysts, probably monodermal teratomas, are rare, and bilateral involvement is uncommon for either lesion. The paper discusses appropriate therapeutic management for these lesions in young children.

pmid-7853587.summary_ja: 精巣がん1,182例のメタ解析で、206例が陰嚢内操作を受けていた。局所再発率は陰嚢内操作群で高かった(2.9%対0.4%)が、遠隔再発率と生存率に差はなかった。病期Iで陰嚢内操作を受けた症例も、サーベイランスから必ずしも除外する必要はなく、補助的局所療法も必須ではないと示唆された。標準治療は高位鼠径精巣摘除術のままである。
pmid-7853587.summary_en: A meta-analysis of 1,182 testicular cancer patients, 206 of whom had scrotal violation (non-standard surgery such as scrotal orchiectomy, open biopsy, or fine needle aspiration), compared local recurrence, distant recurrence, and survival. Local recurrence was higher after scrotal violation (2.9% versus 0.4%), but distant recurrence and survival did not differ. Patients with stage I disease and scrotal violation need not necessarily be excluded from surveillance or receive adjuvant local therapy. High inguinal orchiectomy remains the standard initial treatment.

pmid-7856688.summary_ja: 1962〜1990年に非転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の337例を治療し、253例がメトトレキサート単剤で初回治療を受けた。全例が治癒した。耐性は10.7%で生じ、治療前のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値50,000 mIU/mL以上、非胞状奇胎の先行妊娠、絨毛癌の診断が耐性と関連した。薬剤変更を要する毒性は4.7%のみで、主に口内炎であった。メトトレキサート単剤療法は忍容性と有効性に優れると結論している。
pmid-7856688.summary_en: Single-agent methotrexate was evaluated in 337 patients with nonmetastatic gestational trophoblastic tumors treated from 1962 to 1990, of whom 253 received methotrexate first. All were cured. Resistance developed in 10.7%, and factors associated with resistance included pretreatment hCG of 50,000 mIU/mL or more, nonmolar antecedent pregnancy, and a choriocarcinoma diagnosis. Toxicity requiring a change of agent occurred in only 4.7%, mainly stomatitis. The authors conclude that methotrexate monotherapy is well tolerated and effective.

pmid-7856692.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株5種について、組換えインターフェロンα・β・γの作用をゼラチナーゼ産生と浸潤能の面から検討した。浸潤能の高い株では72kdゼラチナーゼが高発現していた。インターフェロンβのみがゼラチナーゼ産生を低下させ、細胞毒性なしに浸潤を抑制した。絨毛癌の血管転移の抑制に有用となる可能性があり、さらなる研究が必要とされている。
pmid-7856692.summary_en: Five choriocarcinoma cell lines were studied for gelatinase production and invasiveness after exposure to recombinant interferons alpha, beta, and gamma. Highly invasive lines expressed high levels of 72 kd gelatinase, and some also contained an active 68 kd form. Recombinant interferon beta reduced gelatinase production and was the only interferon that inhibited invasion without cytotoxicity. The authors suggest that suppressing gelatinase with interferon beta could help inhibit vascular metastasis of choriocarcinoma, and that further studies are warranted.

pmid-7856755.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるCD30の発現を検討した。胎児性癌または胎児性癌成分を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍の9例すべてでCD30 mRNAが検出され、他の非リンパ性腫瘍では検出されなかった。血清中の可溶性CD30は胎児性癌の8例すべてで検出された。胎児性癌患者のモニタリングに有望なパラメーターであると提案している。
pmid-7856755.summary_en: The authors examined CD30 expression in testicular germ cell neoplasms. CD30 mRNA was detected in all nine cases of embryonal carcinoma or mixed germ cell tumor with an embryonal carcinoma component, and in no other nonlymphoid tumors. Soluble CD30 was detected in all eight sera from patients with embryonal carcinoma, but in only 8 of 10 sera from patients with other testicular germ cell tumors. CD30-expressing germ cells were absent from fetal tissue. The authors propose serum soluble CD30 as a promising parameter for monitoring embryonal carcinoma patients.

pmid-7866996.summary_ja: ヒト胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性疾患における父性由来H19の発現を検討した。正常胎盤ではH19は主に母性アレルから発現していた。完全胞状奇胎ではH19が強く発現し、この組織ではインプリンティングが機能していなかった。絨毛癌へ進展した2例はH19とIGF2が高発現していた。絨毛癌ではH19陽性細胞が減少しており、悪性化の過程での選択を反映する可能性がある。
pmid-7866996.summary_en: The study examined paternally derived H19 expression in human placenta and gestational trophoblastic disease. H19 was expressed mainly from the maternal allele in normal placenta, but was strongly expressed in complete hydatidiform moles, which carry only paternal genetic material, indicating non-imprinting in that tissue. Two complete moles that progressed to choriocarcinoma showed high H19 and IGF2 expression. The choriocarcinomas had similar IGF2 but fewer H19-positive cells, possibly reflecting selection against H19-expressing cells during malignant progression.

pmid-7869484.summary_ja: 本報告では、精巣の単純な類表皮嚢胞(単一皮膚性奇形腫)の患者18例に対する臓器温存手術を報告する。全例で腫瘍を完全に摘出し、隣接実質の生検で関連病変を除外した。術前評価には超音波検査、αフェトプロテインおよびβ-hCGの測定が含まれた。1例では多発性の類表皮嚢胞と、対側精巣の胎児性癌および絨毛癌を含む成人型奇形腫が併存していた。著者らは、良性の精巣類表皮嚢胞に対しては摘出と生検で十分な治療となると結論づけ、関連文献をレビューしている。
pmid-7869484.summary_en: This report describes 18 patients with simple epidermoid cysts of the testis (monodermal teratoma) treated with organ-preserving surgery. All tumors were completely enucleated, and two parenchymal biopsies per patient excluded associated germ cell cancer, scar, or carcinoma in situ. Preoperative evaluation included ultrasonography and AFP and β-hCG measurements. One patient had multiple epidermoid cysts coexisting with an adult teratoma containing embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma. The authors conclude that enucleation with biopsy is adequate treatment for benign testicular epidermoid cysts and review the literature.

pmid-7869524.summary_ja: 米国小児科学会泌尿器科部会の思春期前精巣腫瘍登録から、精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍で転移を有する33例を解析した。後腹膜のみに転移したのは9例、血行性転移のみが13例、リンパ行性と血行性の併存が6例、5例は記録が不明であった。血行性転移が優位であることから、思春期前の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の治療で後腹膜リンパ節郭清を日常的に行う意義は乏しいと結論づけている。
pmid-7869524.summary_en: Using data from the prepubertal testis tumor registry of the American Academy of Pediatrics Section on Urology, the authors analyzed 33 of 212 children with testicular yolk sac tumors who presented with metastases. Retroperitoneal metastases alone occurred in 9 cases, hematogenous-only spread in 13, combined lymphatic and hematogenous spread in 6, and 5 cases were undocumented. The predominance of hematogenous spread suggests that routine retroperitoneal lymph node dissection has no defined role in the initial management of prepubertal yolk sac tumor of the testis.

pmid-7880748.summary_ja: EORTCの第II相試験で、非AFP産生の巨大転移性セミノーマ、性腺外病変、放射線療法後の再発例42例に対し、HOPレジメン（イホスファミド、ビンクリスチン、シスプラチン）を評価した。最大効果はCR 65%、PR 28%で、3年生存率は90%であった。主な毒性は骨髄抑制で、25例で用量減量が必要であった。残存腫瘤の多くは再発せず、HOPは高い有効性を示すが毒性リスクも高いと結論づけている。
pmid-7880748.summary_en: This EORTC phase II trial evaluated the HOP regimen (ifosfamide, vincristine, cisplatin) in 42 eligible patients with bulky non-AFP-producing metastatic seminoma, extragonadal disease, or relapse after radiotherapy. Maximal response was complete remission in 65% and partial remission in 28%, with 3-year survival of 90%. Myelotoxicity was the main toxicity, with dose reductions in 25 patients. Most residual retroperitoneal and mediastinal masses resolved or were resected without relapse. The authors conclude HOP is highly effective but carries substantial toxicity.

pmid-7880752.summary_ja: 本研究はミラノの症例対照研究で、組織学的に確定した良性卵巣奇形腫の女性77例と、非婦人科疾患等で入院した対照231例を比較した。教育年数が長いほどリスクが上昇し（RR 1.6～2.5）、不妊歴ではRR 8.3と高値を示したが少数例に基づく。経産回数、経口避妊薬使用などとの明確な関連は認められなかった。
pmid-7880752.summary_en: This case-control study from Milan examined risk factors for benign ovarian teratoma, comparing 77 women under 65 with histologically confirmed benign ovarian teratoma to 231 hospital controls with non-gynecological, non-hormonal, non-neoplastic illnesses. Higher education was associated with increased risk (RR 1.6 and 2.5 for 7-11 and 12 or more years of schooling, significant trend). A history of infertility showed a markedly elevated RR of 8.3, although based on small numbers. Parity, marital status, menstrual and reproductive factors, and oral contraceptive use showed no clear association with risk.

pmid-7884248.summary_ja: 13歳女児の原発性縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。胸部X線で発見され、正中胸骨切開で大きな嚢胞性成熟奇形腫を完全切除した。腫瘍内には胎児性癌の巣があり、血清AFPは211.1 ng/mlであった。術後1年間の化学療法を経て、術後52か月まで再発はない。若年女性の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の稀な例である。
pmid-7884248.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with a primary anterior mediastinal malignant germ cell tumor, detected on school chest X-ray screening. Resection via median sternotomy revealed a large cystic mature teratoma containing embryonal carcinoma foci, with AFP-positive carcinoma cells; serum AFP was 211.1 ng/ml. She received 13 courses of multi-agent chemotherapy over one postoperative year and remained recurrence-free at 52 months. The report highlights the rarity of mediastinal germ cell tumors in young females, who differ from the usual young male patients.

pmid-7886527.summary_ja: 両側の精巣に同時に発生した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の8例をまとめた報告。4例では両側の組織像が異なっていた。対側病変の多くは超音波検査や術中探索で発見され、2例は原発巣発見の約6か月後に触診で見つかった。治療は従来の病期分類に基づき、8例中5例が再発なく経過している。
pmid-7886527.summary_en: This series reports eight patients with bilateral synchronous testicular germ cell tumors, four of whom had dissimilar histologic findings between the testes. In three patients the contralateral lesion was detected only by testicular ultrasonography or intraoperative exploration, while in two it appeared on palpation about six months after the primary cancer was identified. Treatment followed conventional staging, and five of eight patients remained free of recurrence. The study underscores the need for careful contralateral evaluation in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-7887073.summary_ja: 精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の既往をもつ患者に生じた悪性胸水の症例報告。細胞診では核が大きく核小体が目立つ単個の悪性細胞がみられ、当初は転移性セミノーマが疑われた。詳細な細胞学的・免疫組織化学的検討により転移性横紋筋肉腫と診断された。奇形腫成分からの悪性転化の可能性や、剥離細胞診の診断上の留意点を論じている。
pmid-7887073.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a prior mixed germ cell tumor of the testis who developed a malignant pleural effusion. Cytology showed single malignant cells with high nuclear-cytoplasmic ratio and prominent nucleoli, initially suggesting metastatic seminoma. Careful cytologic and immunohistochemical evaluation instead revealed metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma. The case illustrates sarcoma development in germ cell tumor patients, possibly via malignant transformation of teratomatous elements, and highlights diagnostic pitfalls of exfoliative cytology. Other germ cell tumor cytologic findings are also discussed.

pmid-7893365.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍25例を対象に、p53遺伝子変異、p53タンパク質発現、mdm-2の状態を解析した。多くの腫瘍で核内p53タンパク質の過剰発現がみられたが、遺伝子配列は全例で野生型だった。mdm-2の増幅は3例で認められ、mdm-2 mRNAの発現はp53タンパク質と相関した。野生型p53が放射線療法や化学療法への良好な反応を説明する可能性が論じられている。
pmid-7893365.summary_en: This study analyzed p53 gene mutations, p53 protein expression, and mdm-2 status in 25 testicular germ cell tumors. Most tumors overexpressed nuclear p53 protein, yet all showed wild-type p53 exons 4-9, suggesting no selective pressure for p53 mutation. mdm-2 amplification was found in three tumors, and mdm-2 mRNA overexpression correlated with p53 protein levels. The authors propose that retained wild-type p53 may mediate apoptosis after DNA damage, potentially explaining the good response of these tumors to radiation and chemotherapy and their favorable prognosis.

pmid-7966739.summary_ja: 本シリーズでは、精巣摘除術ではなく臓器温存的な摘出術を受けた両側性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者6例を報告する。組織型はセミノーマ、胎児性癌、ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍であった。全例が上皮内癌に対して20 Gyの精巣照射を受け、術後に生検を施行された。追跡期間の中央値43か月で、全例が病変なしで局所再発はなく、ホルモン値は正常範囲内であった。著者らは、厳格な条件下での臓器温存手術を提案している。
pmid-7966739.summary_en: This series describes six patients with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors treated with organ-sparing enucleation rather than orchiectomy. Histology included seminoma, embryonal carcinoma and Leydig cell tumor. All patients received 20 Gy testicular irradiation for carcinoma in situ and underwent postoperative biopsy. With a median follow-up of 43 months, all remained disease-free without local recurrence, and hormone levels stayed within normal limits. The authors propose organ-sparing surgery under strict prerequisites.

pmid-7966799.summary_ja: インディアナ大学の本シリーズでは、1965年から1989年に非セミノーマ性胚細胞精巣がんに対して後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた1,180例を検討した。臨床病期B患者174例のうち23%は病理学的にリンパ節転移がなかった。病理学的病期Bの患者は、郭清単独で65%が治癒した。シスプラチン時代には、シスプラチン基盤の補助化学療法の追加により再発がなくなり、全生存率は98%であった。著者らは、郭清は診断的かつ治療的であると結論づけている。
pmid-7966799.summary_en: This Indiana University series reviewed 1,180 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous germ cell testis cancer between 1965 and 1989. Among 174 clinical stage B patients, 23% had no nodal disease at pathology. Pathological stage B patients were cured by dissection alone in 65% of cases. After the cisplatin era, adding cisplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy eliminated relapse, and overall survival was 98%. The authors conclude that dissection is both diagnostic and therapeutic.

pmid-7966800.summary_ja: 単独精巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者14例に対し、臓器温存的な腫瘍核出術を行った報告です。拡大鏡下の微小外科手技と術中ドプラ超音波で血管を同定しました。14例中10例で成功し、2例は血流不足のため後に摘除が必要でした。局所再発はなく、術後の放射線療法や経過観察が前提条件とされています。
pmid-7966800.summary_en: The authors report organ-preserving enucleation of malignant germ cell tumors in 14 patients with solitary testes. Tumors were excised under cold ischemia using minisurgical technique with 2-fold magnification, and Doppler sonography localized vessels intraoperatively. The procedure succeeded in 10 of 14 patients, while 2 required later orchiectomy for inadequate blood supply. Two patients had subnormal testosterone, and there were no local recurrences. The authors detail prerequisites, including tumor size of 20 mm or less and postoperative local irradiation.

pmid-7968790.summary_ja: 病期4の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の2歳女児が、大量化学療法後に寛解に至りました。治療終了の12か月後に頭痛や意識障害で発症し、突然死しました。剖検で脳室内に混合型胚細胞腫瘍の大きな病変がみられ、他の悪性所見はありませんでした。寛解中の小児における悪性胚細胞腫瘍の孤立性中枢神経転移の初例として報告されています。
pmid-7968790.summary_en: The authors describe a 2-year-old girl with stage 4 mediastinal germ cell tumor who achieved complete remission after high-dose chemotherapy. Twelve months after completing treatment, she presented with headache, obtundation and brain herniation and died suddenly. Autopsy revealed a large intraventricular lesion with mixed germ cell tumor elements, with no other evidence of malignancy. The authors report this as the first case of isolated CNS metastasis of malignant germ cell tumor in a child in apparent remission, and suggest aggressive chemotherapy may have altered the disease course.

pmid-7983737.summary_ja: ヒト内在性レトロウイルスHERV-K10のGagタンパク質が、セミノーマの腫瘍組織で合成されることを示した研究です。セミノーマ患者では、腫瘍発見時に抗Gag抗体価が約1:2,560と著しく高値でした。免疫組織化学では腫瘍細胞の細胞質にGagが発現していました。腫瘍発生における役割は未解明です。
pmid-7983737.summary_en: The authors show that the human endogenous retrovirus HERV-K10 encodes a Gag protein that is processed into several fragments and expressed in the teratocarcinoma line Tera 1. Antibodies to HERV-K10 Gag were found in 2-4% of tumor patients, but patients with seminoma had markedly higher titers, around 1:2,560, at diagnosis. Immunohistochemistry showed cytoplasmic Gag expression in tumor cells, and an 80-kDa polyprotein was detected in seminoma biopsies. The findings indicate that HERV-K10 Gag is synthesized in seminoma cells, though its role in tumorigenesis remains unknown.

pmid-8519678.summary_ja: 1975～1989年にスコットランド西部で診断された男性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を、がん登録に基づき解析した疫学研究です。発生率は全体で20年、15～44歳男性では25年で倍増していました。増加は社会経済的に恵まれない地域の男性に限られていました。社会経済的状況と発生率の正の相関が確認されました。
pmid-8519678.summary_en: This population-based study used the West of Scotland cancer registry to examine 438 male cases of teratoma diagnosed from 1975 to 1989, plus 44 cases from tertiary centers. Registration accuracy was checked against pathology and residence records. Incidence increased over the period, with doubling times of 20 years overall and 25 years for men aged 15 to 44. The rise was confined to men in the more deprived postcode sectors, while incidence in affluent areas stayed unchanged. The authors confirm a positive correlation between socioeconomic status and incidence.

pmid-8520169.summary_ja: 生後4日の新生児にみられた巨大な頸部未熟奇形腫の症例報告。CTと超音波検査で石灰化と多房性嚢胞を伴う充実性腫瘤を認め、生後12日目に完全切除された。病理で胎児型軟骨と未熟な神経管を確認した。早期の完全切除と仙尾部奇形腫に準じた管理が推奨され、小児奇形腫における頸部奇形腫の頻度も示されている。
pmid-8520169.summary_en: This case report describes a large immature cervical teratoma in a 4-day-old neonate who presented with a neck mass. Contrast-enhanced CT and ultrasonography showed a predominantly solid calcified mass with multiple cysts, which could not clearly be distinguished from hemangioma. Complete surgical resection at 12 days of life revealed an immature teratoma containing fetal-type cartilage and immature neural tubes. The authors recommend early complete excision and management similar to sacrococcygeal teratoma, and report the incidence of cervical teratoma among pediatric teratomas in Western and Japanese series.

pmid-8521888.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣穿刺吸引生検のDNA画像サイトメトリーによる精巣上皮内癌(CIS)の診断と経過観察の有用性を評価した。不妊症の男性50例のうち、2例がCISを有しており、1例は胎児性癌を併存していた。異数性細胞集団によりCISが同定された。限局照射を受けた患者では一倍体細胞が消失し、無治療の患者では持続性のCISが認められた。4年間で浸潤癌は発生しなかった。著者らは、DNAサイトメトリーが客観的かつ迅速な手法として有用であると提案している。
pmid-8521888.summary_en: This study evaluated DNA image cytometry of testicular aspiration biopsies for diagnosing and following testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS). Among 50 infertile men who underwent both surgical and aspiration testis biopsies, two had CIS, one with concurrent embryonal carcinoma. Aneuploid cell populations identified CIS. Serial aspiration biopsies monitored response: a patient treated with localized radiation lost haploid cells, whereas the untreated patient retained persistent CIS. No invasive cancer developed over four years. The authors propose DNA cytometry as an objective, rapid tool.

pmid-8521889.summary_ja: 1974〜1993年に治療された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍23例を後方視的に検討した研究。5年生存率は55%で、セミノーマは良好、縦隔原発と低分化癌組織は予後不良因子であった。後腹膜の非セミノーマは精巣腫瘍に近い経過を示した。組織型と原発部位別の管理が必要と結論している。
pmid-8521889.summary_en: This retrospective review of 23 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated between 1974 and 1993 assessed long-term survival and prognostic factors. Primary sites included retroperitoneum, mediastinum, pineal gland and other locations. Treatment combined cisplatin-based chemotherapy with local irradiation or surgery, and most patients achieved complete response. After median follow-up of 63 months, five-year survival was 55%. Seminomas had excellent outcomes, retroperitoneal nonseminomas behaved like testicular tumors, and poorly differentiated histology and mediastinal primaries predicted worse prognosis.

pmid-8522269.summary_ja: 初診から50年以上経過して発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌(IIIC期)の症例報告。骨盤放射線療法で治療された。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は1〜3%とされ、血清SCC抗原による早期発見の有用性についても考察している。
pmid-8522269.summary_en: A patient with a stage IIIC squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma more than 50 years after initial diagnosis is reported. The tumor was treated with pelvic radiotherapy. The authors note that malignant degeneration of mature cystic teratomas occurs in 1-3% of cases and discuss the value of serum squamous cell carcinoma antigen for detecting degeneration at an early stage.

pmid-8522320.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋切片を用いたin situハイブリダイゼーションで、小児性腺卵黄嚢腫瘍7例の染色体異常を解析。全例で数的異常、6例で12番染色体の増加がみられた。1p36.3の欠失は5例中4例に認められ、小児卵黄嚢腫瘍の発症に関わる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8522320.summary_en: Chromosomal aberrations were examined by in situ hybridization on paraffin sections from seven pediatric gonadal yolk sac tumors. Numerical gains were common, with at least three chromosomes overrepresented in every tumor, and chromosome 12 gain in six. Structural aberrations involving the short arm of chromosome 1 were nonrandom, and a deletion at 1p36.3 was found in four of five tumors. The authors suggest that loss of genes at 1p36.3 is an important event in the pathogenesis of childhood yolk sac tumors, which may differ from adult germ cell tumors.

pmid-8523248.summary_ja: 精巣女性化症候群の17か月の児にみられた腹部腫瘤の症例で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値を示し、病理学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。シスプラチン含有化学療法後にAFPは2か月で正常化し、4年後も無病生存。鼠径ヘルニア手術時の注意と、二次性徴まで続く慎重なフォローアップの重要性を強調している。
pmid-8523248.summary_en: A 17-month-old child with testicular feminization syndrome, identified during inguinal herniorrhaphy, underwent surgery for an abdominal mass with markedly elevated alpha-fetoprotein. Histology showed a yolk sac tumor. After adjuvant cisplatin-containing chemotherapy, AFP normalized within two months, and the patient remained disease-free at four years. The authors emphasize that surgeons performing herniorrhaphy in girls should anticipate testicular feminization, and that careful follow-up is needed until secondary sex characteristics develop.

pmid-8526185.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の74例を対象に、白金製剤併用化学療法を5コース未満と5コース以上で比較した。5コース以上では完全奏効率と生存率が高く、特に進行病期IIIで差が大きかった。軽度の病期IIIでは4コースで十分な可能性があり、完全奏効後の追加コースが進行例の治癒性を高めると示唆された。
pmid-8526185.summary_en: This study of 74 patients with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with platinum-based chemotherapy (VBP, BEP, or EP) compares outcomes with fewer than five versus five or more courses. Complete response and survival were higher with five or more courses, particularly in advanced stage III disease. The authors suggest four courses may suffice for minimal stage III disease, while additional courses after complete response may improve cure rates in advanced disease.

pmid-8527395.summary_ja: 思春期・成人の原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍のうち染色体異常を有する102例を解析した。セミノーマ32例と非セミノーマ性腫瘍70例を対象とした。反復して見られた構造異常は12p等腕染色体(i(12p))のみで、約70%に認められ、非セミノーマで多かった。染色体の増減は組織型により異なり、i(12p)は腫瘍進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8527395.summary_en: Cytogenetic analysis of 102 abnormal cases of primary testicular germ cell tumors in adolescents and adults, comprising 32 seminomas and 70 nonseminomatous tumors. Isochromosome 12p, i(12p), was the only recurrent structural abnormality, present in about 70% of cases and more frequent in nonseminomas. Both histologies showed triploid-range chromosome numbers, with differing gains and losses between seminomas and nonseminomas. The authors suggest i(12p) may contribute to tumor progression and that certain chromosomes may influence differentiation.

pmid-8528292.summary_ja: 1982年から1993年に登録された小児・思春期の精巣胚細胞腫瘍137例の多施設共同研究である。大半が卵黄嚢腫瘍で、全例に半精巣摘除術を施行した。化学療法は病期と組織型に基づき、標準はVBP4コースであった。病期Iの卵黄嚢腫瘍の多くは経過観察とされ、一部は後に化学療法を要した。
pmid-8528292.summary_en: Cooperative MAHO studies (1982 to 1993) of 137 children and adolescents with testicular germ cell tumors, mostly yolk sac tumors, all treated with semicastration. Chemotherapy was given according to stage and histology, using a standard VBP regimen, delayed laparotomy for suspected residual tumor, and salvage therapy for incomplete responses. Most stage I yolk sac tumor patients followed a wait-and-see policy, with a minority later needing delayed chemotherapy. The abstract is truncated.

pmid-8531144.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍細胞株T7800をシスプラチンに段階的に曝露して耐性株T7800Rを作製した。耐性株ではメタロチオネインのmRNAとタンパク質が増加し、耐性は高まったが増殖速度は低下した。複数のヒト腫瘍細胞株でもMT量と耐性は相関したが、MT量の差は耐性の程度を正確には反映しなかった。
pmid-8531144.summary_en: The human teratocarcinoma line T7800 was made cisplatin-resistant by stepwise exposure, yielding T7800R cells with higher metallothionein mRNA and protein, greater cisplatin resistance, and slower growth. Across several human tumor lines, metallothionein content correlated with cisplatin resistance, with no difference in glutathione. The authors conclude that selection for cisplatin resistance in germ cell tumor cells co-selects for enhanced metallothionein, though MT levels do not precisely track the degree of resistance.

pmid-8532694.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるEBウイルスの関与をPCRとEBER in situハイブリダイゼーションで検討した。セミノーマ21例中4例でEBV陽性だったが、腫瘍細胞には陽性所見はなく、陽性は腫瘍内リンパ球に限られた。EBVが腫瘍発生に直接関与する可能性は低いと結論づけている。
pmid-8532694.summary_en: This study used PCR and in situ hybridization for EBV-encoded small RNAs to test whether Epstein-Barr virus is present in testicular germ cell neoplasms. EBV DNA was detected in 4 of 21 seminomas, but none of the nonseminomatous or combined tumors. EBER-positive cells were found only in intratumoral lymphocytes, never in neoplastic cells. The authors conclude that EBV is unlikely to play a direct role in the pathogenesis of these tumors, though whether the lymphocyte findings reflect local factors remains unresolved.

pmid-8533196.summary_ja: ダウン症候群の患者に頭蓋内胚腫と精巣胎児性癌という2つの胚細胞腫瘍が併発した症例の報告である。ダウン症候群における重複原発がんの報告は、著者らの知る限りこれまでにないとされる。白血病以外の悪性腫瘍は稀であり、異なる部位に生じた2つの胚細胞腫瘍の併存は臨床的に注目に値する。
pmid-8533196.summary_en: A patient with Down syndrome developed two germ cell tumors: an intracranial germinoma and a testicular embryonal carcinoma. The authors describe this as a case report and note that, to their knowledge, no previous case of double primary carcinoma in Down syndrome had been published. Because leukemia is more common than other malignancies in this population, the coexistence of two germ cell neoplasms at different sites is unusual and clinically noteworthy.

pmid-8533205.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者には後腹膜に潜在的な病変が存在する可能性があり、病理学的に病期Iと判定された患者でも7～15%が再発する。本研究では、再発した病理病期I期の患者14例と、再発しなかった47例を比較した。精巣摘除標本の増殖活性を組織学およびDNAフローサイトメトリーで評価したところ、遠隔再発を予測した。著者らは、増殖活性が後腹膜転移と同様に再発リスクのマーカーとなる可能性を示唆している。
pmid-8533205.summary_en: Clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients may harbor occult retroperitoneal disease, and those staged pathologically as stage I still relapse in 7 to 15 percent of cases. This study compared 14 pathological stage I patients who relapsed with 47 who did not. Proliferative activity in the orchiectomy specimen, measured by histology and DNA flow cytometry, predicted distant relapse. The authors suggest proliferation may serve as a marker of recurrence risk, as it does for retroperitoneal metastasis.

pmid-8533680.summary_ja: 日本で初めて報告された父子の精巣がん症例である。父は41歳で右精巣セミノーマ、息子は17歳で奇形腫成分を伴う右精巣胎児性癌を発症した。世界でこれまでに報告された父子例は30組のみで、遺伝的要因の関与が示唆されるが確証はないと述べている。
pmid-8533680.summary_en: This report describes a Japanese father and son with testicular cancer, the first such familial pair described in Japan. The father had a right testicular seminoma at 41, and his son had an embryonal carcinoma with teratoma elements at 17. The authors reviewed the 30 father-son pairs previously reported worldwide. They conclude that heritable factors may contribute to familial testicular cancer, although definitive evidence is lacking.

pmid-8533681.summary_ja: 22歳男性の左精巣純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例である。精巣摘除後、COMPE療法と高用量化学療法を施行し、肺転移と傍大動脈リンパ節が著明に縮小した。残存した後腹膜腫瘤を切除し、切除標本では壊死と線維化が認められた。化学療法後2年時点で病勢の証拠はない。
pmid-8533681.summary_en: A 22-year-old man with a pure yolk sac tumor of the left testis received chemotherapy with COMPE and high-dose COME regimens after orchiectomy. Lung metastases and para-aortic nodes responded substantially, and residual retroperitoneal masses were resected. Histology showed necrosis and xanthogranulomatous fibrosis. The patient remained disease-free at two years. The case illustrates a favorable outcome in advanced yolk sac tumor.

pmid-8536234.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍2例由来の細胞株を対象に、FISH、G分染、LOH解析を組み合わせて核型と遺伝子変化を検討した。FISHにより、G分染で同定された切断点の7箇所の修正と21箇所の新規同定が行われた。1、12、18番染色体の異常が多く、18qで両腫瘍にLOHが認められた。
pmid-8536234.summary_en: Newly established cell lines from two human testicular germ cell tumors, a teratoma and a seminoma/teratoma, were analyzed by FISH karyotyping, G-banding, and RFLP-based loss of heterozygosity testing. FISH revised seven of eleven G-banded breakpoints and identified 21 new ones. Chromosomes 1, 12, and 18 were involved most often, with 18q showing LOH in both tumors. The authors note that chromosome 1 rearrangements are more complex than cytogenetics alone predicted.

pmid-8536237.summary_ja: PCR多型により栄養膜腫瘍24例の遺伝学的起源を解析した。胞状奇胎後の腫瘍8例は父性由来であり、非妊娠性絨毛癌3例は父性アレルを欠き単為生殖起源が示唆された。起源の異なる少なくとも3つの亜型が認められ、栄養膜腫瘍の発生機序が多様であることが示された。
pmid-8536237.summary_en: The authors determined the parental origin of 24 gestational trophoblastic neoplasms using PCR polymorphisms. Nine arose after molar pregnancy, 12 after live birth or abortion, and three were nongestational choriocarcinomas. Eight postmolar tumors were androgenetic, and three nongestational choriocarcinomas lacked paternal alleles, suggesting parthenogenetic origin. Three distinct origin patterns were identified, indicating heterogeneous mechanisms among trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-8537500.summary_ja: ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の既往がある35歳女性に、15年後に鎖骨部の腫瘤が生じ、ランゲルハンス細胞組織球症と診断された症例である。両病変の関連が強く示唆され、共通の病因について考察している。胚細胞腫瘍の既往と組織球性疾患の発生の関連を示す稀な報告である。
pmid-8537500.summary_en: A 35-year-old Chinese woman presented with a left clavicular mass 15 years after treatment for a left ovarian dysgerminoma. Histology revealed Langerhans cell histiocytosis. The authors describe a probable association between the two lesions and discuss possible shared pathogenetic mechanisms. The report highlights a suggested link between a prior germ cell tumor and subsequent histiocytic disease, which is rare.

pmid-8537993.summary_ja: 23歳の妊婦で、母体血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇と超音波検査による下顎部胎児嚢胞性腫瘤が認められた症例である。出生した新生児は大きな鼻咽頭奇形腫を有し、気道確保が極めて困難だった。重篤な心奇形と呼吸器疾患により新生児期に死亡した。出生前所見の認識と周産期管理の準備の重要性を強調している。
pmid-8537993.summary_en: The authors describe a neonate with a large nasopharyngeal teratoma, detected prenatally in a 23-year-old pregnant woman with elevated maternal serum AFP and a fetal mandibular cystic mass on ultrasound. The airway was extremely difficult to secure, and severe cardiac anomalies and respiratory disease caused neonatal death. The report emphasizes recognizing prenatal warning signs and preparing for early airway management and maintenance of fetal oxygenation.

pmid-8538044.summary_ja: 家族性仙尾部奇形腫は非常に稀で、8家系31例(日本の1家系を含む)が報告されている。全例がAltman IV型であり、最も多い症状は便秘と肛門直腸狭窄である。死亡例2例のうち1例は術後髄膜炎、もう1例は10年後の悪性転化によるものであった。
pmid-8538044.summary_en: This review summarizes familial sacrococcygeal teratoma, a very rare condition with 31 reported patients across eight kindreds, including one Japanese family. All cases were Altman type IV, with presacral teratoma and bony anomalies. Constipation and anorectal stenosis were the most common symptoms. Two patients died, one from meningitis after surgery and one from malignant transformation ten years later. Malignant change appears less common in familial than sporadic cases.

pmid-8540131.summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の2例で、診断後4年と2年に急性M2白血病を発症した。1例はPEB療法を受けた女性である。化学療法の時期だけでは腫瘍関連と治療関連の白血病を区別できないと結論している。
pmid-8540131.summary_en: This 1995 report describes two patients with mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who developed acute M2 leukemia 4 and 2 years after diagnosis. The authors note that mediastinal tumors have poorer survival than testicular and retroperitoneal counterparts, possibly partly due to hematologic neoplasms. The second patient, a woman, had received PEB chemotherapy, which may have contributed to leukemogenesis. The first patient did not receive adjuvant chemotherapy and developed leukemia months after local recurrence. The authors conclude that time from chemotherapy does not distinguish tumor-associated from therapy-related leukemia.

pmid-8540156.summary_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマの化学療法後に3cm以上の後腹膜残存腫瘤を有した4例に、術中照射20Gyを併用した報告である。2例で生存癌が見つかり追加化学療法を受けた。平均19か月の経過で全例が無病生存し、重篤な合併症はなかった。
pmid-8540156.summary_en: This 1995 report describes four patients with advanced testicular seminoma who had residual retroperitoneal masses of 3 cm or more after chemotherapy. All underwent incomplete retroperitoneal lymph node dissection followed by intraoperative irradiation (IORT) at 20 Gy. Two patients had viable carcinoma in the resected specimen and received further chemotherapy. No IORT-related complications occurred. All four were alive and disease-free at a mean follow-up of 19 months, with a range of 10 to 26 months. The authors propose IORT as an attractive option and as a way to identify patients who need additional chemotherapy.

pmid-8542725.summary_ja: 卵巣の性索間質腫瘍と胚細胞腫瘍の新しい亜型を扱った1995年の総説である。単一胚葉性奇形腫が含まれる。卵巣の転移性腫瘍と原発性腫瘍を鑑別する手がかりも示している。
pmid-8542725.summary_en: This 1995 review examines unusual and recently described ovarian neoplasms, including variants of Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor, monodermal teratomas, and small cell carcinoma of the hypercalcemic and pulmonary types. Monodermal teratomas, a germ cell tumor subtype, are part of the discussion. The article also addresses clues for distinguishing metastatic tumors from primary ovarian tumors. The review aims to help pathologists recognize these entities and interpret ovarian tumor specimens more accurately.

pmid-8542727.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断の新しい方法を論じた1995年の総説である。生物学的理解は進んだが、遺伝学的基盤をさらに明らかにする必要があると述べている。診断、サーベイランス、治療の改善への期待を示す短い論評である。
pmid-8542727.summary_en: This 1995 review discusses new approaches to diagnosing gestational trophoblastic disease. The authors note that progress in understanding the biology of gestational trophoblastic tumors has been considerable. They argue that future work will classify current knowledge as basic. They hope that more precise definition of the genetic basis of these diverse lesions will lead to better diagnostic, surveillance, and treatment methods. The article is brief and mainly an editorial-style overview of the field.

pmid-8547537.summary_ja: カナダの症例対照研究で、精巣がん患者510例と年齢適合対照996例を比較した。停留精巣、手術を要する鼠径ヘルニア、水瘤は精巣がんリスクの上昇と関連した。身長180cm超もリスク増加と関連した。中等度以上の余暇活動はリスク低下と関連した（OR 0.6）。
pmid-8547537.summary_en: This Canadian case-control study of 510 men with testicular cancer and 996 age-matched controls examined risk factors for germ cell cancers. Undescended testis, inguinal hernia requiring surgery, and hydrocele were associated with increased risk. Height above 180 cm was also linked to higher risk. Moderate to high recreational activity was associated with reduced risk (OR 0.6). Questionnaire data were collected by mail, with response rates of 80.3% among cases and 68.1% among controls. The findings highlight developmental factors and physical activity in testicular cancer risk.

pmid-8548037.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた癌9例でp53変異を検討した。内訳は扁平上皮癌6例などであった。4例で核内p53蓄積がみられ、1例の低分化扁平上皮癌でエクソン8にフレームシフト変異を認めた。HPVゲノムは検出されなかった。卵巣類皮嚢腫由来の二次性癌ではp53変異はまれであるが、症例数は少ない。
pmid-8548037.summary_en: This study examined p53 mutations in nine carcinomas arising in mature cystic teratomas of the ovary. The tumors included six squamous cell carcinomas, one squamous cell carcinoma in situ, one undifferentiated small cell carcinoma, and one mucoepidermoid carcinoma. Abnormal nuclear p53 accumulation was seen in four tumors. Sequencing of exons 5-8 identified a frameshift mutation in exon 8 in one poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma. No HPV genome was detected in any sample. The authors conclude that p53 mutations are relatively uncommon in carcinomas developing in ovarian dermoid cysts, although the sample size was small.

pmid-8548132.summary_ja: 絨毛癌、肝様腺癌、小細胞癌、管状腺癌の4成分からなる食道腫瘍の稀な症例を報告する。絨毛癌成分はβ-hCG陽性、肝様腺癌成分はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性細胞を含んだ。腫瘍の口側には胃型円柱上皮が隣接し、バレット食道由来が示唆されたが、逆流歴は確認できなかった。
pmid-8548132.summary_en: This report describes an esophageal tumor composed of four histologic components: choriocarcinoma, hepatoid adenocarcinoma, small cell carcinoma, and tubular adenocarcinoma. Choriocarcinomatous areas contained beta-hCG-positive cells, and hepatoid areas contained AFP-positive cells. Small cell areas expressed serotonin or ACTH, and tubular areas expressed CEA. Non-neoplastic gastric-type columnar epithelium was directly adjacent to the tumor on its oral side. The authors suggest the tumor may have originated from Barrett's esophagus, although a history of reflux could not be confirmed.

pmid-8548737.summary_ja: 精巣上皮内癌(CIS)2例と、隣接する浸潤性腫瘍(非セミノーマ1例、セミノーマ1例)の染色体所見を比較した。同一患者内でCISと浸潤性腫瘍の染色体異常が類似していた。CISと浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍がクローン性に関連することを初めて細胞遺伝学的に示し、CISが前駆病変であることを支持する結果である。
