pmid-8166998.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の上皮内癌を含む20検体について、PCRによりHPVとEBVのDNAを検出した。増幅できた19検体からHPV16型とHPV18型は検出されなかった。EBVは6例で微弱なシグナルを示したが、免疫組織化学と in situ ハイブリダイゼーションでは陰性であった。ウイルスが発癌に直接関与する可能性は低いが、間質のEBV感染リンパ球による増殖促進作用は否定できないと結論している。
pmid-8166998.summary_en: The authors tested 20 testicular germ cell tumor specimens, including preinvasive carcinoma in situ, for HPV and EBV DNA using PCR. None of the 19 successfully amplified samples contained HPV-16 or HPV-18 DNA. Faint EBV DNA signals appeared in six cases on one of two runs, but immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization were negative. The findings argue against a significant direct role for these viruses in testicular germ cell carcinogenesis, although a growth-stimulating effect of EBV-transformed lymphocytes in the stroma cannot be excluded.

pmid-8170083.summary_ja: 41歳男性が頸部リンパ節腫脹で受診し、精巣は正常大であった。CTで後腹膜腫瘍が見つかり、血清hCGとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に上昇していた。頸部リンパ節生検で胎児性癌と診断された。圧痛のある左精巣を摘除したところ、精巣上体直下に約7mmの微小腫瘍が見つかり、病期IIIaとされた。VAB-6療法3コースで部分寛解が得られた。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が疑われる場合は超音波検査で精巣を慎重に検査すべきと述べている。
pmid-8170083.summary_en: A 41-year-old man presented with a cervical lymph node swelling and a normal-sized testis. CT revealed a retroperitoneal tumor, and serum hCG and AFP were markedly elevated. Cervical node biopsy showed embryonal carcinoma. Excision of the tender left testis revealed an occult 7 mm tumor beneath the epididymis, leading to a stage IIIa diagnosis. Three courses of VAB-6 chemotherapy produced partial relief. The authors suggest that the testis should be carefully examined by ultrasonography whenever an extragonadal germ cell tumor is suspected.

pmid-8174069.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍2例で共通して見られた、6p21・6p22・6q23・11q13を含む反復性の複雑な染色体転座を解析した。FISHとパルスフィールドゲル電気泳動により、11q13の切断点をD11S457とD11S546のマーカー間に位置づけた。両腫瘍で異常な制限酵素断片が認められ、切断点はD11S546から約200kbp以内にあると推定された。切断点領域を絞り込んだ分子学的報告である。
pmid-8174069.summary_en: The authors characterized a recurring complex chromosomal translocation involving 6p21, 6p22, 6q23, and 11q13 in two independent extragonadal germ cell tumors. Using FISH and pulsed-field gel electrophoresis, they mapped the 11q13 breakpoint between markers D11S457 and D11S546. Aberrant restriction fragments in both tumors indicated that the breakpoint lies within about 200 kilobase pairs of D11S546. The study narrows the breakpoint region within a long-range restriction map of this chromosomal band.

pmid-8174074.summary_ja: 縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍に認められる染色体12の異常を、競合的in situハイブリダイゼーション法で検討した研究である。i(12p)を含むマウス-ヒト体細胞雑種細胞株由来のプローブを用い、この異常が染色体12短腕の真のアイソクロモソームであることを確認した。胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な染色体異常の分子遺伝学的な裏付けを示している。
pmid-8174074.summary_en: This study applied competitive in situ hybridization to a mediastinal germ cell tumor to examine a chromosome 12 aberration previously identified cytogenetically as isochromosome 12p. Using a mouse-human somatic hybrid cell line containing i(12p) as a probe, the authors confirmed that the marker is a true isochromosome of the short arm of chromosome 12. The work is a molecular cytogenetic characterization of a single mediastinal germ cell tumor case and supports the chromosomal abnormality as a genuine, recurrent feature of germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-8174097.summary_ja: 3例の悪性トロホブラスト性腫瘍（絨毛癌2例、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)1例）の遺伝的起源を制限酵素断片長多型解析で検討した。完全奇胎由来の可能性がある絨毛癌1例は父親由来と母親由来の両方の対立遺伝子を有しており、正常受精を示唆した。もう1例の絨毛癌は減数第一分裂後の胚細胞に由来する単為生殖性のパターンを示した。PSTTは両親由来の対立遺伝子を含み、以前の異常妊娠が示唆された。組織量が少ないためPCR増幅が必要であった。
pmid-8174097.summary_en: The authors determined the genetic origin of three malignant trophoblastic neoplasms, two choriocarcinomas and one placental site trophoblastic tumor, by restriction fragment length polymorphism analysis. One choriocarcinoma, possibly arising from a complete mole, carried both paternal and maternal alleles, suggesting normal fertilization. The other choriocarcinoma showed a parthenogenetic pattern consistent with origin from a germ cell after meiosis I. The PSTT contained alleles from both parents, indicating a prior abnormal pregnancy, and required PCR amplification because little tumor material was available.

pmid-8175442.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの3つの治療戦略を、6施設の後方視的解析で比較した。再発率は監視療法で27%と最も高く、放射線療法6%、カルボプラチン2コース1%、1コースで0%であった。カルボプラチン補助療法は忍容性が良好で有効と結論され、ランダム化試験が必要とされた。
pmid-8175442.summary_en: This study compared three management strategies for Stage I seminoma: surveillance, prophylactic radiotherapy, and adjuvant single-agent carboplatin, at six centers in the Anglian Germ Cell Tumor Group. Recurrence was most frequent under surveillance (27%), followed by radiotherapy (6%) and one course of platinum (1%), with none after one course of carboplatin. Toxicity was similar across groups, although single-course carboplatin appeared to cause less sickness. The authors conclude that carboplatin is well tolerated and effective, and recommend a randomized trial.

pmid-8175977.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARを用い、hCG生合成が正常絨毛と同様に自己調節されるかを検討した。外因性hCGはJAR細胞のhCG遺伝子発現と分泌を抑制しなかった。受容体の発現様式も正常と異なっていた。この自己調節の欠如が、妊娠性絨毛性疾患で高いhCG値を示す理由と考えられた。
pmid-8175977.summary_en: The authors examined whether JAR human choriocarcinoma cells regulate hCG biosynthesis by feedback, as normal trophoblasts do. Exogenous hCG failed to suppress hCG alpha and beta transcripts or secretion in JAR cells, and receptor antibodies had no effect. Unlike normal trophoblasts, JAR cells express multiple hCG/LH receptor transcripts and only a 50-kilodalton receptor isoform. cAMP still induced hCG alpha expression. The authors conclude that the loss of self-regulation may explain the very high hCG levels seen in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-8177140.summary_ja: 1956年から1985年にIGRで治療された小児の卵巣純粋型ディスジャーミノーマ35例を後方視的に検討した。5年全生存率は94.1%であった。病期Iは無症状で生存したが、病期II・IIIでは放射線療法による重篤な晩期障害がみられた。播種例にはシスプラチン含有化学療法を先行し、残存腫瘍のみ放射線療法とすることが提案された。
pmid-8177140.summary_en: This Institut Gustave Roussy study reviewed 35 children with pure ovarian dysgerminoma treated from 1956 to 1985. The five-year overall survival was 94.1%, and disease-free survival was 81.8%. Stage I patients treated with salpingo-oophorectomy and prophylactic radiotherapy all survived without sequelae. Stage II and III patients receiving radiotherapy developed severe late sequelae. The authors propose initial chemotherapy with cisplatin-containing regimens for widespread disease, reserving radiotherapy for residual tumor.

pmid-8177202.summary_ja: 13歳の女児で卵巣未熟奇形腫の既往があり、多発肺結節が出現した。転移との鑑別のため開胸術が行われ、組織学的に結核が疑われた。抗酸菌染色と培養では確定できなかったが、PCRにより結核菌DNAを検出し、抗結核療法により病変は縮小した。腫瘍性病変との鑑別におけるPCRの有用性が示された。
pmid-8177202.summary_en: A 13-year-old girl with ovarian immature teratoma developed multiple pulmonary nodules that raised concern for metastasis. Thoracotomy and histopathology suggested tuberculosis, but acid-fast staining and culture were nondiagnostic. PCR and hybridization detected Mycobacterium tuberculosis DNA in the resected specimens, and anti-mycobacterial therapy led to regression of the lesions. The authors recommend PCR-based mycobacterial DNA detection to distinguish tuberculosis from neoplastic lung lesions in patients who may have germ cell tumors, where surgery may otherwise be indicated.

pmid-8178927.summary_ja: 正常精巣、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)、原発性および転移性精巣セミノーマにおけるインテグリンサブユニットと細胞外マトリックスの分布を検討した。ITGCNではセルトリ細胞と悪性化した胚細胞でα3、α6、β1の発現が増加していた。浸潤性セミノーマへの進展に伴いα3の発現は消失し、ITGCNの非浸潤性の性質との関連が示唆された。細胞外マトリックスの分布はセミノーマ間で異なり、腫瘍と間質の相互作用が生物学的挙動に関与する可能性が示された。
pmid-8178927.summary_en: This 1994 study examined integrin subunits and extracellular matrix proteins in normal testis, intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN), and primary and metastatic testicular seminomas. ITGCN showed increased alpha3, alpha6, and beta1 integrin expression in Sertoli cells and malignant germ cells. Loss of alpha3 accompanied progression to invasive seminoma, suggesting a role in the noninvasive character of ITGCN. Alpha6 and beta1 were strongly expressed in all tumors, while alpha5 was weak in primary seminomas. The extracellular matrix distribution varied between seminomas, implying that tumor-stroma interactions shape biological behavior.

pmid-8180359.summary_ja: 若年女性に多い卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍の診断と治療をレビューした論文である。併用化学療法の導入により予後は大きく改善し、BEPはPVBと同等の有効性と低い毒性を示した。組織型に応じた化学療法の選択、腫瘍マーカーやFIGO病期分類に基づく治療期間の決定が提案されている。初期病期の患者では妊孕性温存が適切とされている。
pmid-8180359.summary_en: This 1994 review covers the diagnosis and treatment of ovarian germ cell malignancies, which are aggressive tumors typically affecting young women. Modern combination chemotherapy transformed their prognosis from poor to highly curable. VAC was an early regimen, while PVB and BEP became standard, with BEP offering equal efficacy and less toxicity. The authors describe tailoring chemotherapy by histology and determining treatment duration using serial tumor markers or FIGO staging. Fertility preservation is appropriate for early-stage disease and selected advanced cases.

pmid-8184059.summary_ja: 骨盤内のT1高信号病変について、出血性腫瘍と奇形腫の鑑別における位相シフト勾配エコーMR法の有用性を60例で検討した。従来のスピンエコー法では両者の信号強度が類似していたが、FLASH法は病変をより明瞭に描出した。位相シフト勾配エコー法は、T1高信号骨盤内病変の鑑別診断に利用しやすい有用な手法である。
pmid-8184059.summary_en: Sixty patients underwent T1- and T2-weighted spin-echo and phase-shift FLASH gradient-echo MRI to evaluate high-signal-intensity pelvic lesions, mainly hemorrhagic tumors and teratomas. Lesion signal intensities were compared with intraperitoneal fat and surgical findings, and diagnostic performance was analyzed using ROC curves. Hemorrhagic lesions and teratomas showed similar signal intensities on conventional sequences, but FLASH imaging detected lesions more decisively. The authors conclude that phase-shift gradient-echo imaging is a readily available tool for differential diagnosis of T1-hyperintense pelvic lesions.

pmid-8184079.summary_ja: 1966〜1991年に治療された病期Iセミノーマ104例について、精巣摘除術後の横隔膜下照射(30Gy)の長期成績を検討した。重篤な急性毒性や晩期合併症は認められなかった。全体の制御率は97.1%で、再発3例は救援化学療法と放射線療法で救済された。二次悪性腫瘍は6例に発生したが、放射線誘発とは考えられなかった。
pmid-8184079.summary_en: This study followed 104 patients with stage I seminoma treated from 1966 to 1991 and evaluated the late effects of postorchiectomy megavoltage infradiaphragmatic irradiation (30 Gy). No serious acute toxicity or late complications occurred. Three patients recurred and were salvaged with chemotherapy and radiation therapy, and two of them remained disease-free long-term. Six patients developed second malignancies, none considered radiation induced. Overall control rate was 97.1%, indicating that first-course postorchiectomy irradiation controls most stage I seminomas.

pmid-8188082.summary_ja: 正常胎盤および絨毛性疾患におけるインプリンティング遺伝子H19の発現を、in situハイブリダイゼーションで検討した。完全胞状奇胎では間質に発現がみられず、一部の増殖細胞のみが陽性であった。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と妊娠性絨毛癌では顕著な発現が認められた。インプリンティングの弛緩と解釈され、完全奇胎の悪性の可能性との関連が示唆された。
pmid-8188082.summary_en: This study examined expression of the imprinted gene H19 by in situ hybridization in normal placenta and trophoblastic disease. H19 was abundantly expressed in normal trophoblast and partial mole, but was absent from the stroma of complete hydatidiform mole, except for some proliferating mononuclear cells. Prominent expression was found in placental site trophoblastic tumor and gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors interpret this emergence of expression as relaxation of imprinting, which may be associated with the malignant potential of complete mole.

pmid-8188522.summary_ja: マクロファージコロニー刺激因子(M-CSF)の、絨毛細胞、胞状奇胎細胞、絨毛癌細胞株に対する作用を検討した。M-CSFは初期妊娠絨毛細胞と奇胎細胞の増殖およびhCG・hPL分泌を促進したが、絨毛癌細胞株には影響がなかった。免疫染色でもM-CSFは絨毛細胞と奇胎細胞に存在し、絨毛癌細胞では陰性であった。正常および奇胎の絨毛細胞はM-CSF依存性である一方、絨毛癌は非依存性と考えられた。
pmid-8188522.summary_en: The authors examined whether macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) regulates growth and hormone secretion of human chorionic cells, hydatidiform mole cells, and choriocarcinoma cell lines. M-CSF promoted growth and hCG and hPL secretion in early gestation chorionic cells and mole cells, but had no effect on choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo, Jar, Jeg-3, and NUC-1. Immunohistochemistry detected M-CSF in chorionic and mole cells but not in choriocarcinoma cells. Growth and differentiation of normal and molar trophoblast appear M-CSF dependent, whereas those of choriocarcinoma are not.

pmid-8188914.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫3例のCTおよびMR所見を病理所見と対比して後方視的に検討した。腫瘍は、T2強調像で低〜等信号を示し造影で著明に増強される隔壁によって小葉状に分けられていた。隔壁は病理学的に線維血管束に相当した。充実性卵巣腫瘤でこの所見を認めた場合、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫を疑うべきである。
pmid-8188914.summary_en: Three patients with ovarian dysgerminoma were retrospectively reviewed, comparing CT and MR findings with pathology. Tumors were divided into lobules by septa that were hypointense or isointense on T2-weighted imaging and showed marked enhancement on contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MR and contrast-enhanced CT. Histologically, these septa corresponded to fibrovascular bundles. The authors conclude that such septal enhancement within a solid ovarian mass should raise the possibility of dysgerminoma.

pmid-8189662.summary_ja: 東日本精巣腫瘍研究グループによる進行精巣腫瘍の検討。初回化学療法で完全奏効に至らなかった症例では、残存腫瘍の切除などにより多くが無病生存を得た。残存腫瘍の組織は壊死・線維化が主で、奇形腫成分を認める例もあった。完全奏効後の再発例も分析され、病期IIIB・IIICで再発が多く、部分奏効後に残存腫瘍切除を受けた例で再発が多かった。
pmid-8189662.summary_en: This report from the East Japan Testicular Tumor Study Group examines advanced testicular tumor patients who did not achieve complete response to primary chemotherapy. Residual-tumor resection or radiation therapy in seminoma stage II patients led to no evidence of disease in several cases, and most non-seminoma stage II and about half of stage III patients with resectable residuals also achieved it. Residual masses were mainly necrosis or fibrosis, with teratoma in six cases. Eight patients who relapsed after complete response were also analyzed. Relapse was more frequent in stage IIIB and IIIC disease and after partial response.

pmid-8193901.summary_ja: セミノーマの治療後に腹腔内転移を生じた患者の症例報告である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍としては稀な転移部位であり、転移病変で腫瘍形態が変化していたことが記載されている。単一症例のため頻度や機序についての結論は限られるが、治療後の非典型的な転移形式を理解する上で参考になる。
pmid-8193901.summary_en: A patient treated for seminoma developed intraperitoneal metastases, an unusual site of spread for testicular germ cell tumour. The case report notes that tumour morphology changed in the metastatic lesions. Because this is a single case, conclusions about frequency or mechanism are limited. The report adds to documentation of atypical metastatic patterns in testicular GCT after treatment, which can inform surveillance and clinical awareness.

pmid-8194048.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍17例について細胞遺伝学とDNAフィンガープリント解析を行った。全例が正常二倍体核型であった。宿主と腫瘍のヘテロ多型の比較から、性腺外および精巣の胚細胞腫瘍は減数分裂の誤りや内部倍加によらず、体細胞または胚細胞からの有糸分裂によって生じると結論している。
pmid-8194048.summary_en: Cytogenetic and DNA fingerprint analyses were performed on 13 new pediatric germ cell tumors, plus four previously reported cases, arising in the ovary, sacrococcygeal region, testis, mediastinum and craniofacial region. All new cases had a normal diploid karyotype. Comparing host and tumor centromeric heteromorphisms, the authors conclude that extragonadal and testicular GCTs do not arise through meiotic errors or endoreduplication. They propose that these tumors arise mitotically from somatic or germ cells, unlike ovarian GCTs, which have several meiotic mechanisms.

pmid-8194197.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんにシスプラチン併用化学療法を行った417例のうち、6例が完全寛解中に単発の脳再発を生じた。多くは手術と放射線療法を受け、3例は19〜86か月後も再発なく生存している。脳が化学療法後の聖域部位となり得ることを示し、この稀な再発は比較的予後が良好であると述べている。
pmid-8194197.summary_en: Among 417 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer, six developed isolated cerebral relapse while in complete remission, a median of four months after chemotherapy ended. Five of the six had advanced pulmonary dissemination, and no viable tumour was found at post-chemotherapy surgery. Most patients underwent surgery and radiotherapy, and three were alive and relapse-free 19 to 86 months later. The authors describe the brain as a sanctuary site and note a relatively favourable prognosis for this rare complication.

pmid-8194563.summary_ja: 新生児に頭蓋、頸部、上縦隔にわたる大きな腫瘍が見られ、頸部リンパ管腫様に見えた。画像・病理検査で囊胞成分を伴う成熟奇形腫と診断された。囊胞形成の機序として、リンパ嚢の閉塞、奇形腫の一部としての異常なリンパ管増殖、脈絡叢組織由来の3説を挙げ、本例では脈絡叢由来が最も可能性が高いとしている。
pmid-8194563.summary_en: A neonate presented with a large tumour involving the cranial, cervical and upper mediastinal regions, initially resembling a hygroma colli. Radiological and pathological examination revealed a mature teratoma with prominent cystic components. The authors discuss three explanations for the cystic formation: obstruction of primary lymphatic sacs by the teratoma, abnormal lymphatic proliferation as part of the teratoma, or origin of the cystic part from choroid plexus tissue containing CSF. They consider the last explanation most probable in this patient.

pmid-8194868.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍67例の保存原発腫瘍を用い、潜在性後腹膜転移を予測した後方視的研究。胎児性癌の割合と異数性細胞のS期分画が独立した予測因子で、併用モデルは91.0%を正しく分類した。組織学的基準のみでは56.7%だった。
pmid-8194868.summary_en: This study examined whether combining DNA flow cytometry with quantitative histopathology improves prediction of occult retroperitoneal metastasis in clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Archival primary tumors from 67 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection were reanalyzed. The percentage of embryonal carcinoma and the S-phase fraction of aneuploid cells were independent predictors. The combined model correctly classified 91.0% of cases, with 95.3% sensitivity and 83.3% specificity, compared with only 56.7% using histopathology alone.

pmid-8199080.summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎を先行妊娠とする持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍6例を16年間にわたり後方視的に検討。2例で肺転移を生じ、5例は化学療法で寛解した。部分胞状奇胎も悪性化しうるため、β-hCGのフォローアップと早期の胸部X線検査が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-8199080.summary_en: This 16-year retrospective review examined persistent gestational trophoblastic tumor after partial hydatidiform mole in 207 women, of whom six had partial mole as the antecedent pregnancy. Two developed pulmonary metastases, and none developed choriocarcinoma. Five of six achieved remission with chemotherapy, and one with hysterectomy. DNA ploidy was triploid in three and diploid in two. The authors conclude that partial mole can be malignant, that follow-up of serum beta-hCG and early chest X-ray are needed.

pmid-8199834.summary_ja: 精巣類表皮嚢胞10例と精巣胚細胞腫瘍481例を22年間で後方視的に解析した研究。周囲に精巣上皮内腫瘍は認められず、単純型は良性で精巣温存手術が妥当と結論づけた。奇形腫や胚細胞腫瘍を伴う複合型とは区別される。
pmid-8199834.summary_en: This review analyzed 10 patients with simple epidermoid cysts of the testis and 481 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated over 22 years. Immunostaining for placental alkaline phosphatase showed no testicular intraepithelial neoplasia around the cysts. The authors propose separating complex epidermoid cysts, which occur with teratoma or germ cell tumor, from simple cysts, which are benign and not teratomas. Testis-sparing surgery is justified for simple cysts. Six of the ten patients were managed with conservative surgery and none relapsed.

pmid-8200404.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた胚細胞悪性腫瘍417例を中央値7年追跡した研究。6例が二次性の精巣腫瘍を発症した。化学療法でリスクは下がるが消失はしないため、後腹膜原発例では慎重な長期フォローアップが必要とされた。
pmid-8200404.summary_en: This study followed 417 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for germ cell malignancy for a median of seven years. Six developed a second testicular tumor. In three cases, the initial tumor was testicular, while in the others it was retroperitoneal. The authors conclude that cisplatin may reduce but does not eliminate the risk of a contralateral testicular tumor. Patients with primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumors therefore need close, careful long-term follow-up.

pmid-8200408.summary_ja: ヌードマウスに移植したヒト精巣腫瘍の胎児性癌と奇形癌に対し、組換えヒトTNFの効果を検討した前臨床研究。腫瘍内投与で両者とも完全退縮が得られ、静脈内投与より有効かつ安全であった。
pmid-8200408.summary_en: This preclinical study tested recombinant human tumor necrosis factor against two human testicular tumor xenografts in nude mice, an embryonal carcinoma line and a teratocarcinoma line. Intratumoral injection produced clear antitumor effects and complete regression in both models, with the embryonal carcinoma line more responsive. Intravenous administration at the same dose had little effect. Histological findings matched tumor volume reduction. The authors conclude that intratumoral delivery is more effective and safer than intravenous delivery for testicular tumors.

pmid-8200647.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍52例を対象に、モノクローナル抗体Ber-H2によるCD30抗原発現を検討した。セミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍成分では陰性、胎児性癌成分の大半では陽性であった。奇形腫成分や精細管内胚細胞腫瘍は陰性で、胎児性癌をセミノーマ・卵黄嚢腫瘍と鑑別する指標となり、セミノーマと精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の関連を示唆する。
pmid-8200647.summary_en: This study examined CD30 antigen expression, detected by the monoclonal antibody Ber-H2, in 52 testicular tumors including pure seminoma, pure embryonal carcinoma, and mixed germ cell tumors. Ber-H2 was absent in seminomas and yolk sac tumor components, present in most embryonal carcinoma components, and absent in teratomatous elements and intratubular germ cell neoplasia. The authors conclude that Ber-H2 helps distinguish embryonal carcinoma from seminoma and yolk sac tumor, and that the negative staining in intratubular germ cell neoplasia supports its close relationship with seminoma.

pmid-8202889.summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘤を呈した若年男性を報告する。縦隔奇形腫が発見された後にクラインフェルター症候群と診断された。縦隔腫瘤を最初に評価することの多い胸部専門医は、この関連を認識しておく必要があると著者らは強調する。本症例は、縦隔奇形腫と性染色体異常の併存を示す症例報告である。
pmid-8202889.summary_en: A young man presented with an anterior mediastinal mass, and a mediastinal teratoma was identified as the cause. Klinefelter syndrome was diagnosed only after this discovery. The authors highlight that this association matters for chest physicians, who are often the first to evaluate patients with mediastinal masses, so the condition should be considered when such a tumor is found.

pmid-8203441.summary_ja: 新生児から20歳までの46,XX核型の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者78例について、3世代にわたる家系を調査した。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）および性腺芽腫は除外されている。第1度・第2度近親者456名に卵巣の悪性腫瘍は認められず、同種腫瘍の発症リスクは上昇していなかった。遺伝性腫瘍で見られる若年発症の傾向とは異なる結果であった。
pmid-8203441.summary_en: This study reviewed three-generation pedigrees of 78 presumptive 46,XX patients aged newborn to 20 years with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, excluding dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma. Among 456 surveyed first- and second-degree relatives, none had a malignant ovarian neoplasm. The authors conclude that relatives of these patients do not have an increased risk of similar tumors, which was unexpected given the usual pattern of hereditary tumors with early onset.

pmid-8204448.summary_ja: 父親のセミノーマと娘のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例を報告する。両腫瘍は組織学的に類似していた。同一家系で胚細胞腫瘍が発生したことは、これらの腫瘍に共通の遺伝的基盤がある可能性を支持する。男女の近親に胚細胞腫瘍が認められた事例として、家族内集積に関する限られた知見を補うものである。
pmid-8204448.summary_en: The authors report seminoma in a father and dysgerminoma in his daughter, with similar histological appearances in both tumors. The occurrence of germ cell tumors of these types in one family supports the idea that they may share a common genetic basis. The brief report adds to limited evidence on familial occurrence of germ cell tumors in male and female relatives.

pmid-8206411.summary_ja: 当初は転移性妊娠性腫瘍と診断された若年女性が、標準的な化学療法に反応しなかった。子宮摘出および両側卵管卵巣摘出術でβ-hCG産生源は同定されず、開胸肺葉切除により原発性肺絨毛癌と判明した。その後化学療法は行わず、3年以上無病で経過している。肺絨毛癌で成功裏に治療された初の報告例とされる。
pmid-8206411.summary_en: A young woman was initially diagnosed with a metastatic gestational neoplasm but did not respond to standard chemotherapy. Hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy failed to identify a source of beta-hCG production, and thoracotomy with lobectomy revealed primary lung choriocarcinoma. She received no further chemotherapy and remained disease free for more than three years. The authors describe this as the first recorded case of lung choriocarcinoma successfully treated with more than one year disease-free survival.

pmid-8209001.summary_ja: 1961年から1985年に精巣セミノーマに対して放射線療法を受けた859例を対象に、死亡率と二次がんの発生を検討したコホート研究である。二次がん死亡は全体として有意な増加を示さなかったが、白血病は相対危険度6.2と顕著に増加した。放射線療法による死亡リスク増加の明確な根拠は示されず、白血病の増加は治療関連の可能性があるとされた。
pmid-8209001.summary_en: This registry-based cohort study followed 859 patients treated with radiotherapy for testicular seminoma between 1961 and 1985 to assess mortality and second cancers. Fifty-one patients died of testicular cancer, and second cancer deaths were not significantly elevated overall. Leukaemia was notably increased, with a relative risk of 6.2. Non-cancer mortality was not elevated, though mortality risk appeared to rise over time. The authors conclude there is no definite evidence of increased mortality from radiotherapy, although the leukaemia excess may be treatment-related.
